title: Mid-Training Language Models on Raw Video
summary: Multimodal large language models learn mostly from paired image-text data or annotated video, and raw web video is rarely used to further train an existing language model. We study whether raw video, with no captions and no text loss, can serve as mid-training data for a pretrained language model. Frames are encoded into continuous visual tokens, and the language model learns to predict the next visual token. We mid-train Qwen3-1.7B on raw clips from YT-Temporal-1B and then apply the same image-text instruction tuning to it and to the model without mid-training, so that the two differ only in mid-training. The mid-trained model scores 2.9 points higher on average across four video benchmarks and 5.1 points higher across ten image benchmarks, spanning perception, document, and chart tasks. Text performance is preserved even though mid-training includes no text, with an average of 48.9 across 14 text benchmarks compared with 48.0 for the model without mid-training. Analyses across training show that the image and video gains emerge within 30% of training and plateau thereafter, varying by less than 0.5 points. Predicting captions fails to outperform next-visual-token prediction, demonstrating that video mid-training can remain purely self-supervised without the computational overhead or labeling noise of automated captioning.

AI.tldr: 本文将原始无字幕网络视频用作预训练语言模型的中期训练数据，通过连续视觉token的下一token预测进行纯自监督训练，证明该方式能提升多模态性能且不损害文本能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型主要依赖图像-文本配对数据或标注视频进行训练，原始网络视频很少被用于进一步训练已有语言模型；作者欲探究无字幕、无文本损失的原始视频能否作为预训练语言模型的中期训练数据。
AI.method: 将视频帧编码为连续视觉token，语言模型学习预测下一个视觉token；以YT-Temporal-1B的原始片段对Qwen3-1.7B进行中期训练，随后对中期训练模型与未中期训练模型施加相同的图像-文本指令微调，以控制变量。
AI.result: 中期训练模型在四个视频基准上平均高2.9分，在十个图像基准（涵盖感知、文档和图表任务）上平均高5.1分；文本性能得以保持，14个文本基准平均48.9分对比未中期训练的48.0分。训练分析显示图像与视频增益在30%训练量内出现并随后趋于平稳，波动小于0.5分；预测字幕的效果未超过下一视觉token预测。
AI.conclusion: 视频中期训练可保持完全自监督，无需自动字幕带来的计算开销或标注噪声，既能提升图像与视频任务表现，又能保留文本能力。

title: Expression-Diverse References for Identity-Preserving Video Generation
summary: Identity-preserving video generation aims to maintain a subject's identity while synthesizing realistic videos. Yet a single reference portrait captures the subject's appearance under only one facial configuration. As expressions change, facial appearance can vary in highly identity-specific ways, leaving the subject's appearance under unseen expressions underdetermined by the reference alone. This expression-dependent variation also complicates evaluation: similarity to a neutral reference may decrease under strong expressions even for real images of the same person. We investigate this limitation from both generation and evaluation perspectives. First, we quantify how face-recognition similarity varies with expression intensity using controlled photographs and MEAD videos. We then construct a compact yet expressive reference gallery that captures diverse expression-dependent facial configurations. Matching against this gallery provides a more robust measure of identity similarity under expressive motion. To further expose performance degradation with expression intensity, we report identity similarity separately for mild, intense, and extreme expressions. For generation, we extend Stand-In to condition on our expression-diverse reference sets and develop a data-curation pipeline that extracts consistent yet diverse face crops from training videos. In practical settings where only a single portrait is available, we construct the reference set by synthesizing additional expressions with a pretrained facial reenactment model. On our controlled benchmark, both real and synthesized reference sets outperform the evaluated baselines in identity similarity across all three expression-intensity regimes, with the largest improvements for extreme expressions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究身份保持视频生成中由表情变化引起的身份外观不确定性，并从生成与评估两方面改进：构建表情多样化的参考图库以提升评估鲁棒性，并扩展Stand-In使其以多样化参考集为条件。
AI.motivation: 单张参考肖像只捕捉了主体在一种面部构型下的外观，而表情变化会以高度身份特异的方式改变面部外观，导致参考图无法确定未见表情下的身份外观。该变化还使评估复杂化：同一真实人物在强烈表情下与中性参考的相似度也可能下降。
AI.method: 1) 使用受控照片与MEAD视频量化人脸识别相似度随表情强度的变化；2) 构建紧凑且具表现力的参考图库以覆盖多样的表情相关面部构型，并据此评估身份相似度；3) 按轻、强、极端三档表情强度分别报告身份相似度；4) 扩展Stand-In以表情多样化参考集为条件，并设计数据筛选流程从训练视频中提取一致且多样的面部裁剪；5) 在仅有单张肖像时，用预训练面部重演模型合成额外表情构成参考集。
AI.result: 在受控基准上，真实与合成参考集在轻、强、极端三种表情强度下的身份相似度均优于所评估的基线，其中极端表情提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 单参考设定的身份保持受限于表情依赖性外观变化；采用表情多样化的参考图库既能提供更鲁棒的身份相似度度量，也能显著提升生成在强烈表情下的身份保持性能。

title: FedAlphaEdit: Null-Space-Aligned Merging for Collaborative Knowledge Editing
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Includes appendices (proofs, implementation reconciliation, experimental details). Code: https://github.com/soutasuga/FedAlphaEdit
summary: Multiple institutions may each hold their own private knowledge edits and wish to integrate them into a single large language model without sharing raw edit requests. Null-space-constrained editing methods such as AlphaEdit mathematically guarantee that each update leaves unrelated knowledge intact, while collaborative frameworks such as CollabEdit aggregate edits from multiple clients without data sharing. Combining the two appears trivial. However, we show that this naive combination fails structurally, and we identify its cause. Guided by this analysis, we propose FedAlphaEdit. To our knowledge, this is the first collaborative knowledge editing framework that aligns both local editing and the server-side merging rule under a single null-space principle for preserving existing knowledge. FedAlphaEdit builds on null-space-aligned merging, in which clients share projected statistics and the server provably recovers the result of editing everything in one place under a one-shot idealization. Empirically, the proposed method repairs the collapse and brings edit success and preservation simultaneously close to the level of centralized editing across two architecture families. FedAlphaEdit thus lets institutions that cannot share raw edit data, such as hospitals and financial firms, jointly maintain a shared model that closely approximates editing all facts in one place.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedAlphaEdit，首个在单一零空间原理下同时对齐本地编辑与服务端合并规则的协作式知识编辑框架，解决AlphaEdit与CollabEdit简单结合导致的结构性失效问题。
AI.motivation: 多个机构各自持有私有知识编辑，希望在不共享原始编辑请求的前提下将其整合进同一大模型。AlphaEdit等零空间约束方法可数学保证不破坏无关知识，CollabEdit等协作框架可实现无数据共享的多客户端聚合，但两者直接结合会结构性失效，作者旨在找出原因并加以解决。
AI.method: 提出FedAlphaEdit，基于零空间对齐合并（null-space-aligned merging）：客户端共享投影后的统计量，服务端在单次理想化条件下可证明地恢复出"集中式一次性编辑全部知识"的结果，从而使本地编辑与服务端合并规则统一于同一零空间原理下。
AI.result: 在两种架构家族上，FedAlphaEdit修复了直接结合的崩溃问题，使编辑成功率与知识保持能力同时接近集中式编辑水平。
AI.conclusion: FedAlphaEdit使无法共享原始编辑数据的机构（如医院、金融机构）能够共同维护一个近似于集中式编辑全部事实的共享模型。

title: Transforming Image Editors into Video Editors
summary: Recent image editing systems have achieved impressive semantic understanding, visual fidelity, and instruction-following ability, while video editing remains substantially more difficult and costly. In this paper, we present a simple alternative to end-to-end video editing: instead of training a monolithic video editor, we transform a strong image editor into a video editor through anchor-based generation. Our key insight is that video editing can be decomposed into two subproblems: editing a sparse set of keyframes and propagating those edits across time. Based on this observation, we propose Anchor-based Video Editing (AVE), a two-stage framework in which a powerful image editor first performs composed editing on selected keyframes, and a motion-guided image-to-video diffusion model then generates the final video by treating the edited keyframes as fixed anchors. This design directly inherits the strengths of modern image editors while avoiding expensive end-to-end video editing training. Experiments on IVEBench and VIE-Bench show that AVE achieves strong performance in instruction following, temporal consistency, and content fidelity. Further ablations reveal that final video editing quality is strongly correlated with the quality of the image editor, suggesting that future progress in video editing may come from stronger image editing foundations and lightweight transfer to video. Code is available at https://github.com/wangf3014/AVE.

AI.tldr: 提出Anchor-based Video Editing（AVE），用“关键帧编辑+运动引导生成”两阶段框架把强图像编辑器转化为视频编辑器，避免昂贵的端到端视频编辑训练。
AI.motivation: 图像编辑在语义理解、视觉保真和指令跟随上已很成熟，但视频编辑仍显著更难且成本更高，端到端训练一个单体视频编辑器代价大。作者希望找到一种简单替代方案，复用强大图像编辑器的能力，而不必从头训练视频编辑模型。
AI.method: 核心洞察是把视频编辑分解为两个子问题：编辑稀疏关键帧、将编辑传播到时间维度。AVE采用两阶段框架：第一阶段用强图像编辑器在选定关键帧上做组合编辑；第二阶段用运动引导的图像到视频扩散模型，将编辑后的关键帧作为固定锚点生成最终视频。
AI.result: 在IVEBench和VIE-Bench上，AVE在指令跟随、时间一致性和内容保真度方面均取得强性能。消融实验发现最终视频编辑质量与图像编辑器质量强相关。
AI.conclusion: 视频编辑的进展可能主要来自更强的图像编辑基础，再通过轻量方式迁移到视频；AVE验证了锚点式两阶段设计的有效性。代码已开源。

title: Rendering-Free Lookahead for Question-Guided Active Vision
summary: Active robot vision requires controlling the camera to reveal task-relevant information that is hidden from the current viewpoint. For example, determining what is inside a box may require raising the camera and looking down into it. For viewpoint-dependent question answering, the challenge is to select camera motions that expose the visual evidence needed to answer the question. Although vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret observed images, selecting such motions requires anticipating the usefulness of unseen views. We quantify this usefulness as answerability, a VLM's estimate that a view suffices to answer the question, and present Rendering-Free Lookahead (RFL), a viewpoint-selection policy that ranks candidate camera motions by predicted future answerability. RFL transfers visual lookahead from deployment to offline training. At training, a privileged teacher renders candidate future views in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes and uses a frozen VLM to compute one- and two-step answerability targets. Through two-stage distillation, a student learns to predict these action values from the question, recent visual observations, and a candidate camera motion. At deployment, RFL uses these predicted values to select camera motions without rendering future views. On 377 E3VS-Bench test episodes in unseen environments, RFL improves the mean judge score by 43\% over a direct-action baseline using the same VLM. These results support learning camera-control policies from privileged visual lookahead for viewpoint-dependent question answering.

AI.tldr: 提出Rendering-Free Lookahead (RFL)策略，通过预测未来视角的"可回答性"来主动选择相机运动，无需在部署时渲染未来视角，在E3VS-Bench上显著优于直接动作基线。
AI.motivation: 主动机器人视觉需要控制相机以揭示当前视角下隐藏的任务相关信息（如探入盒子内部需抬高相机俯视）。对于依赖视角的问答任务，核心挑战是选择能暴露回答问题所需视觉证据的相机运动。尽管视觉语言模型（VLM）能解读已观测图像，但选择此类运动需要预判未观测视角的价值，这是一项难题。
AI.method: 将视角价值量化为"可回答性"（answerability），即VLM对某视角是否足以回答问题的估计。提出Rendering-Free Lookahead (RFL)策略，按预测的未来可回答性对候选相机运动排序。训练时将视觉前瞻从部署迁移到离线：特权教师模型在3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景中渲染候选未来视角，用冻结VLM计算一步和两步可回答性目标；通过两阶段蒸馏，学生模型从问题、近期视觉观测和候选相机运动学习预测动作价值。部署时RFL利用这些预测值选择相机运动，无需渲染未来视角。
AI.result: 在未见环境的377个E3VS-Bench测试回合上，RFL在使用相同VLM的情况下，相比直接动作基线，平均评判分数提升43%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，从特权视觉前瞻中学习相机控制策略，可有效解决依赖视角的问答问题。

title: SatFix: Absolute Visual Localization of UAVs in Satellite Maps from a Single Oblique Image
summary: We study absolute metric UAV localization within a provided geo-referenced satellite region, recovering continuous map position and viewing heading from a single oblique image or a short multi-view clip. Existing cross-view geo-localization methods retrieve the most similar satellite tile from a gallery and report Recall@K, but retrieval depends on gallery sampling, provides no heading estimate, and returns a tile index rather than a continuous coordinate. We propose SatFix, a feed-forward UAV--satellite localization framework built on VGGT-$Ω$. Satellite-grid features act as queries that aggregate UAV visual evidence, and two lightweight heads regress a 3-DoF pose in the satellite-map frame: continuous 2D position and heading. SatFix requires no explicit 3D map, rendered bird's-eye image, auxiliary sensor, or test-time pose alignment. A single model supports both single- and multi-view inputs, with trajectory constraints used during multi-view training. For metric evaluation, we introduce University-Metric, where satellite imagery is re-collected over a region up to 10.7$\times$ longer on a side (about 114$\times$ the ground area) than the original University-1652 tiles, with continuous position and heading labels for the original UAV tours. With one UAV view, SatFix localizes 52.08% of test frames within 50 m and 17.34% within 10 m, with median position and heading errors of 45.66 m and $20.81^\circ$, respectively. Inference takes under 0.1 s per single-view query on an NVIDIA RTX 4090. With nine UAV views, the median position error falls to 21.96 m and the median heading error to $8.73^\circ$. Compared with a fine-tuned VGGT-$Ω$ baseline, SatFix reduces median position error by 34.0% and nine-view median heading error from $25.43^\circ$ to $8.73^\circ$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SatFix，一种前馈式无人机-卫星绝对定位框架，可从未知朝向的单张斜视图像或多视图片段回归卫星地图坐标系下的连续2D位置与航向，并引入University-Metric评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法依赖图库检索返回最相似卫星瓦片并报告Recall@K，存在依赖图库采样、无法估计航向、仅返回瓦片索引而非连续坐标等缺陷，难以满足无人机绝对度量定位需求。
AI.method: 基于VGGT-Ω构建前馈框架SatFix：以卫星网格特征作为查询聚合无人机视觉证据，通过两个轻量级回归头输出卫星地图坐标系下的3-DoF位姿（连续2D位置与航向）；无需显式3D地图、渲染鸟瞰图、辅助传感器或测试时位姿对齐；单一模型支持单视图与多视图输入，多视图训练时引入轨迹约束。
AI.result: 在University-Metric（卫星影像边长较University-1652扩大至10.7倍、面积约114倍，含连续位置与航向标签）上：单视图下52.08%测试帧定位误差小于50 m、17.34%小于10 m，位置与航向中位误差分别为45.66 m与20.81°，单视图推理在RTX 4090上低于0.1 s；九视图下位置中位误差降至21.96 m、航向中位误差降至8.73°。相比微调VGGT-Ω基线，位置中位误差降低34.0%，九视图航向中位误差从25.43°降至8.73°。
AI.conclusion: SatFix以单模型前馈方式实现连续、含航向的绝对度量无人机定位，无需检索或额外传感器，在多视图下精度显著提升，并优于微调基线。

title: Learning What to Trust in Multimodal Learning under Noisy Supervision
summary: Multimodal classification processes and relates information from multiple modalities to achieve more accurate predictions. However, existing methods typically rely on high-quality ground-truth labels, which are difficult to obtain in real-world scenarios. While sample-selection methods for learning with noisy labels aim to identify correctly labeled examples from noisy data, traditional methods primarily focus on unimodal settings and fail to exploit multimodal information fully. This motivates us to build a more reliable noise detector in multimodal learning. To this end, we theoretically analyze the relationship between representation structure and noise detection capability. Based on this analysis, we propose REFINE, which is a multimodal label-noise detection framework that jointly uses fused and unimodal representations for label-noise detection. Specifically, REFINE constructs discriminative eigenvectors through discriminative analysis of the target and background classes and selects trusted representation spaces with better noise detection capability for each class. Within each trusted space, REFINE measures the alignment between each instance representation and the discriminative eigenvectors. It then combines the subsets selected from these spaces. The combined set provides cleaner supervision for updating the multimodal classifier, thereby reducing the influence of mislabeled examples during training and improving model generalization. Extensive experiments across diverse tasks demonstrate REFINE's superiority compared to baseline methods. The source code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: REFINE：一种多模态标签噪声检测框架，联合融合与单模态表示进行噪声检测，通过判别特征向量与可信表示空间提升多模态分类鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现实场景中难以获取高质量真值标签，而现有多模态分类方法依赖高质量标签；传统噪声标签下的样本选择方法主要针对单模态，未能充分利用多模态信息。因此需要构建更可靠的多模态噪声检测器。
AI.method: 理论上分析表示结构与噪声检测能力之间的关系；基于该分析提出REFINE：通过目标类与背景类的判别分析构造判别特征向量，为每个类别选择噪声检测能力更优的可信表示空间；在每个可信空间内度量实例表示与判别特征向量的对齐程度，并组合各空间选出的子集，用更干净的监督信号更新多模态分类器。
AI.result: 在多种任务上的大量实验表明，REFINE相较基线方法具有优越性；源代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: REFINE通过联合融合与单模态表示进行噪声检测，减少误标样本影响，提升多模态分类器的泛化能力。

title: Refine Connections, Close the Gap: A Reliable Enhancement Framework for Driving Scene Topology
summary: In autonomous driving, understanding scene topology - the connectivity between lanes and traffic elements - is critical for safe path planning and motion control. While current methods excel at detecting individual map elements, their connectivity reasoning often falls short of its theoretical potential, leaving a significant performance gap relative to the theoretical upper-bound achievable given the underlying detections. Furthermore, the decision-ready topology graphs passed to downstream tasks often remain unreliable. Current approaches typically derive connectivity by thresholding continuous topology scores; however, these scores often fail to reflect the true logical likelihood of connectivity, resulting in false positives or missing connections. Existing benchmarks further overlook this issue by primarily evaluating continuous metrics, rather than assessing the discrete connectivity required for decision-making. To bridge these gaps, we propose TopoEnhance, a novel topology enhancement framework designed to unlock the latent potential of existing methods and improve the reliability of decision-ready topology. We formulate topology enhancement as a denoising-based reconstruction process, where the model learns to recover structural consistency from stochastically corrupted ground-truth graphs. This formulation enables the model to resolve logical inconsistencies and rectify unreliable connections, producing robust discrete topology graphs that closely approach theoretical maximum performance. Extensive experiments across different baselines show that TopoEnhance consistently improves both continuous topology metrics (TOP score), and discrete connectivity measured by our adapted Topology Jaccard Similarity (TJS) metric. As a flexible, source-agnostic framework, TopoEnhance delivers substantial gains across diverse state-of-the-art baselines without requiring retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TopoEnhance，一个将拓扑增强建模为去噪式重构的通用框架，从随机损坏的真值图中恢复结构一致性，从而提升自动驾驶场景拓扑图的连续指标与离散连通可靠性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需理解车道与交通要素间的连通性以支撑安全路径规划，但现有方法虽能检测单个地图要素，连通性推理远未达到理论潜力；同时，基于连续拓扑分数阈值化得到的决策用拓扑图常不可靠，易产生假阳性或漏连，且现有基准主要评估连续指标，忽视了决策所需的离散连通性。
AI.method: 将拓扑增强形式化为基于去噪的重构过程：模型学习从随机损坏的真值图中恢复结构一致性，从而解决逻辑不一致并修正不可靠连接，生成鲁棒的离散拓扑图。该框架与来源无关、灵活通用，可直接作用于现有基线而无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在多种基线上实验表明，TopoEnhance在连续拓扑指标（TOP score）以及新提出的适配版拓扑Jaccard相似度（TJS）所衡量的离散连通性上均获得一致提升，并在多种先进基线上取得显著增益。
AI.conclusion: TopoEnhance作为源无关的通用增强框架，无需重训即可提升现有方法的拓扑推理能力与决策级拓扑可靠性，缩小了与理论性能上限的差距。

title: AffordDrive3D: Affordance-Aware World-Action Modeling with Spatial Understanding
summary: World-action models have recently improved autonomous driving by jointly learning future scene prediction and trajectory generation. Most existing approaches model the future primarily through RGB appearance, and recent works have begun to incorporate geometric prediction to improve spatial understanding. However, dense geometry describes the spatial layout of the entire scene without indicating which parts are most relevant to the ego vehicle's action. For driving, the model must also identify and anticipate where it can safely move and which regions may pose collision risks. Jointly modeling action-relevant regions and future geometry can provide the policy with both driving-relevant cues and their corresponding spatial structure. We therefore propose AffordDrive3D, an affordance- and geometry-aware world-action model that jointly learns future action-relevant regions and spatial structure. In order to capture the scene semantics and driving context needed for driving affordance prediction, we build AffordDrive3D on a VLM backbone to forecast drivable areas and collision-critical regions that directly affect ego motion, while predicting future geometry from RGB world-model latents. On NAVSIM, AffordDrive3D achieves state-of-the-art performance with 91.3 PDMS and 89.9 EPDMS, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly modeling future affordances and geometry for trajectory planning. Project Page: https://afforddrive3d.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AffordDrive3D——一种可承受性与几何感知的世界-动作模型，通过联合学习未来行动相关区域（可行驶区域、碰撞关键区域）与空间几何结构来改进自动驾驶轨迹规划，在 NAVSIM 上达到 91.3 PDMS 与 89.9 EPDMS 的 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型多以 RGB 外观建模未来，虽引入几何预测以增强空间理解，但稠密几何仅刻画全场景空间布局，无法指示哪些区域与自车行动最相关。驾驶场景还需识别并预判可安全行驶的区域与潜在碰撞风险区域。因此需要联合建模"行动相关区域"与"未来几何"，为策略同时提供驾驶相关线索及其空间结构。
AI.method: 1) 提出 AffordDrive3D，一种可承受性（affordance）与几何感知的世界-动作模型，联合学习未来行动相关区域与空间结构。2) 基于 VLM 主干构建，以捕获驾驶可承受性预测所需的场景语义与驾驶上下文，预测可行驶区域与碰撞关键区域。3) 从 RGB 世界模型潜变量中预测未来几何。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM 基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能：91.3 PDMS 与 89.9 EPDMS。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了联合建模未来可承受性与几何对轨迹规划的有效性。

title: Measuring and Mitigating Solution Mode Collapse in RLVR
summary: A language model (LM) can usually answer the same question in more than one way, but reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is indifferent to which correct answer a model produces. A solution will earn the same reward whether it is the thousandth copy of a familiar answer or one the model has never produced before. Yet, there is potential value in having the model retain multiple correct solutions as it is trained. For instance, multiple modes may give users a choice and provide problem-solving strategies that improve overall model performance. Here, we introduce ModeBench, a benchmark of multi-solution tasks in which the verifier returns both correctness and mode discovered. We then use ModeBench to measure how solution diversity changes under RLVR post-training. We find that RLVR post-training concentrates probability onto fewer correct modes even as accuracy holds or improves, and moreover, that frontier models are already highly concentrated. We then introduce our solution, Re:Max, which stores one verified example per discovered mode in a replay buffer and trains on those stored modes uniformly. A solution found once is, therefore, practiced as often as one found repeatedly. Across three model scales, two RL objectives, and harder task constructions, replay improves both how often a policy succeeds and how many different ways it can succeed.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ModeBench 基准来度量 RLVR 后训练中多解（mode）多样性的变化，发现 RLVR 会把概率集中到更少的正确模式上；进而提出 Re:Max，用回放缓冲区按模式均匀采样训练，在多个模型规模和 RL 目标上同时提升成功率与解法多样性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型对同一问题常有多种正确解法，但 RLVR 的可验证奖励对"用哪种正确解法"无差别，第 1000 次重复的答案与首次出现的新解法获得相同奖励。然而保留多种正确解本身有价值：可为用户提供选择，并带来提升整体性能的解题策略。因此需要量化 RLVR 对解法多样性的影响并加以改进。
AI.method: 1) 构建 ModeBench：多解题任务基准，验证器同时返回正确性与所发现的模式（mode）；2) 用 ModeBench 测量 RLVR 后训练前后解法多样性的变化，并评估前沿模型；3) 提出 Re:Max：在回放缓冲区中为每个已发现模式保存一个经验证的样本，并对缓冲区内的模式进行均匀训练，使"曾出现过一次"的解法与"反复出现"的解法获得同等训练频次。
AI.result: RLVR 后训练在准确率持平或提升的同时，将概率集中到更少的正确模式上；前沿模型本身已高度集中。Re:Max 在三种模型规模、两种 RL 目标以及更难的任务构造下，均同时提升了策略的成功频率与可成功解法的种类数。
AI.conclusion: 标准 RLVR 会牺牲解法多样性，Re:Max 通过基于模式回放的均匀训练，可在不损失（甚至提升）成功率的前提下恢复并保留多种正确解法。

title: Diffusion Meta-Prompting and Steering for Generalizable Foundation Model Adaptation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://deepaksridhar.github.io/dmp.github.io/. Code: https://github.com/DeepakSridhar/dmp
summary: Prompt learning is a popular method for adapting foundation models, but learned prompts are typically task-specific and fail to generalize to new classes, domains, or compositions of tasks. In this paper, we introduce a Diffusion Meta-Prompt (DMP) model , a framework that models the distribution of learned prompts using diffusion models. Given a repository of previously learned prompts, DMP is trained and sampled without access to the original task examples or task losses, and synthesizes new prompts conditioned on natural language task descriptions. To improve the sampling stability, we introduce a test-time steering strategy for DMP, which uses the best training-selected prompt in the repository as a latent anchor during diffusion sampling, without retraining the DMP or accessing test classes. DMP improves generalization across classification, retrieval and text-to-image generation tasks, supports concept composition and negative prompting without explicit training. It reduces storage and inference costs by over 90% compared to prompt retrieval methods. For composite classification, DMP achieves upto 2.0% average gain over prior meta-learning methods across 55 pairs of datasets with gains as high as 8.5% on specific pairs such as Eurosat and Flowers. DMP also enhances cross-task generalization with ~2-9% improvement for hierarchical classification task. We further provide a theoretical guarantee bounding the expected task loss of prompts sampled from a DMP. Code is available: https://github.com/DeepakSridhar/dmp

AI.tldr: 本文提出扩散元提示（DMP）框架，用扩散模型建模已学习提示的分布，在无需原始任务样本或损失的情况下，依据自然语言任务描述合成新提示，并引入测试时引导策略提升采样稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有提示学习得到的提示通常是任务特定的，难以泛化到新类别、新领域或任务组合，且提示检索方法存储与推理开销大。
AI.method: DMP将提示视为数据，对已有提示库训练扩散模型并采样生成新提示；采样时以训练中选出的最优提示作为潜在锚点进行测试时引导，无需重训练或访问测试类；并给出采样提示期望任务损失的理論界。
AI.result: 在分类、检索和文本到图像生成任务上提升泛化能力，支持概念组合与负向提示且无需显式训练；相比提示检索方法存储与推理成本降低90%以上；组合分类在55对数据集上平均提升最高2.0%（如Eurosat与Flowers单对高达8.5%）；层级分类跨任务泛化提升约2-9%。
AI.conclusion: DMP通过建模提示分布与测试时引导，实现了高效、可组合且具理论保障的提示生成，显著优于先前的元学习方法并大幅降低资源开销。

authors: The International Digital Twin Consortium in Healthcare
title: Clinician use of language models diverges from how the models are evaluated
summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants are being deployed to clinicians across health systems, and judgments about their readiness rest largely on benchmark scores, most of them derived from examination questions or curated cases. A benchmark predicts performance in deployment only to the extent that its items resemble real use, yet whether benchmarks reflect the work these systems receive has rarely been measured. Here we analyze 127,833 queries sent by 6,342 physicians, advanced practice providers and nurses in 35 specialties to an institutional assistant during an eight-month roll-out. We characterize each query with RCQ-Map, a clinician-validated framework grounded in taxonomies of clinical questions and of LLM evaluation, which records its task, intent, answerability, missing information and potential harm. Documentation and administration (36.2%) and knowledge retrieval (28.9%) made up nearly two-thirds of use, and diagnosis 3.7%; more than a third of queries could not be answered well as posed. Applying RCQ-Map to 58 public benchmarks drawn from major evaluation suites and frontier model reports, which we assemble into the Clinical AI Benchmark Atlas, showed that the median benchmark contained no documentation requests and shared 31% of the task mix of real use, less than an even spread across task categories would. Benchmarks in suites designed to resemble clinical practice were individually no closer to real use than those used in frontier model reports. Benchmark scores therefore say little about how clinical AI performs on most of the work it is actually given, and evaluation should be matched to real clinical use.

AI.tldr: 分析127,833条真实临床助手查询发现，文书行政(36.2%)与知识检索(28.9%)占近三分之二，诊断仅3.7%；对58个公开基准的映射显示其中位数基准不含文书类请求，任务构成与真实使用仅重合31%，低于均匀分布的预期，说明现有基准评分难以反映真实临床使用表现。
AI.motivation: LLM助手正被部署给临床医生，其可用性判断主要依赖基准分数，而这些基准多源自考试题或精选病例。基准只有在题目与真实使用相似时才能预测部署表现，但"基准是否反映系统实际接收的工作"此前鲜有测量。
AI.method: 1) 收集某机构助手在八个月推广期内、来自35个专科的6,342名医生、高级实践提供者和护士的127,833条查询；2) 构建并采用经临床医生验证的RCQ-Map框架（以临床问题分类学和LLM评估分类学为基础），标注每条查询的任务、意图、可回答性、缺失信息与潜在危害；3) 将RCQ-Map应用于58个公开基准（来自主流评估套件与前沿模型报告），汇编为Clinical AI Benchmark Atlas，与真实使用进行对比。
AI.result: 文书与行政占36.2%、知识检索占28.9%，合计近三分之二，诊断仅占3.7%；超过三分之一的查询在原始表述下无法得到良好回答。58个基准的中位数基准不含任何文书类请求，任务构成与真实使用仅重合31%，低于任务类别均匀分布时的水平；且旨在贴近临床实践的评估套件中的基准，其接近真实使用的程度并不优于前沿模型报告中所用的基准。
AI.conclusion: 基准分数几乎无法说明临床AI在其实际承担的大部分工作中的表现，评估应当与真实临床使用相匹配。

title: No Distillation Needed: Single-Pass Real-Time Talking Heads via Acausal Noise Shaping
summary: Audio-driven facial animation underpins real-time avatars, telepresence, and embodied virtual agents. And it must run online: each frame emitted from audio observed up to the current time, at interactive rates. Recent progress is dominated by diffusion models, which need many network evaluations per sample and are therefore a poor fit for streaming. We argue the cost is unnecessary in this domain. Audio-conditioned facial motion occupies a comparatively low-dimensional manifold, a regime where a single-pass GAN suffices. The obstacle is not capacity but stochastic structure. We show that a causal, time-invariant generator driven by i.i.d. noise cannot suppress its output spectrum over a band without collapsing its per-step innovation. We proposed FaceGAN, which dissolved the limitation by shaping the noise pathway acausally. Because the driving noise is synthetic, its future can be sampled now, so the audio-to-expression path stays causal, and the model supports fully causal operation. FaceGAN emits expression and head pose in a single forward pass per frame and matches or outperforms state-of-art approaches in generation quality. Being feed-forward with bounded attention windows, it generates indefinitely without drift.

AI.tldr: FaceGAN：以单步前馈GAN替代扩散模型实现流式音频驱动面部动画
AI.motivation: 音频驱动面部动画需在线流式生成（每帧基于当前及历史音频、交互帧率）。扩散模型每样本需多次网络评估，不适配流式场景；作者认为该领域成本可省——音频条件的面部运动处于低维流形，单步GAN足够，真正障碍在随机结构而非模型容量。
AI.method: 理论上证明：因果、时不变、由i.i.d.噪声驱动的生成器无法在抑制输出频带的同时避免每步创新崩塌。据此提出FaceGAN，通过非因果地塑造噪声通路来突破该限制——由于驱动噪声为合成噪声，其未来可提前采样，而音频到表情的路径保持因果，从而支持完全因果运行；每帧单次前向传播输出表情与头部姿态，采用有界注意力窗口的前馈结构。
AI.result: 生成质量与当前最先进方法相当或更优；前馈加有界注意力窗口，可无限生成而不产生漂移。
AI.conclusion: 在音频驱动面部动画中，扩散模型的高昂推理成本并非必要；通过非因果噪声塑造解除因果时不变生成器的频谱抑制—创新崩塌矛盾，单步GAN即可实现高质量、无漂移的实时流式生成。

title: Contrast Enhancement or Noise Reduction? On Improving Cervical Cancer Classification
summary: Purpose: Cervical cancer is one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide. Deep learning has shown promising performance in medical image classification. The influence of image preprocessing algorithms on classification performance remains insufficiently investigated in the literature. This research aims to evaluate the impact of image preprocessing algorithms on the performance of CNNs for Pap smear image classification. Methods: Three CNN architectures (ResNet-34, MobileNet-V2, and DenseNet-121) were trained and evaluated using the SIPaKMeD dataset. Two preprocessing algorithms were applied: the PMD filter for noise reduction and CLAHE for contrast enhancement. The model performance was assessed using a confusion matrix. Results: Preprocessing improved the classification performance of all models. CLAHE significantly increased the accuracy of ResNet-34 from 76.73% to 84.16% and DenseNet-121 from 76.73% to 84.16%. The PMD filter yielded limited improvement and slightly reduced the MobileNet-V2 performance. Novelty: This research provides a systematic comparison of contrast enhancement and noise reduction techniques across CNN architectures. This research demonstrates that contrast enhancement is more effective than noise reduction in improving CNN performance. The research provides new pipelines for improving cervical cancer classification.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了PMD去噪与CLAHE对比度增强两种预处理算法对ResNet-34、MobileNet-V2和DenseNet-121在SIPaKMeD宫颈细胞涂片分类任务上的影响，发现CLAHE显著提升性能，而PMD滤波收益有限甚至略有负面效果。
AI.motivation: 宫颈癌是全球主要致死原因之一，深度学习在医学图像分类中表现良好，但图像预处理算法对分类性能的影响在文献中研究不足，因此有必要系统评估预处理对CNN性能的作用。
AI.method: 使用SIPaKMeD数据集，训练并评估三种CNN架构（ResNet-34、MobileNet-V2、DenseNet-121）；应用两种预处理算法：PMD滤波去噪与CLAHE对比度增强；采用混淆矩阵评估模型性能。
AI.result: 预处理提升了所有模型的分类性能。CLAHE将ResNet-34与DenseNet-121的准确率均从76.73%提升至84.16%；PMD滤波带来的提升有限，并使MobileNet-V2性能略有下降。
AI.conclusion: 对比度增强在提升CNN性能方面比去噪更有效；该研究提供了跨CNN架构的预处理技术系统比较，并为宫颈癌分类提供了新的流程方案。

title: Continuous Ground-Truth Construction and a Recovery Policy for Air--Water Robotic Tracking
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027)
summary: Visual tracking across the air-water interface is challenged by splashes, bubbles, refraction, reflections, and abrupt appearance changes that can temporarily invalidate observations. This setting poses two coupled difficulties: first, for evaluation, image-only annotation cannot reliably describe the target's physical location during visual blindness; second, for online tracking, corrupted observations can contaminate motion estimates and appearance templates. We address the first difficulty with a construction pipeline that synchronizes camera frames with motion-capture poses, projects known target geometry, corrects underwater projection with a medium-gated residual, and subjects the annotations to manual review. This yields an evaluation-only cross-medium test set of 22,346 frames. We further introduce a Cross-Medium Recovery Policy (CMRP) centered on confidence-triggered template selection. It supplies MixFormerV2 with the fixed initial template, a window-best pre-trigger template, and a trigger-frame Kalman-guided image crop, together with their associated weights, without retraining the visual backbone. In the accuracy evaluation, CMRP achieves 49.90 Macro Success AUC, 2.95 points above MixFormerV2 Official. On selected cross-medium transition and occlusion-recovery intervals, CMRP increases MixFormerV2 tracking coverage from 47.91\% to 50.43\% relative to Official updating, while mean loss-to-recovery latency over successfully recovered videos decreases from 55.3 to 49.3 frames.

AI.tldr: 该文针对跨水空界面视觉跟踪中飞溅、气泡、折射、反射等导致的观测失效问题，构建了同步动捕位姿的跨介质评测集，并提出置信度触发的跨介质恢复策略CMRP，在不重训视觉主干的情况下提升MixFormerV2的跟踪精度与恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 跨水空界面跟踪面临两类耦合难题：评测层面，纯图像标注无法可靠反映视觉盲区时目标的真实物理位置；在线跟踪层面，被污染的观测会污染运动估计与外观模板。因此既需要可信的跨介质评测基准，也需要在观测失效时稳健的模板选择与恢复机制。
AI.method: 评测方面，提出构建流水线：将相机帧与动作捕捉位姿同步，投影已知目标几何，用水介质门控残差校正水下投影，并进行人工复核，形成仅用于评测的跨介质测试集（22,346帧）。跟踪方面，提出跨介质恢复策略CMRP，以置信度触发模板选择为核心，向MixFormerV2提供固定初始模板、触发前窗口最优模板和触发帧的Kalman引导图像裁剪及其权重，且不重训视觉主干。
AI.result: 精度评测中CMRP取得49.90 Macro Success AUC，较MixFormerV2 Official高出2.95个点；在选定的跨介质转换与遮挡恢复区间，跟踪覆盖率由Official更新的47.91%提升至50.43%，成功恢复视频的平均丢失-恢复时延由55.3帧降至49.3帧。
AI.conclusion: 同步动捕位姿的标注流水线可为跨介质跟踪提供可靠的物理位置评测；置信度触发的多模板选择机制在冻结视觉主干的前提下即可显著提升跨介质跟踪精度并缩短恢复时延，为观测失效场景提供了一种轻量、即插即用的恢复方案。

title: Skeleton-Guided Progressive Test-Time Adaptation for Thin Curvilinear Structures
summary: Accurate segmentation of thin curvilinear structures is vital for various real-world applications, from vessel analysis to road extraction. Yet their intricate geometry makes even minor pixel-wise errors enough to break the global topology, and this structural fragility turns severe domain shifts into catastrophic failures. The difficulty is most acute under cross-modality gaps, where the imaging process itself differs fundamentally between source and target. While test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical source-free remedy, existing methods adapt feature statistics and confidence, neither of which constrains connectivity, and thus degrade under such extreme gaps. To address this, we propose Skeleton-Guided Progressive Test-Time Adaptation (SGP-TTA). Progressive Batch Normalization (ProgBN) shifts normalization from frozen source statistics toward current target estimates under a sample-count schedule, so that the source-target balance follows the stage of adaptation rather than a fixed coefficient. Consensus Skeleton Recall (CSR) then derives a structural target from geometrically aligned multi-view predictions and updates only the BN affine parameters to preserve connected structures. Extensive experiments show that SGP-TTA consistently outperforms existing TTA methods in topological connectivity, with the largest margins under cross-modality shift. The project page is available at https://boa-jang.github.io/SGP-TTA.

AI.tldr: 提出SGP-TTA框架，通过渐进式批归一化与共识骨架召回解决细长曲线结构在跨模态域偏移下的测试时自适应问题。
AI.motivation: 细长曲线结构（如血管、道路）分割对像素级误差极敏感，微小错误即可破坏全局拓扑。现有TTA方法仅调整特征统计量和置信度，无法约束连通性，在跨模态极端域偏移下性能严重退化。
AI.method: SGP-TTA包含两个模块：(1) ProgBN，按样本数调度将归一化从冻结的源域统计量逐步过渡到目标域估计，使源-目标平衡随自适应阶段动态变化而非固定系数；(2) CSR，从几何对齐的多视角预测中提取结构目标，仅更新BN仿射参数以保持连通结构。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SGP-TTA在拓扑连通性上持续优于现有TTA方法，在跨模态偏移下优势最显著。
AI.conclusion: SGP-TTA通过渐进归一化与骨架引导的结构约束，有效缓解了细长结构在跨模态域偏移中的拓扑断裂问题，为无源域TTA提供了新思路。

title: TKCAM: Text and Keyframe to Camera Trajectory Generation
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures. Paper accepted to NeurIPS2026 (submission number 15461)
summary: Generating high-quality and controllable camera motion is essential for AI-assisted cinematography, video synthesis, and 3D scene understanding. We introduce TKCAM, a Text- and Keyframe-conditioned CAMera-motion synthesis framework based on generative masked modeling. We represent camera dynamics using a 12-dimensional kinematic feature comprising position, velocity, and a continuous rotation representation and discretize them into hierarchical motion tokens via a Residual Vector Quantizer (RVQ). A two-stage masked transformer architecture then learns to reconstruct and refine these tokens, utilizing explicit self- and cross-attention modules for multimodal conditioning. A central feature of our framework is sparse visual keyframe conditioning: users can provide free-form text prompts together with RGB observations at selected timestamps, which provide temporally localized visual guidance for generating coherent in-between trajectories. Furthermore, to advance evaluation standards, we curate RealEstate10K-Cap, a large-scale text-camera dataset, and establish a cross-domain benchmark with a Universal CLaTr Evaluator. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TKCAM surpasses recent state-of-the-art baselines on Fréchet distance (FID), text-motion matching scores, and retrieval metrics (R@K), while additional analyses evaluate temporal smoothness and cross-domain generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/linearalgebrayhz/TKCAM.

AI.tldr: 提出TKCAM，一个基于生成式掩码建模的文本与关键帧条件相机运动合成框架，并配套RealEstate10K-Cap数据集与跨域评测基准。
AI.motivation: 高质量、可控的相机运动生成对AI辅助电影摄影、视频合成和3D场景理解至关重要，现有方法在可控性与多模态条件下生成连贯轨迹方面仍有不足。
AI.method: 用12维运动学特征（位置、速度、连续旋转表示）表征相机动态，经RVQ离散化为层次化运动token；采用两阶段掩码Transformer进行token重建与精炼，并结合自注意力与交叉注意力实现多模态条件；核心是稀疏视觉关键帧条件——用户给定自由文本提示与选定时间戳的RGB观测，用于生成时间局部化引导下的连贯中间轨迹。
AI.result: 构建RealEstate10K-Cap大规模文本-相机数据集，建立基于Universal CLaTr Evaluator的跨域基准；实验显示TKCAM在FID、文本-运动匹配分数与检索指标R@K上超越近期SOTA，并额外评估了时间平滑性与跨域泛化。
AI.conclusion: TKCAM通过掩码生成建模与稀疏关键帧条件，实现了可控且连贯的相机运动合成，并推动了该任务的评测标准化。

title: Lapras: Latent Reasoning for Time Series Language Models
summary: Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) offer a promising path toward time series understanding by reasoning over temporal signals and producing natural language answers and explanations. A common approach is Chain-of-Thought (CoT), which generates step-by-step rationales linking relevant signal patterns to final answers. Although these models learn from reference CoT traces during post-training, generating faithful descriptions of input time series at inference remains challenging. Expressing high-dimensional, continuous temporal representations in discrete language tokens may cause the model to neglect task-relevant patterns or describe them inaccurately. Because later reasoning steps build on these descriptions, early errors propagate, leading to incorrect answers with plausible explanations that are inconsistent with the input signal. We propose Lapras (Latent Post-trained Reasoning Across Series), a post-training framework that equips TSLMs with latent reasoning. A model trained with Lapras reasons through a sequence of continuous thoughts in the joint time series-language space, producing text only for the final answer. It learns this through teacher-student self-distillation, where a teacher trained on CoT reference traces reasons explicitly through text. The student aligns its hidden states with the teacher's at the answer stage, transferring the teacher's reasoning ability into its latent computation. We evaluate Lapras across four TSLM backbones on five time series question answering benchmarks. Lapras improves average F1 by up to 10.79% over explicit CoT while generating 23.9x fewer tokens. Lapras's continuous thoughts can also be decoded into readable reasoning traces via standard language decoding, preserving textual explanations. Together, these results highlight Lapras as a promising post-training paradigm for efficient, effective, and interpretable TSLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lapras，一种面向时间序列语言模型（TSLM）的后训练框架，用连续隐空间推理替代显式思维链，在五个基准上平均F1最高提升10.79%，生成token减少23.9倍，且隐式思维仍可解码为可读推理轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有TSLM依赖链式思维（CoT）做时间序列理解，需将高维连续的时序表示压缩为离散语言token。这一过程易导致模型忽略任务相关模式或描述失真；由于后续推理步骤建立在这些描述之上，早期错误会逐步传播，最终产生答案错误、解释看似合理却与输入信号不符的结果。核心问题是：生成对输入时间序列的忠实描述在推理阶段仍很困难。
AI.method: 提出Lapras（Latent Post-trained Reasoning Across Series）后训练框架，赋予TSLM隐空间推理能力。模型在时间序列-语言联合空间中通过一串连续"思维"进行推理，仅在输出最终答案时生成文本。训练采用教师-学生自蒸馏：教师在CoT参考轨迹上训练、以显式文本推理；学生在答案阶段将自身隐状态与教师对齐，从而把教师的推理能力迁移到学生的隐式计算中。
AI.result: 在四种TSLM骨干模型、五个时间序列问答基准上评估。相较显式CoT，Lapras平均F1最高提升10.79%，同时生成token数减少23.9倍。其连续思维还可通过标准语言解码还原为可读的推理轨迹，保留文本解释能力。
AI.conclusion: Lapras是一种兼具高效性、有效性与可解释性的TSLM后训练范式，通过隐空间推理缓解了离散化描述带来的误差传播问题。

title: False Claims, Credible Images: A Red-Teaming Benchmark for Commercial Image Generators
comment: 29 pages, 19 figures, 6 tables. Project website: https://github.com/Ye-ze-yu/EpiReal-Bench
summary: Image-generation models can now produce text-rich, natural-looking visual artifacts that are hard to distinguish from real-world evidence, such as news reports and textbook pages. Yet, the same capability introduces a new risk: these models can just as easily fabricate visual misinformation. Even commercial models (e.g., GPT-Image-2) readily produce it. Curiously, we find that these models can recognize a claim as false when asked, yet still render that very claim as credible visual evidence. This discrepancy points to a blind spot in current alignment: safeguards judge what an image shows, not what it asserts; however, existing red-teaming benchmarks target conventional harmful content, such as violent or explicit imagery, and say little about where the alignment boundaries lie for visual misinformation, especially in commercial models. To fill this gap, we introduce EpiReal-Bench, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating visual misinformation risks in commercial image generators, comprising 10k false-claim prompts and 10k corresponding generated images that span 10 real-world claim categories and 10 credible visual formats. We further introduce EpiReal-Attack, a skill-guided black-box optimization framework that uses Pareto-based selection and multimodal feedback to identify commands that bypass alignment safeguards while preserving visual realism, textual legibility, and semantic fidelity. Experiments on four commercial models reveal that more than 70% of false-claim prompts elicit images that faithfully depict the corresponding misinformation, and EpiReal-Attack pushes this rate to 95%. Most worryingly, these models are only a click away, and their outputs are cheap to spread yet hard to disbelieve, leaving this dimension of alignment largely unguarded.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EpiReal-Bench（首个针对商业图像生成器视觉错误信息风险的系统性基准，含1万条虚假声明提示与1万张对应生成图像，覆盖10类现实声明与10种可信视觉格式）及 EpiReal-Attack（技能引导的黑盒优化框架，结合帕累托选择与多模态反馈，在保持视觉真实感、文字可读性与语义保真度的同时绕过对齐防护）；实验显示四个商业模型中超过70%的虚假声明提示可生成忠实呈现错误信息的图像，经攻击后比例升至95%。
AI.motivation: 图像生成模型能产出文本丰富、高度逼真的视觉产物，同时也可轻易伪造视觉错误信息（连商业模型如 GPT-Image-2 亦然）。作者发现一种矛盾现象：模型在被询问时能识别某声明为假，却仍将该声明渲染为可信的视觉证据。这说明当前对齐存在盲点——防护机制判断的是"图像展示了什么"，而非"图像断言了什么"。而既有红队基准主要针对暴力、露骨等常规有害内容，对视觉错误信息的对齐边界（尤其在商业模型中）缺乏刻画，因此需要填补这一评估空白。
AI.method: 1) EpiReal-Bench：面向商业图像生成器的视觉错误信息风险评估基准，包含10k虚假声明提示与10k对应生成图像，覆盖10个现实声明类别与10种可信视觉格式。2) EpiReal-Attack：技能引导的黑盒优化框架，采用帕累托（Pareto）选择与多模态反馈，搜索能够绕过对齐防护、同时保持视觉真实感、文本可读性与语义保真度的指令。基于该框架对四个商业模型进行实验。
AI.result: 在四个商业模型上，超过70%的虚假声明提示即可诱导模型生成忠实描绘相应错误信息的图像；EpiReal-Attack 将这一比例提升至95%。
AI.conclusion: 商业图像生成器在视觉错误信息维度上的对齐基本处于失守状态：模型虽能识别虚假声明，却仍乐于将其可视化为可信证据；相关输出仅"一键之遥"、传播成本低廉却难以被质疑。该研究揭示了"判断内容危害"与"判断内容真伪"之间的对齐缺口，呼吁将断言真实性纳入图像生成对齐与防护范围。

title: DiscoVL: Unveiling Disentangled C ross-Modal Representation Learning via Orthogonal Adversarial Regularization for V ision-Language Models
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Accepted to ECCV 2026
summary: Pre-trained vision-language models excel across varied perception tasks, but adapting them to novel downstream settings without sacrificing generalization remains non-trivial. Existing parameter-efficient prompt learning method often yields inconsistent representations and fails to account for semantic distribution shifts. In this work, we present DiscoVL, a disentangled cross-modal representation learning framework that couples orthogonal adversarial regularization with structured cross-modal alignment for vision-language models. To address the insufficient cross-modal interaction, our DiscoVL designs a multi-branch low-rank residual aligner that decomposes representations into subspaces and enables bidirectional cross-modal feedback between visual and textual streams at each layer. Furthermore, while conventional triplet constraints overfit features to class centroids, we design an orthogonal regularization for adversarial triplet loss, which prevents centroid collapse and substantially boosts generalization. Evaluations on 15 benchmarks demonstrate that DiscoVL delivers consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods for base-to-novel generalization, cross-dataset evaluation, and few-shot learning

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DiscoVL：一种解耦跨模态表示学习框架，将正交对抗正则与结构化跨模态对齐结合用于视觉-语言模型，在 15 个基准上于基类到新类泛化、跨数据集评估和少样本学习均取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉-语言模型感知能力强，但适配到新下游场景时难以在不牺牲泛化性的前提下进行。现有参数高效提示学习方法常产生不一致的表示，且未考虑语义分布偏移。
AI.method: 针对跨模态交互不足，设计多分支低秩残差对齐器：将表示分解到子空间，并在每层实现视觉与文本流的双向跨模态反馈。针对传统三元组约束使特征过拟合类别中心的问题，设计正交正则化的对抗三元组损失，防止中心坍缩并提升泛化。
AI.result: 在 15 个基准上的评估表明，DiscoVL 在基类到新类泛化、跨数据集评估和少样本学习方面相较最先进方法取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: DiscoVL 通过解耦跨模态表示学习、多分支低秩残差对齐与正交对抗三元组正则，有效缓解表示不一致与语义分布偏移，为视觉-语言模型的下游适配提供兼顾参数效率与泛化性的方案。

title: MCL: Meta Convolution Layer
summary: Dynamic convolution enhances convolutional neural networks (CNNs) by adapting kernels to input content, but it expresses the effective kernel as a linear mixture of a small number of basis kernels, which limits expressivity and complicates optimization as the mixture size grows. In this work, we revisit dynamic convolution from a functional perspective and propose the Meta Convolution Layer (MCL), which directly models the convolutional kernel as an input-conditioned function W(x) realized via a high-order polynomial expansion. Leveraging nested residual blocks inspired by deep polynomial networks, MCL implements a structured polynomial meta-network that generates a single input-adaptive kernel, thereby decoupling representational power from the explicit number of mixture kernels and alleviating training instability. MCL is a plug-in addition with standard convolutions and can be seamlessly integrated into both CNN and transformer backbones. Experimental evaluation shows that adding MCL improves the Top-1 accuracy of Resnet- 18, Resnet-50 and ResNet-101 by 6.61%, 3.42% and 3.05% on the ImageNet dataset. Moreover, the proposed method significantly boosts the accuracy of Resnet and Wide-Resnet variants on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets. Additionally, the proposed method outperforms previous methods on fine-grained visual classification tasks using Swin and ViT backbones. These results demonstrate that high-order polynomial kernel generation is a powerful and scalable alternative to linear mixture based dynamic convolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出元卷积层（MCL），从函数视角将卷积核建模为输入条件函数，通过高阶多项式展开和嵌套残差块生成单一自适应核，在ImageNet、CIFAR及细粒度分类任务上显著优于线性混合式动态卷积。
AI.motivation: 现有动态卷积将有效核表示为少量基核的线性混合，限制了表达能力，且随混合规模增大而加剧优化难度。作者希望将表达能力与显式混合核数量解耦，并缓解训练不稳定问题。
AI.method: 提出Meta Convolution Layer（MCL），从函数视角将卷积核直接建模为输入条件函数W(x)，借助高阶多项式展开实现；采用受深度多项式网络启发的嵌套残差块，构建结构化多项式元网络，生成单一输入自适应核。MCL为插件式模块，可与标准卷积配合并集成到CNN和Transformer骨干中。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上，加入MCL使ResNet-18/50/101的Top-1精度分别提升6.61%、3.42%、3.05%；在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上显著提升ResNet与Wide-ResNet变体精度；在Swin和ViT骨干的细粒度视觉分类任务上优于已有方法。
AI.conclusion: 高阶多项式核生成是线性混合式动态卷积的一种强大且可扩展的替代方案，能有效提升多种骨干网络在多类视觉任务上的性能。

title: GameCommBench: A Unified Benchmark and Type-Aware Evaluation for AI-Generated Game Commentary
summary: Game commentary is an open-ended generation task requiring multimodal perception, strategic reasoning, and contextual knowledge. Existing AI-Generated Game Commentary (AI-GGC) studies remain fragmented across games, modalities, and evaluation protocols, while overlap-based or holistic evaluators fail to capture the functional heterogeneity of commentary. We introduce \textsc{GameCommBench}, a unified benchmark spanning board games, sports, and esports, with commentary aligned to heterogeneous game contexts and annotated by commentary type. We further propose Type-Aware Commentary Evaluation (TACE), a structured framework for evaluating different types of commentary. We then validate TACE for reliability and human agreement, and use it to benchmark representative AI commentators. Results reveal non-uniform capability profiles, with live observation and strategic analysis emerging as major bottlenecks. Together, \textsc{GameCommBench} and TACE provide a diagnostic foundation for comparable and interpretable AI-GGC evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一基准GameCommBench与类型感知评估框架TACE，用于AI生成游戏解说的评测，覆盖棋类、体育和电竞，并揭示现有模型在实时观察与战略分析上的能力短板。
AI.motivation: 游戏解说生成需要多模态感知、策略推理与情境知识，但现有AI-GGC研究在游戏类型、模态和评估协议上呈碎片化；同时基于重叠度或整体性评估的方法无法刻画解说内容的功能异质性，难以实现可比较、可解释的评测。
AI.method: 构建统一基准GameCommBench，涵盖棋类、体育和电竞，将解说明与异构游戏情境对齐并按解说类型标注；提出类型感知解说评估框架TACE，对不同类型解说进行结构化评估；随后验证TACE的可靠性与人类一致性，并用其评测代表性AI解说模型。
AI.result: TACE通过可靠性与人类一致性验证；对代表性AI解说模型的评测显示出非均匀的能力分布，其中实时观察（live observation）与战略分析（strategic analysis）是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: GameCommBench与TACE共同为AI-GGC提供了可比较、可解释的诊断性评估基础，推动该领域从碎片化研究走向统一与功能化评测。

title: SFT-as-Context Mitigates Forgetting in Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) equips large language models (LLMs) with specialized capabilities, but often comes at the cost of forgetting the general capabilities of their parent models (i.e., the pretrained models before fine-tuning). This trade-off is especially limiting for queries that require both specialized and general capabilities. We introduce SFT-as-context, a training-free method in which the parent model uses the SFT model's response as context to answer the query. This allows the parent model to acquire fine-tuned capabilities from the SFT response through in-context learning while preserving its own general capabilities. Across 19 parent-SFT model pairs and 11 benchmarks, SFT-as-context remains close to the SFT models on fine-tuned capabilities, with gaps of only 2.2 and 2.1 percentage points on AIME 2024 and LiveCodeBench and 2.0 macro MAE on NutriBench-English, while staying within 2.2 percentage points of the parent models on general capabilities on average. Remarkably, it can solve queries requiring both fine-tuned and general capabilities, even when neither the parent nor SFT model succeeds alone. This approach also extends beyond parent-SFT pairs: responses from a small open-source SFT model can improve a strong closed-source LLM, outperforming either model alone. Furthermore, we use a Bayesian framework to derive theoretical guarantees that bound the error of SFT-as-context relative to the SFT model on fine-tuned capabilities and to the parent model on general capabilities. In addition, we visualize the attention weights and find that the parent model attends more to useful SFT responses and less to irrelevant ones, suggesting that selective attention helps the parent model use the SFT response through in-context learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SFT-as-context：一种无需训练的方法，让父模型（预训练模型）将SFT模型的回答作为上下文，通过上下文学习获取微调能力，同时保留通用能力。
AI.motivation: SFT赋予大模型专门能力，但会导致通用能力遗忘，形成能力权衡；而许多查询同时需要专门能力和通用能力，现有方法难以兼顾。
AI.method: 父模型将SFT模型的回答作为上下文，通过上下文学习（in-context learning）吸收其微调能力，无需任何训练；并用贝叶斯框架推导误差界，同时可视化注意力权重分析机制。
AI.result: 在19对父-SFT模型、11个基准上，SFT-as-context在微调能力上接近SFT模型（AIME 2024与LiveCodeBench仅差2.2和2.1个百分点，NutriBench-English macro MAE差2.0），通用能力平均在父模型2.2个百分点内；还能解决父模型与SFT模型单独都失败的查询，并可跨模型对提升闭源LLM。
AI.conclusion: SFT-as-context无需训练即可兼顾专门与通用能力，兼具理论误差界支撑，注意力可视化表明父模型的选择性注意力是实现该效果的关键机制。

title: Can a System-One LLM Perform Knowledge Tracing When Few or No Learners Are Logged?
comment: 41 pages, 7 figures. Code and result summaries: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/jevkt-coldstart
summary: Knowledge tracing (KT) models need many logged learners, so a new course or platform starts without a usable model. In LLM-based KT the LLM generates the answer, which we call System-Two; it is either fine-tuned on the target data or reasons and votes over ten samples, which is slow and gives coarse probabilities. We ask whether an off-the-shelf System-One LLM, which returns a probability for a typed question directly in a single pass, can perform KT when few or no learners are logged. On seven datasets, Jev without any data from the target platform reaches a mean AUC of .706, above the best of 28 deep KT models trained on 8 learners (.689) and above System-Two Thinking-KT on all seven datasets (.650) at about 1/100 of its API cost. Adding examples and a similar-learner statistic from the logged learners (JevKT) raises this to .722; JevKT stays significantly ahead of deep KT up to 16 learners and ahead on average up to 64, and supervised KT catches up between 64 and 128 learners. Among the readers we tested, the gain is specific to Jev, since three other LLMs queried with the byte-identical typed request through the official System-One adapter fall below it on all seven datasets, and reader swaps and contamination checks find no evidence that the input format or memorised data explain the gain. For new learners the advantage holds from their first interactions, whereas on unseen items with all learners logged, deep KT remains ahead.

AI.tldr: 现成的System-One大语言模型（Jev）在单次前向传播中直接输出作答概率，无需目标平台数据即可完成知识追踪；在七个数据集上平均AUC达0.706，超过用8名学习者训练的28个深度KT模型（0.689）及Thinking-KT（0.650），成本约为后者1/100；加入示例与相似学习者统计后（JevKT）升至0.722，优势可持续到64名学习者。
AI.motivation: 知识追踪模型依赖大量日志学习者数据，新课程或新平台冷启动时缺乏可用模型。已有的LLM-based KT属于"System-Two"范式：要么在目标数据上微调，要么对十个样本进行推理投票，速度慢且只能给出粗糙概率。本文因此追问：一个现成的"System-One"LLM——对给定题目在单次pass中直接返回概率——能否在极少甚至没有学习者日志的情况下完成KT。
AI.method: 采用免训练（training-free）的System-One范式：Jev直接对类型化问题在单次前向传播中输出作答概率，完全不使用目标平台数据。JevKT在此基础上引入日志学习者的少量示例与相似学习者统计量作为上下文。评估覆盖七个数据集，与28个深度KT模型（分别用8、16、64、128名学习者训练）、System-Two的Thinking-KT进行对比，并控制API成本；通过字节级相同的类型化请求经官方System-One适配器查询另外三个LLM、进行reader swap与数据污染检查，以排除输入格式和记忆数据的解释。
AI.result: Jev在无目标平台数据下平均AUC为0.706，高于8名学习者训练的最佳深度KT（0.689）和Thinking-KT（0.650），API成本约为后者的1/100。加入示例与相似学习者统计后（JevKT）提升至0.722。JevKT在至多16名学习者时显著优于深度KT，平均优势保持到64名，监督式KT在64—128名学习者之间追平。三个其他LLM在完全相同请求下均低于Jev；reader swap与污染检查未发现格式或记忆数据能解释该增益。对新学习者，优势自首次交互即成立；而在全部学习者已记录、面对未见题目时，深度KT仍领先。
AI.conclusion: 现成System-One LLM可在冷启动、少样本甚至零样本条件下有效进行知识追踪，以极低成本超越部分深度KT与System-Two方法，但其增益具有模型特异性（仅Jev显著）且优势随学习者数量增加而收敛，在用户全记录、题目未见场景下仍不及深度KT，因此适合作为低资源新平台的冷启动方案而非全面替代。

title: The "10th Juror": Open-Set Standpoint Screening for Bureaucratic Bias Detection
summary: Presupposing the boundaries of bias is itself a form of bias. We study closed-loop bias governance for Dutch government documents, where a system must detect biased language, ground decisions in legal and contextual evidence, rewrite problematic sentences when intervention is warranted, and verify that the rewrite mitigates harm without distorting meaning. Existing methods face three challenges: (i) discriminative classifiers capture surface regularities but lack normative grounding; (ii) zero-shot LLMs often adopt generic viewpoints and over-flag ambiguous administrative language; and (iii) fixed taxonomies inherit the Closed-World Assumption, missing emerging local targets. We propose MARS-Gov, a standpoint-aware multi-agent framework that combines legal retrieval, open-set target screening, specialized jurors, conservative routing, and rewrite verification. When screening finds an uncovered group, MARS-Gov instantiates a dynamic "10th juror" to deliberate outside the fixed panel. On DGDB, MARS-Gov sets a new SOTA with 0.880 F1, outperforming the strongest zero-shot LLM detector by 20.2 points (29.8% relative) and the best supervised Dutch encoder by 6.8 points, while reducing unnecessary interventions to 2.5%. Leave-One-Category-Out (LOCO) evaluation recovers held-out categories with 85.1% Correct@1 and 93.8% Correct@3.

AI.tldr: 提出MARS-Gov——一种立场感知的多智能体框架，用于荷兰政府文档的闭环偏见治理，在DGDB数据集上以0.880 F1刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 预设偏见边界本身就是一种偏见。现有方法存在三重挑战：判别式分类器仅捕获表面规律、缺乏规范依据；零样本LLM常采取泛化立场、过度标记模糊行政用语；固定分类体系承袭封闭世界假设，遗漏新兴本地目标群体。
AI.method: MARS-Gov整合法律检索、开放集目标筛查、专业化陪审员、保守路由与改写验证。当筛查发现未被覆盖的群体时，动态实例化"第10位陪审员"，在固定陪审团之外进行审议。
AI.result: 在DGDB上取得0.880 F1的新SOTA，较最强零样本LLM检测器提升20.2个点（相对提升29.8%），较最佳有监督荷兰语编码器提升6.8个点，同时将不必要干预降至2.5%。留一类别（LOCO）评估中，被留出类别召回率达85.1% Correct@1与93.8% Correct@3。
AI.conclusion: 立场感知的多智能体闭环治理框架可在保持语义不失真的前提下有效检测并缓解行政文档中的偏见语言，并通过动态陪审员机制突破固定分类体系的封闭世界限制，具备开放集泛化能力。

title: IntrinSync: Joint Intrinsic Decomposition and Reciprocal Rendering
summary: Inverse rendering decomposes an image into intrinsic properties such as appearance, illumination, geometry, and material, yet these properties are inherently interdependent. A reliable decomposition should produce intrinsic maps that are not only individually plausible, but also mutually compatible in explaining the image. However, existing methods either model intrinsic channels in isolation or treat inverse and forward rendering as separate processes, leaving the interdependence underexploited. In this paper, we introduce IntrinSync, a unified framework that captures this interdependence through joint-channel modeling and reciprocal inverse-forward rendering. At the channel level, we jointly decompose an input RGB into albedo, shading, surface normal, roughness, and metallic maps through a 1-to-N mapping, enabling information exchange across channels throughout generation. At the process level, we establish inverse-forward reciprocity through a dual cycle-consistent objective that aligns corresponding predictions across a closed loop. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves competitive intrinsic estimation and forward rendering performance, improving coherence and physical consistency. Beyond decomposition, IntrinSync provides a physically grounded interface for image editing, allowing intrinsic properties to be explicitly manipulated and rendered back into RGB images.

AI.tldr: IntrinSync 是一个统一框架，通过联合通道建模与逆-正渲染互惠机制捕捉本征属性间的相互依赖，实现更连贯、物理一致的本征分解与图像编辑。
AI.motivation: 逆向渲染需将图像分解为外观、光照、几何、材质等本征属性，但这些属性本质相互依赖。可靠分解要求各本征图不仅各自合理，还需在解释图像时相互兼容。然而现有方法要么孤立建模各本征通道，要么将逆向与正向渲染视为独立过程，未能充分利用这种相互依赖。
AI.method: 提出 IntrinSync 统一框架，在通道层面以 1-to-N 映射将输入 RGB 联合分解为 albedo、shading、表面法线、粗糙度、金属度图，实现各通道生成过程中的信息交换；在过程层面通过双循环一致性目标建立逆向-正向渲染互惠，使闭环中对应预测相互对齐。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在本征估计与正向渲染上均取得有竞争力的性能，提升了连贯性与物理一致性。此外，IntrinSync 提供了物理可解释的编辑接口，可显式操控本征属性并渲染回 RGB 图像。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合通道建模与逆-正渲染互惠，IntrinSync 有效利用本征属性间的相互依赖，提升分解的连贯性与物理一致性，并为图像编辑提供物理可解释的交互界面。

title: ActiveMedAgent: Cost-Aware Trajectory Learning for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis
summary: Clinical diagnosis is inherently sequential: clinicians escalate from cheap to costly tests only when additional evidence is expected to resolve diagnostic uncertainty. We present ActiveMedAgent, a framework that brings this cost-aware sequential logic to multimodal medical AI. Given a frozen, API-accessed vision-language model, ActiveMedAgent tracks probability distributions over candidate diagnoses and scores each acquisition by its per-step diagnostic utility minus cost. A lightweight MLP controller is then trained offline on these scored trajectories, learning when to request additional evidence and when to commit. Across three commonly used benchmarks, trajectory-based policy learning consistently outperforms both unguided acquisition and full-modality baselines. Notably, we identify an information overload effect. In 175 cases, the agent produces a correct diagnosis with fewer channels while the full-modality baseline fails, showing that learning what to omit can be as important as learning what to acquire.

AI.tldr: 提出 ActiveMedAgent，将临床“按需递增、成本感知”的序贯诊断逻辑引入多模态医学 AI：在冻结的 API 视觉语言模型上跟踪候选诊断分布，以“每步诊断效用减成本”为采集打分，并用轻量 MLP 控制器离线学习何时继续获取证据、何时做出诊断。三个基准上基于轨迹的策略学习优于无引导采集与全模态基线，并发现信息过载效应（175 例中智能体用更少通道正确诊断而全模态基线失败）。
AI.motivation: 临床诊断本质上是序贯的：医生仅在新增证据有望消解不确定性时，才从低成本检查升级到高成本检查。现有医学 AI 多倾向于一次性使用全部模态，忽视采集成本与“何时停止”的决策问题，因此需要把成本感知的序贯逻辑引入多模态医学 AI。
AI.method: 以冻结、经 API 访问的视觉语言模型为基础：1) 维护候选诊断上的概率分布；2) 对每个候选采集按其单步诊断效用减去成本进行打分；3) 在这些已打分轨迹上离线训练轻量 MLP 控制器，学习“请求额外证据”与“给出结论”的决策策略。整体为基于轨迹的策略学习框架，不微调底层 VLM。
AI.result: 在三个常用基准上，基于轨迹的策略学习持续优于无引导采集（unguided acquisition）与全模态基线（full-modality baselines）。同时发现信息过载效应：175 个案例中，智能体以更少通道即可给出正确诊断，而使用全部模态的基线反而失败。
AI.conclusion: 成本感知的序贯采集策略可提升多模态医学 AI 的诊断效率与效果；学会“省略什么”与学会“获取什么”同等重要，表明主动、按需的证据采集优于无差别地使用全部模态。

title: Improving Image-Based Nutrition Estimation Through Multimodal Food-Item Verification and Recovery
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: Single-image nutrition estimation can fail silently when visible foods are missed. Even when a food is correctly identified, its proposed region may not support portion estimation. We propose a framework that uses multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to inventory visible foods and separately verify food identity and whether each proposed 2D region supports portion estimation. One whole-image review uses these verification results to identify unresolved gaps and omitted foods, triggering at most one targeted recovery pass. Recovered regions are re-verified without access to the recovery prompt, then reconciled into a final item set for nutrition estimation. The framework requires no task-specific fine-tuning. Matched evaluation on common valid-output samples shows that item-level grounding improves mass accuracy across all tested settings and energy accuracy relative to an adapted retrieval baseline, with item-identity precision and recall also improving, while post-recovery visual coverage is assessed separately at inference time without ground-truth annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需任务微调的MLLM框架，通过"盘点-验证-恢复-复核"流程提升单图营养估计中食物识别与份量估计的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 单图营养估计存在两类静默失败：可见食物被漏检，以及食物虽被正确识别但其候选区域不足以支持份量估计。现有方法缺乏对识别与份量可行性的显式校验，也缺乏对遗漏项的有效补救机制。
AI.method: 利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）先盘点可见食物，并分别验证食物身份（identity）与每个候选2D区域是否支持份量估计（portion estimation）；通过一次整图复核汇总验证结果，识别未解决的缺口与被遗漏食物，触发至多一次针对性恢复（recovery）流程；恢复所得区域在无法访问恢复提示的条件下重新验证，再与原有项整合为最终食物项集合用于营养估计。整个框架无需任务特定微调。
AI.result: 在常见有效输出样本上进行的匹配评估显示：项级grounding在所有测试设置下提升了质量估计精度，相对适配的检索式基线提升了能量估计精度，同时项身份precision与recall均有改善；恢复后的视觉覆盖率在推理阶段单独评估，无需真值标注。
AI.conclusion: 通过在MLLM上引入分离式验证与单次定向恢复机制，可在不进行任务微调的情况下缓解单图营养估计中的漏检与区域不可用问题，提升身份识别与份量/能量估计的准确性，并提供无需标注的覆盖率自评估途径。

title: A Unified Score Matching Paradigm for Video Anomaly Detection and Anticipation
summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is a fundamental and safety-critical task in computer vision. Recent generative approaches detect anomalies from a distributional perspective, but remain limited by local anomaly modes. Meanwhile, video anomaly anticipation (VAA), as a proactive extension beyond post-hoc detection, introduces additional challenges. In particular, the contrastive inference paradigm in VAD, which relies on ground-truth frames, is not applicable to VAA, hindering its development. To address these challenges, we propose a unified score-driven framework, termed Uni-DSM, based on denoising score matching (DSM), which models anomaly patterns through likelihood estimation and score functions over the learned data distribution. Within this unified framework, we adopt a shared noise-conditioned score transformer backbone with scene-dependent embeddings and motion-aware weighting for distribution-level modeling. Instead of introducing separate architectures, Uni-DSM unifies VAD and VAA through different inference and supervision paradigms built upon the same score-based formulation. For VAD, we instantiate an autoregressive denoising score matching (ADSM) mechanism, which progressively accumulates anomalous evidence via autoregressive denoising, enabling enhanced perception of local modes beyond visual cues. For VAA, we extend the same architecture by incorporating a lightweight auxiliary decoder and a novel self-distilled denoising score matching (SDSM) mechanism. By constructing supervision from output discrepancies instead of relying on unavailable future ground truth, our method achieves efficient training suitable or early anomaly anticipation. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both VAD and VAA while maintaining high efficiency, establishing a unified and scalable pipeline from anomaly detection to anticipation.

AI.tldr: 提出统一评分驱动框架 Uni-DSM，基于去噪评分匹配将视频异常检测与异常预判统一，兼顾检测与预判并达 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式视频异常检测受局部异常模式限制；视频异常预判作为主动扩展更具挑战，且依赖真值帧的对比推理范式不适用于预判，制约其发展。
AI.method: 构建基于去噪评分匹配（DSM）的统一框架 Uni-DSM，通过似然估计与评分函数建模异常模式。采用共享的噪声条件评分 Transformer 主干，引入场景相关嵌入与运动感知加权进行分布级建模。检测端实例化自回归去噪评分匹配（ADSM），逐步累积异常证据；预判端复用同一架构，加装轻量辅助解码器与自蒸馏去噪评分匹配（SDSM），以输出差异构造监督替代不可得的未来真值。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，VAD 与 VAA 均取得 SOTA 性能，同时保持高效率。
AI.conclusion: Uni-DSM 以同一评分公式统一检测与预判，通过不同推理与监督范式实现，建立了从异常检测到预判的统一可扩展流程。

title: SP-DocReader: Difference-Aware Self-Play for Precise Document OCR
summary: Accurate page transcription remains difficult for vision language models under limited input and training budgets. We present SP-DocReader, a self-play framework for optical character recognition (OCR) that targets residual errors after supervised fine-tuning. Reading Discrepancy Masking aligns reference and generated model tokens through a longest common subsequence, then scores unmatched positions with their full conditioning prefixes. Focused Fidelity Loss adds direct negative log-likelihood supervision at unmatched ground-truth positions. Only the OCR module is trained, while the backbone remains frozen. We derive the combined gradient to distinguish relative score optimization from direct supervision. Compared with SFT-2, SP-DR-3 reduces Vary-600K character error rate on both backbones. On Qwen3-VL-4B, it reduces character error rate by approximately 54 percent and improves DocVQA Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS) by 3.7 points. These results show the value of focusing self-play training on the discrepancies that remain after supervised fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: SP-DocReader 是一个面向 OCR 的自博弈框架，通过阅读差异掩码与聚焦保真损失，在冻结主干、仅训练 OCR 模块的条件下显著降低字符错误率并提升 DocVQA 的 ANLS。
AI.motivation: 在有限输入与训练预算下，视觉语言模型的页面转录仍不准确；监督微调后仍存在残余错误，本文旨在针对这些残留差异进行进一步优化。
AI.method: 提出 SP-DocReader 自博弈框架：Reading Discrepancy Masking 用最长公共子序列对齐参考与生成 token，并对未匹配位置结合完整条件前缀打分；Focused Fidelity Loss 在未匹配的真实位置直接施加负对数似然监督；仅训练 OCR 模块、主干冻结，并推导联合梯度以区分相对打分优化与直接监督。
AI.result: 相比 SFT-2，SP-DR-3 在两个主干上均降低 Vary-600K 字符错误率；在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上字符错误率约降低 54%，DocVQA 的 ANLS 提升 3.7 个点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将自博弈训练聚焦于监督微调后残留的差异是有价值的。

title: Do LLMs Learn from Rewards in Context? : Rethinking the role of reward in In-Context RL
summary: LLM agents increasingly improve at inference time by accumulating experience in context rather than by updating parameters. This process is often described as in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL). Whether in-context learning (ICL) can actually play the role of RL, however, has not been tested. We study this question in its simplest form, direct ICRL, where the model conditions directly on raw trajectory-reward pairs, and ask whether the reward acts as a learning signal. Through controlled experiments on four benchmarks across six models, we find that the reward is read, but its effect is small: flipping, randomizing, or removing the reward leaves the improvement curve almost unchanged, and this holds even under meta-prompts that explicitly instruct the model to explore, exploit, or reason over rewards. Trajectories drive improvement, but not through their semantic content: shuffled or corrupted trajectories work as well as real ones. These patterns closely mirror those known in ICL, suggesting that direct ICRL is better understood as a special case of ICL than as inference-time RL. This reframing has implications for agent memory design: ICL factors such as input distribution and demonstrations may matter more than RL elements such as reward shaping and exploration.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验"上下文强化学习（ICRL）"是否真能起到RL的作用：通过四个基准、六个模型的受控实验发现，奖励虽被读取但影响极小，轨迹内容也无实质作用，直接ICRL更像是ICL的特例而非推理时RL。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在推理时越来越多地依靠在上下文中积累经验（而非更新参数）来提升性能，这一过程常被称为上下文强化学习（ICRL）。然而，上下文学习（ICL）能否真正扮演RL的角色尚未得到检验。作者希望在最简单形式——直接ICRL（模型直接以原始轨迹-奖励对为条件）上回答：奖励是否真的作为学习信号起作用。
AI.method: 在四个基准、六个模型上开展受控实验，观察奖励被翻转、随机化或移除时性能提升曲线的变化；并在显式指示模型探索、利用或对奖励进行推理的元提示（meta-prompt）条件下重复实验；同时检验轨迹语义内容的作用，例如打乱或损坏轨迹后模型表现是否仍能提升。
AI.result: 奖励确实被模型读取，但效应很小：翻转、随机化或删除奖励后，改进曲线几乎不变，即使在显式指示探索/利用/推理奖励的元提示下也是如此。轨迹是性能提升的驱动因素，但并非通过其语义内容起作用——打乱或损坏的轨迹与真实轨迹效果相当。这些模式与ICL中的已知现象高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 直接ICRL更适合被理解为ICL的一个特例，而非推理时的强化学习。这一重新定位对智能体记忆设计具有启示：输入分布、示范等ICL因素可能比奖励塑形、探索等RL要素更为重要。

title: CARE: Constrained Attention Refinement for Fine-Grained Visual Classification via Teacher-Student Distillation
summary: Fine-grained visual classification requires models to recognize subtle local traits while exposing the visual evidence behind their predictions. Class-specific attention pathways provide a natural basis for interpretable recognition, but their constrained prediction structure limits discriminative capacity and underuses intermediate representations from strong pretrained backbones. To address this problem, we propose CARE, a constrained attention refinement framework for interpretable fine-grained recognition via teacher-student distillation. CARE keeps the final prediction and explanation within a class-specific attention student, while introducing a training-only auxiliary query teacher that reads selected intermediate DINOv2 layers with learnable queries. The teacher fuses multi-level representations and transfers logit-standardized class-discriminative knowledge to the student. To further refine the explanation pathway, we design diversity and sparsity terms to regularize student attention heads, reducing redundancy and encouraging compact trait localization. Experiments on CUB, Oxford-IIIT Pet, Stanford Dogs, and Stanford Cars show that CARE achieves strong classification performance under an interpretable frozen-backbone setting, reaching 78.5% Top-1 accuracy on CUB. Faithfulness analysis with insertion and deletion metrics further indicates that the top-ranked attention regions retain class-relevant evidence for explanation.

AI.tldr: 提出CARE框架，通过教师-学生蒸馏在保持类特定注意力可解释性的同时提升细粒度识别性能。
AI.motivation: 细粒度视觉分类需要模型识别细微局部特征并展示预测依据。类特定注意力路径天然具有可解释性，但其受限的预测结构限制了判别能力，且未能充分利用强预训练骨干的中间表征。
AI.method: CARE保持最终预测与解释于类特定注意力学生网络中，引入仅在训练时使用的辅助查询教师网络，通过可学习查询读取DINOv2选定中间层，融合多层级表征并向学生传递logit标准化的类判别知识；同时设计多样性与稀疏性正则项约束学生注意力头，减少冗余并促进紧凑的特征定位。
AI.result: 在CUB、Oxford-IIIT Pet、Stanford Dogs和Stanford Cars数据集上，CARE在可解释冻结骨干设定下取得强分类性能，CUB上Top-1达78.5%；插入与删除指标的忠实性分析表明，排名靠前的注意力区域保留了类相关证据。
AI.conclusion: CARE通过教师-学生蒸馏与注意力正则化，在可解释冻结骨干框架下兼顾判别性能与解释忠实性，验证了约束注意力路径细粒度识别的有效性。

title: Local Prototype Reconstruction for Text-Compatible Speech-to-LLM Bridge Pretraining
summary: Speech-to-LLM systems often connect a frozen speech encoder to a frozen large language model (LLM) through a small trainable bridge. The bridge is usually treated as plumbing, but it in fact defines the geometry of the speech-to-LLM interface, and the pretraining objective decides whether that interface provides a reusable initialization for downstream tasks. We study a transferable bridge through two complementary properties: global alignment with the text side, and local lexical manifold compatibility, where bridge embeddings remain close to the frozen LLM's input-embedding neighbourhoods. We make this property measurable with a fixed, head-free, timestamp-free diagnostic that applies to any objective, and show that next-word prediction (NWP) and sentence-level contrastive pretraining do not fully capture token-level lexical compatibility. We then introduce Local Prototype Reconstruction (LPR), a lightweight training-only regularizer that requires each aligned bridge token to be reconstructable from a small neighbourhood of frozen LLM token embeddings, with a hard single-prototype anchor as its limiting case. On multilingual ASR and speech translation, LPR improves transfer, with the largest gains on translation and low-resource adaptation. Crucially, our independent diagnostic correlates with downstream gains across objectives, suggesting that lexical manifold compatibility is predictive of reusability for speech-to-LLM bridges.

AI.tldr: 本文将语音到LLM系统中的"桥接模块"视为决定接口几何结构的关键组件，提出全局对齐与局部词汇流形兼容性两项可迁移性质，并设计无头、无时间戳的诊断指标及训练期正则化方法LPR，实验证明词汇流形兼容性可预测下游可复用性。
AI.motivation: 现有语音到LLM系统通常将冻结语音编码器与冻结大语言模型通过小型可训练桥接模块连接，但桥接模块常被当作"管道"处理，忽视了它实际定义了语音-LLM接口的几何结构；同时预训练目标是否能为下游任务提供可复用初始化尚不明确，缺乏衡量接口质量的客观手段。
AI.method: 提出两项桥接可迁移性质：与文本侧的全局对齐，以及局部词汇流形兼容性（桥接嵌入需靠近冻结LLM输入嵌入邻域）。设计固定、无头且无时间戳的诊断指标，适用于任意目标函数。进一步提出局部原型重建（LPR）——一种轻量、仅训练期使用的正则化器，要求每个对齐后的桥接token可由冻结LLM token嵌入的小邻域重建，并以硬单原型锚定为其极限情形。
AI.result: 诊断实验表明，下一词预测（NWP）与句子级对比预训练均不能完全捕获token级词汇兼容性。在多语言ASR与语音翻译任务上，LPR提升了迁移效果，在翻译与低资源适配场景增益最大。独立诊断指标在不同目标函数下与下游增益呈相关关系。
AI.conclusion: 词汇流形兼容性对语音到LLM桥接的可复用性具有预测作用，LPR作为训练期正则化器可有效提升迁移性能，为桥接模块设计提供了新的度量与优化视角。

title: LadderEdit: Edit-Level Residual Compression for Memory-Efficient Lifelong Editing of LLMs
summary: Lifelong editing of LLMs requires storing thousands of edits after acquisition. A widely used family of approaches attaches one LoRA adapter per edit, which preserves behavior but grows linearly in storage. To address this challenge, we propose LadderEdit, a method that compresses each LoRA adapter after it is acquired. Each edit is first stored at low rank as a cheap sketch. We then check whether this sketch still satisfies the rewrite, generalization, and locality contract on probe prompts. Edits that pass keep the sketch; those that fail are promoted to a higher rank along a ladder until the contract is met. Because every edit retains some representation, coverage is maintained, and only hard edits consume more rank. Across ZsRE, CounterFact, and WikiBigEdit benchmarks on LLaMA-3-8B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-7B, LadderEdit tracks exact LoRA storage at 5.2x less memory and remains effective at 50,000 sequential edits.

AI.tldr: LadderEdit：为终身编辑中的每个 LoRA adapter 建立低秩草图，通过探针验证契约，失败者沿"阶梯"逐级升秩，从而以 5.2 倍更低内存逼近精确 LoRA 存储的效果。
AI.motivation: LLM 终身编辑需在获取后存储数千条编辑。主流做法为每条编辑挂接一个 LoRA adapter，虽能保持行为不变，但存储量随编辑数线性增长，成本难以承受。因此需要一种在保持编辑效果（改写、泛化、局部性）的前提下压缩每条 adapter 的方法。
AI.method: 每条编辑先以低秩形式存为廉价 sketch；在探针提示上检验该 sketch 是否仍满足改写、泛化与局部性契约；通过者保留 sketch，未通过者沿"阶梯"逐步提升秩直至满足契约。因每条编辑均保留一定表征，覆盖得以维持，且只有困难编辑才占用更高秩。
AI.result: 在 ZsRE、CounterFact、WikiBigEdit 三个基准与 LLaMA-3-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B 三个模型上，LadderEdit 以约 5.2 倍更少内存达到与精确 LoRA 存储相当的水平，并在 50,000 次顺序编辑下仍保持有效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，自适应秩分配的压缩策略可在不牺牲编辑质量的前提下显著降低终身编辑的存储开销，并具备大规模顺序编辑的可扩展性。

title: VGGTWorld-VLA: Intent-Conditioned 3D World Evolution for Autonomous Driving
summary: VGGT provides a strong foundation for geometry-centric world models by recovering unified 3D scene geometry from visual observations. Although recent extensions enable temporal 3D prediction, their future evolution remains weakly conditioned on driving intentions and actions, limiting their ability to model alternative action-dependent futures. We propose VGGTWorld-VLA, an intention-conditioned extension of VGGT-World for controllable 3D world evolution in autonomous driving. First, we introduce an action--semantic conditioning mechanism that injects complementary driving semantics and ego-motion representations into the future-token stream, enabling different future geometry predictions for the same observed scene under alternative ego actions. Second, we develop a geometry--language--action bridge that adapts historical geometry, VLA semantic features, and maneuver and trajectory representations for joint conditioning of future geometry prediction. We evaluate future geometry prediction on NAVSIM, while conditioning ablations further examine the contributions of semantic and action information. Compared with the baseline, our method demonstrates competitive geometry prediction performance. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of semantic and action conditioning. These results demonstrate the potential of semantic and action conditioning for controllable VGGT-based world prediction in autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 提出 VGGTWorld-VLA，将 VGGT-World 扩展为意图/动作条件的可控 3D 世界演化模型，用于自动驾驶未来几何预测。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 VGGT 的时序 3D 预测其未来演化较弱地受驾驶意图与动作条件约束，难以建模不同动作下的多种可能未来。
AI.method: 1) 动作-语义条件机制：将驾驶语义与自车运动表示注入未来 token 流，使同一观测场景在不同自车动作下产生不同未来几何；2) 几何-语言-动作桥接：融合历史几何、VLA 语义特征与机动/轨迹表示，联合条件化未来几何预测。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM 上评估未来几何预测，与基线相比取得有竞争力的几何预测性能；条件消融实验验证了语义与动作信息的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 语义与动作条件化对基于 VGGT 的可控世界预测具有潜力，支持自动驾驶中的动作依赖式未来几何建模。

title: AutoAdapt: Reliable Few-Shot Adaptation under Clinical Distribution Shifts
summary: Large pretrained clinical models provide a practical way to reuse learned prior knowledge across hospitals by adapting models to them. In practice, a target hospital may only have a small labeled patient cohort, a setting commonly referred to as few-shot adaptation. This requires making multiple decisions, such as which pretrained model to adapt, how much of the model to update, and which patients to use. Nevertheless, this process faces two primary challenges. First, the best adaptation strategy varies across clinical tasks. Second, evaluating and comparing candidate strategies becomes unreliable due to the small patient cohort. In this work, we introduce AutoAdapt with two core designs to deal with these challenges. The Adapter defines an extensible space of adaptation recipes, and the Automator forms a weighted recipe combination from evidence within the adaptation patients. We propose a reliability rule to ensure that only the most effective strategy on most available patients will be selected. These selected strategies then form a combination for effective few-shot adaptation. We conduct extensive experiments across critical care, emergency care, and diagnostic datasets, and the results show that AutoAdapt consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance using only a few patients for adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出 AutoAdapt 框架，通过 Adapter 定义可扩展的适应策略空间，Automator 基于适应患者证据形成加权策略组合，并引入可靠性准则筛选策略，实现小样本临床模型适应。
AI.motivation: 临床预训练模型跨医院复用时，目标医院通常只有少量标注患者队列（few-shot adaptation），需要决策选择哪个预训练模型、更新多少参数、使用哪些患者。此过程面临两大挑战：最优适应策略随临床任务变化；小队列导致候选策略评估与比较不可靠。
AI.method: AutoAdapt 包含两个核心设计：Adapter 构建可扩展的适应"配方"（recipe）空间；Automator 从适应患者的证据中形成加权的配方组合。同时提出可靠性准则，确保只选择在大多数可用患者上最有效的策略，最终将选中的策略组合用于小样本适应。
AI.result: 在重症监护、急诊护理和诊断数据集上开展大量实验，结果表明 AutoAdapt 仅用少量患者进行适应即可持续取得最先进（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: AutoAdapt 通过策略空间建模与可靠性筛选，缓解了临床小样本适应中策略依赖任务与评估不可靠的问题，实现了高效、稳定的跨医院模型复用。

title: VAMR: Multi-Question Agentic Reasoning for Efficient Long-Form Video Understanding
summary: Long-form video understanding often involves multiple questions about different aspects of the same recording. Yet existing video agents typically process each question through an isolated tool-use trajectory. This repeatedly restarts video exploration and memory construction, missing opportunities to acquire evidence jointly and progressively build a shared understanding that supports the complete question set. We introduce \textbf{VAMR} (\textbf{V}ideo \textbf{A}gent for \textbf{M}ulti-Question \textbf{R}easoning), which coordinates all questions about a video through one shared tool-use trajectory. At each round, a persistent policy model can invoke tools for one or more unresolved questions and submit answers for questions with sufficient evidence. Question-conditioned visual perception retrieves fine-grained clues for several questions in one call, while layered multi-question memory integrates reusable context into a shared video story and preserves separate evidence for individual questions. After supervised fine-tuning initializes this interaction protocol, we propose question-horizon policy optimization (\qhpo) to optimize shared trajectories in which questions progress and finish at different rounds. Specifically, a question-level critic estimates the value of each active question, while round alignment maps each question advantage to the rounds that directly serve it before the aligned advantages are aggregated to optimize the shared actor. Across LVBench, Video-Holmes, and LongVideoBench, VAMR achieves the highest accuracy overall and the fewest reasoning rounds among iterative methods.
