On LVBench, it reaches 62.1\% accuracy, exceeding VideoARM by \textbf{4.3} points while reducing reasoning rounds and processed frames by \textbf{85.9\%} and \textbf{61.4\%}.

AI.tldr: 提出VAMR多问题视频智能体，用单一共享工具调用轨迹协同回答同一长视频的多个问题，并设计QHPO强化学习优化异步完成的问题轨迹，在多个基准上取得最高精度与最少推理轮数。
AI.motivation: 现有视频智能体对每个问题采用独立的工具调用轨迹，反复重启视频探索与记忆构建，无法联合获取证据、逐步构建共享理解以支撑整套问题，导致效率低、冗余计算多。
AI.method: VAMR通过一条共享工具使用轨迹协调同一视频的所有问题：每轮由持久化策略模型为一个或多个未解决问题调用工具，并对证据充足的问题提交答案；采用问题条件视觉感知在一次调用中为多问题检索细粒度线索；使用分层多问题记忆，将可复用上下文整合为共享视频故事并保留各问题独立证据。先以监督微调初始化交互协议，再提出问题视野策略优化（QHPO），用问题级critic估计每个活跃问题的价值，并通过轮次对齐将问题优势映射到直接服务该问题的轮次，聚合后优化共享actor。
AI.result: 在LVBench、Video-Holmes和LongVideoBench上，VAMR总体精度最高，且在迭代方法中推理轮数最少。在LVBench上达到62.1%准确率，超过VideoARM 4.3个百分点，同时将推理轮数和处理帧数分别减少85.9%和61.4%。
AI.conclusion: 共享轨迹的多问题协同推理能显著提升长视频理解效率与精度，QHPO可有效优化问题异步推进的共享策略。

title: IntactWorld: Joint World Modeling with Intact Features
summary: While recent video generation models synthesize highly realistic visuals, they lack a genuine understanding of intrinsic real-world logic. Existing methods attempt to understand the world by internalizing diverse world knowledge, yet constrained by computational overhead or dimensionality alignment, their learning processes inevitably compress features, causing a severe loss of structural information. To address this, we propose \textbf{IntactWorld}, a \textbf{Joint World Modeling Architecture} utilizing uncompressed \textbf{Intact Features}. Since data naturally reside on a low-dimensional manifold within a high-dimensional space, predicting the flow velocity $v$ within this uncompressed high-dimensional space induces a severe manifold gap. To successfully eliminate this optimization bottleneck, our framework instead predicts the clean feature $x_0$ at intermediate layers. Furthermore, to mitigate the computational overhead of incorporating complete world knowledge, we introduce a \textit{Full-to-Compact Training Paradigm}. By replacing raw full features with highly refined CLS tokens, this paradigm enables efficient single-branch guidance, reducing spatial memory consumption by 11.4\% and cutting inference latency by 43.8\%. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of IntactWorld, outperforming established baselines by 2.46 points on the VBench 2.0 benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出IntactWorld联合世界建模架构，利用未压缩的完整特征进行视频生成的世界知识理解，通过预测中间层干净特征缓解流形间隙，并采用全到紧凑训练范式降低计算开销，在VBench 2.0上超越基线2.46分。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能合成逼真视觉内容，但缺乏对真实世界内在逻辑的理解。已有方法试图通过内化世界知识来理解世界，但受限于计算开销或维度对齐，其学习过程不可避免地压缩特征，导致严重的结构信息损失。
AI.method: 提出IntactWorld——一种利用未压缩完整特征的联合世界建模范式。针对数据在高维空间低维流形上分布、在未压缩高维空间预测流速度v会引发流形间隙的问题，框架改为预测中间层的干净特征x0以消除优化瓶颈。此外提出全到紧凑训练范式，用高度精炼的CLS token替代原始完整特征，实现高效单分支引导。
AI.result: 该范式减少11.4%的空间内存消耗，降低43.8%的推理延迟；在VBench 2.0基准上超越既有基线2.46分，验证了IntactWorld的有效性。
AI.conclusion: IntactWorld通过保留未压缩完整特征并预测中间层干净特征，在维持世界知识理解能力的同时显著降低计算与内存开销，在视频生成的世界建模任务上取得优于基线的性能。

title: Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Registration: A Comprehensive Review, Challenges and Prospects
comment: 12 figures, 8 tables, 135 references. Review article accepted for publication in Photogrammetric Engineering and Remote Sensing (ASPS), manuscript number PERS-26-00034
summary: Multimodal remote sensing image registration is a crucial prerequisite for the collaborative processing and downstream application of remote sensing data, such as image fusion, change detection, and target recognition. However, significant variations in radiometry, geometry, scale, viewpoint, and time often exist between multimodal images. These differences, driven by varying sensor geometries, physical radiation mechanisms, imaging platforms, and environmental disturbances, pose severe challenges to achieving high-precision, robust registration. This paper systematically reviews the progress of mainstream multimodal remote sensing image registration methods. Based on their registration pipelines, existing approaches are categorized into three main types: region-based, feature-based, and deep learning-based methods. We detail the core principles, representative algorithms, advantages, and limitations of each category. Additionally, we summarize publicly available multimodal image datasets in the remote sensing domain, analyzing their specific characteristics and applicable scenarios. Finally, we highlight current bottlenecks in high-precision registration research and outline future development trends. This review aims to provide a comprehensive reference and valuable insights for researchers in related fields.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了多模态遥感图像配准的主流方法，按配准流程将现有方法分为区域、特征和深度学习三类，并总结公开数据集、瓶颈与未来趋势。
AI.motivation: 多模态遥感图像配准是图像融合、变化检测、目标识别等协同处理与下游应用的重要前提，但多模态图像间存在显著的辐射、几何、尺度、视角和时间差异，由传感器几何、物理辐射机制、成像平台和环境扰动等因素引起，给高精度、鲁棒配准带来严峻挑战。
AI.method: 综述性研究。基于配准流程，将现有多模态遥感图像配准方法归纳为三类：基于区域的方法、基于特征的方法和基于深度学习的方法；分别阐述其核心原理、代表性算法、优势与局限，并总结遥感领域公开多模态图像数据集及其特点与适用场景。
AI.result: 梳理了三类方法的原理、代表算法及优缺点，归纳了公开多模态遥感图像数据集的特征与适用场景，并指出当前高精度配准研究的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 本文为多模态遥感图像配准研究提供了系统参考，并展望了未来发展趋势，旨在为相关领域研究者提供有价值的见解。

title: MATE4D: Matrix-Guided Editable 4D Generation from a Single Image
summary: Generative models have rapidly pushed content creation be-yond 2D imagery toward dynamic 3D and 4D scene synthesis. Yet pro-ducing realistic and temporally stable 4D content from a single image is still difficult because one view provides limited structural cues and weak motion evidence. We introduce MATE4D, a framework that converts one input image into editable dynamic 4D content. Our method constructs a spatio-temporal multi-view image matrix with text-guided background manipulation, delivering coherent supervision over viewpoint, appear-ance, and motion. These synthesized observations are used to optimize 3D Gaussian primitives, which are then animated through a lightweight deformation module to form a 4D representation. The resulting scenes preserve geometry more faithfully, maintain smoother temporal behavior, and keep background edits more consistent, reducing context ambiguity and motion artifacts. Experiments on Objaverse-XL and Diffusion4D show that MATE4D outperforms strong baselines in visual quality, effi-ciency, and controllability, supporting practical AR/VR content creation.

AI.tldr: 提出MATE4D框架，从单张图像生成可编辑的动态4D内容。
AI.motivation: 单图生成逼真且时序稳定的4D内容困难，因为单一视角提供的结构线索和运动证据有限。
AI.method: 构建时空多视角图像矩阵并结合文本引导的背景操作以提供视角、外观和运动的连贯监督；用合成观测优化3D高斯原语，再通过轻量变形模块驱动其动画化，形成4D表示。
AI.result: 生成的场景几何更忠实、时序更平滑、背景编辑更一致，减少上下文歧义和运动伪影；在Objaverse-XL和Diffusion4D上，视觉质量、效率和可控性优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: MATE4D支持实际的AR/VR内容创作。

title: RAG-Stress: Probing the Limits of Evidence Reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Following retrieved evidence does not guarantee factual correctness: misleading evidence can induce a model to replace an answer it previously gave correctly. Standard accuracy measures obscure this behavior by combining answer replacement with preexisting errors. We introduce RAG-Stress, a controlled diagnostic protocol for examining the limits of evidence reliance in retrieval-augmented generation. The protocol holds the question and reference answer fixed, edits one assertion to support a designated incorrect answer, and crosses two source priority policies with three positions of the answer span within the evidence text. We measure misleading rate (MR) on each model's subset of questions answered correctly without retrieval, alongside clean accuracy on the full evaluation set. We evaluate fifteen systems spanning API models, open models, and search agents trained with reinforcement learning on TriviaQA-RC, HotpotQA, and SearchQA, with additional English and Chinese MedQA evaluations. Instructions that prioritize documents consistently produce higher MR than those permitting reliance on prior knowledge. Averaged over models and positions, the gap ranges from 10.9 to 13.5 percentage points across the three QA datasets. Mean MR follows End $>$ Beginning $>$ Middle under both policies, although individual models do not uniformly follow this ordering. A separate paired audit of 500 questions and two checkpoints supports increased harmful override without establishing a corresponding improvement in beneficial correction. These findings distinguish evidence adherence from factual reliability and motivate evaluating whether retrieved evidence preserves, replaces, or corrects a model's answers.

AI.tldr: 提出 RAG-Stress 诊断协议，隔离测量检索增强生成中对误导性证据的依赖程度，发现强制优先文档的策略显著提高误导率，且证据位置与有害覆盖行为存在系统性差异。
AI.motivation: 常规准确率指标将"答案被替换"与"原有错误"混在一起，掩盖了模型在检索证据误导下放弃原本正确答案的行为，因此需要一个受控协议来考察证据依赖的边界。
AI.method: RAG-Stress 固定问题与参考答案，仅编辑一条断言使其支持指定的错误答案，并交叉两种来源优先策略与三种答案片段在证据文本中的位置。在无检索条件下已答对的子集上测误导率（MR），同时在全评测集上测干净准确率；评测 15 个系统（API 模型、开源模型、经强化学习训练的搜索智能体），数据集为 TriviaQA-RC、HotpotQA、SearchQA，并补充中英文 MedQA。
AI.result: 要求优先文档的指令一致地比允许依赖先验知识的指令产生更高的 MR，跨三个 QA 数据集、对模型与位置平均的差距为 10.9–13.5 个百分点。平均 MR 在两种策略下均呈 End > Beginning > Middle，但单个模型并非一致遵循该顺序。对 500 个问题与两个检查点的配对审计支持有害覆盖增加，却未发现有益纠正的相应提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果将"证据依从"与"事实可靠性"区分开来，主张评测模型答案究竟是被检索证据保留、替换还是纠正。

title: WorldFact-Bench: Beyond Image-Internal Plausibility to Image-World Consistency
summary: Advances in image generation have made visual authenticity increasingly difficult to assess. Although image forensics now examines both generation artifacts and higher-level visual inconsistencies, a plausible image can still contradict real-world facts or rules. We introduce WorldFact-Bench to evaluate image-world consistency from a single image, without a predefined claim or verification target. The benchmark contains 1,274 source-aligned real-fake pairs across four verification regimes and ten semantic domains. Each pair introduces a specific, evidence-supported factual conflict while seeking to preserve non-target content and visual plausibility. Images are evaluated independently, and pair accuracy requires both members of a pair to be classified correctly. We further propose PERSIST-Agent, which organizes iterative verification around a persistent state linking candidate facts, visual observations, evidence, and verification statuses. This state guides subsequent inspection and retrieval while retaining unresolved candidates. With backbone weights fixed, harness self-optimization refines the agent's prompts and execution rules through validation feedback. Experiments reveal strong label biases in several detectors and uneven gains from retrieval. On the evaluated 8B backbones, PERSIST-Agent improves pair accuracy over both direct judgment and retrieval-augmented baselines, while ablations support the role of persistent verification state. These findings highlight the value of state-guided verification and the remaining gap between visual plausibility and factual correctness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 WorldFact-Bench 基准与 PERSIST-Agent 智能体，用于评估单张图像的"图像-世界一致性"，即视觉上合理的图像是否与真实世界事实相冲突。
AI.motivation: 图像生成技术使视觉真实性愈发难以判定。现有图像取证虽已同时考察生成痕迹与高层视觉不一致，但一张视觉上合理的图像仍可能与真实世界的事实或规则相矛盾；且单图场景下往往缺乏预定义断言或验证目标，现有方法难以覆盖此类事实性冲突。
AI.method: (1) 构建 WorldFact-Bench：包含 1,274 组源对齐的真实-伪造配对，覆盖 4 种验证机制与 10 个语义域；每对引入一个有证据支持的具体事实冲突，同时尽量保持非目标内容与视觉合理性。图像独立评估，配对准确率要求一对中两张均判对。(2) 提出 PERSIST-Agent：以持久化状态组织迭代验证，该状态关联候选事实、视觉观察、证据与验证状态，指导后续审查与检索并保留未决候选。(3) 在固定主干权重的前提下，通过验证反馈进行 harness 自优化，改进智能体的提示与执行规则。
AI.result: 实验发现若干检测器存在明显的标签偏置，检索带来的增益也不均衡。在评测的 8B 主干上，PERSIST-Agent 的配对准确率优于直接判断与检索增强基线；消融实验支持持久验证状态的作用。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了状态引导验证的价值，并揭示了视觉合理性与事实正确性之间仍存在的差距。

title: RGBD-to-3D Object Mesh Refinement via Depth Matching and Symmetry Propagation
summary: Single-view 3D reconstructors often produce plausible meshes that disagree with the input view, especially near depth discontinuities and self-occlusions. We present a lightweight, plug-and-play RGBD-to-3D refinement that improves any RGB-to-3D reconstructor without retraining. Given a depth map, we correct the visible surface by bipartite matching to back-projected depth points, mirror these corrections onto the occluded side across a detected symmetry plane, and propagate them with a smoothness solver. Every stage is closed-form, making the method orders of magnitude faster than optimization-heavy test-time refinement. On GSO and OmniObject3D with five backbones, it yields consistent gains, also with monocular pseudo-depth, benefits more from symmetry on symmetric objects, and compares favorably with prior refinement in accuracy and runtime. It further improves an RGB-D-to-mesh reconstructor and transfers to real captures with noisy sensor depth.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量、即插即用的RGBD-to-3D细化方法，可在不重新训练的情况下改进任意RGB-to-3D重建器：利用深度图通过二分图匹配校正可见表面，借助对称平面镜像校正到被遮挡一侧，再用平滑求解器传播；全程闭式解，速度远快于优化式测试时细化，并在多个数据集与骨架上取得一致增益。
AI.motivation: 单视图3D重建器常生成看似合理但与输入视图不一致的网格，尤其在深度不连续处和自遮挡区域。现有测试时细化通常依赖高开销优化，亟需一种无需重训练、快速且通用的细化方案。
AI.method: 给定深度图，先通过二分图匹配将可见表面校正到反投影的深度点上；检测对称平面后，把校正镜像到被遮挡一侧；最后用平滑求解器进行传播。每个阶段均为闭式求解，因此比优化型测试时细化快数个数量级，并且可即插即用地作用于任意RGB-to-3D重建器而无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在GSO与OmniObject3D数据集、五种骨干网络上均取得一致精度提升；使用单目伪深度时同样有效；在对称物体上从对称性获益更多；在精度与运行时间上优于已有细化方法；还能改进RGB-D-to-mesh重建器，并可迁移到带噪声传感器深度的真实采集数据。
AI.conclusion: 该闭式RGBD-to-3D细化框架通用、高效且无需重训练，能稳定提升多类重建器在合成与真实数据上的表现，为单视图3D重建的一致性校正提供了实用方案。

title: Is the Future Predictable? Modeling Future Predictability for Reliable Temporal Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable when reasoning about the future. Existing models often overlook the difference among future states, committing to specific answers even when the queried facts are inherently volatile. To capture this challenge, we introduce ChronoRegime, a future-oriented temporal reasoning task that requires models to determine whether historical temporal evidence justifies commitment to a future answer. Furthermore, we propose Confidence-Aware Temporal Reasoning (CTR), a framework that estimates future predictability from temporal dynamics and regulates answer commitment accordingly. Rather than performing unconditional forecasting, CTR commits only when the reconstructed evidence supports the target future state. Across multiple LLMs, CTR improves strict overall accuracy by 6.7 percentage points and reduces hallucination rates by 18.4 percentage points on average over the plain QA baseline. These results demonstrate that explicit predictability assessment is an effective mechanism for safer and more reliable temporal reasoning under future uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向未来的时间推理任务ChronoRegime及框架CTR，通过评估未来可预测性来决定是否作答，在多个LLM上提升严格准确率6.7个百分点并降低幻觉率18.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM在涉及未来的推理中不可靠，常忽略不同未来状态之间的差异，即使所查询事实本质上具有波动性也强行给出确定答案。
AI.method: 提出ChronoRegime任务，要求模型判断历史时间证据是否足以支撑对某个未来答案的承诺；并提出置信感知时间推理框架CTR，依据时间动态估计未来可预测性并据此调节答案承诺，仅在重构证据支持目标未来状态时才作答。
AI.result: 在多个LLM上，相较普通问答基线，CTR平均将严格总体准确率提升6.7个百分点，并将幻觉率降低18.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式的可预测性评估是未来不确定性下实现更安全、更可靠时间推理的有效机制。

title: OmniDex: Scaling Dexterous Hand Grasping to Diverse Cluttered Scenes
summary: Dexterous grasping is the foundational primitive in embodied AI, demanding massive data to train robust models. As real-world data collection is expensive, simulation has become the mainstream paradigm. Yet, while cluttered scenes best reflect real-world applications, learning to grasp within them is bottlenecked by a critical scarcity of large-scale data. To resolve this, we curate high-quality 3D objects and supporting bases, proposing a scalable seed-and-filter strategy that bypasses sluggish scene-level optimization. This yields an unprecedented benchmark comprising over 2.6 million scenes and 0.4B scene-specific grasp ground truths, featuring diverse realistic layouts paired with rich semantic and geometric observations. Furthermore, we introduce the OmniDex model to overcome the grasp multimodality and last-millimeter precision errors plaguing current generative models. By coupling Soft Winner-Takes-All learning with human-inspired physical constraints during training, and utilizing physics-driven ranking, our approach achieves robust dexterous grasping without the latency of post-optimization. Experimental results show that OmniDex model achieves state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization across diverse scenes, views, and unseen objects.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了超260万场景、4亿抓取真值的大规模杂乱场景灵巧抓取数据集（seed-and-filter策略），并提出OmniDex模型，通过Soft WTA学习与物理约束训练及物理驱动排序，实现无需后优化的鲁棒抓取，达SOTA并具强泛化性。
AI.motivation: 灵巧抓取是具身智能的基础能力，需海量数据训练；真实数据采集昂贵，仿真成为主流。但杂乱场景中最贴近实际应用，却因大规模数据稀缺而成为学习瓶颈。同时现有生成模型存在抓取多模态性与"最后一毫米"精度误差问题。
AI.method: 1) 整理高质量3D物体与支撑底座，提出可扩展的seed-and-filter策略，绕开缓慢的场景级优化，生成大规模场景与场景专属抓取真值；2) 提出OmniDex模型：训练时结合Soft Winner-Takes-All学习与类人物理约束以应对抓取多模态性，推理时采用物理驱动排序保证精度，且无需后优化带来的延迟。
AI.result: 构建了超过2.6百万场景、0.4B场景专属抓取真值（0.4 billion）的benchmark，含多样真实布局及丰富语义与几何观测；OmniDex在多样场景、视角及未见物体上取得SOTA性能与强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以大规模杂乱场景抓取数据集与OmniDex模型，同时解决了数据稀缺与生成模型精度/多模态难题，实现高效鲁棒的灵巧抓取，推动杂乱场景下灵巧抓取研究。

title: Selective Listening: Mechanism-Guided Control of Audio Influence in Large Audio-Language Models
summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) exploit multimodal evidence, yet task-irrelevant audio can alter text-reasoning decisions when listening is unnecessary. Aggregate Accuracy can hide this paired drift because audio-induced repairs and damages may cancel. Paired drift analysis and targeted interventions identify architecture-specific, intervention-sensitive late audio pathways as actionable control points. We introduce ICAP-Gate, which applies mechanism-guided, task-conditioned control to each model's pathway. Across four LALMs, two reasoning benchmarks, and environmental-sound and natural-speech interference, ICAP-Gate has lower point estimates for Influence Rate and Answer Flip than ungated inference in all 16 full-split model--condition evaluations. Fixed suppression degrades automatic speech recognition (ASR) across all four models, whereas ICAP-Gate matches ungated ASR performance by preserving the pathway for explicit audio-demand instructions. ICAP-Gate has lower paired-drift point estimates than mitigation prompting in all four evaluated settings and provides competitive stabilization relative to eight-sample Self-Consistency while using one generation per query; in controlled ARC measurements, Self-Consistency incurs $7.0$--$9.2\times$ ungated latency. These results establish selective modality influence control as a design principle for robust multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出ICAP-Gate，通过对晚期音频通路进行机制引导、任务条件化的选择性控制，抑制不必要音频对推理的干扰。
AI.motivation: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）会利用多模态证据，但当任务无需听觉时，无关音频仍可能改变文本推理决策。聚合准确率会掩盖这种成对漂移，因为音频引起的修复与损害可能相互抵消，因此需要更精细的漂移分析与干预手段。
AI.method: 通过成对漂移分析与定向干预，识别出架构特异、对干预敏感的晚期音频通路作为可操作控制点；据此提出ICAP-Gate，对每个模型的该通路施加机制引导、任务条件化的控制。
AI.result: 在4个LALM、2个推理基准以及环境声与自然语音干扰下，ICAP-Gate在全部16个全划分模型–条件评估中，Influence Rate与Answer Flip的点估计均低于无门控推理；固定抑制会损害全部4个模型的ASR表现，而ICAP-Gate在显式音频需求指令下保留该通路，ASR表现与无门控相当；在4个评估设置中成对漂移点估计均低于缓解提示；相对8样本Self-Consistency具有竞争力，且每查询仅需一次生成，而Self-Consistency在ARC上带来7.0–9.2倍无门控延迟。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，选择性模态影响控制可作为鲁棒多模态推理的设计原则。

title: 3DTexMOR: 3D Gaussian Multi-Object Removal via Texture-Space Inpainting
comment: 17 pages, including appendix. Kunxin Guang and Yonghao Zhao contributed equally
summary: 3D object removal aims to remove target objects from reconstructed scenes and complete the geometry and appearance of occluded regions. Existing NeRF- and 3DGS-based methods typically inpaint 2D images to guide 3D completion. However, complex multi-object layouts limit the surrounding context visible in each view, making 2D inpainting prone to artifacts. Inconsistent completions across views also introduce conflicting supervision and blurry reconstructions. We propose 3D Gaussian Multi-Object Removal via Texture-Space Inpainting (3DTexMOR). Our key idea is to perform inpainting in a unified texture space shared by all views. By combining complementary observations, this space provides richer context for recovering missing regions and promotes cross-view appearance consistency. We aggregate multi-view observations into texture maps, inpaint the missing regions, and reproject the completed maps into camera views to supervise Gaussian scene completion. To avoid the influence of view-dependent highlights and reflections, we decompose appearance and aggregate view-independent intrinsic attributes instead of RGB colors. We further introduce geometrically regularized Gaussian completion to constrain the geometry of the completed regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate visually plausible completions and state-of-the-art multi-object removal performance, improving PSNR by 5.8 dB and reducing LPIPS by at least 22% compared with existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出3DTexMOR，在统一纹理空间进行修复以实现3D高斯多物体移除，通过聚合多视角观测获得更丰富上下文与跨视角一致性，PSNR提升5.8 dB，LPIPS降低至少22%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于NeRF和3DGS的3D物体移除方法通常通过修补2D图像来引导3D补全。但复杂多物体布局限制了每个视角可见的周围上下文，导致2D修补易产生伪影；不同视角间补全结果不一致还会引入冲突监督，造成重建模糊。
AI.method: 提出3DTexMOR：核心是在所有视角共享的统一纹理空间中进行修复。将多视角观测聚合为纹理图，修补缺失区域，再将补全后的纹理图重投影回相机视角以监督高斯场景补全。为避免视角相关高光与反射影响，分解外观并聚合视角无关的本征属性而非RGB颜色。此外引入几何正则化高斯补全以约束补全区域的几何。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法实现了视觉上合理的补全效果和当前最优（state-of-the-art）的多物体移除性能：相比现有方法PSNR提升5.8 dB，LPIPS降低至少22%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在统一纹理空间中聚合互补观测进行修复，可提供更丰富的上下文并促进跨视角外观一致性，从而有效解决多物体移除中的上下文受限与视角不一致问题，实现高质量3D场景补全。

title: Dissecting Representation Structure in Vision Transformers: A Rigorous Architectural Study
summary: Representation structure is crucial for understanding Vision Transformer (ViT) architectures and their generalization behavior. However, prior studies neither isolate nor analyze module-level features nor investigate how their interactions contribute to performance estimation. In this work, we conduct the first rigorous analysis of feature information across diverse architectural scales, empirically uncover the relationship between ViT representation and generalization behavior, and leverage these insights to guide efficient ViT design. Our contributions are fivefold: Across diverse architectural scales, 1) We identify feature collapse at initialization, which leads to redundancy, and propose a reduction scheme to mitigate this issue. 2) We quantify feature information using entropy and the minimum eigenvalue, demonstrating that these metrics serve as reliable indicators for generalization prediction. 3) We show that feature in the token space provides a more faithful representation than those in embedding space. 4) We discover an unexpected finding: features produced by linear submodules within ViT layers are critical for the prediction of generalization performance. 5) Our proposed proxy improves the correlation ranking by 18-48% over prior baselines and can effectively identify ViT architectures that achieve higher accuracy at lower or comparable computational cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统分析ViT模块级特征信息，揭示其与泛化行为的关系，并提出基于熵与最小特征值的泛化预测代理，同时用于指导高效ViT设计。
AI.motivation: 现有研究未隔离或分析模块级特征，也未探讨模块间特征交互如何影响性能估计，因此ViT表示结构与泛化行为的关系尚不清晰。
AI.method: 在不同架构尺度下对ViT特征信息进行严格分析：识别初始化时的特征坍缩并提出去冗余方案；用熵和最小特征值量化特征信息；比较token空间与embedding空间特征；分析ViT层内线性子模块特征的贡献，并据此构建泛化预测代理指标。
AI.result: 熵和最小特征值可作为泛化预测的可靠指标；token空间特征比embedding空间更忠实；层内线性子模块产生的特征对泛化预测至关重要；所提代理相比基线将相关性排序提升18–48%，并能识别在更低或相当计算成本下获得更高精度的ViT架构。
AI.conclusion: 模块级特征信息分析可有效刻画ViT表示与泛化行为，并为高效ViT架构设计提供可操作的指导依据。

title: Bridging KV-Cache Quantization and Linear Attention: From Theory to Pretrained Weight Migration
summary: KV-cache quantization and linear attention are two representative approaches to tackling the storage and computational costs of Transformers. KV-cache quantization compresses individual KV entries into discrete codes but retains all entries, whereas linear attention recurrently aggregates multiple historical KV contributions into a fixed-size continuous state but can introduce interference. This contrast raises the question of whether per-KV compression and multi-KV aggregation can be bridged within a single mechanism for efficient attention. We identify RAM-Net as such a bridge through soft assignments over a discrete address space. These assignments determine recurrent updates to the continuous slot state associated with each address. Under a restricted RAM-Net construction, we prove that soft address assignments extend hard quantized matching to a separable read-write overlap that locally approximates full-attention similarity and supports recurrent aggregation. These connections further enable Transformer-to-RAM-Net weight migration through a new path based on a soft-quantized intermediate construction. Across nine pretrained Transformer models from 0.3B to 7B parameters, RAM-Net recovers an average of 87.1% of the teachers' accuracy gains over random guessing across six commonsense and knowledge tasks using only a 500M-token budget per model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RAM-Net，通过离散地址空间上的软分配将 KV 缓存量化与线性注意力统一，并实现 Transformer 到 RAM-Net 的权重迁移。
AI.motivation: KV 缓存量化保留全部条目但压缩为离散码，线性注意力则将多历史 KV 聚合为固定尺寸连续状态但引入干扰，二者各有取舍，亟需统一机制以兼顾高效性与表达能力。
AI.method: 将 RAM-Net 视为二者的桥梁：通过离散地址空间上的软分配驱动对每个地址对应连续槽状态的循环更新；在受限构造下证明软地址分配可将硬量化匹配扩展为可分离读写重叠，从而局部近似全注意力相似度并支持循环聚合；据此提出基于软量化中间构造的 Transformer 到 RAM-Net 权重迁移路径。
AI.result: 在 9 个 0.3B 至 7B 参数的预训练 Transformer 上，每个模型仅用 500M token 预算，在 6 个常识与知识任务上平均恢复教师模型相对随机猜测准确率增益的 87.1%。
AI.conclusion: 软分配机制可在单一框架内统一逐 KV 压缩与多 KV 聚合，验证了 RAM-Net 作为高效注意力桥梁的有效性及权重迁移的可行性。

title: GATOR: Generative and Agentic 3D Object Reconstruction From Casual Images
summary: Reconstructing complete, scene-aligned 3D objects from casual images requires integrating sparse, uncertain observations and inferring surfaces hidden by occlusions. We present GATOR, a generative and agentic framework that recovers textured object assets and their scene-relative pose from one or more images. Our local modality mixer couples patch-aligned RGB, target-mask, and pointmap features before cross-view reasoning, preserving scene context while distinguishing the target from its surroundings. Text-guided semantic conditioning complements these spatial cues with category names and object captions through stage-specific adapters for structure, geometry, and appearance generation. The generated asset initializes a multimodal agent, providing instance-specific geometry and pose for targeted structural and texture refinement through an observation-guided edit-render-review loop. Across synthetic objects, cluttered tabletops, and indoor scenes, GATOR achieves strong geometric and appearance fidelity while recovering scene-relative pose from sparse observations. Time-budget comparisons and scene-level simulation further demonstrate the reconstruction efficiency and simulation readiness. Project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/gator/

AI.tldr: GATOR是一个生成式与智能体结合的框架，可从单张或多张随意拍摄的图像中重建完整、与场景对齐的带纹理3D物体资产，并恢复其相对场景的位姿。
AI.motivation: 从随意图像重建完整且与场景对齐的3D物体，需要整合稀疏、不确定的观测，并推断被遮挡的隐藏表面，这具有较大挑战性。
AI.method: 提出局部模态混合器，在跨视角推理前耦合块对齐的RGB、目标掩码与点图特征，保留场景上下文并区分目标与背景；采用文本引导的语义条件，通过针对结构、几何与外观的阶段性适配器引入类别名称和物体描述；生成资产用于初始化多模态智能体，提供实例特定的几何与位姿，并通过观测引导的“编辑—渲染—审查”循环进行结构与纹理细化。
AI.result: 在合成物体、杂乱桌面和室内场景上，GATOR在几何与外观保真度方面表现良好，并能从稀疏观测中恢复场景相对位姿；时间预算对比与场景级仿真进一步验证了重建效率与仿真可用性。
AI.conclusion: GATOR能够从稀疏、随意的图像观测中高效重建完整且场景对齐的带纹理3D物体资产，并具备面向仿真应用的潜力。

title: The Lattice of Transition Laws
summary: Diffusion and autoregression (AR) have long been seen as different categories of generative models, with diffusion specialising in continuous fields and AR specialising in discrete tokens. Recent work seeks to combine the advantages of the two models, and each hybrid fixes its decoding schedule by design. In this paper, we ask whether the performance of decoding schedules of one model can be predicted before decoding at a fixed number of steps. We describe diffusion, AR, and models in between as paths on one corruption lattice, and define the cost of a schedule as the dependence its parallel steps discard. The cost shows that the fewest steps of a zero-cost schedule are set by the geometry of the data, in the same way for tokens and for continuous fields. In particular, for data that are Markov on a graph and dependent along its paths, the fewest steps equal the graph's treedepth, which is logarithmic in the length of a sequence and linear in the side length of a grid. With fewer steps than the treedepth, every schedule pays a positive cost, whose ranking we predict before decoding with a kernel of pairwise dependence estimated from pretrained weights. Across text generation, image generation, and video generation, we verify most of the predictions about the rankings of different schedules under different metrics and benchmarks. This work therefore provides a design principle for decoding for future AR models, diffusion models, and anything in between. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/The-Lattice-of-Transition-Laws.

AI.tldr: 论文将扩散模型、自回归模型及其中间形式统一为"腐蚀格"上的路径，用"并行步丢弃的依赖"定义调度代价，揭示零代价调度的最少步数由数据几何决定（如马尔可夫图数据的树深），并可在解码前预测不同调度性能排序。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型擅长连续场、自回归擅长离散token，近期混合模型试图结合两者优势，但每种混合方法的解码调度由设计固定，缺乏统一理论来判断调度优劣、也无法在解码前预测性能。
AI.method: 将扩散、自回归及中间模型描述为单一腐蚀格上的路径；把调度代价定义为并行步所丢弃的依赖；用数据几何分析零代价调度的最少步数；对图上马尔可夫数据证明最少步数等于图的树深；并利用从预训练权重估计的成对依赖核，在解码前预测不同调度代价的排序。
AI.result: 证明最少步数由数据几何决定（token与连续场一致）；图上马尔可夫数据的最少步数等于树深，序列长为对数级、网格边长为线性级；少于树深时任何调度代价为正，其排序可在解码前预测；在文本、图像、视频生成任务中，多数关于不同度量与基准下调度排序的预测得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来自回归模型、扩散模型及其中间形式的解码提供了一条设计原则，即通过腐蚀格与调度代价理论指导调度选择，实现可预测的高效解码。

title: How Firm Should a Grasp Be?
summary: An ideal robot grasp is firm enough to securely handle an object, yet gentle enough to avoid damaging it. Achieving this balance requires knowledge of the object's material properties, such as its mass, elasticity, and surface friction. These properties, however, are seldom precisely known a priori. In this work, we propose a visuotactile approach to estimating material properties in real time, during the process of grasping. Our method uses these estimated properties to determine the minimum grasp force required to handle the object. We contribute a new dataset of real-world objects (fruits and vegetables) with measured physical properties (shape, mass, elasticity, and friction), which we use to construct our force estimation model via simulations. We experimentally validate our approach to grasp force control using a robot with a parallel-jaw gripper. We demonstrate our system's ability to gently grasp a wide variety of objects, in each case adapting to their unique physical properties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于视觉-触觉融合的方法，在抓取过程中实时估计物体材质属性（质量、弹性、表面摩擦），据此确定抓取所需最小夹持力，并通过平行夹爪机器人验证了系统对多种物体的自适应轻柔抓取能力。
AI.motivation: 理想抓取需兼顾牢固与轻柔：既要不掉落物体，又要避免损坏。这依赖于对物体材质属性（如质量、弹性、表面摩擦）的了解，而此类属性通常无法先验精确获知。因此需要在抓取过程中实时估计这些属性，并以此确定最小抓取力。
AI.method: 1) 提出视觉-触觉（visuotactile）融合方法，在抓取过程中实时估计材质属性；2) 利用估计属性计算处理物体所需的最小夹持力；3) 构建一个新的真实世界物体数据集（水果与蔬菜），并测量其形状、质量、弹性和摩擦等物理属性；4) 基于该数据集通过仿真构建力估计模型。
AI.result: 在配备平行夹爪的机器人上进行了抓取力控制的实验验证；系统能够轻柔抓取多种类别的物体，并在每种情况下自适应其独特的物理属性。
AI.conclusion: 实时视觉-触觉材质属性估计结合最小夹持力模型，可实现对多样物体的自适应轻柔抓取，验证了该方法的有效性。

title: SafeInferCom: Safe Inference-Time Compute via Verifier-Guided Mid-Generation Intervention for Robotic Task Planning
summary: Large Reasoning Language Models (LRLMs) enable multi-step reasoning for robotic task planning, but continued reasoning can overwrite valid intermediate plans or leave constraint violations unresolved, reducing planning reliability and wasting inference-time computation. We develop an inference-time monitor that exposes and verifies intermediate plans without disrupting the original decoding trajectory. Building on this monitor, we propose SafeInferCom, a formal verifier-guided framework that preserves valid intermediate plans and directs error correction during generation. Experiments across multiple LRLMs and planning domains reveal reasoning-response inconsistency and limited self-correction under one-shot inference. SafeInferCom improves planning success and accelerates error correction relative to one-shot inference. When combined with iterative refinement, it further improves success while reducing token usage compared with refinement alone. We additionally evaluate SafeInferCom in VirtualHome and provide a real-world robotic-arm demonstration.

AI.tldr: 提出推理时监控器与SafeInferCom框架，通过形式化验证器保留有效中间规划并指导生成中的错误纠正，提升大推理模型的机器人任务规划可靠性与效率。
AI.motivation: 大推理语言模型用于机器人任务规划时，持续推理可能覆盖有效中间规划或遗留约束违规，降低规划可靠性并浪费推理算力。
AI.method: 开发推理时监控器，在不干扰原始解码轨迹的前提下暴露并验证中间规划；基于该监控器构建SafeInferCom形式化验证器引导框架，保留有效中间规划并在生成过程中直接纠正错误。
AI.result: 在多种大推理模型与规划域上的实验揭示了推理-响应不一致及单次推理下自我纠正能力有限；SafeInferCom相对单次推理提升了规划成功率并加速错误纠正；与迭代精炼结合时，成功率进一步提升且相比单独精炼减少token消耗；并在VirtualHome及真实机械臂演示中验证。
AI.conclusion: 形式化验证器引导的推理时干预可有效提升机器人任务规划的可靠性并优化推理时算力使用。

title: Harness Compilation: Which Decisions Should a Small Vision-Language Model Keep?
summary: Small vision-language models may be able to read external evidence yet struggle to obtain it. We introduce Harness Compilation (HC), an offline procedure that adapts the division of work between a frozen small VLM and its external harness. A large teacher uses student execution traces to revise reusable content and control, while a separate validation set selects the deployed harness. Deployment requires neither weight updates nor teacher calls. Across seven visual question-answering settings with students of at most 9B parameters, HC improves scores over bare students by 9.9-23.9 points, averaged over three independent builds per setting. Interventions on five runtime decision types (invocation, selection, argument generation, evidence integration and abstention) show why this allocation matters: requesting evidence and generating open queries can be costly, whereas bounded choices and reading supplied text can remain useful student work. Fact cards benefit all ten evaluated students, but decision policies transfer unevenly. Recompilation for a new student model helps when the transferred interface no longer fits the student. With 100 practice items, HC exceeds answer-only LoRA on three tasks. Larger training budgets can match or surpass a fixed harness, while combining the two improves SlideVQA beyond either alone. These findings support allocating work from measured student behavior rather than uniformly removing decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出Harness Compilation（HC）：用大教师模型基于小学生VLM的执行轨迹离线改写外部工具（harness）的内容与控制，并由验证集选择部署方案；部署时无需更新权重或调用教师。七个VQA设置（学生≤9B）平均提升9.9–23.9分。
AI.motivation: 小视觉语言模型能读外部证据但难以主动获取证据，即"读得懂、拿不到"；现有做法常一刀切地移除决策或依赖在线教师调用，成本高且未必适配具体学生。
AI.method: HC为离线流程：冻结小学生VLM，大教师用学生执行轨迹修订可复用的内容与控制策略，独立验证集选择最终harness。并对五类运行时决策（调用、选择、参数生成、证据整合、弃答）做干预分析；对比answer-only LoRA、固定harness及两者结合。
AI.result: 七个VQA设置、每设置三次独立构建平均提升9.9–23.9分；事实卡片对全部十个学生有益，但决策策略迁移效果不均；换学生需重编译；100个练习样本即超过answer-only LoRA（三个任务）；更大训练预算可媲美/超过固定harness，二者结合在SlideVQA上进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 应按测量到的学生行为来分配工作，而非统一削减决策权限；主动请求证据与生成开放式查询代价高，受约束的选择与读取给定文本更适合留给学生。

title: MiniVer-V: Identifying Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Short Video Verification
summary: A core challenge in short-video fact-checking is identifying which evidence is sufficient to support a verification conclusion. Existing approaches either give the verifier all available evidence, introducing noise, or select evidence by topical relevance, which conflates relatedness with sufficiency. We identify evidential sufficiency as the selection criterion: whether a subset of evidence is adequate to support a confident verdict without redundancy. We introduce MiniVer-V, a benchmark of 195 short videos with three-way verdict annotations (supported, refuted, insufficient) and 5,510 multimodal evidence units spanning visual keyframes, speech transcripts, and web-retrieved external sources. We propose a two-layer verification framework that separates claim-video consistency, assessed from internal evidence, from factual verdict determination, which additionally requires external corroboration. On top of it, a sufficiency-driven greedy search assembles evidence until a sufficiency threshold is met and outputs insufficient when the candidate pool is exhausted, rather than forcing a verdict. With Claude Sonnet 4, the method reaches a Macro-F1 of 0.510 using 4.5 evidence units on average (16% of the full evidence set), statistically indistinguishable from the full-evidence baseline (0.518 with 27.7 units), while significantly improving recognition of insufficient cases over the same search without abstention. The efficiency result replicates with GPT-5.5 and holds only partially with an open-weight Qwen2.5-72B verifier. Ablations show that external evidence is indispensable for factual determination, while internal video evidence grounds the verdict in claim-video consistency. These findings suggest that evidence-efficient verification is achievable, and that explicit abstention is needed when evidence is genuinely inadequate.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以"证据充分性"作为短视频事实核查的证据选择标准，构建了 MiniVer-V 基准（195 个短视频、三分裁决、5,510 个多模态证据单元），并提出两层验证框架与充分性驱动的贪心搜索方法。在 Claude Sonnet 4 上以平均 4.5 个证据单元（占全集 16%）达到 Macro-F1 0.510，与使用全证据的基线（0.518，27.7 单元）在统计上无显著差异，同时显著提升"证据不足"类别的识别能力。
AI.motivation: 短视频事实核查的核心难题在于判断哪些证据足以支撑验证结论。现有方法要么把全部证据交给验证器而引入噪声，要么仅按主题相关性筛选证据，将"相关"与"充分"混为一谈。作者据此提出应以"证据充分性"——即某证据子集是否足以在无冗余情况下支撑可信裁决——作为证据选择准则。
AI.method: 1) 构建 MiniVer-V 基准：195 个短视频，含 supported/refuted/insufficient 三分裁决标注，以及 5,510 个多模态证据单元（视觉关键帧、语音转写、网络检索的外部来源）。2) 提出两层验证框架：第一层评估"主张—视频一致性"（基于内部证据），第二层进行事实裁决判定（额外需要外部证据佐证）。3) 在框架之上设计充分性驱动的贪心搜索：不断聚合证据直至满足充分性阈值；若候选池耗尽则输出 insufficient，而非强行给出裁决。
AI.result: 在 Claude Sonnet 4 上，方法以平均 4.5 个证据单元（占完整证据集的 16%）取得 Macro-F1 0.510，与全证据基线（0.518，27.7 个单元）无统计显著差异；相比不含弃权的相同搜索，显著提升了"证据不足"案例的识别率。效率结论在 GPT-5.5 上可复现，在开源权重 Qwen2.5-72B 验证器上仅部分成立。消融实验表明：外部证据对事实裁决不可或缺，而内部视频证据使裁决锚定于主张—视频一致性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明证据高效的验证是可行的，且在证据确实不充分时需要显式弃权（abstention）。

title: Breaking the Group Size Barrier: Parameter-Efficient Group Dance Generation with Chain-of-Dancers
summary: Group dance generation aims to synthesize coordinated multi-dancer choreography from music, with broad applications in animation and interactive content creation. This task requires modeling dense inter-person dependencies to ensure spatial coordination, while naturally preserving individual dancer identities. Existing approaches model all dancers jointly with end-to-end transformers, which tie the architecture to a fixed group size and entangle per-dancer identities across frames. We propose ChainDance, a scalable framework that reformulates group dance generation as a Chain-of-Dancers: a sequential decomposition over per-dancer conditional distributions, allowing a single model to scale across variable group sizes without retraining and naturally preserving per-dancer identity. Built on a frozen single-dancer diffusion backbone, ChainDance introduces two lightweight modules: a Role-Aware Text Encoder (RATE) for per-dancer semantic conditioning, and a Group-Aware Motion Encoder (GAME) that aggregates previously generated dancers via a distance-weighted graph convolutional network, and incorporates a training-free noise optimization procedure at inference time to enforce global spatial coherence. Experiments on AIOZ-GDance demonstrate that ChainDance achieves state-of-the-art motion quality and group coordination while structurally preserving per-dancer identity, with $3$-$4\times$ fewer parameters and requiring $3$-$6\times$ less training time compared to prior approaches.

AI.tldr: ChainDance 将群舞生成重构为"舞者链"式的逐人条件分解，基于冻结的单人扩散骨干，仅加两个轻量模块，即可支持可变人数、保持个体身份，并在 AIOZ-GDance 上以更少参数和训练时间取得最优效果。
AI.motivation: 群舞生成需同时建模密集的人与人依赖以保证空间协调，又要保持每位舞者的个体身份。现有方法用端到端 Transformer 联合建模所有舞者，导致架构绑定固定团队规模，且跨帧的个体身份相互纠缠，难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出 ChainDance：把群舞生成重写为 Chain-of-Dancers，即对逐舞者条件分布的序列化分解，使单一模型可跨人数规模扩展而无需重训，并天然保持个体身份。它建立在冻结的单人扩散骨干上，引入两个轻量模块：Role-Aware Text Encoder（RATE）用于逐舞者语义条件；Group-Aware Motion Encoder（GAME）通过距离加权图卷积网络聚合已生成舞者。推理阶段还加入免训练的噪声优化过程以强制全局空间一致性。
AI.result: 在 AIOZ-GDance 数据集上，ChainDance 取得最优的动作质量与群体协调性，并结构化地保持逐舞者身份，同时相比现有方法参数量减少 3–4 倍、训练时间减少 3–6 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过序列化分解与冻结骨干加轻量模块的设计，ChainDance 在可变人数群舞生成中兼顾协调性与身份保持，并显著提升参数与训练效率，为可扩展的群舞生成提供了新范式。

title: Attributing HOW, Not Just WHICH: Counterfactual Response Trajectories for Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image generation, yet tracing their outputs to individual training examples remains challenging. Existing attribution methods often compress factor-specific effects into scalar responses, making distinct internal changes indistinguishable. This is particularly limiting for diffusion models, where semantic factors emerge through evolving representation dynamics during denoising. We therefore reformulate diffusion data attribution as attributing factor-induced internal response trajectories. In this paper, we propose a novel Concept Attribution method through Dynamic Trajectories(CADT). We argue that attribution should therefore ask not only \emph{which} examples matter, but also \emph{how} their influence unfolds during generation. Specifically, we construct matched counterfactual pairs at identical noisy states to isolate factor-specific representation displacements, and model their directional and magnitude evolution across denoising as dynamic attribution signatures. For each training example and generated query, CADT extracts stage-wise feature vectors and integrates them along the denoising process to form a trajectory descriptor. Applying the same construction across the training set yields a bank of factor-specific trajectory descriptors. The covariance statistics of this bank are then used to construct . CADT uses this covariance-aware positive-semidefinite kernel to calibrate the query and training representations, and compares the calibrated query trajectory with each training trajectory to produce the final training-sample attribution scores. Experiments on multiple public datasets show consistent improvements over existing diffusion attribution baselines across hierarchical, compositional, and style attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CADT，将扩散模型的数据归因从标量响应重构为“因子诱导的内部响应轨迹”归因。通过在相同噪声状态构建匹配反事实对，提取去噪各阶段的方向与幅度演化作为动态归因签名，并构建因子特定的轨迹描述子库，利用其协方差的半正定核校准查询与训练表示，最终输出训练样本归因分数，在层级、组合与风格归因任务上均优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型归因方法将因子特定效应压缩为标量响应，难以区分不同的内部变化；而扩散模型的语义因子是在去噪过程中通过不断演化的表示动态逐步形成的，标量归因无法刻画这种动态性，因此需要将归因问题重新表述为对因子诱导的内部响应轨迹的归因。
AI.method: 1) 在相同噪声状态构建匹配反事实对，隔离因子特定的表示位移；2) 将位移的方向与幅度在去噪过程中的演化建模为动态归因签名；3) 对每个训练样本与生成查询提取分阶段特征向量，沿去噪过程积分形成轨迹描述子；4) 对训练集施加相同构造，得到因子特定轨迹描述子库；5) 利用该库的协方差统计构建半正定核，对查询与训练表示进行协方差感知的校准，再比较校准后的查询轨迹与各训练轨迹，得到最终训练样本归因分数。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集上的实验表明，CADT在层级归因、组合归因与风格归因三类任务上相较现有扩散归因基线均取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 归因不仅应回答“哪些样本重要”，还应回答“其影响在生成过程中如何展开”；通过将扩散数据归因重构为动态轨迹层面的因子归因，并借助协方差感知的半正定核进行轨迹校准与比较，可有效提升归因的区分度与准确性。

title: TAP3D: Thermal-Assisted 3D Human Point Clouds
summary: Human body point clouds are a versatile representation for AI-enabled human sensing. However, existing methods using LiDAR, radar, and depth cameras suffer from inherent drawbacks in high cost, sparse reconstruction, and privacy concerns, etc. In this paper, we exploit low-cost thermal arrays and present TAP3D, the first system to reconstruct 3D human point clouds from body heat signatures, offering significant advantages in cost, density, human sensitivity, and privacy. To overcome major challenges in depth estimation, thermal interference, and multi-person separation, we propose a novel physics-informed design, which integrates a forward thermal physics model with two distinct modules: multi-primitive estimation for self-supervised joint recovery of depth and other thermal properties, and geometric perspective fusion for suppressing interference and disentangling multiple people. We implement TAP3D using a single commodity thermal array sensor and build a large-scale dataset (160K samples, 8 environments, 11 users) for evaluation. TAP3D achieves remarkable accuracy for dense point cloud generation, enabling downstream tasks like fall detection (91.46%), indoor tracking (21.86 cm MAE), and human mesh recovery (4.87 cm error). By transforming body heat into point clouds for the first time, TAP3D pioneers a new paradigm for privacy-first, fully passive human sensing for many applications. TAP3D is open-sourced at https://github.com/aiot-lab/TAP3D.

AI.tldr: TAP3D是首个利用低成本热阵列从人体热特征重建3D人体点云的系统，通过物理先验设计解决深度估计与多人分离难题，在隐私、成本和密度上具优势。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LiDAR、雷达、深度相机的人体点云方法存在高成本、稀疏重建和隐私问题等固有缺陷，作者希望利用低成本热阵列实现隐私友好的人体感知。
AI.method: 提出物理先验设计，将前向热物理模型与两个模块结合：多基元估计用于自监督联合恢复深度及其他热属性，几何透视融合用于抑制干扰与分离多人；使用单个商用热阵列传感器实现。
AI.result: 构建了大规模数据集（160K样本、8种环境、11名用户）；实现高精度稠密点云生成，下游任务表现：跌倒检测91.46%、室内跟踪21.86 cm MAE、人体网格恢复4.87 cm误差。
AI.conclusion: TAP3D首次将人体热量转化为点云，开创了隐私优先、完全被动的人体感知新范式，适用于多种应用，并已开源。

title: Read What Matters: Query-Adaptive Quantization for KV Caches
summary: KV-cache entries are stored before their future queries are known, but each decoding query needs precision in different places. We study this mismatch using separate budgets for retained bits and bits fetched per query. ReadKV stores each key and value in a progressive code whose prefixes support different reconstruction precisions. For each query, it allocates key-channel prefixes using the query, computes attention from the reconstructed keys, and then allocates value-token prefixes using that attention. Stored entries remain unchanged. Each stage optimizes a calibrated distortion objective under a fixed budget; we prove exact allocation under diminishing refinement gains and relate these objectives to attention-output error. We also exhibit a finite-dimensional attention family where query-dependent access strictly outperforms every query-independent reader at the same read budget, even with unrestricted competing encoders and decoders. Across six base models, reading four bits on average from an eight-bit cache increases C4 perplexity by at most 0.66%, using about one quarter of the logical reads and half the retained capacity of a 16-bit cache. It is consistently more accurate than storing and fully reading four bits at the same payload-read budget. Retaining more bits than each query fetches is aimed at long-context decoding, where the cache bytes moved per step, rather than the weights, dominate cost. Long-context question answering and retrieval on two instruction-tuned models provide additional quality evidence. On the tested 8K-token, batch-one, single-layer workload on an NVIDIA A10G, a restricted eight-bit ReadKV reader with a two-bit mean payload-read budget has 39% lower latency than the tested TurboQuant codec.

AI.tldr: ReadKV 用渐进式编码存储 KV-cache，在固定读取预算下按查询自适应分配键/值的重构精度，读取精度严格优于查询无关读取，并以更低延迟实现近无损生成质量。
AI.motivation: KV-cache 条目在写入时其未来查询尚不可知，而不同解码查询需要不同位置的高精度，形成“存储先于查询”的失配。论文用“保留比特预算”与“每查询读取比特预算”两个独立维度刻画该失配，并针对长上下文解码中缓存字节搬运成为主要开销的场景，追求在低读取预算下保持注意力输出质量。
AI.method: ReadKV 将每个 key/value 以渐进式编码存储，前缀对应不同重构精度；对每个查询，先用查询分配 key-channel 前缀、由重构键计算注意力，再用该注意力分配 value-token 前缀，存储条目保持不变。两阶段均在固定预算下优化校准后的失真目标，作者证明在细化增益递减条件下可精确求解分配，并将目标与注意力输出误差关联；同时构造有限维注意力族证明查询相关访问在相同读取预算下严格优于任何查询无关读取器（即使对手的编解码器不受限）。
AI.result: 六个基础模型上，从 8-bit 缓存平均读取 4 bit，C4 困惑度上升不超过 0.66%，逻辑读取量约为 16-bit 缓存的四分之一、保留容量为其一半；在相同 payload-read 预算下持续优于“存 4-bit 并完整读取”。两个指令微调模型的长上下文问答与检索提供额外质量证据。NVIDIA A10G 上 8K token、batch-one、单层负载中，受限 8-bit ReadKV 读取器（2-bit 平均 payload 读取预算）比所测 TurboQuant 编解码器延迟低 39%。
AI.conclusion: 保留比特多于每查询读取比特的“读取预算”范式适合长上下文解码，其中每步缓存搬运字节而非权重主导成本；ReadKV 在质量、读取量与延迟上均优于既有低比特存储/完整读取方案及 TurboQuant，并给出查询相关访问优势的理论刻画。

title: Why On-Policy Distillation Sometimes Fails: Vanishing Learning Signals
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) enables effective capability transfer between language models, yet the mechanisms underlying its failures are not fully understood. Across code generation and mathematical reasoning, OPD with larger-scale teachers exhibits early loss plateaus, with an average final loss reduction of 25.1% after 200 updates, compared with 96.2% for self-RL teachers, obtained by further reinforcement learning (RL) training of the initial student. To understand this difference, we analyze OPD as an idealized continuous-time dynamical system in the small-learning-rate limit. Our training-log diagnostics associate these plateaus with an early decline in a gradient-based learning-signal proxy while substantial loss remains; these measurements do not establish why the underlying gradient weakens. We further prove a local recovery guarantee for teachers sufficiently close to the initial student in a shared parameterization under regularity conditions, offering a conditional explanation for the success of self-RL teachers in our experiments. Across runs with and without loss plateaus, we observe small relative parameter changes (0.025-0.098%) and high similarity between the student's representations before and after OPD (linear CKA $>0.98$ across layers). These observations suggest that limited representation adaptation may contribute to learning-signal collapse, a hypothesis that remains to be tested. Code is available at https://github.com/leizhao7/opd-learning-signals.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中损失平台期与学习信号崩溃现象，将其建模为小学习率极限下的连续时间动力系统，并提出教师接近初始学生时的局部恢复保证。
AI.motivation: OPD 能实现语言模型间的能力迁移，但其失败机制尚不清楚。实验发现：大规模教师做 OPD 时会出现早期损失平台期（200 步后平均仅降 25.1%），而自 RL 教师可达 96.2%，这一差异需要机制性解释。
AI.method: 在小学习率极限下将 OPD 视为理想化连续时间动力系统；通过训练日志诊断关联平台期与基于梯度的学习信号代理指标的早期下降；在共享参数化与正则条件下，证明当教师足够接近初始学生时的局部恢复保证。
AI.result: 代码生成与数学推理任务中，大规模教师的 OPD 出现早期损失平台期；自 RL 教师无此现象。诊断显示平台期伴随学习信号代理指标早期下降。所有运行中参数相对变化极小（0.025–0.098%），学生表示前后高度相似（逐层线性 CKA > 0.98）。
AI.conclusion: 有限的表示适配可能促成学习信号崩溃；局部恢复保证为自 RL 教师的成功提供条件性解释。该表示适配假设仍需进一步检验。

title: V-CoLA: Vision Token Compression with Linear Attention
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities but suffer from substantial computational overhead, as vision tokens dominate the input sequence. This motivates vision token compression as a key direction to alleviate the burden. However, with the emergence of hybrid architectures incorporating linear attention (\eg, Qwen3.5), prior methods designed for softmax attention struggle to generalize. Our analysis reveals that both attention- and similarity-based approaches suffer notable performance degradation, underscoring the urgent need for compression methods tailored to this regime. To this end, we propose \textbf{V-CoLA}, an efficient training-free token compression framework specifically designed for linear attention. V-CoLA introduces a novel \textit{uniqueness-aware importance criterion} for identifying critical vision tokens, coupled with an \textit{adaptive token merging strategy} that performs compression. All components are optimized at the implementation level to remain compatible with the chunk-wise parallelism of linear attention, ensuring strong practical value. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of V-CoLA: it achieves 99.5\% of the original performance with only 50.0\% of vision tokens, and over 88.0\% with as few as 12.5\%, while delivering a 1.86$\times$ to 6.15$\times$ prefill speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练视觉 token 压缩框架 V-CoLA，专为线性注意力（如 Qwen3.5）混合架构设计，在保留 50% 视觉 token 时达到原性能的 99.5%，12.5% 时仍保持 88% 以上，并带来 1.86×–6.15× 的 prefill 加速。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型输入中视觉 token 占比过高，导致显著计算开销，因此视觉 token 压缩是关键方向；但随着含线性注意力的混合架构出现，原有面向 softmax 注意力的压缩方法难以泛化——作者分析发现基于注意力与基于相似度的方法在此场景下性能明显下降，亟需针对该范式定制压缩方案。
AI.method: V-CoLA 是一个免训练、面向线性注意力的高效 token 压缩框架：1）提出新颖的"唯一性感知重要性准则"（uniqueness-aware importance criterion）识别关键视觉 token；2）配合"自适应 token 合并策略"（adaptive token merging strategy）完成压缩；3）所有组件在实现层面优化，以兼容线性注意力的分块并行（chunk-wise parallelism）。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，V-CoLA 仅用 50.0% 视觉 token 即达原性能的 99.5%，用 12.5% 视觉 token 仍保持超过 88.0% 的性能，同时实现 1.86× 至 6.15× 的 prefill 加速。
AI.conclusion: 现有压缩方法无法适配线性注意力混合架构，而 V-CoLA 通过唯一性感知重要性准则与自适应合并策略，并保持分块并行兼容性，在近乎无损压缩与显著 prefill 加速方面验证了其有效性与实用性。

title: LR-V2X: Loss-Resilient Collaborative Perception under Low-Bandwidth Communication
summary: Given the inherent unpredictability of packet loss in vehicular wireless communications, V2X collaborative perception can yield practical benefits only if agents can achieve reliable collaboration under lossy and low-bandwidth communication conditions. Existing dense BEV feature fusion methods depend on redundant BEV feature exchange, which is infeasible in low-bandwidth scenarios, while compact-communication methods aggressively compress messages but can hardly recover the missing feature content after packet loss. In this paper, we present LR-V2X, a loss-resilient, latent-space reconstruction framework that converts corrupted received latents (even under severe 90% packet loss) into a spatial prior and then reconstructs the missing BEV information from this informative prior and using ego context as condition. Notably, the model can be trained under complete communication conditions and can be directly applied to lossy conditions at test time, eliminating the need for training under numerous lossy conditions. Experiments on DAIR-V2X and V2XREAL show that LR-V2X delivers the strongest robustness under severe packet loss and preserves reliable collaboration as communication quality degrades. And it reduces communication overhead by $64\times$ compared to dense BEV feature fusion baselines. Code will be released at https://github.com/sidiangongyuan/LR-V2X.

AI.tldr: 提出LR-V2X框架，通过潜空间重建实现丢包鲁棒且低带宽的V2X协同感知。
AI.motivation: 车载无线通信中丢包不可预测，V2X协同感知只有在有损、低带宽通信下仍能可靠协作才有实用价值。现有稠密BEV特征融合依赖冗余特征交换，低带宽下不可行；紧凑通信方法虽能压缩消息，但丢包后难以恢复缺失特征内容。
AI.method: LR-V2X是一个丢包鲁棒的潜空间重建框架：将受损的接收潜表示（即使90%严重丢包）转换为空间先验，再以自车上下文为条件，从该先验重建缺失的BEV信息。模型可在完整通信条件下训练，测试时直接应用于有损条件，无需针对大量有损情况训练。
AI.result: 在DAIR-V2X和V2XREAL上，LR-V2X在严重丢包下展现最强鲁棒性，随通信质量下降仍保持可靠协作；相比稠密BEV特征融合基线，通信开销降低64倍。
AI.conclusion: LR-V2X通过潜空间重建实现丢包鲁棒与低带宽协同感知，兼顾鲁棒性与通信效率，代码将开源。

title: Gated Memory: Admission-Controlled Memory Formation for Conversational AI
summary: Personalized conversational AI relies on long-term memory systems that extract facts from user utterances and store them in persistent vector stores. Despite progress in retrieval, deduplication, and lifecycle management, the formation stage, the moment a fact is first written to storage has received almost no principled attention. We identify this as the binding constraint on memory quality in production systems. Critical contextual signals, such as the distinction between a permanent user attribute and a transient situation, exist only in the original utterance and are irreversibly lost the moment extraction produces a subject-relation-object triple. No downstream process can recover them. We propose Gated Memory, a lightweight, modular formation framework that interposes two decision checkpoints between conversation and storage: an admission gate that evaluates every candidate fact against the full utterance context before extraction runs, and a conditional enrichment stage that grounds admitted facts through an entity scope taxonomy with privacy constraints. The gate evaluates only the current exchange while using prior turns as read-only reference context, and produces a structured formation record. Admitted content is decomposed into atomic facts, each categorized, tagged with provenance (directly stated versus inferred), scoped to its condition of applicability, and grounded in resolved time and place, subject to a constraint that no entity absent from the context may be asserted. On the LoCoMo-10 benchmark with atypical emotional density in utterance data, Gated Memory achieves an overall +2.6% relative improvement in LLM-judge accuracy over a strong baseline with identical retrieval and generation, establishing formation quality as a measurable constraint on memory performance.

AI.tldr: 论文指出个性化对话AI的记忆系统中"事实形成阶段"（事实首次写入存储的时刻）是关键瓶颈，提出Gated Memory框架，通过准入闸门与条件化富化两步决策，在LoCoMo-10上以相同检索与生成获得+2.6%相对提升。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆研究集中于检索、去重与生命周期管理，而对"事实形成阶段"缺乏原理性关注。关键上下文信号（如永久性用户属性与瞬时情境的区分）只存在于原始话语中，一旦抽取为主-谓-宾三元组便不可逆地丢失，下游任何流程都无法恢复，因此形成阶段是生产系统中记忆质量的约束瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Gated Memory：一个轻量、模块化的形成框架，在对话与存储之间插入两个决策检查点。①准入闸门：在抽取运行前，结合完整话语上下文评估每个候选事实；闸门仅评估当前轮次，将历史轮次作为只读参考上下文，并产结构化形成记录。②条件化富化：通过带隐私约束的实体范围分类体系对已准入事实进行落地。准入内容被分解为原子事实，每条进行分类、标注来源（直接陈述 vs 推断）、限定适用条件范围，并基于解析后的时间与地点落地；约束条件是不得断言上下文中不存在的实体。
AI.result: 在话语数据具有非典型情绪密度的LoCoMo-10基准上，Gated Memory在检索与生成完全相同的前提下，相较强基线在LLM-judge准确率上取得+2.6%的总体相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 形成质量可作为记忆性能的一个可测量约束被确立，说明在抽取前介入记忆形成阶段对提升个性化对话AI的记忆质量具有实质价值。

title: Phonological Interference in Multilingual Speech Models
summary: Phoneme-level models transcribe or generate speech as a sequence of phonemes, the smallest sound units that distinguish words. These models enable fine-grained pronunciation control and understanding, yet often fail on input that does not match any single training language, such as speech alternating between two languages, known as code-switching, or low-resource languages absent from training. We identify a systematic failure mode behind this, phonological interference: models assume the input is in a single language and impose its phonology, overriding local phoneme-level decisions that conflict with the assumed language. We measure interference by how often a model retains phonemes that one language has but the other lacks. On code-switched input, two phone recognizers (speech-to-phoneme models) and a phoneme-conditioned text-to-speech model lose 32% to 79% of these phonemes, but lose far fewer of the phonemes both languages share. On unseen languages, we find that phone recognizers impose the phonology of the training language they assign to the speech, and the more confident the assignment, the more they lose phonemes the unseen language has but the assigned language lacks. We probe the models' language estimate from their internal activations, and trace interference to a low dimensional subspace. On monolingual speech, steering this subspace toward another language makes the model lose the phonemes that only the original language uses and produce phonemes that only the target language has. We introduce windowed language estimation (WLE), an inference time repair that replaces the model's language estimate in this subspace with one computed from a short window around each position. On code-switched input, WLE removes 34% to 69% of the interference in all three models, and in the recognizers it leaves monolingual performance essentially unchanged.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别出音素级模型的系统性失效模式“音系干扰”，将其定位到内部激活的低维子空间，并提出窗口化语言估计（WLE）在推理时修复，在三个模型上消除34%–69%的干扰。
AI.motivation: 音素级模型（语音转音素、音素条件语音合成）支持细粒度发音控制，但在语码转换或未见过低资源语言上表现不佳。作者希望揭示这一失败的共同机制，而非仅停留在任务层面的性能下降。
AI.method: 提出“音系干扰”概念：模型假定输入为单一语言并强加其音系，从而覆盖与之冲突的局部音素决策。以“某一语言有、另一语言无的音素”的保留率作为干扰度量；从模型内部激活探测语言估计，定位并追踪到低维子空间；通过在该子空间内朝另一语言方向操纵进行因果验证；提出推理时修复方法 WLE，用每个位置周围短窗口估计的语言替换原语言估计。
AI.result: 语码转换输入上，两个音素识别器与一个音素条件TTS模型丢失32%–79%的语言独有音素，而共有音素损失远小；未见语言上，识别器强加其判定训练语言的音系，判定越自信丢失越多。单语语音上，子空间操纵可使模型丢失原语言独有音素并产生目标语言独有音素。WLE 在三个模型上消除34%–69%的干扰，识别器单语性能基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 音系干扰是跨模型、跨任务的统一失效机制，源于模型内部的低维语言估计表征；通过推理时替换该表征的 WLE 可在不牺牲单语性能的前提下显著缓解干扰，为多语言/语码转换音素级建模提供了机制性解释与轻量修复方案。

title: Being-M0.7: A Latent World-Action Model for Humanoid Robots
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated locomotion and manipulation informed by future scene evolution and whole-body motion, yet learning these capabilities is constrained by scarce robot demonstrations. Human video and motion datasets offer scalable supervision, but many contain only video or motion rather than paired video-motion data. Moreover, human motion does not directly specify executable robot actions. We present Being-M0.7, a latent world-action model that transfers visual-motion priors learned from mixed-modality human data to humanoid control through pre-training, robot mid-training, and action post-training. We curate a corpus from more than 10,000 hours of raw human-centric data, integrating video-only, motion-only, and paired video-motion streams to learn complementary visual dynamics and whole-body kinematic structure. Joint prediction of future latent visual states and motion encourages visual representations to encode future kinematics. Robot mid-training adapts this coarse-grained prior to robot viewpoints and body dynamics. During action post-training, an action expert combines visual predictive representations from the frozen, adapted prior with current images and proprioception through gated cross-attention, grounding predictive context in executable whole-body commands. Being-M0.7 achieves the highest aggregate success rate among the compared baselines on SIMPLE and matches the strongest baseline on real-world Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出潜空间世界-动作模型Being-M0.7，利用混合模态人类数据预训练，实现人形机器人全身移动操作控制。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人移动操作需协调运动与操作并预判未来场景演化，但机器人示范数据稀缺；人类视频与动作数据可扩展，然而多为单一模态、缺乏视频-动作配对，且人类动作无法直接映射为可执行的机器人动作。
AI.method: 构建超1万小时以人为中心的混合模态语料（纯视频、纯动作、视频-动作配对），学习互补的视觉动态与全身运动学结构；通过联合预测未来潜在视觉状态与运动，使视觉表征编码未来运动学；随后进行机器人中期训练，将粗粒度先验适配到机器人视角与身体动力学；最后在动作后训练中，动作专家通过门控交叉注意力将冻结适配先验的视觉预测表征与当前图像、本体感受结合，生成可执行全身指令。
AI.result: 在SIMPLE基准上取得对比基线中最高的总体成功率；在真实世界Unitree G1移动操作任务上与最强基线持平。
AI.conclusion: 混合模态人类数据预训练结合三阶段训练流程，可有效将视觉-运动先验迁移至人形机器人全身移动操作控制。

title: When Scene Text Hijacks the Scene: Uncovering, Exploiting, and Mitigating Rendered-Text Semantic Leakage in Image Generation Models
comment: To appear in the 2027 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (IEEE S&P 2027)
summary: The reliability and accountability of image generative models (IGMs) are essential for building responsible and trustworthy AI systems. Recent IGMs, such as Nano Banana and GPT-Image, now support complex instruction following, realistic image synthesis, and controllable scene-text rendering. As these capabilities expand, safety analysis must also account for new control channels introduced by complex prompts. In this work, we study rendered-text semantic leakage, a largely overlooked phenomenon in open-domain text rendering. Although rendered text is intended to serve as a local visual constraint that should be reproduced verbatim in the generated image, it also carries linguistic semantics that may be interpreted by the model as part of the input instruction. This makes rendered text a potential semantic control channel whose safety implications remain insufficiently understood. We systematically characterize this phenomenon by decoupling the main visual prompt from the rendered text and measuring their individual and compositional effects on generated images. We quantify semantic leakage and rendering fidelity, and further analyze how leakage emerges from intermediate model evidence. We then show that harmful semantics embedded in scene text can persist through LLM-based prompt enhancement pipelines and steer non-text image regions, even when the main visual prompt remains benign. Finally, we propose a preliminary mitigation approach that reduces unsafe semantic transfer from rendered text to non-text regions while preserving the intended text-rendering behavior on FLUX-2-dev. Our findings reveal rendered text as a dual-use carrier of visible data and latent semantics, exposing a text-centric cross-modal attack surface in modern IGMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究图像生成模型（IGM）中的“渲染文本语义泄漏”现象：场景文本本应只是局部视觉约束（逐字复现），但其语言语义会被模型当作输入指令的一部分解读，成为潜在的语义控制通道。
AI.motivation: 随着 Nano Banana、GPT-Image 等 IGM 支持复杂指令跟随、逼真图像合成与可控场景文本渲染，安全分析需覆盖复杂提示引入的新控制通道。渲染文本在开放域文本渲染中的安全隐患尚缺乏系统理解。
AI.method: 将主视觉提示与渲染文本解耦，分别测量二者单独及组合对生成图像的影响；量化语义泄漏程度与渲染保真度；分析泄漏如何从模型中间层证据中产生；并检验 LLM 提示增强管线是否传播场景文本中的有害语义。
AI.result: 即使主视觉提示保持良性，嵌入场景文本的有害语义仍可穿透 LLM 提示增强管线，并影响非文本图像区域；在 FLUX-2-dev 上提出的初步缓解方法可在保持预期文本渲染行为的同时减少从渲染文本到非文本区域的不安全语义迁移。
AI.conclusion: 渲染文本是“可见数据+潜在语义”的双用途载体，暴露出现代 IGM 中以文本为中心的跨模态攻击面，需纳入安全分析范畴。

title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction
summary: Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1.

AI.tldr: 作者提出 REMORY：在文本摘要之外附加一段有界的“软记忆 token”，作为序列维度上的残差连接，使冻结的 LLM 能以极少输入位置近似全历史续写性能，从而改善长时程智能体的决策质量。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体为在有限上下文窗口内持续运行必须压缩历史，但纯文本摘要往往不足以支撑后续每一个决策，存在信息损失导致的决策偏差。因此需要一种在摘要之外补充可用信息的机制，且不依赖对底层大模型的微调。
AI.method: REMORY 是一个神经记忆网络。输入为历史与摘要，网络学习生成一批有界的软记忆 token，以摘要为条件并拼接在摘要之后，构成沿序列维度的残差连接式补充。训练目标是使冻结 LLM 在这些 token 辅助下产生的续写，逼近其使用完整历史时的续写。推理时仅占用极少量输入位置。
AI.result: 在 SummHay 上，REMORY 在洞察覆盖基本不变的情况下提升了来源归因能力，并以仅 5.2% 的输入位置接近全上下文联合得分。在多个长时程智能体基准上，Qwen3.8-27B 与 GLM-5.3-Flash 均获得一致增益；在 BrowseComp 与 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，两模型的重复工具输出与工具错误显著减少。
AI.conclusion: 用神经生成的软记忆 token 作为摘要的残差式补充，可在不微调 LLM 的前提下以极小上下文开销恢复近全历史性能，是长时程智能体记忆压缩的一种有效且通用（跨模型、跨任务）的方案。

title: When Do We Need On-Policy Distillation? Distilling on Offline Student Rollouts Is Often Better
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become increasingly popular for transferring teacher capabilities to student models. In this work, we ask a critical research question: Is on-policy sampling always beneficial for distilling arbitrary teacher-student pairs? We show that a simple alternative, Semi-OPD, which distills from offline rollouts generated by the initial student, can often outperform OPD in both accuracy and training efficiency. Across 17 teacher-student pairs ranging from 1.5B to 235B parameters, Semi-OPD outperforms OPD in 14 cases, with up to +13.6% accuracy and 11.4x training speedup. We further find that the choice between OPD and Semi-OPD depends on the alignment between the initial teacher and student, quantified by an output-token overlap ratio: OPD is beneficial only when the two are highly aligned with high overlap ratios. Our deeper investigation suggests that effective distillation requires on-policyness w.r.t. both the student and the teacher. For misaligned pairs, student rollouts can become increasingly off-policy w.r.t. the teacher as context length grows, weakening the distillation signal. In contrast, Semi-OPD is often more stable, as it distills on shorter contexts while covering full trajectories and exposing the student to more teacher-preferred tokens. Beyond proposing Semi-OPD as an efficient alternative, our work motivates the community to rethink when to use OPD and to study stronger OPD variants with meaningful teacher-student pairs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Semi-OPD方法，用初始学生模型生成的离线轨迹进行蒸馏，在17个师生模型对中14个优于OPD，最高提升13.6%准确率和11.4倍训练加速，并揭示OPD有效性取决于师生对齐程度。
AI.motivation: 已有工作普遍认为on-policy蒸馏(OPD)总能有效迁移教师能力，但作者质疑这一假设：on-policy采样是否对任意师生模型对都有益？是否存在更简单高效的替代方案？
AI.method: 提出Semi-OPD，从初始学生模型生成的离线rollout进行蒸馏；在1.5B到235B参数的17个师生模型对上对比OPD与Semi-OPD；用输出token重叠率量化师生对齐程度。
AI.result: Semi-OPD在17对中14对优于OPD，准确率最高提升13.6%，训练加速最高11.4倍；OPD仅在师生高度对齐（高重叠率）时才有益；失配模型对中，随上下文增长学生rollout对教师越来越off-policy，削弱蒸馏信号；Semi-OPD更稳定，在更短上下文上蒸馏且覆盖完整轨迹，让学生接触更多教师偏好token。
AI.conclusion: 有效蒸馏需要同时对学生和教师保持on-policy性；OPD并非普遍最优，应根据师生对齐度选择方法；呼吁社区重新审视OPD的使用场景，并在有意义的师生模型对上研究更强的OPD变体。

title: Spatial-Frequency-Aware Implicit Neural Representation of Multidimensional Signals via MLP-KAN Fusion
summary: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have emerged as a compelling paradigm for modeling multidimensional signals by mapping continuous coordinates to signal values. However, Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP)-based INRs inherently suffer from spectral bias, which favors low-frequency components and suppresses the reconstruction of essential high-frequency details. While existing techniques, such as Fourier feature mappings, mitigate this issue, they often rely on sensitive manual tuning and are prone to spectral artifacts. In this paper, we propose a spatial-frequency-aware INR framework that combines an MLP branch with a Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) branch for complementary frequency-oriented modeling. The MLP branch provides a low-frequency-oriented representation of smooth structures, whereas the KAN branch complements localized variations and fine details. To coordinate the two branches, we integrate the discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and inverse discrete wavelet transform (IDWT) into the output fusion stage. The outputs of the two branches are decomposed into wavelet coefficients, and the corresponding coefficients are additively fused before inverse wavelet reconstruction. A wavelet-domain band-separation regularization further penalizes high-frequency responses in the MLP branch and low-frequency responses in the KAN branch, thereby encouraging complementary frequency-oriented behavior. Experiments on 1D signals, 2D images, 3D volumes and signed distance functions, videos, and 4D light-fields demonstrate the applicability of the proposed representation across the evaluated signal modalities. Results demonstrate improved reconstruction fidelity across the evaluated signal modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种空间-频率感知的隐式神经表示（INR）框架，将MLP分支与KAN分支结合，并通过小波变换进行输出融合与频带分离正则化，从而缓解MLP的频谱偏置问题，在1D信号、2D图像、3D体数据与SDF、视频及4D光场等多种模态上提升了重建保真度。
AI.motivation: 基于MLP的隐式神经表示存在固有的频谱偏置：偏好低频分量，抑制高频细节的重建。现有方法如傅里叶特征映射虽能缓解该问题，但依赖敏感的人工调参，且易产生频谱伪影。因此作者希望构建一种无需精细调参、能自然实现频率互补建模的INR框架。
AI.method: 提出空间-频率感知的INR框架，包含MLP分支与Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）分支：MLP分支负责低频平滑结构表示，KAN分支补充局部变化与精细细节。在输出融合阶段引入离散小波变换（DWT）与逆离散小波变换（IDWT）：将两分支输出分解为小波系数，对应系数相加融合后再进行逆小波重建。同时设计小波域频带分离正则化，惩罚MLP分支的高频响应与KAN分支的低频响应，促使二者形成互补的频率行为。
AI.result: 在1D信号、2D图像、3D体数据与有符号距离函数（SDF）、视频以及4D光场等任务上进行实验，结果表明所提表示在所评估的各信号模态上均具有适用性，并提升了重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: 通过MLP与KAN双分支的频率互补建模，结合小波域融合与频带分离正则化，可有效缓解INR的频谱偏置，实现无需敏感人工调参的多模态高保真信号重建。

title: iCATS: Fast Video Generation via Interaction-Aware Sparse Attention and Timestep-Adaptive Sparsity
summary: Training-free sparse attention offers a practical acceleration solution to Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) via reducing computations without fine-tuning. It typically involves estimating the importance of query-key regions and deriving sparse masks to compute only the important candidates, which inevitably introduces approximation errors that may degrade generation quality. To better balance the efficiency-quality trade-off, we propose iCATS, integrating improved importance estimation and sparse mask construction with an efficient hardware execution strategy. Specifically, for importance estimation, unlike previous works that perform independent clustering over query and key tokens based on feature similarity to estimate attention scores, iCATS demonstrates that clustering based on query-key dot-product interactions is more accurate and further reformulates this objective as a simple quadratic form for low-cost computation. For sparse mask construction, instead of using a fixed top-p rule, we observe that tolerance to sparse approximation errors varies across denoising timesteps and therefore introduce an SNR-guided sparsity schedule to adjust sparsity dynamically, leading to higher accuracy. Finally, for hardware execution, we devise a tail-merging strategy to reduce padding overhead caused by irregular cluster sizes, improving GPU kernel utilization. Extensive experiments show that iCATS achieves $2.03\times$ acceleration with 31.017 dB PSNR on HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B and $1.55\times$ acceleration with 29.301 dB PSNR on Wan2.1-T2V-14B, delivering a state-of-the-art efficiency-quality trade-off.

AI.tldr: iCATS 是一种免训练稀疏注意力方法，通过改进的重要性估计、动态稀疏掩码构建与硬件执行策略，在 DiT 视频生成中实现更优的效率-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 免训练稀疏注意力可加速 Diffusion Transformers（DiTs）而无需微调，但既有方法在估计 query-key 区域重要性并生成稀疏掩码时不可避免地引入近似误差，导致生成质量下降。因此需要在效率与质量之间取得更好平衡。
AI.method: iCATS 从三方面改进：(1) 重要性估计：不同于以往基于特征相似度对 query 和 key token 独立聚类，iCATS 基于 query-key 点积交互进行聚类，并将该目标重构为简单二次形式以降低计算成本；(2) 稀疏掩码构建：不再使用固定 top-p 规则，观察到不同去噪时间步对稀疏近似误差的容忍度不同，引入 SNR 引导的稀疏度调度动态调整稀疏度；(3) 硬件执行：设计尾部合并（tail-merging）策略，减少不规则簇大小导致的填充开销，提升 GPU kernel 利用率。
AI.result: 在 HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B 上实现 2.03× 加速，PSNR 为 31.017 dB；在 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 上实现 1.55× 加速，PSNR 为 29.301 dB，达到当前最优的效率-质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: iCATS 通过整合改进的重要性估计、SNR 引导的动态稀疏掩码构建及尾部合并硬件执行策略，在免训练条件下显著提升 DiT 稀疏注意力的效率-质量权衡，并在大规模视频生成模型上验证了其有效性。

title: Efficient Multi-Granularity Knowledge Transfer for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology report generation can automatically generate clinical descriptions from X-ray images, thereby significantly improving the efficiency of radiologists. This task is challenging because it requires medical knowledge to accurately identify diseases and describe them in a professional manner. However, existing methods often overlook the importance of enhancing medical knowledge in describing pivotal areas, a capability that requires models to effectively extract and aggregate knowledge at multiple levels of granularity. Accordingly, we herein propose a novel and compact Efficient Multi-Granularity Knowledge Transfer (\textbf{EMGKT}) method to address the above issues. First, we encode global knowledge embeddings using a medical vision-language model, which provides contextual medical knowledge. Moreover, we devise a novel Fine-Grained Knowledge Distillation (FGKD) training task which efficiently extract fine-grained knowledge. Specifically, the FGKD training task contains teacher embeddings and student embeddings. Teacher embeddings are encoded using extra priors; while student embeddings are learned from the teacher embeddings through knowledge distillation. During inference, the student embeddings are used to enhance fine-grained knowledge while the teacher embeddings are discarded, resulting in negligible computational costs and no need for extra priors. Finally, we further develop a mixture of disease diagnosis expert classifiers to enhance knowledge extraction. The classifiers are initialized using disease embeddings and are modeled as different experts to address various granularity features. Notably, \textbf{EMGKT} can be efficiently applied to most existing methods. Extensive experiments are conducted on two widely-used public datasets and various baselines, which demonstrates the effectiveness and transferability of \textbf{EMGKT}.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种高效多粒度知识迁移（EMGKT）方法，用于放射学报告生成，通过全局知识嵌入、细粒度知识蒸馏和疾病诊断专家分类器，在不增加推理成本的前提下提升医学知识提取与聚合能力。
AI.motivation: 放射学报告生成需医学知识来准确识别疾病并以专业方式描述，但现有方法忽视了对关键区域描述所需医学知识的增强，即模型需在多粒度层级上有效提取和聚合知识的能力。
AI.method: 提出EMGKT方法：1) 用医学视觉-语言模型编码全局知识嵌入以提供上下文医学知识；2) 设计细粒度知识蒸馏（FGKD）训练任务，教师嵌入由额外先验编码，学生嵌入通过知识蒸馏从教师学习，推理时仅用学生嵌入，丢弃教师嵌入，从而计算开销可忽略且无需额外先验；3) 构建疾病诊断混合专家分类器，用疾病嵌入初始化并建模为不同专家以应对不同粒度特征。EMGKT可高效应用于大多数现有方法。
AI.result: 在两个广泛使用的公开数据集及多种基线上进行大量实验，验证了EMGKT的有效性和可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: EMGKT通过多粒度知识迁移有效增强放射学报告生成中的医学知识提取与聚合，且在推理阶段保持低计算成本，并可高效地应用于现有方法。

title: BeliefScope: Diagnosing Evidence-Driven Revision and Pressure-Induced Shifts in Large Language Models
summary: A language model may revise the same proposition after receiving genuinely relevant evidence or after receiving directional user pressure that adds no relevant fact. The observable response shift alone therefore does not reveal which source drove the change. We introduce BeliefScope, a controlled black-box framework for separating these two sources of influence around a fixed target proposition. BeliefScope crosses Evidence and Pressure with factor-specific local controls and measures response changes through probability reports, categorical judgments, and action recommendations on channel-appropriate scales. To determine when these observable contrasts support reliable attribution, we evaluate the observation design under controlled synthetic conditions. Known-truth recovery and targeted ablations establish where Evidence- and Pressure-related effects can be separated, while semi-synthetic stress tests map how that recoverability changes as the observation process becomes noisier and more heterogeneous. Across a 36-family Qwen/Llama study, with targeted 12-family checks that also include Gemma3-12B, the resulting profiles show substantial evaluation-context dependence: broad model-level differences can change under matched controls, decoding, or response interfaces, while some narrower within-model patterns remain stable. Instruction interventions further show that reduced target-aligned Pressure following can reflect either stable resistance or movement in the opposite direction. BeliefScope summarizes these measurements as a conditional belief-response profile that keeps diagnostic effects tied to the evaluation conditions under which they are observed, together with explicit validity boundaries for that diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出 BeliefScope：一个受控黑盒框架，用于区分"证据"与"用户压力"对语言模型同一命题的信念响应影响，并给出条件化的信念–响应画像及其诊断有效边界。
AI.motivation: 模型在收到真实相关证据后，或在收到不含新相关事实的方向性用户压力后，都可能修改同一命题；仅凭可观测的响应偏移无法判断变化源自何处，因此需要可控观测设计来分离两类影响因素。
AI.method: 以固定目标命题为中心，将 Evidence 与 Pressure 做因子交叉，并配以因子特异的局部控制；通过概率报告、类别判断与行动建议在各自适配的量表上测量响应变化。在受控合成条件下评估观测设计的可辨识性：已知真值恢复与定向消融确定两类效应可分离之处；半合成压力测试刻画可恢复性随观测过程噪声化与异质化如何变化。在 Qwen/Llama 的 36 个模型族上开展研究，并做含 Gemma3-12B 的 12 族定向验证；另设指令干预实验。
AI.result: 所得画像显示显著的评估情境依赖性：在匹配控制、解码设置或响应接口变化时，宽泛的模型级差异可能改变，而部分较窄的模型内模式保持稳定。指令干预进一步表明，目标对齐型压力跟随的降低既可能来自稳定抵抗，也可能来自朝相反方向的移动。
AI.conclusion: BeliefScope 将测量结果汇总为条件化信念–响应画像，使诊断效应始终绑定于其被观测时的评估条件，并给出该诊断的明确有效边界。

title: Collaboratively Guided Adversarial Robust Distillation with Teacher-Favorable Examples
summary: Adversarial distillation transfers robustness from high-capacity teachers to compact students. Existing adversarial distillation methods mainly use teacher predictions on clean or adversarial examples to supervise student learning. However, teacher-favorable supervision within the perturbation neighborhood remains underexplored in adversarial distillation. We therefore propose Collaboratively Guided Adversarial Robust Distillation (CGARD), which jointly optimizes distinct student-adversarial and teacher-collaborative examples within the same perturbation neighborhood. The teacher-collaborative example is constrained to incur no greater cross-entropy loss under the teacher than the clean input. CGARD combines collaborative teacher guidance with adversarial teacher supervision to improve robust knowledge transfer. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, including white-box evaluation and additional black-box transfer evaluation, demonstrate consistent robustness improvements over strong adversarial distillation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出协同引导对抗鲁棒蒸馏（CGARD），在同一扰动邻域内联合优化学生对抗样本与教师协同样本，以提升紧凑学生的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗蒸馏主要利用教师对干净样本或对抗样本的预测来监督学生，忽视了扰动邻域内对教师更"友好"（损失更小）的样本所能提供的监督信号，导致鲁棒知识迁移不充分。
AI.method: 提出CGARD框架，在同一扰动邻域内联合优化两类样本：学生对抗样本（用于对抗性教师监督）与教师协同样本（约束其受教师监督时的交叉熵损失不高于干净输入），并将协同教师引导与对抗教师监督相结合。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上进行实验，涵盖白盒评估以及额外的黑盒迁移评估，相比强对抗蒸馏基线方法均取得一致的鲁棒性提升。
AI.conclusion: 在扰动邻域内引入教师友好的协同样本作为监督信号，可有效增强对抗蒸馏的鲁棒知识迁移效果，验证了该方向的可行性与有效性。

title: FloorSAV: Elucidating Spatial Audio-Visual Context with 2D Floormap for AV-LLMs
summary: While 3D spatial reasoning in dynamic egocentric environments is crucial for embodied intelligence, audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) lack explicit mechanisms to process and internalize global geometry directly from raw sensory streams. Existing approaches either require costly fine-tuning or underutilize the model's cross-modal reasoning capacities. In this paper, we propose FloorSAV, a novel framework that explicitly grounds spatial audio-visual context by rendering a dynamic 2D floormap. By integrating 3D point clouds, camera trajectories, spatial audio cues, and semantically grounded object landmarks, we inject this floormap into the AV-LLM as a synchronized stream with an egocentric video. AV-LLMs utilize their multi-modal capabilities to jointly reason over visual, auditory, and geometric cues in a single inference with floormap interpretation guidance. We further introduce SAVED-Bench (Spatial Audio-Visual Egocentric Benchmark with Dynamic Agents), constructing essential tasks of spatial capability in real-world scenarios: dynamic relativity, regional, and path reasoning QAs. FloorSAV improves AV-LLMs' spatial reasoning on various tasks from both SAVED-Bench and SAVVY-Bench. Studies with ground-truth floormaps demonstrate the substantial potential of FloorSAV with accurate spatial information.

AI.tldr: 提出FloorSAV框架，通过将3D点云、相机轨迹、空间音频与语义地标渲染为动态2D平面图（floormap），并以同步流形式注入音视觉大模型（AV-LLM），无需昂贵微调即可增强其第一视角动态环境下的空间推理能力；同时构建SAVED-Bench基准，在多项任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 动态第一视角（egocentric）环境中的3D空间推理对具身智能至关重要，但现有音视觉大模型（AV-LLM）缺乏从原始感知流中直接处理并内化全局几何信息的显式机制；已有方法要么依赖代价高昂的微调，要么未能充分利用模型的跨模态推理能力。
