AI.method: 提出 SRSP：以冻结的下游 TTS 模型为环境，训练基于文本的风格规划器。给定对话历史与回复文本，规划器生成候选指令，并用 GRPO（组相对策略优化）进行优化，奖励为目标语音 token 的 teacher-forced 似然。
AI.result: 在 ISCSLP 2026 CoT-TTS 语料库的英语子集上，SRSP 相比 Base LLM 与目标音频信息驱动的描述生成基线，获得更高的语音风格与情感相似度、更低的梅尔倒谱失真；基于 LLM 的表达性语音评估在语境适配性与参考一致性上也优于全部基线。
AI.conclusion: 将风格规划直接与下游 TTS 的声学目标对齐（而非仅追求描述-语音对齐）是更有效的路径；以合成器似然为奖励的强化学习可显著提升自然语言风格指令的可控性与合成质量。

title: Who Verifies the Verifier? Co-Evolving Inspectable Graders with Self-Improving Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
summary: We changed the agent: did it actually get better? Every self-improving agent loop answers this hundreds of times, and every answer comes from a verifier. On open-ended tasks none exists, so the loop is handed a hand-written rubric or a bare LLM judge grading output from a model like itself, inviting reward hacking and shared blind spots. We make the verifier the evolving object: an inspectable expression over small, mostly deterministic drawback detectors, synthesized from clustered failures, gated at birth, and selected for agreement with a ten-item anchored reference set plus consensus over unlabeled outputs, never for the agent's score. On MBPP+ it gains +0.21 held-out agreement over the hand-authored seed composition, on every seed, and ends ahead of the bare LLM judge it contains. One finding should change how co-evolved verifiers are validated: removing the anchor guards collapses the verifier into a vacuous always-pass grader, yet that collapsed verifier trains skills just as well. Downstream task score cannot certify a self-evolved verifier. Score does answer sufficiency, and there an evolved verifier can substitute: Double Ratchet, pairing the verifier with a lifecycle-managed skill loop, retains 88-110% of the lift that ground truth or a rubric buys the same loop, across code generation, enterprise text-to-SQL, and reference-free report generation. When evolved skills gamed the report rubric, an outer judge caught it and one added detector repaired it; the judge itself was wrong until given the task contract.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"验证器"本身作为自演化对象：用可检查的表达式组合小型、多为确定性的缺陷检测器，从聚类失败中合成，出生时设门控，并按与十项锚定参考集的一致性和无标签输出的共识来筛选，而非按智能体得分。在MBPP+上较人工种子提升+0.21留出一致性，且优于其内含的裸LLM评判器。关键发现：移除锚点守卫会使验证器坍缩为恒过的空验证器，但该坍缩验证器训练技能的效果一样好，说明下游任务得分无法认证自演化验证器。Double Ratchet将验证器与生命周期管理的技能循环配对，在代码生成、企业级text-to-SQL和无参考报告生成中保留88-110%的提升。
AI.motivation: 自改进智能体循环每次都要回答"改动后是否真的更好"，而答案依赖验证器。在开放式任务上不存在真值验证器，循环只能依赖手写评分标准或与自身同源的裸LLM评判器，前者僵化、后者易导致奖励黑客和共同盲区。因此需要让验证器本身成为可演化、可检查且能自我验证的对象。
AI.method: 把验证器建模为对小规模、多为确定性缺陷检测器的可检查表达式；由聚类失败合成候选，出生时进行门控筛选；选择依据是与十项锚定参考集的一致性以及在无标签输出上的共识，而非智能体得分。在其上构建Double Ratchet，将演化验证器与生命周期管理的技能循环配对。
AI.result: MBPP+上，相较人工编写的种子组合，留出集一致性提升+0.21，且在每一个种子上均成立，并优于其内含的裸LLM评判器。消融显示：移除锚点守卫后验证器坍缩为恒过的空评分器，但该坍缩验证器训练出的技能同样好，说明下游任务得分不能认证自演化验证器。Double Ratchet在代码生成、企业级text-to-SQL与无参考报告生成中保留88-110%的提升。当演化技能钻报告评分标准的空子时，由外层评判器发现，添加一个检测器即可修复；而该评判器在获得任务契约之前本身也是错的。
AI.conclusion: 验证器应是可演化、可检查且按一致性而非下游得分筛选的对象。下游任务得分只回答"充分性"而非"正确性"，无法认证自演化验证器；在充分性意义上，演化验证器可替代真值或人工评分标准，配合生命周期管理的技能循环可保留大部分提升。验证需引入锚定守卫与外层评判/任务契约，防止验证器崩塌与技能钻空子。

title: SAGE: Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis for Visual Grounding in Vision-Language Decoders
summary: Recent large vision-language models (VLMs) pair a visual encoder with a large language model (LLM) and perform well on diverse image-text tasks, yet their reliability is often limited by decoder attention pathologies that suppress visual evidence and exacerbate hallucinations. In this paper, we revisit visual attention sinks and uncover a structured, layer-dependent behavior: across prompts, early and late decoder layers exhibit prompt-invariant attention collapse onto the same few image regions, which we term PIS (Prompt-Invariant Sinks), whereas mid layers become prompt-conditioned and drive vision-language alignment. This split suggests that treating sinks as a uniform effect is incomplete. Building on this insight, we propose SAGE (Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis), a lightweight intervention that steers decoder attention away from PIS and toward query-dependent regions of interest (ROIs) using token-aligned ROI masks derived from standard vision backbones such as CLIP, ViT, and DINOv3. Evaluated on diverse vision-encoder + decoder-only LLM VLM families, SAGE improves visual grounding, reduces hallucinations, and yields consistent gains across public downstream vision-language benchmarks, including fine-grained visual discrimination settings where localized evidence is crucial, when instantiated with backbone-derived ROI masks.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示视觉语言模型中存在层依赖的"提示不变性注意力汇"（PIS），并提出轻量干预方法 SAGE 以引导注意力远离 PIS、聚焦查询相关区域，从而提升视觉定位并减少幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大视觉语言模型（VLM）虽在多模态任务上表现优异，但解码器注意力缺陷会抑制视觉证据、加剧幻觉。作者认为将注意力汇视为统一现象是不完整的，因此重新审视视觉注意力汇，探究其是否存在结构化、层依赖的行为。
AI.method: 作者发现解码器早期与晚期层在不同提示下都出现注意力坍缩到相同少数图像区域的现象，命名为 PIS（提示不变性汇），而中间层则表现为提示条件化并驱动视觉-语言对齐。基于此，提出 SAGE（汇感知引导强调），一种轻量干预方法：利用标准视觉骨干（如 CLIP、ViT、DINOv3）生成的令牌对齐 ROI 掩码，将解码器注意力从 PIS 转向查询相关的感兴趣区域。
AI.result: 在多种视觉编码器+仅解码器 LLM 的 VLM 家族上评估，SAGE 提升了视觉定位能力、减少了幻觉，并在公开下游视觉语言基准上取得一致增益，尤其在需要局部证据的细粒度视觉判别任务中，当配合骨干网络生成的 ROI 掩码时效果显著。
AI.conclusion: 视觉注意力汇并非均匀现象，而是具有层依赖的结构化行为（PIS）。通过 SAGE 对注意力进行汇感知引导，可有效改善 VLM 的视觉定位、抑制幻觉并提升多模态基准表现，为注意力调控提供简洁有效的思路。

title: Conditional Residual Prediction: Improving Autoregressive Video Diffusion without a Bidirectional Teacher
summary: Causal video diffusion models generate video autoregressively, which suits streaming, interactive, and long-video generation. Under standard training, however, they often yield lower generation quality than bidirectional models of the same size. Many existing approaches address this gap by initializing from or distilling a pretrained bidirectional teacher. We instead train a causal model from an image-model initialization, with no bidirectional video model at any stage. Because this path requires neither a large bidirectional teacher nor a complex distillation pipeline, it is simpler and more scalable. On this path, we find that a causal model trained on ground-truth history becomes strongly dependent on it, so that at inference errors in its own generated history propagate forward. We hypothesize that much of this dependence is unnecessary, because the current input already determines much of what the history provides. We propose Conditional Residual Prediction (CRP), a simple recipe for reducing a model's reliance on a condition: the model first predicts the target without the condition, and the condition may only add a residual on top of this prediction. Applied to history, CRP makes the model predict each chunk from the present as far as it can and use the past only for what the present cannot supply. In controlled experiments, CRP nearly closes the 6.14-point gap to a bidirectional model trained under the same setup. Scaling this recipe, we train Optica, a 2B-parameter causal video model that autoregressively generates 5-second 480p videos and reaches 82.78 on VBench with only about 15M training videos.

AI.tldr: 本文提出条件残差预测（CRP）训练配方，使因果视频扩散模型在不依赖双向教师模型的前提下，从图像模型初始化直接训练，显著缩小与双向模型的生成质量差距，并据此训练出2B参数的Optica模型。
AI.motivation: 因果视频扩散模型适合流式、交互式与长视频生成，但在标准训练下生成质量低于同规模双向模型。现有方法多依靠预训练双向教师模型进行初始化或蒸馏来弥补差距，流程复杂、依赖大模型、难以扩展。作者希望探索一条无需双向视频模型参与、更简单且更可扩展的训练路径。
AI.method: 作者从图像模型初始化出发直接训练因果模型，全程不使用双向视频模型。研究发现，在真实历史（ground-truth history）上训练的因果模型会强烈依赖历史条件，导致推理时自身生成历史中的误差向前传播。为此提出条件残差预测（CRP）：模型先在不使用该条件下预测目标，条件只能在此基础上叠加一个残差。将CRP应用于历史条件，模型会尽可能仅凭当前输入预测每个视频块，仅把过去用于补充当前无法提供的信息。
AI.result: 在受控实验中，CRP几乎弥合了与同设置下训练的双向模型之间6.14分的差距。将该配方扩展到规模化训练，得到2B参数的因果视频模型Optica，可自回归生成5秒480p视频，仅用约1500万个训练视频即在VBench上达到82.78分。
AI.conclusion: 因果视频模型对历史的依赖存在大量冗余，通过CRP可有效降低该依赖、抑制误差传播，从而在无需双向教师与复杂蒸馏流程的情况下接近双向模型质量，并具备良好的可扩展性。

title: Beyond Resolution: Object-to-Image Ratio Mismatch in Instance Retrieval
summary: Visual instance retrieval often fails when the same object appears at different apparent sizes in the query and gallery. We show that the dominant cause is usually not resolution loss but object-to-image (O2I) ratio mismatch: the object occupies different fractions of the two images. On a controlled benchmark of 3,021 Objaverse objects rendered at five camera distances, more than 80% of the cross-distance degradation is attributable to O2I mismatch rather than resolution for 9 of 12 pretrained backbones; multi-scale architectures cut the resolution-only effect to single digits yet remain equally susceptible. The failure is also asymmetric: tight queries retrieve more reliably against wide gallery images than the reverse. Guided by this analysis, query-side scale augmentation and an OWLv2 crop reranker reach state of the art on ILIAS 100M (29.2 mAP@1000 before reranking, 42.0 after) without training or modifying the precomputed gallery index, and a LoRA fine-tune matches the query-side gains at a single forward pass, showing that O2I robustness is learnable.

AI.tldr: 视觉实例检索中跨尺度失败的主因是目标占图比例（O2I）失配而非分辨率损失，据此提出的查询侧尺度增强与重排序方法在无训练条件下取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 同一物体在查询图与图库图中表观尺寸不同时，视觉实例检索性能显著下降。作者旨在厘清该退化的真正成因：是分辨率损失，还是目标占图比例（O2I）失配。
AI.method: 构建受控基准：3,021 个 Objaverse 物体、五种相机距离渲染；在 12 个预训练骨干上分解分辨率与 O2I 效应；分析失败的方向性不对称；基于分析结果设计查询侧尺度增强、OWLv2 裁剪重排序器，以及 LoRA 微调方案。
AI.result: 12 个骨干中有 9 个，超过 80% 的跨距离退化归因于 O2I 失配；多尺度架构将纯分辨率效应降至个位数百分比但仍同样受影响。失败具不对称性：紧致查询对宽视角图库的检索更可靠，反之则较差。在 ILIAS 100M 上，查询侧尺度增强加 OWLv2 裁剪重排序达到 SOTA（重排前 29.2 mAP@1000，重排后 42.0），且无需训练或修改预计算图库索引；LoRA 微调以单次前向匹配查询侧增益。
AI.conclusion: O2I 比例失配而非分辨率是跨尺度实例检索的主导成因，且该鲁棒性可通过查询侧增强或单次前向的 LoRA 微调学习获得，为无索引重训的高效改进提供了依据。

title: Stop My Dancing! Understanding, Detecting and Attributing Motion-Aware Deepfake Videos
comment: This individual submission was not coordinated with the team. Based on internal team discussions, this article cannot currently be published as a preprint, so the submission needs to be withdrawn
summary: Pose-guided diffusion models can now synthesize entire human figures in motion, spawning a new class of deepfakes: Motion Aware Deepfake (MAD) that have already reached hundreds of millions of viewers. To better understand this emerging threat, we construct the first MAD-specific benchmark and measurement framework, containing over 1.5 million frames that mix 1,363 real and 30,122 synthetic videos from six controllable generators, with realistic perturbations and open-world evaluation splits. Then, we dissect MAD and discover that, despite their global coherence, these videos betray faint yet reliable cues: because the model relies on limited input frames for motion synthesis, it must predict and simulate coherent movement at motion boundaries, thereby producing high-frequency artifacts along with model-specific spectral fingerprints. Based on the observations obtained from analysis on dataset, we propose MoDA, the first defense framework tailored to detect and attribute MAD videos. MoDA couples spatial semantics with steganalysis-rich frequency features via cross-domain alignment and multi-scale aggregation, achieving 94.8% in-distribution and 89.1% cross-dataset detection accuracy gains of 10% to 25% over prior work and 91.5% model attribution accuracy. MoDA achieves 81.94% accuracy on 200 clips produced by two unseen commercial MAD platforms, indicating promising zero-shot transfer, and 78.13% detection accuracy on 1,200 unseen MAD video clips (55k frames in total) collected from the open Internet. Under white-box, gray-box, and black-box adaptive attacks, MoDA maintains relatively stable detection and attribution performance while the accuracies of the baselines drop rapidly.

AI.tldr: 本文构建首个面向"动作感知深伪"（MAD）的基准与测量框架（超150万帧、1363真实+30122合成视频、6个可控生成器），揭示MAD因运动合成依赖有限输入帧而在运动边界产生高频伪影及模型特定频谱指纹，并提出检测与归因框架MoDA，在分布内、跨数据集、零样本及自适应攻击场景下均取得显著优于基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 姿态引导扩散模型已能合成整段运动中的人体，催生了动辄触达数亿观众的新型深伪——Motion Aware Deepfake（MAD）。然而针对此类威胁，学界缺乏专门的基准数据集与测量方法，也缺少面向MAD的检测与归因防御手段，亟需系统性地理解并应对这一新兴风险。
AI.method: 作者首先构建首个MAD专用基准与测量框架，涵盖超150万帧、1363个真实视频与6个可控生成器产生的30122个合成视频，包含真实扰动与开放世界评测划分。随后剖析MAD，发现其虽具全局连贯性，但因运动合成依赖有限输入帧，必须在运动边界预测并模拟连贯运动，从而产生高频伪影与模型特定频谱指纹。基于此提出MoDA框架：通过跨域对齐与多尺度聚合，将空间语义与富含隐写分析特征的频域特征耦合，用于MAD视频的检测与模型归因。
AI.result: MoDA在分布内检测准确率达94.8%，跨数据集达89.1%，较先前工作提升10%至25%，模型归因准确率91.5%。在两个未见过的商业MAD平台生成的200个片段上达81.94%，显示良好的零样本迁移能力；在从开放互联网采集的1200个未见MAD视频片段（共5.5万帧）上检测准确率为78.13%。在白盒、灰盒与黑盒自适应攻击下，MoDA检测与归因性能保持相对稳定，而基线准确率迅速下降。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次系统性地构建了MAD基准与测量框架，揭示了运动合成固有缺陷带来的高频与频谱线索，并证明融合空间语义与频域隐写特征的MoDA在检测、归因及跨域/零样本和多种自适应攻击下均具备优越且鲁棒的防御能力，为应对动作感知深伪威胁提供了有效方案。

title: Parametric Trajectory Distillation for Few-Step Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion and flow models require many sequential evaluations, making generation computationally expensive. Few-step distillation reduces this cost but poses a capacity allocation problem: a student must match the teacher's iterative generation with far less sequential computation. Existing trajectory methods ask the student to reproduce teacher transitions that are highly curved at high noise, which can exceed its capacity and degrade fine detail. We introduce Parametric Trajectory Distillation (PTD), which lets the student parameterize teacher trajectory segments as polynomials and learn from teacher guidance along its own predicted path. PTD is designed to let the learned curvature adapt to the backbone's predictive capacity, preserving motion and diversity. The curvature head is used only in training; inference keeps the original backbone architecture. On Wan2.1-14B, four-step PTD sets a new state of the art for trajectory distillation, significantly improving dynamic quality and naturalness over PDD, the best-performing trajectory-only method on this model, under the same training setting. On the 33B audio-video MiniMax-H3, LoRA-trained PTD significantly improves diversity and naturalness over the state-of-the-art LightX2V Turbo. Blinded human votes give PTD 55.1% and 63.4% preference shares against PDD and LightX2V Turbo. Project page: https://alan-lanfeng.github.io/PTD/.

AI.tldr: PTD（Parametric Trajectory Distillation，参数化轨迹蒸馏）将教师轨迹段参数化为多项式，让学生在自身预测路径上接受教师引导，使学习到的曲率自适应骨干网络的预测能力，从而在少步蒸馏中兼顾运动保真度与多样性，且训练时的曲率头在推理时移除。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散与流模型需要大量顺序求解步骤，生成成本高昂。少步蒸馏虽能降低开销，但存在容量分配难题：学生网络需以远少于教师的顺序计算量匹配教师的迭代生成。现有轨迹式方法要求学生复现教师在噪声水平高时曲线高度弯曲的轨迹转移，这超出学生容量，导致细节退化。
AI.method: 提出参数化轨迹蒸馏（PTD）。核心是让学生将教师的轨迹段参数化为多项式，并沿着自身预测的路径从教师引导中学习，使所学曲率能够适配骨干网络的预测容量。引入曲率头（curvature head），仅在训练阶段使用；推理时保持原始骨干架构不变。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.1-14B 上，四步 PTD 刷新了轨迹蒸馏的最新水平，在相同训练设置下相比该模型上表现最佳的纯轨迹方法 PDD，显著提升了动态质量与自然度；在 33B 音视频模型 MiniMax-H3 上，经 LoRA 训练的 PTD 相比最新的 LightX2V Turbo 显著改善了多样性与自然度。盲测人类投票中，PTD 相对 PDD 和 LightX2V Turbo 的偏好占比分别为 55.1% 与 63.4%。
AI.conclusion: PTD 通过让学生自适应地参数化并拟合教师轨迹曲率，缓解了少步蒸馏中的容量错配问题，在保持推理架构不变的前提下，于大规模视频与音视频生成模型上取得更优的动态质量、自然度与多样性，并获得人类偏好的实证支持。

title: Beyond Sequences: Distilling Structured Decision Memory for LLM Recommendation
summary: Despite the adoption of large language models (LLMs) in recommendation systems, prevailing approaches mostly model single-type behaviors (e.g., views or purchases). Even when incorporating multiple behaviors, existing methods flatten heterogeneous actions into homogeneous token sequences, ignoring their distinct decision-making roles. This flattening fails to capture semantic hierarchies and contextual nuances in complex decision-making, such as trade-offs between price and quality. Consequently, performance degrades in critical ``difficult-choice'' scenarios involving highly similar items. To bridge this gap, we propose MARI (Memory-Augmented Recommendation with Interpretability), which grounds predictions in explicit, structured decision evidence. MARI maintains a Decision Memory Bank (DMB) that archives users' past rationales as Structured Decision Memories (SDMs): concise records of goals, constraints, and trade-offs. These SDMs are generated offline via Post-Hoc Decision Distillation from heterogeneous behaviors and user-generated content. By retrieving relevant SDMs to augment LLM reasoning, MARI achieves interpretability and scalability without the prohibitive cost of processing long raw sequences. Extensive experiments show MARI significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on standard next-item prediction and a newly introduced Difficult Choice Prediction task, incurring low latency overhead by decoupling memory construction from online inference. Qualitative analyses reveal actionable, human-readable insights into user decision-making, marking a concrete step toward reasoning-aware recommendation systems.

AI.tldr: MARI通过离线蒸馏构建结构化决策记忆库，动态检索增强LLM推理，在标准下一项预测及新提出的"困难选择预测"任务上显著超越现有方法，并具低延迟与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推荐方法多建模单一行为（浏览或购买），即便引入多行为也将异构动作展平为同质token序列，忽略其决策角色差异；无法捕捉语义层级与价格-质量权衡等上下文细微差别，导致在高度相似商品的"困难选择"场景中性能下降。
AI.method: 提出MARI（记忆增强可解释推荐）。维护决策记忆库DMB，以结构化决策记忆SDM存储用户过往理性依据（目标、约束、权衡的精简记录）。SDM通过事后决策蒸馏从异构行为与用户生成内容中离线生成；在线时检索相关SDM增强LLM推理，实现可解释与可扩展而无需处理长原始序列。
AI.result: 在标准下一项预测任务与新提出的困难选择预测任务上均显著优于SOTA基线；因构建与在线推理解耦，延迟开销低；定性分析呈现可读的用户决策洞察。
AI.conclusion: MARI以结构化决策证据为预测依据，是迈向推理感知推荐系统的具体一步，兼顾可解释性、可扩展性与低延迟。

title: WARP-VLA: Wrist-Camera Adaptation for View-Robust Policy Execution in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Despite recent advances in Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) for robotic manipulation, their performance remains sensitive to changes in camera configuration. The problem becomes more evident in cross-setup deployment, as reproducing the exact camera pose used for training is nearly impossible. Unlike fixed external views, wrist views are more challenging because the camera moves with the robot, causing even small mounting variations to alter fine-grained geometric cues. To address this, we propose WARP-VLA, a camera-view robust VLA for diverse wrist camera configurations. WARP-VLA adopts a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture where individual experts learn view-specific feature transformations, and a router combines them based on implicit view information. This allows the policy to be deployed without requiring camera extrinsic parameters as additional input. Through experiments on the LIBERO benchmark, WARP-VLA improves the average success rate of pi-0.5 from 39.2% to 78.3% under wrist-view perturbations. The real-robot experiments further show that the feature-level adaptation learned in simulation successfully transfers to diverse deployment settings. To facilitate reproducibility and future research, we release our wrist viewpoint robustness benchmark and a plug-and-play implementation.

AI.tldr: 提出WARP-VLA，一种对腕部相机配置变化鲁棒的视觉-语言-动作模型，采用混合专家架构学习视角特定特征变换，无需相机外参即可部署，在LIBERO基准上将pi-0.5成功率从39.2%提升至78.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型对相机配置变化敏感，跨装置部署时难以复现训练时的相机位姿。相比固定外部视角，腕部视角更困难，因为相机随机器人移动，微小的安装偏差就会改变细粒度几何线索。
AI.method: 提出WARP-VLA。采用混合专家（MoE）架构，各专家学习视角特定的特征变换，路由器基于隐式视角信息进行组合，从而在部署时无需相机外参作为额外输入。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上，腕部视角扰动下将pi-0.5的平均成功率从39.2%提升至78.3%；真实机器人实验表明仿真中学到的特征级适应能成功迁移至多样化部署场景。
AI.conclusion: WARP-VLA有效提升了腕部相机视角变化下的鲁棒性，且仿真到真实迁移可行。作者发布了腕部视角鲁棒性基准与即插即用实现，以促进可复现性和后续研究。

title: Does Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) Dominate Arabic Dialects in LLMs? A Representation-Level Analysis
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often default to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) when generating Arabic, even when prompted with dialectal Arabic. A natural explanation is that their internal representations are dominated by MSA. We test this hypothesis by adapting the language-dominance framework of Shani and Basirat (2025) (https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2025.blackboxnlp-1.7) to 26 Arabic varieties. Across layers and model families, we find no evidence that MSA acts as a dominant internal representation for Arabic dialects. Instead, dialect representations form a dense and highly overlapping space: normalized mutual information drops sharply compared to patterns reported for more distinct languages. Moreover, the strongest separability effects are not confined to intermediate layers, but can shift toward later layers depending on the architecture. These findings challenge a common interpretation of MSA-biased generation: output preference does not necessarily reveal internal representational dominance. Analyses of multilingual and dialectal LLMs should therefore distinguish generation bias from the geometry of internal representations.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验"LLM生成阿拉伯语时默认使用现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）是因为内部表征被MSA主导"这一假设，对26种阿拉伯语变体进行分析后发现：MSA并非方言的主导性内部表征；方言表征构成密集且高度重叠的空间，且最强可分性效应并不局限于中间层，可随架构后移。研究结论是输出偏好不等于内部表征主导，生成偏见与内部表征几何应加以区分。
AI.motivation: LLM在被提示使用方言阿拉伯语时仍常默认生成现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）。一种自然解释是模型内部表征被MSA主导。作者希望检验这一假设是否成立，以厘清"输出偏好"与"内部表征主导"之间的关系。
AI.method: 将Shani和Basirat（2025）的语言主导性框架适配到26种阿拉伯语变体上，跨不同层与不同模型家族进行分析，测量标准化互信息以刻画各变体表征空间的分离与重叠程度，并考察最强可分性效应出现的层级位置。
AI.result: 在各层与各模型家族中，均未发现MSA作为阿拉伯语方言主导性内部表征的证据。方言表征形成密集且高度重叠的空间，标准化互信息相比更彼此区分的语言所报告的模式显著下降。此外，最强可分性效应并不局限于中间层，而会依架构不同向更靠后的层移动。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现挑战了对MSA偏向生成的一种常见解读：输出偏好并不必然反映内部表征主导。因此，多语言与方言LLM的分析应将生成偏见与内部表征的几何结构区分开来。

title: Residual Advantage: Student-Relative Teacher Guidance for RL with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and on-policy distillation (OPD) have become two main paradigms for post-training reasoning models. RLVR gives each response a single outcome label, leaving the steps inside it without separate credit. OPD provides token-level guidance at student-visited prefixes, but its pointwise signal does not directly reflect the pattern of teacher--student disagreement across the vocabulary. Dense, unbounded log-ratio supervision can amplify the teacher's influence, yet a strong solver is not necessarily a suitable guide when the student's solution paths depart from the teacher's. We propose Residual Advantage (\RA{}), which treats the teacher--student probability residual as a bounded one-step reward, subtracts the corresponding state value under the student policy to form a standard advantage, and centers the result within each response before adding it to the verifier advantage. The guidance term has zero mean within each response, so the verifier advantage remains the response's mean label and the teacher only redistributes credit among the steps within it. \CoRA{} further updates a teacher LoRA with verifier advantages on the same scored student batch and uses the updated teacher in the next iteration's residual, adapting guidance to the student's attempts. With Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-4B-Base students and a Qwen3-8B teacher, \RA{} combined with GRPO or REINFORCE++ improves the underlying sequence-advantage algorithm in all 24 comparisons on three mathematical benchmarks, raising macro Avg@8 by 1.7--3.6 points and Pass@8 by 3.9--6.3 points. Both combinations surpass teacher-only OPD, and \CoRA{} adds a further 1.0--1.5 Avg@8 points.

AI.tldr: 提出 Residual Advantage (RA)，将教师-学生概率残差作为有界一步奖励，构造标准优势并在响应内中心化后叠加到 verifier 优势上；CoRA 进一步迭代更新教师 LoRA，在数学推理基准上稳定提升 GRPO/REINFORCE++。
AI.motivation: RLVR 只给整条响应一个结果标签，步骤级信用缺失；OPD 提供 token 级指导，但其逐点信号未反映词表上教师-学生分歧模式。稠密无界 log-ratio 监督会放大教师影响，而强解题者未必适合作为学生偏离路径时的引导者。
AI.method: RP（Residual Advantage）：把教师-学生概率残差视为有界一步奖励，减去学生策略下对应状态价值得到标准优势，在每条响应内做中心化后加到 verifier 优势上，保证引导项均值为零、verifier 优势仍为响应的平均标签，教师仅在响应内重新分配步骤信用。CoRA：在同一批已打分学生数据上用 verifier 优势更新教师 LoRA，并在下一轮残差中使用更新后的教师，使指导随学生尝试自适应。
AI.result: 以 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 与 Qwen3-4B-Base 为学生、Qwen3-8B 为教师，RP 结合 GRPO 或 REINFORCE++ 在三个数学基准的 24 项比较中全部优于原始序列优势算法，宏平均 Avg@8 提升 1.7--3.6 分，Pass@8 提升 3.9--6.3 分；两种组合均超过纯教师 OPD，CoRA 再额外带来 1.0--1.5 Avg@8 分提升。
AI.conclusion: RA 将密集教师指导转化为有界、响应内零均值的步骤级优势修正，不改变结果级信用分配，可与主流策略优化算法即插即用；CoRA 通过迭代更新教师 LoRA 使指导自适应学生，取得一致且叠加的性能增益。

title: When Can You Prune Your Network? A Study of Intermediate Neurons in Multilingual Speech Parsing
comment: to appear in Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: End-to-end speech parsing, a task recently proposed, consists in predicting both the transcription and the syntactic tree for a spoken utterance. Existing architectures for speech parsing often utilise intermediate neural networks. In this work, we examine the effectiveness of intermediate neural networks (NN) for parsing, and, specifically, what role do they play. We introduce a simpler end-to-end architecture for speech parsing, where we remove these intermediate NN units, reducing the parameters by 12%, while achieving comparable or better performance than prior method on both automatic speech recognition (ASR) and parsing. We demonstrate that intermediate NN units help reduce the representational gap when the pre-trained encoder is frozen. We do a comprehensive evaluation of speech parsing on French, and medium-low resource languages Slovenian and Naija. We further investigate the impact of the training data size and intermediate layers of the pretrained speech encoder on speech parsing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究端到端语音解析中中间神经网络的必要性，提出去除中间NN单元的简化架构，参数减少12%的同时在ASR与解析任务上达到相当或更优性能，并在法语、斯洛文尼亚语和Naija语上评估。
AI.motivation: 现有语音解析架构普遍依赖中间神经网络单元，但其具体作用尚不明确，缺乏对其功能的分析。本文旨在探究这些中间NN单元是否必要及其所扮演的角色。
AI.method: 提出一种更简化的端到端语音解析架构，移除中间NN单元；在预训练语音编码器冻结与不冻结条件下对比分析中间单元对表征差距的影响；在法语及中低资源语言（斯洛文尼亚语、Naija）上进行评估，并考察训练数据规模和编码器中间层对解析的影响。
AI.result: 去除中间NN单元后参数减少12%，ASR与解析性能与既有方法相当或更优；实验表明，当预训练编码器冻结时，中间NN单元有助于缩小表征差距。此外还揭示了训练数据规模及预训练语音编码器中间层的作用。
AI.conclusion: 中间NN单元并非语音解析的必需组件，其价值主要体现在编码器冻结时弥补表征差距；简化架构可在减少参数的同时保持或提升性能，并为多语言及资源受限场景下的语音解析提供了实证参考。

title: MSGAT: Multi-Head Spiking Graph Attention with Similarity-Space Fusion for Image-Text Retrieval
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient computing paradigm through sparse event-driven computation, showing great potential for efficient multimodal learning. However, applying SNNs to high-level multimodal tasks, such as image-text retrieval (ITR), remains challenging, since sparse spike representations make it difficult to capture semantic structures required for cross-modal alignment. Existing spiking ITR methods rely on local alignment and additional soft-label supervision during training, while lacking awareness of structural and multi-granularity relationships. To address these issues, we propose a Multi-head Spiking Graph Attention Network (\textbf{MSGAT}) for structural modeling and equip it with dynamic attention heads to capture complementary relational patterns and enable spike-driven graph reasoning and aggregation. However, within a two-branch multi-granularity fusion framework, the fine-grained spike representations generated by MSGAT are sparse and discrete, whereas the global representations are continuous, making conventional feature-level fusion susceptible to interference across heterogeneous representations. Therefore, we introduce \textbf{Sim-Fuse}, a similarity-space fusion alignment strategy integrating coarse- and fine-grained matching relations while avoiding direct fusion of heterogeneous representations. Experiments on Flickr30K and MSCOCO show our method outperforms ANN methods under matched settings and existing SNN retrieval baselines. Moreover, with only two time steps, our SNN achieves comparable or superior performance to its ANN counterpart while reducing theoretical module-level energy by 55\%. The code is provided in the Supplementary Materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向脉冲神经网络图像-文本检索的MSGAT与Sim-Fuse方法，在Flickr30K和MSCOCO上超越ANN匹配设置与现有SNN基线，两时间步下性能相当且理论模块级能耗降低55%。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络凭借稀疏事件驱动计算具备能效优势，但应用于图像-文本检索等高层多模态任务时，稀疏脉冲表示难以捕捉跨模态对齐所需的语义结构。现有脉冲ITR方法依赖局部对齐和训练期额外软标签监督，缺乏对结构性与多粒度关系的感知。
AI.method: 提出多头脉冲图注意力网络（MSGAT）进行结构化建模，配备动态注意力头以捕捉互补关系模式并实现脉冲驱动的图推理与聚合；在双分支多粒度融合框架中，针对MSGAT生成的细粒度脉冲表示稀疏离散、全局表示连续导致异构表征干扰的问题，引入Sim-Fuse相似度空间融合对齐策略，融合粗细粒度匹配关系并避免异构表示的直接融合。
AI.result: 在Flickr30K和MSCOCO数据集上，方法在匹配设置下优于ANN方法，并超越现有SNN检索基线；仅用两个时间步，SNN即达到与其ANN对应模型相当或更优的性能，同时理论模块级能耗降低55%。
AI.conclusion: 脉冲图注意力与相似度空间融合对齐可有效提升SNN在多模态检索中的结构与多粒度建模能力，在保持能效优势的同时实现与ANN相当甚至更优的检索性能。

title: HAND: A Biologically-Inspired Activation Function that Improves Generalisation and Sample Efficiency in Image Classification
summary: DNNs exhibit robustness and generalisation issues not seen in humans. They are also far less data-efficient learners, requiring considerably more training samples to accurately classify novel exemplars. Inductive bias could help with these issues by providing in-built mechanisms to improve generalisation, and hence, reduce reliance on learning from data. We incorporate a biologically-inspired inductive bias into a new activation function, HAND (Homeostasis, Accelerating Nonlinearity, and Divisive-nomalisation), and show its effectiveness with CNNs trained on image classification. Using HAND a ConvNeXt-tiny required 25 training epochs to reach the same accuracy on ImageNet1k as the unmodified model achieved after 200 epochs. Consistent with the effects of an inductive bias, the performance gap reduced with training time and increased data augmentation. When the volume of training data was reduced and unevenly distributed between classes (Long-tailed ImageNet) the improvements in accuracy were even larger and did not reduce with increased training time. Generalisation performance with the common-corruptions data, and the ability to reject samples from unknown classes, were unaffected or improved by HAND. Results generalised across CNN architectures and training data-sets. HAND can, therefore, reduce the required training time and/or the required volume and variety of training data, helping to improve sample efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受生物启发的激活函数 HAND（稳态、加速非线性、除法归一化），将其作为归纳偏置嵌入 CNN，以提升图像分类的泛化性与样本效率。
AI.motivation: DNN 存在鲁棒性与泛化缺陷，且数据效率远低于人类，需要大量训练样本才能准确分类新样本。归纳偏置可通过内置机制改善泛化，从而降低对数据学习的依赖。
AI.method: 将生物启发的归纳偏置引入新的激活函数 HAND，包含稳态（Homeostasis）、加速非线性（Accelerating Nonlinearity）与除法归一化（Divisive-normalisation）三个机制，并在 CNN 图像分类任务中验证；涵盖 ConvNeXt-tiny 与 ImageNet1k、长尾 ImageNet、常见损坏数据及未知类拒识，并跨 CNN 架构与数据集检验泛化性。
AI.result: 使用 HAND 的 ConvNeXt-tiny 仅需 25 个训练 epoch 即可达到未修改模型 200 epoch 的 ImageNet1k 精度。性能差距随训练时间增加和数据增强增强而缩小；在数据量减少且类间分布不均（长尾 ImageNet）时精度提升更大，且不随训练时间增加而衰减。常见损坏数据上的泛化性能及未知类拒识能力未受影响或有所提升。结果在不同 CNN 架构与数据集上均可泛化。
AI.conclusion: HAND 可减少所需训练时间及/或训练数据的规模与多样性，有助于提升样本效率。

title: Constitutional Gating and Deterministic Recovery for Multi-Agent LLM Negotiation: Ablations Against a Stateful Adversarial Gatekeeper
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures. v3: corrects a statement about the companion paper (Section 6). v2 added the code and data repository and its licence (Appendix F) and described the released May 2026 logs as excerpts. Changes are listed at the end of Appendix F; no result changed. Code, logs and analysis: https://github.com/0x-AO-Protocol/constitutional-gating-testbed. Companion paper: arXiv:2610.09772
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems negotiating with a stateful counterpart waste model calls in three ways: polite loops that never meet the counterpart's hidden acceptance condition, malformed outputs that trigger retries, and compliance deadlocks in which the counterpart demands something the agent must refuse. We study a three-part control stack - a 5-Pillar runtime constitution, a 4-tier swarm (Director, three-agent majority vote, Monitor, schema hard gate) and Cognitive Annealing (deterministic deadlock detection, atomic purge of the agent-side context, a canonical recovery message) - against a released adversarial Gatekeeper whose acceptance rules are fixed regular expressions and whose LLM only renders reply text. The testbed has a known solution: it measures whether the stack executes a constitution-aligned strategy against swarm drift and recovers from deadlock, not whether it discovers anything. In five runs per configuration (30 runs; Gemini 2.5 Pro agents, Claude Haiku 4.5 Gatekeeper) we find: (i) the constitution and Director make an acceptable framing possible but not reliable - 0/5 baseline unlocks versus 1/5 and 2/5 with the constitution; when the swarm unlocks it does so in one turn with 7-8 calls and about 15k tokens (67-73% below baseline); when it does not, it costs 17-38% more; (ii) the Monitor and hard gate do not reduce unlocks and leave an audit trail; (iii) under a honeytrap-to-compliance deadlock, LLM-only steering escapes 0 of 5 times while atomic purge plus a canonical strike escapes 5 of 5 (Fisher $p = 0.008$) at the same call budget, with zero calls for the strike. LLM-written strikes failed the deterministic pre-flight 5 of 5 times although an LLM Monitor had approved four. Pre-registered hypotheses on average call and token reduction were not supported. Cost is bounded in every arm by deterministic stop rules; the stack adds recovery at no extra model cost.

AI.tldr: 本研究报告了一套三段式控制栈（5-Pillar运行时宪法、4层蜂群架构、Cognitive Annealing），用于解决多智能体LLM系统在与有状态对手协商时的三类模型调用浪费问题，并在对抗性Gatekeeper测试平台上验证其解锁能力与死锁恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统在与有状态对手谈判时，会因三种原因浪费模型调用：永不能满足对手隐藏接受条件的礼貌循环、触发重试的畸形输出、以及对手要求智能体必须拒绝之物的合规死锁。研究动机是考察控制栈能否在蜂群漂移下执行符合宪法的策略并从死锁中恢复。
AI.method: 测试平台为已发布的对抗性Gatekeeper，其接受规则为固定正则表达式，其LLM仅负责渲染回复文本，且存在已知解。控制栈由三部分组成：(1) 5-Pillar运行时宪法；(2) 4层蜂群（Director、三智能体多数投票、Monitor、schema硬门）；(3) Cognitive Annealing（确定性死锁检测、智能体侧上下文的原子清除、规范化恢复消息）。每个配置运行5次，共30次（智能体用Gemini 2.5 Pro，Gatekeeper用Claude Haiku 4.5）。
AI.result: (i) 宪法与Director使可接受的框架成为可能但不稳定：基线解锁0/5，加宪法后为1/5与2/5；解锁时仅需1轮、7-8次调用、约15k tokens（比基线低67-73%），未解锁时成本高17-38%。(ii) Monitor与硬门未减少解锁率，且留下了审计线索。(iii) 在honeytrap-to-compliance死锁下，纯LLM引导0/5次逃脱，而原子清除加规范化strike则5/5次逃脱（Fisher p=0.008），调用预算相同，strike零调用。LLM撰写的strike在确定性预检中5/5次失败，尽管LLM Monitor批准了其中四次。关于平均调用与token减少的预注册假设未获支持。
AI.conclusion: 在每一实验组中，成本均被确定性停止规则所约束；该控制栈在不增加额外模型成本的前提下提供了恢复能力。确定性机制（原子清除与规范化strike）在死锁恢复上显著优于纯LLM引导。

title: Learning the Loop, Not Just the Page: Execution-Grounded Loop Learning for Web Generation
summary: Functional Web generation is increasingly optimized with executable rewards, yet existing methods largely focus on the quality of the final page and leave the process of diagnosing and repairing imperfect implementations underexplored. We identify a central challenge in this setting: the Generator and Refiner produce executable artifacts with direct environment rewards, whereas the intermediate Critic influences downstream behavior without a directly executable outcome. We introduce WebLoop, an execution-grounded framework that jointly learns generation, critique, and refinement within a shared policy. WebLoop trains an execution-free Critic with complementary signals for requirement-level discriminability and downstream helpfulness, first establishing reliable diagnosis and then introducing consequence-aware credit, while all three roles are jointly optimized with group-relative policy learning. With Qwen3.5-9B, WebLoop reaches 41.5 Overall on WebRise and 38.9% accuracy on WebGen-Bench, improving the base model by 11.3 and 15.4 points, respectively. The gains transfer to first-pass generation, persist at 27B scale, and generalize from text-only training to multimodal inputs. Controlled analyses further show that the improvement cannot be explained by an additional refinement pass alone, highlighting the importance of learning the Critic and the loop itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WebLoop，一个以执行为基础的框架，在同一共享策略中联合学习生成、批判与精炼，重点解决中间 Critic 缺乏可直接执行结果所带来的训练挑战。在 Qwen3.5-9B 上，WebLoop 在 WebRise 上达到 41.5 Overall，在 WebGen-Bench 上达到 38.9% 准确率，相比基座模型分别提升 11.3 和 15.4 个点，且增益可迁移、可跨规模保持并泛化至多模态输入。
AI.motivation: 功能性网页生成正越来越多地借助可执行奖励进行优化，但现有方法主要关注最终页面质量，对不完美实现的诊断与修复过程探索不足。作者识别出该场景的核心难题：Generator 与 Refiner 产出可执行工件并直接获得环境奖励，而作为中间环节的 Critic 仅通过影响下游行为起作用，缺乏可直接执行的产出，导致难以直接优化。
AI.method: WebLoop 以执行基础为依托，在同一共享策略内联合学习生成、批判与精炼三种角色。它训练一个无需执行的 Critic，引入互补信号：一是需求级别的可区分性，二是对下游的有用性；先建立可靠的诊断能力，再引入后果感知的信用分配。三个角色通过组相对策略学习（group-relative policy learning）进行联合优化。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-9B 上，WebLoop 于 WebRise 取得 41.5 Overall，在 WebGen-Bench 上取得 38.9% 准确率，较基座模型分别提升 11.3 与 15.4 个点。增益可迁移到首轮生成，在 27B 规模下依然保持，并能从纯文本训练泛化到多模态输入。控制实验进一步表明，该提升无法仅由增加一次精炼过程来解释。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，学习 Critic 与循环机制本身是性能提升的关键来源，而非单纯增加精炼次数。WebLoop 表明，通过对中间 Critic 施加互补信号并进行联合优化，可有效提升功能性网页生成的诊断与修复能力，且该框架具备良好的可扩展性与泛化性。

title: Prosody-to-Text: Predicting text from low-pass filtered speech
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: While predicting prosody from text is an established task in the field, the opposite direction, predicting text that fits a given prosodic pattern, remains largely overlooked. We find this unfortunate, because this opposite direction could lead to some very interesting use cases. Therefore, in this paper, we make the first steps in the prosody-to-text direction by inves- tigating how much of the original sentence can be recovered from its prosodic pattern. To this end, we fine-tune the Whis- per model using only the 12 lowest Mel bins (low-pass filter with approximately 450Hz cutoff), and obtain surprisingly accurate results (WER 36%), with 10% of utterances be- ing recovered perfectly, and 40% of utterances having Word Error Rate at or below 25%. We also find that, given the correct prefix, the next token was predicted correctly in 79% of cases. Our results suggest that the relationship between low-frequency speech features and lexical content is much stronger than previously thought, and we believe that direct- ing more attention to this topic might open the door to new applications, such as using prosody to guide text generation of modern LLMs

AI.tldr: 本文将"韵律到文本"作为反向新任务,仅用Whisper最低12个Mel频带(约450Hz低通)微调,即可从韵律模式中恢复原句,WER 36%,10%句子完全正确。
AI.motivation: 从文本预测韵律已是成熟任务,但反向的"从给定韵律模式预测文本"长期被忽视。作者认为该方向具有有趣的潜在应用价值(如用韵律引导LLM文本生成),因此需要探索低频频谱特征与词汇内容之间的关系究竟有多强。
AI.method: 初步探索韵律到文本方向:将Whisper模型仅使用最低12个Mel频带(低通滤波,截止频率约450Hz)进行微调,并在此基础上评估句子恢复能力,包括整体WER、完美恢复比例,以及给定正确前缀时的下一词元预测准确率。
AI.result: 结果出人意料地准确:整体WER为36%;10%的语句被完全正确恢复;40%的语句WER不超过25%;给定正确前缀时,下一词元预测正确率达79%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明低频语音特征与词汇内容之间的关系远比此前认为的更强,值得学术界给予更多关注,并有望开启新应用,例如用韵律引导现代LLM的文本生成。

title: OX-NeRF: 3D X-ray Tomography Reconstruction from Sparse Views Using Implicit Neural Representation
summary: NeRF and Gaussian splatting methods have been successfully applied on X-ray scenes where the views are too sparse for 3D reconstruction via classical methods. Ultra-sparse scenes with 10 or fewer views such as those with high-rate or low-dose acquisition still, however, present a significant challenge. To address this problem we present a new framework, Optimised X-ray Neural Radiance Fields (OX-NeRF), that combines cross-scene feature learning with scene-specific optimisation to reconstruct sets of related scenes. OX-NeRF employs a convolutional neural network (CNN) to identify cross-scene features while maintaining scene-specific multi-resolution hash grids of spatial features. The paired representations are fused and passed to a multilayer perceptron (MLP); the CNN, hash grids and MLP are then jointly optimised end-to-end. Benchmarking on parallel-beam and cone-beam X-ray datasets shows OX-NeRF provides significantly higher reconstruction accuracy on ultra-sparse scenes compared to existing radiance field methods.

AI.tldr: OX-NeRF框架结合跨场景特征学习与场景特定优化，通过CNN、多分辨率哈希网格与MLP的联合端到端训练，显著提升超稀疏X射线场景的3D重建精度。
AI.motivation: 经典方法在视图稀疏时难以完成3D重建，而NeRF与高斯溅射虽已用于X射线场景，但在视图数不超过10的超稀疏情况（如高速率或低剂量采集）下仍面临重大挑战。
AI.method: 提出OX-NeRF框架：用CNN提取跨场景共享特征，同时为每个场景维护特定的多分辨率哈希网格空间特征表示；将二者配对融合后输入MLP，CNN、哈希网格与MLP进行端到端联合优化，实现跨场景学习与场景特定优化的结合。
AI.result: 在平行束与锥束X射线数据集上的基准测试表明，相比现有辐射场方法，OX-NeRF在超稀疏场景下取得显著更高的重建精度。
AI.conclusion: 跨场景特征学习与场景特定表示的结合能有效缓解超稀疏X射线视图的重建难题，OX-NeRF为10视图以内的X射线3D重建提供了新的解决方案。

title: SWE-Journey: Towards More Realistic Evaluation of Coding Assistants through Long-Horizon, Multi-Turn Interaction
summary: Coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex have become a major application of LLM agents, yet existing benchmarks remain far from real-world use, particularly in task horizon and interaction length. Code assistants require completing long chains of development work in continuously evolving repositories, while repeatedly clarifying requirements and adapting implementations through multi-turn interaction. To address these gaps, we introduce SWE-Journey, a benchmark for more realistic evaluation of coding assistants. To address the task-horizon gap, we propose a weak-to-strong synthesis pipeline that automatically constructs long-horizon coding tasks. To address the interaction gap, we mine four representative user personas from real interaction data and build a user-simulation agent to reproduce realistic code-assistance interactions. On average, models pass over 75% of tests for requested functionality with software architects, but fewer than 25% with non-coders. These results show that current coding assistants still fall short of enabling reliable coding for non-coders. We further analyze the reasons for this gap and identify asking right, finding right, and fixing right as key capabilities during interaction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SWE-Journey 基准，通过弱到强的任务合成与用户模拟智能体，从任务长度和多轮交互两个维度更真实地评测编程助手；结果显示模型面对软件架构师用户通过率超75%，而面对非程序员用户不足25%。
AI.motivation: 现有编程助手（如 Claude Code、Codex）的评测基准与现实使用脱节，尤其体现在两方面：一是任务视野（task horizon）过短，真实开发需要在持续演进的代码库中完成长链条开发工作；二是交互长度不足，真实场景需通过多轮对话反复澄清需求、调整实现。因此需要更贴近真实使用的评测基准。
AI.method: 提出 SWE-Journey 基准。针对任务视野差距，设计弱到强（weak-to-strong）合成流水线，自动构造长视野编程任务；针对交互差距，从真实交互数据中挖掘四类代表性用户画像（user personas），并构建用户模拟智能体以复现真实的代码辅助交互过程。
AI.result: 平均而言，面对软件架构师用户时，模型在所需功能测试上的通过率超过75%；而面对非程序员用户时，通过率不足25%。结果表明当前编程助手仍难以支撑非程序员进行可靠编程。
AI.conclusion: 现有编程助手与非程序员可靠编程的目标仍有明显差距。论文进一步分析该差距的成因，识别出交互过程中三项关键能力：问得对（asking right）、找得对（finding right）、修得对（fixing right）。

title: Hankel Subspace Self-Supervised Learning for Parallel MRI Reconstruction
summary: Parallel magnetic resonance imaging reconstruction is an ill-posed inverse problem under undersampling. Multi-coil acquisition and Hankel lifting expose complementary repeated information: observations of the same anatomy across coils and repeated local k-space neighborhoods in overlapping windows. These dependencies guide recovery of missing k-space data. However, splitting lifted Hankel entries for self-supervision can place the original sample in both input and target, causing data leakage. We propose Hankel Subspace Self-Supervised Reconstruction (HSSRecon), a scan-specific reconstruction framework for parallel magnetic resonance imaging. HSSRecon partitions data by physical acquisition units before Hankel lifting and applies multiplicity normalization to repeated Hankel copies in overlapping windows. Rather than learning a mapping that directly predicts missing data, the network learns a compact complex-valued Hankel subspace operator. Reconstruction is performed over the original k-space variables using a conjugategradient solver with hard data consistency. This design separates structural learning in the Hankel domain from data consistency in the physical domain: the former exploits multi-coil and local Hankel correlations, while the latter solves over unacquired degrees of freedom. We provide theoretical analyses of physicalgroup splitting and multiplicity normalization, and establish positive definiteness, uniqueness, hard data consistency, and a finite-step conjugate-gradient error bound for the system. On fastMRI brain data with three contrasts and three sampling masks, HSSRecon achieves competitive peak signal-to-noise ratio, structural similarity, and normalized mean squared error across six aggregated conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HSSRecon，一种面向并行MRI的扫描特异性自监督重建框架。它按物理采集单元划分数据后再做Hankel提升，并对重叠窗口中重复的Hankel副本进行多重性归一化，以避免自监督中的数据泄漏；网络学习紧凑的复值Hankel子空间算子，并借助带硬数据一致性的共轭梯度求解器在原始k空间变量上完成重建。理论分析证明了正定性、唯一性、硬数据一致性及有限步CG误差界；在fastMRI脑部三对比度、三采样掩码上取得有竞争力的PSNR、SSIM和NMSE。
AI.motivation: 并行MRI在欠采样下重建是不适定逆问题。多线圈采集与Hankel提升暴露了互补的重复信息（同一解剖结构跨线圈的观测、重叠窗口中重复的局部k空间邻域），可指导缺失k空间恢复。但直接拆分提升后的Hankel条目做自监督，会使原始样本同时出现在输入与目标中，造成数据泄漏。
AI.method: 提出HSSRecon扫描特异性重建框架：在Hankel提升前按物理采集单元划分数据，避免泄漏；对重叠窗口中重复的Hankel副本施加多重性归一化。网络不直接预测缺失数据，而是学习紧凑的复值Hankel子空间算子；重建在原始k空间变量上进行，使用带硬数据一致性的共轭梯度求解器，将Hankel域的结构学习与物理域的数据一致性分离。文中给出物理组划分与多重性归一化的理论分析，并证明系统的正定性、唯一性、硬数据一致性及有限步CG误差界。
AI.result: 在fastMRI脑部数据上，使用三种对比度和三种采样掩码，HSSRecon在六种聚合条件下的PSNR、SSIM与NMSE均具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: HSSRecon通过物理单元划分与多重性归一化消除自监督泄漏，并将Hankel域结构学习与物理域数据一致性解耦，在并行MRI重建中兼顾理论保证与实证性能。

title: Incremental Open-Ended Deep Research with Structured Harness
summary: Existing Open-Ended Deep Research (OEDR) systems primarily generate reports from scratch, making them inefficient for scenarios where research reports need to be continuously maintained as new information emerges. We introduce \textbf{Incremental Open-Ended Deep Research (Incremental-OEDR)}, a research setting that treats a report as an evolving research state and incrementally updates it by preserving valid knowledge, revising outdated or incomplete content, and incorporating newly available information. To support this setting, we propose \textbf{Structured Harness}, which represents reports as structured collections of outlines, sections, and supporting evidence, and provides structured retrieval, a persistent structured evidence pool, and structured generation for selective report updating and evidence reuse. We further establish a temporal evaluation framework spanning ten years, with \emph{Single-Step Task} and \emph{Long-Chain Task} to evaluate incremental updates over both individual transitions and long-term update chains. Extensive Experiments on DeepResearch Bench and DeepConsult under both the Open-source Configuration (OC) and Proprietary Configuration (PC) show that Incremental-OEDR maintains competitive report quality while substantially improving report continuity and reducing research costs. As shown in Figure~\ref{fig:profile}, it achieves up to 0.51 higher content-level ROUGE-L F1, 0.63 higher outline-level EM F1, 33\% lower token consumption, and 61\% fewer search calls than OEDR on DeepResearch Bench. For more details, please refer to our project page: https://ioedr-project.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出增量式开放式深度研究（Incremental-OEDR）新任务，将研究报告视为可演化状态并支持增量更新；设计结构化框架（Structured Harness）及时序评测体系，在保持报告质量的同时大幅提升连续性并降低研究成本。
AI.motivation: 现有开放式深度研究（OEDR）系统主要从零生成报告，当新信息不断出现、报告需要持续维护时效率低下，缺乏对已有知识的保留、过时内容的修订与新增信息的整合机制。
AI.method: 提出Incremental-OEDR研究设定，将报告视为不断演化的研究状态，通过保留有效知识、修订过时或不完整内容、纳入新信息来实现增量更新；设计Structured Harness，将报告表示为大纲、章节与支撑证据的结构化集合，并提供结构化检索、持久化结构化证据池及结构化生成，以支持选择性报告更新与证据复用；构建跨十年的时序评测框架，包含单步任务（Single-Step Task）与长链任务（Long-Chain Task）。
AI.result: 在DeepResearch Bench与DeepConsult上，于开源配置（OC）和专有配置（PC）下均保持有竞争力的报告质量，同时显著提升报告连续性并降低研究成本：相较OEDR，内容级ROUGE-L F1提升最多0.51，大纲级EM F1提升0.63，Token消耗降低33%，搜索调用减少61%。
AI.conclusion: Incremental-OEDR在报告质量、连续性与研究成本之间取得良好平衡，验证了增量式研究范式的有效性，为持续演化的深度研究报告维护提供了可行方案。

title: PAM-ToD: Plug-and-Play Appearance Modeling for Cross-Time-of-Day 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Adapting a pre-trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) road scene to a new time of day requires learning appearance changes from a few anchor images while preserving consistent, real-time rendering. We propose PAM-ToD, a lightweight plug-in that learns color corrections while keeping the pre-trained 3DGS parameters fixed. PAM-ToD scales each Gaussian's existing color to model illumination changes and uses an additive term for additional brightness, such as when street lamps turn on at night. Under a simplified image formation model, unchanged surface albedo can be eliminated from the relation between source and target appearances, allowing us to learn these corrections without separately estimating albedo and illumination. The model corrects colors across the scene while allowing the corrections to vary by location and by Gaussian. To guide learning from a few anchor images, it discourages abrupt spatial changes in these corrections. We also introduce CARLA-ToD, a benchmark with matching geometry, camera poses, and moving-object trajectories across three times of day. A few target-time anchor images are used to train each plug-in, while separate views are used for evaluation. Across the static and dynamic settings, PAM-ToD achieves higher PSNR and lower LPIPS than the baselines, even when the anchor images come from a single synchronized capture across multiple cameras.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级插件PAM-ToD，在冻结预训练3DGS参数的前提下学习颜色校正，实现道路场景昼夜外观迁移，并发布CARLA-ToD基准。
AI.motivation: 将预训练3DGS道路场景迁移到新的时段需从少量锚点图像学习外观变化，同时保持一致的实时渲染；现有方法难以在少量锚点下兼顾外观变化建模与渲染一致性。
AI.method: PAM-ToD作为插件，保持预训练3DGS参数固定，仅学习颜色校正：对每个高斯的现有颜色进行缩放以建模光照变化，并加入加性项建模额外亮度（如夜间路灯开启）。在简化成像模型下，从源与目标外观关系式中消去不变的地表反照率，从而无需分别估计反照率与光照；校正按位置与高斯可变，并通过抑制校正的骤变来约束从少量锚点图像的学习。同时构建CARLA-ToD基准，包含三个时段下匹配的几何、相机位姿与运动物体轨迹。
AI.result: 在静态与动态设置下，PAM-ToD的PSNR高于基线、LPIPS低于基线；即使锚点图像来自多相机单次同步采集，仍保持优势。每个插件仅用少量目标时段锚点图像训练，评估使用独立视角。
AI.conclusion: PAM-ToD以极轻量的插件形式实现高效的道路场景时段外观迁移，在少量锚点条件下优于基线，且CARLA-ToD为跨时段道路场景研究提供了可控基准。

title: Smoothing the Top-k Exposure Boundary for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts models scale parameter capacity efficiently while maintaining a fixed compute budget per token. However, traditional training paradigms enforce a static choice of top-$k$ experts, which converts a continuous routing distribution into a rigid step function. This constraint introduces a brittle boundary where highly competitive experts are arbitrarily separated into full-supervision and zero-feedback zones based on minor score fluctuations. To address this issue, we propose Elastic Expert Routing, which stochastically samples the active expert budget from a localized discrete distribution centered at $k$. Over multiple training iterations, this mechanism softens the sharp threshold into a gradual probability distribution. Because the sampling neighborhood remains symmetric, this approach matches the expected computational cost of deterministic training, while preserving the inference budget. During supervised fine-tuning, elastic routing improves downstream macro-averages on OLMoE-1B-7B and Qwen3-30B-A3B by $+0.84$ and $+2.02$ points, respectively. In addition, in from-scratch pretraining, it reduces validation LM loss by up to $0.04$ and outperforms the static top-$k$ baseline by $1.6$ points on average across downstream tasks. Comparisons on Qwen3 fine-tuning and from-scratch pretraining further show higher average scores than Noisy top-$k$, expert FFN dropout, and DefaultMoE.

AI.tldr: 提出Elastic Expert Routing，通过在以k为中心的局部离散分布上随机采样活跃专家预算，将top-k的刚性阈值软化为概率分布，在保持期望计算成本与推理预算不变的前提下提升稀疏MoE模型性能。
AI.motivation: 传统稀疏MoE训练强制静态top-k专家选择，将连续路由分布转化为刚性阶跃函数，导致微小分数波动即把高度竞争的专家武断划入全监督区或零反馈区，形成脆弱的硬边界，损害训练效果。
AI.method: Elastic Expert Routing：从以k为中心的局部离散分布中随机采样活跃专家数量（预算），多次迭代后将尖锐阈值软化为渐进概率分布；采样邻域对称，故期望计算成本与确定性训练一致，推理预算保持不变。
AI.result: 监督微调中，OLMoE-1B-7B和Qwen3-30B-A3B下游宏平均分别提升+0.84和+2.02分；从头预训练中验证LM损失最多降低0.04，下游任务平均超静态top-k基线1.6分；在Qwen3微调与从头预训练上平均得分高于Noisy top-k、专家FFN dropout和DefaultMoE。
AI.conclusion: 弹性路由以零额外期望计算开销缓解top-k硬阈值问题，在微调与预训练两种场景下均优于静态top-k及多种相关基线，是一种通用且有效的稀疏MoE训练改进方案。

title: CoCam4D: Geometry-Aware Cooperative 4D Perception for Camera-Only Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicles often suffer from limited perception due to occlusions, blind spots, limited sensor range, and the complex nature of surrounding environments. Multi-agent collaborative perception (CP) addresses these challenges by allowing vehicles to share sensory information and reconstruct the scene cooperatively. However, camera-only perception remains fundamentally limited by the uncertainty of distance-dependent monocular depth estimation. We propose CoCam4D, a Bayesian framework for collaborative perception that explicitly models geometric uncertainty. It uses a VGGT-based feedforward network to generate 3D Gaussian scene representations with associated uncertainty estimates, enabling multiple vehicles or agents to efficiently combine their observations. By sharing compact Gaussian primitives, reliable observations from one agent can reduce the depth uncertainty of another without requiring LiDAR sensors. To support real-world deployment, we introduce Dynamic Object Primitives (DOPs), a compact 35-byte representation designed for efficient C-V2X communication. Extensive experiments show that our proposed method consistently outperforms recent vision-only methods, achieving improvements of 11.48% on OPV2V+ and 10.62% on DAIR-V2X-C, demonstrating the potential of geometrically grounded collaborative perception for LiDAR-free autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoCam4D，一个显式建模几何不确定性的贝叶斯协同感知框架。它利用基于VGGT的前馈网络生成带不确定性估计的3D高斯场景表示，使多智能体高效融合观测；通过共享紧凑高斯原语，无需LiDAR即可降低彼此的深度不确定性，并引入35字节的动态对象原语（DOPs）以适配C-V2X通信。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶常因遮挡、盲区、传感器范围受限及环境复杂而感知受限；多智能体协同感知可缓解此类问题，但纯相机感知受制于单目深度估计的距离相关不确定性。因此需要显式建模几何不确定性、且无需LiDAR的协同感知方案。
AI.method: 提出CoCam4D贝叶斯协同感知框架；采用基于VGGT的前馈网络生成带不确定性估计的3D高斯场景表示；多车/多智能体共享紧凑高斯原语以融合观测并降低深度不确定性；并设计35字节的动态对象原语（DOPs）用于高效C-V2X通信。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法一致优于近期纯视觉方法，在OPV2V+上提升11.48%，在DAIR-V2X-C上提升10.62%。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了基于几何基础的协同感知在无LiDAR自动驾驶中的潜力，能够在纯视觉条件下通过不确定性感知的多智能体融合提升感知性能。

title: Chronos Enables Code Agents to Reason over Software Evolution
summary: Historical pull requests record the design decisions, compatibility constraints, and implementation patterns behind a codebase's current state. Experience relevant to a new task can span related changes whose descriptions emphasize different concerns. We introduce Chronos, a test-time framework that makes this connected history available to large language model (LLM)-based code agents. Chronos distills merged pull requests into structured experience cards and connects them through a typed graph of code-level, developer-intent, and organizational relations. Semantic search identifies entry cards, and weighted multi-hop expansion retrieves connected changes for selective reading. The same memory guides candidate generation and patch selection: a patch-focused change agent and a validation-strategy agent each develop a patch, and an evolution steward consults history to select between them. On SWE-Bench Verified, the full workflow improves SWE-Agent across all six evaluated LLM backbones, raising the mean resolution rate from 69.2% to 72.9% and reaching 79.8% with MiniMax M2.5. With the same backbone, it raises resolution rates from 48.3% to 51.7% on SWE-Bench Pro and from 41.0% to 43.5% on FEA-Bench Lite. Both experience-guided single-agent variants also outperform the base agent. In a human evaluation on 100 tasks with ten cards retrieved per task, graph-grounded retrieval increases the mean number of useful cards from 1.24 to 2.87 over flat semantic retrieval. These results demonstrate the value of PR relations for retrieving useful repository experience and of the evaluated workflows for applying that experience during patch generation and selection.

AI.tldr: Chronos 是一个面向 LLM 代码智能体的测试时框架，将历史合并 PR 蒸馏为结构化经验卡，并通过类型化关系图连接与检索，用于指导补丁生成与选择，在多个基准上提升了解题率。
AI.motivation: 历史 pull request 记录了代码库设计决策、兼容性约束与实现模式，但相关经验往往分散在涉及不同关注点的变更中。如何让 LLM 代码智能体在测试时利用这种相互关联的仓库历史，是提升补丁生成与选择质量的关键问题。
AI.method: Chronos 将已合并的 pull request 蒸馏为结构化"经验卡"，并以代码层、开发者意图与组织关系构成的类型化图相互连接。语义搜索定位入口卡片，加权多跳扩展检索关联变更以供选择性阅读。同一记忆同时指导候选生成与补丁选择：一个补丁聚焦变更智能体和一个验证策略智能体各自生成补丁，再由演化管家查阅历史进行选择。
AI.result: 在 SWE-Bench Verified 上，完整流程在全部六个评测 LLM 主干上均提升 SWE-Agent，平均解决率从 69.2% 提升至 72.9%，搭配 MiniMax M2.5 达到 79.8%。同一主干下，SWE-Bench Pro 从 48.3% 提升至 51.7%，FEA-Bench Lite 从 41.0% 提升至 43.5%。两个经验引导的单智能体变体也均优于基础智能体。在 100 个任务、每任务检索 10 张卡片的人工评估中，图支撑检索将有用卡片平均数从 1.24 提升至 2.87。
AI.conclusion: PR 关系对于检索有用的仓库经验具有价值，且所评估的工作流能有效在补丁生成与选择过程中应用这些经验，为 LLM 代码智能体提供可复用的历史经验支持。

title: SV-TAD: Native Sparse Convs for Efficient Temporal Action Detection
summary: To adapt billion-parameter Vision Transformers for long-video understanding, recent methods freeze the backbone and train lightweight convolutional modules. While effective for parameter-efficient training, existing adapters do not reduce inference-time computation, leaving scalability with respect to video length largely unaddressed. Token selection can reduce attention cost by pruning redundant tokens, but it breaks the spatial grid structure required by convolutional adapters. This forces an expensive dense reconstruction, nullifying much of the potential speedup. We address this by introducing native sparse 2D convolutions, a primitive that allows these adapters, for the first time, to operate directly and efficiently on dynamically pruned token sets. We integrate this primitive into SV-TAD, an adapter framework for temporal action detection, reducing VideoMAEv2-L computation by up to 64% and achieving 2.2x faster inference, while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy on THUMOS-14 and ActivityNet-1.3. When scaled to InternVideoNext-L, our approach surpasses the previous state of the art at roughly half its computational cost. Moreover, the sparse formulation naturally supports auxiliary task tokens, which improves fine-grained assembly detection on ATTACH.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出原生稀疏2D卷积（native sparse 2D convolutions），使卷积适配器能直接作用于动态剪枝后的token集合，并将其集成到SV-TAD框架中用于时序动作检测，大幅降低长视频理解的推理计算量，同时保持或超越SOTA精度。
AI.motivation: 为适配十亿参数级Vision Transformer进行长视频理解，现有方法冻结骨干网络并训练轻量卷积模块以实现参数高效训练，但这些适配器无法降低推理阶段的计算量，视频长度可扩展性问题未解决。Token选择虽能通过剪枝冗余token减少注意力开销，却破坏了卷积适配器所需的规则空间网格结构，被迫进行昂贵的稠密重建，抵消了大部分潜在加速。
AI.method: 提出原生稀疏2D卷积这一基础算子，使卷积适配器首次能够直接且高效地在动态剪枝后的token集合上运行；将该算子集成到面向时序动作检测的适配器框架SV-TAD中。
AI.result: 在VideoMAEv2-L上减少最多64%计算量，实现2.2倍推理加速，同时在THUMOS-14和ActivityNet-1.3上保持SOTA精度；扩展至InternVideoNext-L时，以约一半计算成本超越此前SOTA；稀疏公式天然支持辅助任务token，在ATTACH上提升细粒度装配动作检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 原生稀疏2D卷积解决了token剪枝与卷积适配器空间网格需求之间的矛盾，兼顾推理效率与精度，为长视频理解提供了可扩展的适配方案，并能自然扩展至辅助任务。

title: Adapting English Quality Classifiers for Multilingual LLM Pretraining Data Selection
summary: Recent advances in large language model (LLM) pretraining highlight the role of high-quality training data in improving performance. While model-based filtering has proven effective in selecting high-quality subsets from web-scale corpora, especially for high-resource languages, low-resource languages face challenges due to limited availability of annotated data. This work explores extending quality filtering to over 100 languages by proposing a multilingual adaptation approach that converts an existing English quality classifier into a multilingual variant. Our approach proposes training a small multi-layer perceptron on top of Transformer encoder-only model embeddings, using multilingual text as input and scores obtained from English classifiers applied to machine-translated text as labels. Our 1B, 3B and 8B scale experiments show that our approach maintains the downstream LLM benchmark performance of existing multilingual model-based filtering baselines, without harming regional and cultural knowledge benchmarks. To further evaluate cross-lingual generalization, we compare classifier scores of high-quality synthetic data and web samples, and the correlation of classifier scores with LLM-based ones, revealing that the classifier can learn the scoring criteria of its original English variant, even for languages not included in its training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多语言适配方法，将现有英语质量分类器转换为支持100多种语言的多语言变体，用于低资源语言的训练数据质量过滤。
AI.motivation: 高质量训练数据对LLM预训练性能至关重要，基于模型的质量过滤在高资源语言上有效，但低资源语言因缺乏标注数据而难以应用。本文旨在将质量过滤扩展至100多种语言。
AI.method: 在仅编码器Transformer嵌入之上训练一个小型多层感知机（MLP），以多语言文本为输入，以英语分类器对机器翻译文本的打分作为标签进行训练。
AI.result: 在1B、3B和8B规模实验中，该方法在保持现有多语言基于模型过滤基线的下游LLM基准性能的同时，未损害区域与文化知识基准。分类器得分与LLM打分具有相关性，且对未参与训练的语言也能学到原始英语变体的评分标准。
AI.conclusion: 通过多语言适配可将英语质量分类器迁移至100多种语言，在低资源场景下实现有效质量过滤，并具备跨语言泛化能力。

title: Measuring Cultural Alignment Beyond the Average: A Framework for Evaluating Maternal-Health LLM Interactions in Indian Contexts
summary: Existing evaluation methods for healthcare LLMs primarily assess factual correctness,safety, and fluency, while providing limited insight into whether generated interactions reflect culturally situated healthcare reasoning. This limitation is particularly important in maternal health, where care decisions are shaped by social and relational norms. We introduce MH-INDIC, a culturally grounded evaluation framework for maternal-health interactions in urban and semi-urban North Indian contexts that operationalises cultural behaviour through ten dimensions of maternal-health reasoning. Using a 26-item survey administered to 102 pregnant and postpartum women from urban and semi-urban North India, we evaluate ten LLMs. We distinguish population level cultural alignment from profile-level behavioural variation. Although several models approximate the human population-level distribution, all evaluated systems exhibit substantially lower variation across demographic and household profiles than the human cohort, revealing a gap between aggregate alignment and profile-conditioned sensitivity. As a downstream application of MH-INDIC, we use the strongest-aligned proprietary and open-source models to generate culturally conditioned maternal-health dialogues under zero-shot, self-conditioned, and human-grounded prompting. Human-grounded conditioning produces stronger profile alignment and dialogue quality ratings, suggesting that measured cultural profiles can improve the cultural grounding of generated interactions

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MH-INDIC——一个面向北印度城市与半城市语境、文化根植的孕产妇健康交互评估框架，用十个孕产妇健康推理维度操作化文化行为；通过对102名孕产期女性的26题问卷评估10个LLM，发现模型可近似人群层面文化分布，但跨人口与家庭画像的行为变异显著低于人类，揭示"聚合对齐"与"画像条件敏感性"之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗LLM评估主要衡量事实正确性、安全性与流畅度，难以判断生成交互是否体现文化情境化的医疗推理。这一局限在孕产妇健康领域尤为关键，因为照护决策受社会与关系规范塑造。
AI.method: 构建MH-INDIC文化根植评估框架，以十个孕产妇健康推理维度操作化文化行为；对北印度城市与半城市102名孕产期女性实施26项问卷；评估10个LLM，并区分人群层面文化对齐与画像层面行为变异；下游应用中以最强对齐的闭源与开源模型，在zero-shot、self-conditioned与human-grounded三种提示条件下生成文化条件化孕产妇健康对话。
AI.result: 多个模型能近似人类人群层面的分布，但所有被评估系统在人口与家庭画像上的变异均显著低于人类队列；human-grounded conditioning带来更强的画像对齐与更高的对话质量评分。
AI.conclusion: 聚合层面的文化对齐并不等同于画像条件下的敏感性，二者存在系统性差距；经测量的文化画像可用于提升生成交互的文化根植性，MH-INDIC为孕产妇健康交互的文化情境化评估与改进提供了可操作路径。

title: Probing for Long-Horizon Deductive Reasoning Capabilities in Language Models with Prolog
summary: Current frontier LLMs can theoretically process long contexts with 1M tokens or more. But to what extent can they go beyond simple retrieval and perform deeper reasoning over such long contexts? We empirically investigate long-horizon reasoning capabilities of LLMs, focusing on deductive logic expressed in Prolog. We construct ProloNg, a synthetic testbed to probe Prolog Long Reasoning, which systematically varies the complexity (reasoning depth) of problems, where the hardest case has a reasoning depth of 22 and 62k context length. We study 8 reasoning models across 5 families of frontier LLMs, and find that performance degrades substantially as reasoning depth grows, with the majority of models approaching chance beyond depth 10.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了Prolog长推理测试集ProloNg，系统变化推理深度，发现8个前沿推理模型随深度增加性能大幅下降，深度超过10后多数模型接近随机水平。
AI.motivation: 当前前沿LLM理论上可处理百万级token长上下文，但其能否在长上下文中进行超出简单检索的深度推理尚不清楚，需要实证检验长程推理能力。
AI.method: 以Prolog表达的演绎逻辑为对象，构建合成测试平台ProloNg（Prolog Long Reasoning），系统变化问题复杂度（推理深度），最难案例推理深度达22、上下文长度62k；评估5个前沿LLM家族共8个推理模型。
AI.result: 随推理深度增长模型性能显著下降，深度超过10后大多数模型表现接近随机猜测水平。
AI.conclusion: 前沿LLM在长上下文中的深度演绎推理能力仍十分有限，长上下文处理能力不等于长程推理能力。

title: Large Language Model Turnover Undermines Screening for Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Scientific Writing
summary: Journals and conferences have begun to screen submitted manuscripts for text written using large language models (LLMs). The reliability of this screening rests on benchmark evaluations against a fixed set of LLM versions, while the versions in actual use keep changing. Here we quantify how this LLM turnover affects the screening of scientific manuscripts. We paired 4,000 pre-ChatGPT abstracts from the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences with their rewrites by 23 LLM versions from three vendors, released between June 2023 and August 2026. We then trained detectors under maintenance scenarios ranging from a detector retrained on every new version to one trained once and never updated. Detectors trained only on a vendor's past versions can collapse at the boundaries between model generations: calibrated to falsely flag 1% of human-written abstracts, they catch above 99% of rewrites just before the sharpest boundary and 3.8% just after it. Detectors trained on later versions can also miss rewrites of earlier ones. Vocabulary differences between versions largely track where detection transfers and where it fails. In the two screening scenarios we simulated, screens covering all 23 versions either flagged one in eight human-written abstracts or missed one in three rewrites of the newest version. Indeed, a commercial detector missed most rewrites of the version just after the sharpest boundary while flagging almost no human-written abstracts. Research-integrity policy should therefore treat the benchmark accuracy of a detector as provisional, to be re-verified with every LLM release, including earlier versions.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了大语言模型版本更迭对科学稿件AI文本筛查可靠性的影响，发现检测器在模型代际边界处性能会急剧崩溃，基准精度应被视为临时性指标。
AI.motivation: 期刊和会议已开始筛查投稿中使用大语言模型撰写的文本，但这种筛查的可靠性依赖于针对固定LLM版本集合的基准评估，而实际使用的模型版本却在不断变化。作者希望量化LLM版本更替对科学稿件筛查的影响。
AI.method: 将4,000篇ChatGPT之前的PNAS摘要与由3家厂商、2023年6月至2026年8月间发布的23个LLM版本生成的改写文本配对。在从"每有新版本即重新训练"到"训练一次永不更新"的多种维护情景下训练检测器。
AI.result: 仅用某厂商历史版本训练的检测器会在模型代际边界处崩溃：在校准为1%人类摘要误报率下，最锐利边界之前可捕获超99%的改写，边界之后仅3.8%。用较晚版本训练的检测器也会漏检较早版本的改写。版本间的词汇差异在很大程度上决定了检测迁移的成败。在两个模拟筛查情景中，覆盖全部23个版本的筛查要么误报八分之一的人类摘要，要么漏检最新版本三分之一的改写。一款商业检测器漏检了最锐利边界之后版本的多数改写，同时几乎不误报人类摘要。
AI.conclusion: 科研诚信政策应将检测器的基准精度视为临时性指标，需在每次LLM发布时（包括旧版本）重新验证。

title: S$^3$Geo: Structure-Semantic Synergistic Learning for Cross-View Geo-Localization
summary: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) aims to estimate geographic locations by matching images captured from different viewpoints, such as drone and satellite views. Existing methods mainly rely on visual representations, but often fail to jointly model fine-grained structural correspondences and semantic priors, making them prone to confusion between visually similar but semantically different regions, and thus limiting robustness under large viewpoint variations. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{S$^3$Geo}, a structure-semantic synergistic learning framework for cross-view matching. Specifically, we first introduce a Decoupled Query Pooling (DQP) module to extract a compact set of region-aware features from dense tokens, enabling explicit modeling of local structural patterns. We then design a query-level contrastive learning scheme with an optimal transport (OT)-based formulation to establish soft correspondences under cross-view spatial misalignment. Furthermore, we incorporate a Semantic Knowledge Distillation (SKD) strategy from a frozen CLIP teacher to transfer semantic priors and relational structures, thereby improving discrimination on hard negatives. By operating synergistically, the semantic priors provide robust contextual filtering, which guides the structural module to establish precise spatial alignments. Experiments on the University-1652 and SUES-200 datasets demonstrate that \textbf{S$^3$Geo} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches without increasing inference complexity, validating the effectiveness of jointly modeling structural and semantic information for CVGL.

AI.tldr: 提出S³Geo框架，通过结构-语义协同学习提升跨视角地理定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法主要依赖视觉表征，难以联合建模细粒度结构对应与语义先验，容易混淆视觉相似但语义不同的区域，在大视角变化下鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: 提出S³Geo结构-语义协同学习框架：1) 解耦查询池化(DQP)模块从密集token中提取紧凑的区域感知特征以建模局部结构；2) 基于最优传输(OT)的查询级对比学习，在跨视角空间错位下建立软对应；3) 语义知识蒸馏(SKD)策略，从冻结的CLIP教师模型中迁移语义先验与关系结构。
AI.result: 在University-1652和SUES-200数据集上，S³Geo在不增加推理复杂度的情况下持续优于最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 验证了联合建模结构与语义信息对跨视角地理定位的有效性，语义先验提供鲁棒上下文过滤并指导结构模块建立精确空间对齐。

title: Beyond Report Imitation: Clinically Aware Multi-Image Ultrasound Report Generation from Visible Evidence
summary: Generating ultrasound reports from multiple images requires aggregating clinical evidence across views, yet archived key frames capture only part of the dynamic examination. Raw-report imitation is therefore misaligned with visual supervision: content that is clinically valid for the full examination may be unverifiable from the images available to a model. This gap creates a clinical behavior alignment problem. A model must preserve visible findings, avoid diagnostic reversals and unsupported completion, and not collapse into conservative templates. We propose CAMEO, a Clinically Aware Multi-image Evidence-grounded Orchestration framework for ultrasound report generation. Stage I learns ultrasound visual-language primitives; Stage II performs Cross-View Evidence Grounding by distilling trusted visible report points into multi-image QA and report-style supervision; and Stage III performs Clinically Aware Preference Alignment using clinical-error-oriented preference pairs. From USReport, we construct USReport-Distilled with 17,670 evidence-grounded paired-image training instances and USReport-Pref with 21,869 preference pairs; we additionally use 25,631 PubMedVision-US ultrasound instruction samples for domain adaptation and multi-image instruction tuning. On the primary USReport-Distilled benchmark, CAMEO improves over EchoVLM from 0.25 to 0.40 BLEU-1, 0.28 to 0.45 ROUGE-1, and 0.27 to 0.43 METEOR, while raising ClinicalScore from 55.02 to 74.20. These results underscore the value of evidence-grounded supervision, clinically aware alignment, and clinically structured evaluation for reliable ultrasound report generation.

AI.tldr: 提出CAMEO三阶段框架（超声视觉-语言基元学习、跨视角证据接地、临床感知偏好对齐），并构建USReport-Distilled与USReport-Pref数据集，在超声报告生成上显著优于EchoVLM。
AI.motivation: 多图超声报告生成需跨视角聚合临床证据，但归档关键帧仅覆盖动态检查的部分信息，导致原始报告模仿与视觉监督存在错位：完整检查中临床有效的内容可能无法由模型可见图像验证，形成临床行为对齐问题。模型需保留可见发现、避免诊断反转与无依据补全，且不能退化为保守模板。
AI.method: 提出CAMEO（Clinically Aware Multi-image Evidence-grounded Orchestration）框架，分三阶段：Stage I学习超声视觉-语言基元；Stage II进行跨视角证据接地，将可信的可见报告要点蒸馏为多图问答与报告风格监督；Stage III利用面向临床错误的偏好对进行临床感知偏好对齐。基于USReport构建USReport-Distilled（17,670条证据接地的成对图像训练实例）与USReport-Pref（21,869条偏好对），并额外使用25,631条PubMedVision-US超声指令样本进行领域适应与多图指令微调。
AI.result: 在USReport-Distilled主基准上，CAMEO较EchoVLM将BLEU-1从0.25提升至0.40，ROUGE-1从0.28提升至0.45，METEOR从0.27提升至0.43，ClinicalScore从55.02提升至74.20。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了证据接地监督、临床感知对齐以及临床结构化评估在可靠超声报告生成中的价值。

title: PointVGGT: Zero-Shot Multiview RGB-D Point Cloud Registration with Visual Geometry Foundation Priors
summary: This paper addresses multiview RGB-D point cloud registration, aiming to estimate global rigid poses for unordered RGB-D scans and align them in a metrically consistent coordinate frame. The conventional pairwise-then-global paradigm suffers from locally optimized pairwise registration, severe error propagation and high computational burden. In particular, existing methods typically treat RGB data as a mere auxiliary matching cue and overlook the holistic geometric priors (e.g., camera poses and 3D models) encoded across image sequences. This paper introduces PointVGGT, a zero-shot framework built upon a novel \emph{foundation-then-refinement} paradigm that systematically leverages visual geometry foundation models (e.g., VGGT) as the computational backbone for robust, training-free multiview RGB-D registration. In the foundation stage, we directly recover metrically consistent global poses (without any pairwise estimation) by grounding the scale-ambiguous pose predictions of the foundation model against metric depth observations. In the refinement stage, we introduce an efficient voxelized spatial hashing mechanism that exploits the globally coherent 3D reconstruction (induced by the foundation model) as a shared spatial anchor, enabling dense multiview correspondences in near-linear time. On top of this, an IRLS-based robust motion-only bundle adjustment is performed using a conjugate gradient solver to jointly minimize the correspondence and reprojection residuals for multiview pose refinement. Extensive experiments on indoor/object-centric/outdoor datasets verify the outstanding zero-shot registration accuracy and computational efficiency of our proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出 PointVGGT：一种零样本多视图 RGB-D 点云配准框架，用"foundation-then-refinement"范式替代传统"先两两再全局"，先在基础模型阶段恢复度量一致的全局位姿，再经体素哈希与鲁棒 BA 精化。实验证明其零样本精度与效率均优。
AI.motivation: 传统"先两两配准、再全局对齐"范式存在三方面问题：两两配准陷入局部最优、误差严重传播、计算开销大；且现有方法仅把 RGB 数据当作辅助匹配线索，忽略了图像序列中隐含的整体几何先验（如相机位姿与 3D 模型）。
AI.method: 提出 PointVGGT，基于视觉几何基础模型（如 VGGT）构建的免训练零样本框架，分两阶段：基础阶段直接恢复度量一致的全局位姿（不做任何两两估计），将基础模型的尺度模糊位姿预测与度量深度观测对齐以消解尺度歧义；精化阶段引入高效体素化空间哈希，将基础模型产生的全局一致 3D 重建作为共享空间锚点，实现近线性时间的稠密多视图对应，并在此基础上用共轭梯度求解器执行基于 IRLS 的鲁棒 motion-only bundle adjustment，联合最小化对应残差与重投影残差以精化多视图位姿。
AI.result: 在室内、以物体为中心及室外数据集上的大量实验验证了该方法具有出色的零样本配准精度和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: PointVGGT 以 foundation-then-refinement 范式系统利用视觉几何基础模型的整体几何先验，规避了传统两两配准的局部最优、误差传播与高开销问题，实现了免训练的鲁棒多视图 RGB-D 配准。

title: TAM: Task-Aware Memory Distillation for Efficient Spatiotemporal Prediction
summary: Knowledge distillation enables efficient spatiotemporal prediction by transferring knowledge from an accurate teacher to a compact student. However, matching outputs or features independently for each sample leaves cross-sample predictive structure underused. Exploiting this structure requires representations and historical references that reflect the dynamics of each task. We propose TAM, a Task-Aware Memory Distillation framework that organizes a frozen teacher's knowledge into a bounded, retrievable history. Memory entries encode latent features, forecast changes, or flow residuals, while task-specific selection rules identify relevant historical references. The student either matches the teacher's similarity distribution over shared references or regresses observation-conditioned residual prototypes. These objectives complement supervised prediction and conventional distillation. The teacher, memory, and auxiliary adapters are used only during training, leaving student inference unchanged. We evaluate TAM on video prediction, weather forecasting, and traffic flow prediction across multiple teacher-student configurations. Averaged over four paired runs, adding TAM improves SSIM on all six video datasets and reduces MSE on five relative to the corresponding KD baselines. Mean paired MSE reductions reach 1.86% on KittiCaltech, 1.93% on WeatherBench with a gSTA teacher, and 1.01% on TaxiBJ. These results demonstrate the utility of historical teacher supervision across distinct forecasting tasks without additional student inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出任务感知记忆蒸馏（TAM）框架，将教师知识组织为可检索历史，供学生在训练时进行结构化蒸馏，提升时空预测而无额外推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有知识蒸馏在时空预测中独立匹配每样本的输出或特征，忽略了跨样本的预测结构，而利用该结构需要反映任务动态的表示与历史参考。
AI.method: 构建有界可检索记忆，条目编码潜在特征、预测变化或流残差；用任务特定选择规则检索相关历史参考。学生或匹配教师对共享参考的相似度分布，或回归以观测为条件的残差原型，并与监督预测和常规蒸馏目标互补。教师、记忆与适配器仅用于训练。
AI.result: 在视频预测、天气预报和交通流预测上评估。四次配对运行平均，六视频数据集SSIM全提升，五个MSE下降；KittiCaltech MSE平均降1.86%，WeatherBench（gSTA教师）降1.93%，TaxiBJ降1.01%。
AI.conclusion: 历史教师监督在不同预测任务中有效，且不增加学生推理成本。

title: Neural Networks for Temporal Pattern Recognition and Dynamic Arm Gesture Speed Estimation for Robot Control
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Published in Proceedings of the Intelligent Robotics FAIR 2026 (IntRob '26), June 18-19, 2026, Budapest, Hungary, ACM
summary: Deploying intelligent robotic systems that interact with humans through gestures requires neural networks capable of recognizing diverse temporal patterns. We present a systematic benchmark of ten abstract sequential tasks--five permutation-invariant (set) and five order-dependent (sequence) problems--evaluated across eighteen neural network architectures spanning recurrent, convolutional, attention-based, and set-function families. Beyond the core architecture-task grid, we explore numerous preprocessing and target-variable transformations, yielding more than 250 distinct experimental configurations. All variants are trained and tested under strictly identical conditions (fixed random seeds, shared hyperparameters, shared data splits) to ensure fair and reproducible comparison. Ranking across all ten tasks reveals four consistently top-performing architectures--BiGRU, TCN, Conv1D, and GRUReLU--all compact enough for real-time deployment (under 2,000 parameters in the benchmark setting). Based on this ranking, we apply three architecturally diverse top models (BiGRU, TCN, and GRUReLU) to a practical robotics problem: estimating the execution speed of dynamic arm gestures from skeletal keypoint sequences. Three speed interpretations (peak count, period time, and mean spike spacing) are evaluated on a custom dataset of eight traffic-related gesture classes comprising 256,710 frames recorded via OpenPose. The best configuration achieves a mean absolute error of 0.198 on the peak-count interpretation, corresponding to roughly 5% relative error, while the period-time interpretation reaches approximately 4% relative error, and the mean spike spacing interpretation approximately 8% relative error. These results demonstrate that neural networks can reliably estimate gesture speed from skeletal data, opening a path toward speed-aware gesture-controlled robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统基准测试了18种神经网络架构在10个抽象序列任务上的表现，并选取三种最优模型应用于机器人手势速度估计。
AI.motivation: 部署通过手势与人交互的智能机器人系统，需要能识别多样时序模式的神经网络，但缺乏统一、公平的架构比较与实用性验证。
AI.method: 在10个抽象序列任务（5个置换不变集合任务、5个顺序依赖序列任务）上评估18种架构（循环、卷积、注意力、集合函数等），并引入多种预处理与目标变量变换，共超过250种配置；所有变体在固定随机种子、共享超参数和数据划分下训练测试。随后用三种架构多样的最优模型（BiGRU、TCN、GRUReLU）处理真实机器人问题——从骨骼关键点序列估计动态手臂手势执行速度。
AI.result: 排名显示四种稳定最优架构：BiGRU、TCN、Conv1D、GRUReLU，参数量均少于2000，适合实时部署。在手势速度估计任务中（基于OpenPose采集的8类交通相关手势、256,710帧的自建数据集），峰值计数解释的平均绝对误差为0.198（约5%相对误差），周期时间约4%，平均尖峰间隔约8%。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络可可靠地从骨骼数据估计手势速度，为速度感知的手势控制机器人系统提供了可行路径。

title: UXBench Pro: Benchmarking Personalized User Experience in Multi-Turn Dialogue Interactions
summary: Evaluating user experience (UX) with automated computational methods has gained increasing attention, supported by empirical evidence from UXBench. However, binary preference prediction provides limited insight, while relying on a single user-agnostic reward model overlooks the inherent heterogeneity of users, whose expectations can differ substantially. In this paper, we present UXBench Pro, comprising 1{,}000 test instances derived from real user interactions across 12 task scenarios and 82 domains. Each instance is paired with a FACTORS user profile that characterizes the user through seven interpretable behavioral facets, differentiating user groups. To provide richer evaluation insights, we introduce a dual-perspective paradigm that combines a personalized User Reward Model (URM) for third-person judgment with Sim4Eval, a user simulator that enables multi-turn interactions and provides first-person evaluation across four cognitive state dimensions. To assess the reliability of these based evaluators, we further introduce two meta-benchmarks, URMBench and USimBench, that evaluate how faithfully they reproduce real human preferences and behaviors. Extensive experiments reveal seven key findings that highlight the importance of user modeling and multi-perspective evaluation, offering a fresh perspective on user-centric benchmarking and motivating personalized model optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UXBench Pro，通过多视角评估范式与用户画像建模，推动用户体验评估从二元偏好预测转向个性化、可靠的多维评测。
AI.motivation: 现有 UX 自动化评估依赖二元偏好预测，信息量有限；且使用单一、与用户无关的奖励模型，忽视了用户期望的异质性。
AI.method: 构建 UXBench Pro，含 1,000 个来自真实交互、覆盖 12 类任务场景与 82 个领域的测试实例；每个实例配备 FACTORS 用户画像（七个可解释行为维度）。提出双视角范式：个性化用户奖励模型（URM）进行第三人称判断，Sim4Eval 用户模拟器支持多轮交互并在四个认知状态维度上做第一人称评估。另设 URMBench 与 USimBench 两个元基准检验评估器还原真实人类偏好与行为的忠实度。
AI.result: 大量实验得出七项关键发现，凸显用户建模与多视角评估的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 以用户为中心的评测新视角得以确立，并为个性化模型优化提供动机与方向。

title: Revisiting Handcrafted Minutiae Detection: A Simple and Effective Open Source Baseline for Modern Fingerprint Workflows
summary: Handcrafted minutiae detection algorithms remain fundamental to biometric science and forensic practice due to their full auditability, adherence to international standards, and operational independence from training datasets or GPU hardware. However, current open-source traditional baselines are severely outdated, relying almost exclusively on legacy C/C++ codebases that lack seamless integration with modern scientific software ecosystems. To bridge this gap, the present work introduces SBMEX (Skeleton-Based Minutiae EXtraction), a fast and deterministic minutiae detection method integrated into the open source \texttt{pyfing} package. SBMEX achieves high computational throughput by employing a dual Look-Up Table architecture that replaces runtime neighborhood scanning during Crossing Number computation and skeleton tracking. Additionally, it incorporates a continuous quality scoring framework driven by tracking path length, dual ridge-valley skeleton fusion, and spatial density decay. Rigorous evaluation on NIST SD302 datasets demonstrates that SBMEX delivers feature extraction accuracy comparable to or outperforming traditional open-source baselines without fine-tuning, while achieving a drastic reduction in minutiae detection latency relative to classical Crossing Number Python implementations.
