AI.tldr: SBMEX是一种基于骨架的快速确定性细节点检测方法，已集成至开源pyfing包，通过双查找表架构实现高吞吐量，并在NIST SD302上取得与传统基线相当或更优的精度与显著更低的延迟。
AI.motivation: 手工设计的细节点检测算法因完全可审计、符合国际标准、不依赖训练数据或GPU硬件，在生物识别与法医实践中仍具基础地位；但现有开源传统基线严重过时，多依赖遗留C/C++代码，难以与现代科学软件生态无缝集成。
AI.method: 提出SBMEX（Skeleton-Based Minutiae EXtraction），采用双查找表（LUT）架构替代Crossing Number计算与骨架跟踪中的运行时邻域扫描；并引入由跟踪路径长度、双脊-谷骨架融合及空间密度衰减驱动的连续质量评分框架。
AI.result: 在NIST SD302数据集上，无需微调即可获得与传统开源基线相当或更优的特征提取精度，同时相较经典Crossing Number的Python实现，细节点检测延迟大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: SBMEX在保持传统细节点检测可审计性与标准符合性的同时，解决了开源基线老旧、集成困难的问题，为现代科学计算生态提供了高效、确定性的细节点提取方案。

title: Phonologically Informed Tokenization for German Speech Recognition: A Cross-Domain Study
summary: German is a morphologically rich language whose syllable structure is exceptionally well-predicted by the Knuth--Liang hyphenation algorithm. We ask whether phonologically informed tokenization can serve as a competitive target for end-to-end speech recognition. We compare three tokenizer families on the Omnilingual ASR wav2vec 2.0 backbone fine-tuned with CTC: the pretrained multilingual character inventory, a data-driven Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) over orthography, and phonologically informed units from Pyphen syllabification and grapheme-to-phoneme conversion. Across 40 fine-tunes, we evaluate on three German test sets spanning orthogonal shifts: in-domain read speech, dialectal spontaneous speech, and standard-German spontaneous speech. In-domain, all phonologically informed tokenizers match BPE and the multilingual character baseline on both WER and CER. Under domain shift the picture splits along vocabulary size rather than the linguistic axis of variation: at small vocabularies, syllable-aware tokenization improves on dialectal speech, where phonetic surface forms vary but syllable structure is preserved, and stays ahead on spontaneous speech, where new word-forms violate vocabulary closure. A phoneme-level confusion analysis further shows that all tokenizers commit the same canonical function-word errors, indicating that the acoustic encoder, not the tokenizer, dominates the error topology. Our findings suggest that tokenizer choice may depend on the vocabulary budget as much as on the distribution shift expected at deployment rather than reducing to a single universal optimum.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语音识别中分词器的选择问题：在德语上比较字符、BPE与语音学驱动（音节/音素）三类分词器，发现域内性能相当，域偏移下差异主要由词表大小而非语言学维度决定。
AI.motivation: 德语形态丰富，其音节结构可被Knuth–Liang连字符算法很好地预测，因此作者希望探究：具备语音学信息的分词能否成为端到端语音识别的有竞争力的建模目标，并检验分词器选择是否在域偏移下带来收益。
AI.method: 以Omnilingual ASR的wav2vec 2.0为骨干、用CTC微调，比较三类分词器：预训练多语言字符表、基于正字法的数据驱动BPE、以及由Pyphen音节切分与字素到音素转换得到的语音学驱动单元。共进行40次微调，在三个德语测试集（域内朗读语音、方言自发语音、标准德语自发语音）上评估WER与CER。
AI.result: 域内条件下，所有语音学驱动分词器在WER和CER上均与BPE及多语言字符基线持平。域偏移下，性能差异沿词表大小而非语言学变异轴分化：小词表时，音节感知分词在方言语音上更优（音段表层形式变化而音节结构保持），并在自发语音上保持领先（新词形破坏词表封闭性）。音素级混淆分析显示各类分词器犯相同的典型功能词错误，说明错误拓扑由声学编码器而非分词器主导。
AI.conclusion: 分词器选择并非存在单一普适最优解，而是同时取决于词表预算与部署时预期的分布偏移；语音学信息分词在特定词表规模与偏移类型下具有优势，但错误结构主要由声学编码器决定。

title: Tabula Rasa: Monte Carlo estimation of unit-variance noise with controlled spatio-temporal correlation
summary: We suggest a method to generate time-varying Gaussian noise with controlled variance and controlled temporal correlation. This noise is used in several downstream tasks for temporal control and temporal coherence. The core technical idea is to phrase this problem as joint Monte-Carlo estimation of both a classic pixel reconstruction and estimation of variance using the concept of "sketching" from the database literature. We demonstrate that our method allows temporal control for downstream tasks with simpler and faster code than previous methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种生成方差可控、时间相关性可控的时变高斯噪声的方法，核心是将像素重建与方差估计建模为联合蒙特卡洛估计，并借用数据库领域的"sketching"概念，从而以更简单、更快的代码实现下游任务的时间控制与时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 下游任务（如时间控制、时间一致性）需要噪声具备可调控的方差与时间相关性。此前方法在实现这类时变噪声时，代码复杂、速度较慢，缺乏统一且高效的处理方式。
AI.method: 将生成时变高斯噪声的问题形式化为一个联合蒙特卡洛估计问题：同时估计经典像素重建量与方差，并引入数据库文献中的"sketching"技术作为核心工具，使方差估计与重建在一次联合估计框架内完成。
AI.result: 该方法能够为下游任务提供时间控制能力，且相比以往方法，所需代码更简单、运行速度更快。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合蒙特卡洛估计结合sketching，可在统一框架下生成方差与时间相关性均可控的时变高斯噪声，兼顾功能性与实现效率。

title: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
summary: Improving a long-horizon LLM agent means evolving the harness around a frozen model or training its weights. We let a self-evolving harness make the system stronger first, then cross seed and evolved harnesses with base and trained weights to learn which gains the trained model keeps and which still need the runtime. We show that the right lever can be read off the agent's failure composition: labelling failed trajectories by the first signal that fires separates process failures (blocked calls, loops, exhausted step budgets) from content failures (a delivered plan that is poor). Harness evolution repairs the former, the behaviour it instils can be trained into the weights, and content failures are what weight training is for. On DeepPlanning, a self-evolving harness loop lifts the held-out score of Qwen3.5-4B from 0.16 to 0.30 and of Qwen3.5-9B from 0.32 to 0.44; for 4B, held-out delivery rises from 55% to 90% while content failures are left for the weights. LoRA adapters trained on evolved-harness trajectories internalise the gain: under the original harness they add +0.13 on held-out tasks for both sizes; on 4B they stack with the harness to more than double the held-out score, and on 9B the adapter alone matches the full evolution line, cutting content failures from a quarter of trajectories to one in twenty. A placebo adapter trained on answer-shuffled trajectories falls below the base model. The loop transfers to WebArena-Lite (+0.09 on 117 unseen tasks), where the gain lives in what the model sees and adapters do not add to it. The result is a diagnose-then-intervene rule applied twice: read the failure composition to choose between harness and weights, then read what the accepted edits changed to decide which gains to train in. Scores are four-rollout means against fresh anchors, same-night except where marked, across eight models from six families and two benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 通过“失败构成诊断”区分过程失败与内容失败，用自演化harness先修复过程失败，再将之蒸馏进权重，实现harness与权重训练的互补组合。
AI.motivation: 提升长程LLM智能体通常只有两条路：在冻结模型外围演化harness，或训练模型权重。二者孰优、能否叠加尚不清楚，需要判定每种干预手段究竟解决哪类失败。
AI.method: 将失败轨迹按首个触发信号标注，区分过程失败（调用受阻、循环、步数预算耗尽）与内容失败（交付的计划质量差）。先运行自演化harness循环修复过程失败，再在演化harness轨迹上训练LoRA适配器，并将base/演化harness与base/训练权重交叉组合进行对照；另设答案打乱的安慰剂适配器作负对照。
AI.result: DeepPlanning上，自演化harness将Qwen3.5-4B的留出分数由0.16升至0.30、9B由0.32升至0.44；4B交付率由55%升至90%。LoRA适配器在原harness下两规模均+0.13；4B上与harness叠加使留出分数翻倍以上，9B上适配器单独即匹配完整演化线，将内容失败由四分之一降至二十分之一。安慰剂适配器低于基座模型。迁移到WebArena-Lite（117个未见任务）获+0.09，增益主要来自模型观测内容，适配器不再叠加。结果基于四个rollout均值、八个模型、六个家族、两个基准。
AI.conclusion: 提出可复用的“先诊断后干预”规则：先读失败构成来决定用harness还是权重，再读被接受的编辑改变了什么来决定哪些增益值得训练进权重。过程失败宜由harness修复并蒸馏，内容失败则须依赖权重训练。

title: DisFace3DNet: Explainable Facial Attractiveness Prediction via 3D Component Disentanglement
summary: Facial attractiveness prediction usually assigns one overall rating, leaving the roles of shape, appearance, and viewing conditions implicit. We propose DisFace3DNet, which uses 3D component disentanglement to learn seven component reference scores from overall ratings with auxiliary weak semantic supervision, without human-labeled component targets. Designated 3D representations and image cues feed jointly learned routes for identity, skin, hair, light, background, expression, and pose. A constrained fit then combines five static and two signed dynamic scores into the overall rating, exposing each component's numerical contribution and supporting component-specific comparisons across images. On SCUT-FBP5500, DisFace3DNet achieves a Pearson correlation of $0.8904\pm0.0063$ (mean $\pm$ standard deviation across five folds) with average human ratings; its component terms reconstruct every held-out prediction to numerical precision. Skin, hair, and facial shape account for the largest component-wise prediction variation. Human evaluation supports the score directions for facial shape, skin, and hair; expression agreement is weaker. DisFace3DNet thus connects overall prediction to quantitative analysis of the facial and contextual cues entering each estimate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DisFace3DNet，通过 3D 组件解耦从整体评分中学习七个组件参考分数，实现面部吸引力的可解释预测与组件级定量分析。
AI.motivation: 传统面部吸引力预测通常只输出一个整体评分，将形状、外观和拍摄条件等因素的作用隐含其中，缺乏可解释性和组件级的定量分析能力。
AI.method: 提出 DisFace3DNet，利用 3D 组件解耦，在仅有整体评分和辅助弱语义监督、无人工标注组件目标的情况下学习七个组件参考分数。为身份、皮肤、头发、光照、背景、表情和姿态设计指定的 3D 表示与图像线索，输入联合学习的路径；再通过约束拟合将五个静态分量与两个带符号的动态分量组合为整体评分。
AI.result: 在 SCUT-FBP5500 数据集上，DisFace3DNet 与人类平均评分的 Pearson 相关系数达 0.8904±0.0063（五折均值±标准差）；组件项可数值精确地重构每个留出预测。皮肤、头发和面部形状在组件层面的预测变异中贡献最大。人工评估支持面部形状、皮肤和头发的分数方向，表情一致性较弱。
AI.conclusion: DisFace3DNet 将整体预测与对每个估计所涉及的面部及情境线索的定量分析相连接。

title: DIAL-OPD: Learning More from Fewer Tokens in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated trajectories with token-level teacher signals. Its sampled-token variant avoids the cost of full-vocabulary probabilities. Yet we find that training on fewer tokens can outperform full-token OPD, challenging the intuition that more supervision improves learning. This motivates selecting tokens by learning value. Existing disagreement-based criteria ignore probability scale: tokens assigned negligible probability by both models, termed low-low tokens, can receive large log-ratio rewards and hinder learning. We propose DIAL-OPD, a token-selection method that bridges log-probability and probability spaces by weighting reward magnitude with the logarithmic mean of teacher and student probabilities. A parameter beta controls this weighting, and the highest-scoring tokens are retained. Across 4 teacher-student pairs and 7 mathematical reasoning benchmarks, we compare DIAL-OPD with 9 baselines. Retaining only 40% of tokens, it outperforms Vanilla OPD and its full-token variants, with mean accuracy gains reaching 5.25 percentage points over Vanilla OPD, and doubles AIME25 Pass@16 from 13.33% to 26.67%. It also achieves up to an 18% relative improvement in mean accuracy over the strongest token-selection baseline at matched retention ratios. With a 4B teacher, DIAL-OPD surpasses the strongest full-token baseline using an 8B teacher at both student scales, showing that effective supervision allocation can outweigh teacher scaling. Further analysis shows that moderate beta balances suppressing low-low tokens against preserving useful disagreements. Token-level evidence reveals that DIAL-OPD filters high-reward tokens with limited reasoning value while preserving supervision critical to reasoning correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DIAL-OPD，一种基于学习价值的token选择方法，用于on-policy蒸馏（OPD）。它通过对数均值加权奖励幅度来桥接对数概率与概率空间，有效抑制"低-低"token，仅保留40%的token即超越Vanilla OPD及全token变体。
AI.motivation: 现有OPD的sampled-token变体虽避免了全词表概率开销，但作者发现用更少token训练反而可能优于全token OPD，挑战了"更多监督即更好"的直觉。同时，已有基于分歧的选择准则忽略了概率尺度问题：被师生模型都赋予可忽略概率的"低-低"token会获得较大对数比奖励，反而阻碍学习。因此需要按学习价值来选择token。
AI.method: 提出DIAL-OPD：一种token选择方法，通过以师生概率的对数均值对奖励幅度进行加权，桥接对数概率空间与概率空间。方法含参数beta控制加权程度，保留得分最高的token。
AI.result: 在4组师生对和7个数学推理基准上，与9个基线对比：仅保留40%的token即超越Vanilla OPD及其全token变体，较Vanilla OPD平均准确率提升达5.25个百分点，将AIME25 Pass@16从13.33%翻倍至26.67%；在相同保留比下，较最强token选择基线平均准确率相对提升最多18%。使用4B教师时，DIAL-OPD在两个学生规模上均超越使用8B教师的最强全token基线。
AI.conclusion: 有效的监督分配可胜过教师规模扩展。进一步分析表明，适中的beta能在抑制"低-低"token与保留有用分歧之间取得平衡。token级证据显示，DIAL-OPD过滤掉了高奖励但对推理价值有限的token，同时保留了推理正确性所必需的关键监督。

title: Autoregressive Retriever: Improving Query Understanding from Item Feedback for Universal Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Universal multimodal retrieval typically encodes a query once and ranks independently indexed items by embedding similarity. This design supports efficient search, but leaves the query representation unchanged even when retrieved items could help clarify the information need. We introduce the AutoRegressive Retriever (ARR), a multimodal retrieval model that learns both to select informative items and to use their content to refine subsequent retrieval. ARR alternates between retrieving an item and updating the query embedding, then uses the final embedding to rank the collection. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the encoder to use feedback through stepwise contrastive supervision. Reinforcement learning treats feedback items as actions and optimizes their selection using the final reciprocal rank of a relevant item. A query-side adapter enables this optimization against a fixed item index. ARR demonstrates strong retrieval performance on both in-domain and zero-shot benchmarks, outperforming the compared baselines on average. Further analyses show that feedback improves retrieval at inference time and that training with feedback also improves the initial query embedding, before any item is observed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoRegressive Retriever（ARR），一种多模态检索模型，可在检索过程中利用已检索项反馈迭代更新查询表示，并结合监督微调与强化学习进行训练。
AI.motivation: 传统通用多模态检索将查询编码一次后即固定表示，检索到的条目无法帮助澄清信息需求，限制了检索效果。
AI.method: ARR在检索条目与更新查询嵌入之间交替进行，最终嵌入用于排序。监督微调通过逐步对比监督让编码器学会利用反馈；强化学习将反馈项视为动作，以相关项最终倒数排名为奖励进行选择优化；查询侧适配器支持在固定条目索引上优化。
AI.result: 在域内与零样本基准上均表现强劲，平均优于对比基线。分析表明推理时反馈可提升检索，且带反馈训练还能改善初始查询嵌入。
AI.conclusion: 交互式反馈机制能有效改进多模态检索，兼顾效率与表示优化。

title: Perceptually Grounded and Semantics-Aware Evaluation for Holistic Co-Speech Gesture Generation
summary: Holistic and semantics-aware co-speech gesture generation has advanced rapidly, yet evaluation remains behind: objective metrics do not consistently reflect human perception, and semantic appropriateness remains difficult to quantify. We present a perceptually grounded and semantics-aware benchmark that combines standardized model comparison, human-centered metric validation, and fine-grained semantic evaluation. We first curate a list of 13 objective metrics covering different aspects, including distributional similarity, geometric fidelity, kinematic quality, cross-modal synchrony, and semantic appropriateness. For the semantic-appropriateness category, we propose a new metric, Semantic Gesture Preservation (SGP), which measures how far semantic gestures in the ground truth are preserved in the generated gestures. For this, we augment the BEAT2 dataset's annotations using a multi-modal LLM. We then conduct a perceptual study where 101 participants score generated gestures among five dimensions, including human-likeness, motion diversity, absence of animation errors, speech timing and content match. We systematically analyze objective metric--subjective score correlations. Unlike Semantic Score (SC), which shows no significant association with the evaluated perceptual dimensions, SGP is selectively aligned with speech-aware human judgments. We construct five target-specific composite metrics aligned with the subjective dimensions. These composites improve perceptual alignment across all five dimensions, with the largest gains for absence of animation errors and content match, indicating that complementary objective signals can better approximate human judgments than individual metrics alone. Overall, our results show that objective metrics require validation against subjective evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个结合标准化模型比较、以人为中心的指标验证与细粒度语义评估的语音手势生成基准，涵盖13项客观指标，并提出语义手势保留度（SGP）新指标，通过101人感知实验与相关性分析证明SGP与主观判断部分对齐，且构建的五类目标导向复合指标整体提升感知对齐度。
AI.motivation: 语音手势生成在整体性与语义感知方面进展迅速，但评估方法相对滞后：客观指标与人类感知不一致，语义恰当性难以量化。因此需要建立一个感知与语义双重支撑的评估基准，并对现有指标进行主观验证。
AI.method: 1) 梳理13项客观指标，覆盖分布相似性、几何保真、运动学质量、跨模态同步和语义恰当性；2) 针对语义恰当性提出SGP指标，衡量真实语义手势在生成结果中的保留程度，并用多模态大语言模型增强BEAT2数据集的标注；3) 开展101名参与者的感知研究，从拟人度、动作多样性、动画错误缺失、语音时序匹配和内容匹配五个维度打分；4) 系统分析客观指标与主观评分的相关性，并构建与主观维度对齐的五类复合指标。
AI.result: 语义得分（SC）与所评估的感知维度无显著关联，而SGP与语音相关的人类判断呈现选择性对齐；构建的五类目标导向复合指标在全部五个维度上均改善感知对齐，其中在"动画错误缺失"和"内容匹配"上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 互补的客观信号比单一指标更能逼近人类判断；客观指标必须通过主观评估加以验证。

title: VESSI - VLM-Enhanced Support for Surveillance and Investigations
comment: 12-page main manuscript, 3 main figures; supplementary material included
summary: Automated video surveillance analysis has become a critical component of intelligence infrastructures and Law Enforcement agencies. Traditional systems lack the semantic module for comprehensive situational awareness and forensic tasks, limiting their ability to interpret events meaningfully or support post-incident investigations. This slows operational insight and increases the burden on human analysts. Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer promising pathways to bridge this gap. To address this, we propose VLM-Enhanced Support for Surveillance and Investigations (VESSI), a VLM-based framework designed to enhance automated video surveillance analysis through prompt-driven interrogation of video sequences where salient visual features are converted into textual descriptions. We test our framework with four state-of-the-art models. Since most datasets for this task are unlabeled, we also propose the Composite Model Utility Score (CMUS) to assess VLM performance. Experimental results show that our solution substantially improves the analysis capabilities of human operators and enhances the flexibility of automated surveillance systems. In our evaluation, the most reliable model flagged potentially relevant activity in more than 66% of the videos while reducing review time by more than 85%, offering a practical balance between selectivity and efficiency. The model ordering produced by the reference-free CMUS evaluation was reproduced by the normal-video CMUS evaluation and matched the false-positive-rate ordering obtained from 5,909 manually referenced frames. This agreement supports the operational use of the score within the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 提出VLM-Enhanced Support for Surveillance and Investigations (VESSI)框架，利用视觉语言模型对视频序列进行提示驱动的问答式分析，将显著视觉特征转为文本描述，以增强自动化视频监控与调查能力。同时提出无参考的Composite Model Utility Score (CMUS)评估VLM性能，实验显示可靠模型以超85%的审阅时间缩减标记了超66%视频中的潜在相关活动。
AI.motivation: 传统自动化视频监控系统缺乏语义模块，难以支撑态势感知与取证任务，导致事件解读能力有限、事后调查支持不足，并加重人工分析员负担。视觉语言模型（VLMs）的进展为弥补这一缺口提供了可能路径。
AI.method: 提出VESSI框架，基于VLM对视频序列进行提示驱动的interrogation，将显著视觉特征转换为文本描述；在四个state-of-the-art模型上测试该框架。针对多数数据集无标注的问题，提出Composite Model Utility Score (CMUS)以评估VLM性能。
AI.result: 实验结果显著提升了人工操作员的分析能力与自动化监控系统的灵活性。最可靠模型在逾66%的视频中标记出潜在相关活动，同时将审阅时间缩短逾85%，在选择性（selectivity）与效率间取得实用平衡。无参考CMUS评估得到的模型排序与normal-video CMUS评估一致，并与基于5,909帧人工标注所得false-positive-rate排序相吻合。
AI.conclusion: CMUS排序的一致性与人工标注FPR排序的吻合，支持该评分在评估场景下的实际部署使用；VESSI框架在自动化视频监控分析中兼顾了分析深度与运营效率。

title: TRACE: Diagnosing Verifier Brittleness in Agentic Evaluation
summary: Verifier scores now serve as both benchmark metrics and training rewards for large language model (LLM) agents, and a change in score is routinely read as a change in capability. It may instead reflect a change in the evaluation. We introduce TRACE, a protocol that turns a score change from a verdict into a testable diagnosis: it applies a targeted change to one part of an evaluation, compares paired runs, checks whether the agent's behavior changed, and rescores unchanged trajectories to test whether the scoring rule is responsible. In a controlled suite of 25 synthetic tasks, renaming tools lowers a scripted agent's score by 0.250 even though it performs exactly the same operations; restoring the original names at scoring time closes the entire gap, while the same mutation exposes a genuine behavioral failure in a second agent. On public $τ^2$-bench tasks with four LLM agents, an initial 30-task study finds mixed reward changes whose one clear effect does not replicate. In a larger follow-up on 88 new tasks with repeated runs per condition, renaming tools or reformatting tool outputs leaves reward unchanged to within $\pm$0.10 for seven of eight agent-change pairs, whereas tool names that deliberately mislead lower every agent's reward by 0.20-0.44, showing that the setup can detect real effects. Identical reruns flip 15-36% of task outcomes, so single-run comparisons cannot separate presentation effects from run-to-run variation. Two frontier LLM judges give consistent verdicts when a fixed trajectory is presented differently, yet disagree with each other on 57% of the same records, largely because one grades procedure rather than outcome. TRACE thus separates what a score change says about the agent from what it says about the measurement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE协议，将评测分数变化从"结论"转化为可检验的"诊断"，用以区分分数变化反映的是智能体能力变化还是评测设置变化。
AI.motivation: 验证器分数既被用作基准指标又被用作LLM智能体的训练奖励，人们习惯把分数变化直接解读为能力变化，但这种变化可能只是评测方式改变所致，二者混淆会误导模型评估与训练。
AI.method: TRACE对评测的某一部分施加定向改动，比较配对运行结果，检验智能体行为是否改变，并对未变化的轨迹重新打分，以判断分数变化是否由评分规则引起。实验包括25个合成任务的受控套件、公开τ²-bench上的30任务初步研究与88个新任务的重复运行follow-up，以及两个前沿LLM评判者的对照测试。
AI.result: 合成任务中，工具重命名使脚本化智能体分数下降0.250，尽管其操作完全相同；评分时恢复原名可完全消除差距，而同一改动在第二个智能体上暴露出真实的行为失败。τ²-bench实验中，七对智能体-改动组合中奖励变化在±0.10以内，而故意误导的工具名使所有智能体奖励下降0.20-0.44。相同重跑会使15-36%的任务结果翻转。两个LLM评判者面对同一轨迹的不同呈现给出一致判定，但彼此在57%的记录上不一致。
AI.conclusion: TRACE能够分离分数变化中关于智能体的信息与关于测量的信息，提示单次运行比较无法区分呈现效应与运行间波动，评测设计本身是分数变化的重要来源。

title: HI3D 3.0 (Twinkle3D): Object-specific 3D Asset Generation with High Resolution
summary: Image-to-3D generation has become increasingly capable of producing objects that closely resemble the input image, and an outstanding challenge is to reproduce the depicted object itself, including the specific geometry that defines it. Inscriptions, brand marks, and repeated structures are frequently distorted or lost, despite being critical to object identity. We present Hi3D 3.0, an image-to-3D generation system targeting object-specific fidelity, with Twinkle3D as its geometry model for generating watertight triangle meshes at $2048^{3}$ resolution. Twinkle3D advances high-fidelity geometry generation along four dimensions. First, while O-Voxel/FaithC offers high representational precision, it often suffers from poor surface quality and non-watertight geometry. We address both issues while retaining its $2048^{3}$-level precision. Second, we scale diffusion generation to sequences of up to 300K geometric tokens through a redesigned DiT architecture and large-scale distributed training optimizations, reducing training time per step from approximately ten minutes to ten seconds. Third, subsequent refinement cannot fully compensate for errors introduced during initial generation; we therefore strengthen both global shape and local detail in the initial generation stage, and the resulting single-stage model surpasses prior two-stage pipelines with $512^{3}$ refinement. Finally, we introduce a fine-grained image-3D cross-modal interaction mechanism that strengthens correspondence between visual evidence and geometric tokens, improving the recovery of object-specific structures. We evaluate geometric fidelity using alignment metrics derived from silhouettes and normal fields. Hi3D 3.0 outperforms four commercial systems across all reported metrics, recovering 82.1% of inscribed characters at 98.2% precision, compared with 21.7% recall for the strongest competitor.

AI.tldr: 提出 Hi3D 3.0 图像到3D生成系统，其几何模型 Twinkle3D 可在 2048³ 分辨率下生成水密三角网格，通过高精度表征修复、扩散生成扩展、单阶段生成增强和细粒度跨模态交互四方面提升物体特定保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到3D生成虽能产出与输入图像相似的对象，但难以复现对象本身的特定几何，铭文、品牌标识和重复结构常被扭曲或丢失，而这些对物体身份识别至关重要。因此需要面向物体特定保真度的高保真几何生成方法。
AI.method: Twinkle3D 从四方面推进高保真几何生成：（1）解决 O-Voxel/FaithC 表征在保留 2048³ 级精度的同时表面质量差、非水密的问题；（2）通过重新设计的 DiT 架构和大规模分布式训练优化，将扩散生成扩展至最多 300K 几何 token 序列，单步训练时间从约十分钟降至十秒；（3）在初始生成阶段同时强化全局形状与局部细节，使单阶段模型超越此前带 512³ 细化的两阶段流程；（4）引入细粒度图像-3D 跨模态交互机制，增强视觉证据与几何 token 的对应关系。
AI.result: 采用基于轮廓线和法线场的对齐指标评估几何保真度。Hi3D 3.0 在所有报告指标上优于四个商业系统，以 98.2% 的精确率恢复 82.1% 的铭文字符，而最强竞品的召回率仅为 21.7%。
AI.conclusion: Hi3D 3.0 通过 Twinkle3D 在 2048³ 分辨率下实现水密网格的高保真图像到3D生成，显著提升了物体特定结构（如铭文）的恢复能力，并在几何保真度指标上全面超越现有商业系统。

title: Structured Sentiment Analysis Using Sequence Labeling as Dependency Graph Parsing
summary: This study addresses the problem of structured sentiment analysis, whose goal is to obtain a fine-grained sentiment graph where the nodes represent spans of sentiment holders, targets, and expressions, while the arcs define the relationships among them. Our proposed approach casts the task as dependency graph parsing, but departs from traditional parsing methods by solving it through sequence labeling. To do so, we leverage recent advances in linearized graph encodings that allow each word in the input to be assigned a label, effectively capturing the structure of the dependency graph. We conducted experiments on seven datasets spanning five languages (English, Spanish, Norwegian, Basque, and Catalan), showing performance competitive with leading, more complex single-model approaches.

AI.tldr: 该研究将结构化情感分析建模为依存图解析任务，但采用序列标注而非传统解析方法，通过线性化图编码为每个词分配标签来捕捉依存图结构。在涵盖五种语言（英语、西班牙语、挪威语、巴斯克语、加泰罗尼亚语）的七个数据集上实验，性能与领先的更复杂单模型方法相媲美。
AI.motivation: 结构化情感分析的目标是获得细粒度情感图，其中节点代表情感持有者、目标和表达的跨度，弧定义它们之间的关系。现有领先方法通常较为复杂，本文希望探索更简洁的建模方式。
AI.method: 将任务建模为依存图解析，但区别于传统解析方法，改以序列标注求解。利用线性化图编码的最新进展，为输入中每个词分配一个标签，从而有效捕捉依存图结构。
AI.result: 在跨越五种语言（英语、西班牙语、挪威语、巴斯克语、加泰罗尼亚语）的七个数据集上进行实验，性能与领先的、更复杂的单模型方法具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法证明了将结构化情感分析作为依存图解析、并通过序列标注实现的有效性，在多个语言和数据集上以相对简单的单模型达到有竞争力的性能。

title: Internalizer: Portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping for Very Large Language Models
summary: Hypernetworks that map a context directly to a LoRA adapter let a large language model carry that context in its weights, but prior work has demonstrated them only on base models of up to 14 billion parameters. We present the Internalizer, a state-of-the-art, portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping hypernetwork that generates document-specific LoRA adapters for the frozen 284B-parameter DeepSeek v4 Flash, a target two orders of magnitude larger than in any previous work. Most of its parameters live in a model-agnostic trunk with only thin entry and exit layers per base model, so it trains cheaply against small models before being ported to the large one. On unseen documents of up to 4096 tokens, the generated adapters reach 84.9% top-1 and 97.8% top-5 teacher-forced accuracy against 63.4% and 83.5% for the base model, with nothing in the context window but a three-word instruction. Once the hypernetwork is trained, a single forward pass turns any document into an adapter for such a model, which could be served alone for speed or alongside the document in the window to raise accuracy further.

AI.tldr: 提出 Internalizer 超网络，将上下文直接映射为文档专属 LoRA 适配器，首次成功应用于 284B 参数级别的 DeepSeek v4 Flash，在无上下文窗口信息的情况下显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 超网络可将上下文直接编码进模型权重（生成 LoRA 适配器），但既有工作仅验证于最大 14B 参数的基础模型，缺乏在更大规模模型上的可扩展性与可移植性验证。作者希望将这一"上下文到参数映射"能力扩展到数百亿参数级别的模型。
AI.method: 提出 Internalizer，一种可移植的 Context-to-Parameter Mapping 超网络，为冻结的 284B 参数 DeepSeek v4 Flash 生成文档特定 LoRA 适配器。其大部分参数位于与具体基座模型无关的主干（model-agnostic trunk），每个基座模型仅需薄的入口层与出口层，因而可先在小模型上低成本训练，再迁移到大模型。推理时，仅需三词指令作为上下文提示。
AI.result: 在最长 4096 token 的未见文档上，生成的适配器达到 84.9% top-1 和 97.8% top-5 的 teacher-forced 准确率，而基线模型仅为 63.4% 和 83.5%；且上下文窗口中除三词指令外无任何其他信息。
AI.conclusion: 超网络训练完成后，单次前向即可将任意文档转化为该模型的适配器，既可单独部署以提升速度，也可与文档同置于上下文窗口中以进一步提升准确率，验证了该方法在超大规模模型上的可行性与可移植性。

title: 4-Tensor Attention Model for Semantic Physical Reality
summary: We describe a 4-tensor attention model that predicts the next semantic state of a scene, for video generation and robot planning. A window of states has positions (x, t) and two fibers, a semantic fiber and a temporal-context fiber, and one softmax normalizes attention jointly over the window. Frames and an agent's situation are written as those states; the encoder, the renderer, and the planner remain outside the update. To test the update on its own, we train on ROCStories, where each window poses the same next-sentence task at the semantic layer. On the validation split, with one seed per setting, the last-sentence cross-entropy on the three matched settings is lower for the 4-tensor model than for a free-running one-dimensional transformer by 5.3% at H=2, L=2, by 2.6% at H=4, L=2, and by 2.4% at H=4, L=3. At H=4, L=2 the parameter counts are nearly the same, 172.5M and 175.9M. On the same two GPUs that 4-tensor run finished in 2.4 hours and the baseline run in 45.2 hours; the baseline is trained by free-running decoding, one sequential forward pass per target token.

AI.tldr: 提出一种4-张量注意力模型，通过联合归一化窗口内语义与时序上下文两纤维，预测场景下一语义状态，在ROCStories上比自由运行的一维Transformer取得更低交叉熵，且训练时间显著缩短。
AI.motivation: 为视频生成与机器人规划预测场景的下一语义状态。作者希望单独检验该注意力更新机制本身的效果，故将编码器、渲染器与规划器置于更新之外，只在语义层用统一窗口任务进行训练与评估。
AI.method: 构建4-张量注意力模型：窗口内状态带有位置(x, t)以及语义纤维和时序上下文纤维两条纤维，用一个softmax在窗口上联合归一化注意力。帧与智能体情境均写成这些状态，编码器、渲染器、规划器不参与更新。在ROCStories上训练，每个窗口在语义层执行相同的下一句预测任务。
AI.result: 在验证集上，每个设置使用一个随机种子，三个匹配设置的最后一句交叉熵均低于自由运行的一维Transformer：H=2, L=2时降低5.3%；H=4, L=2时降低2.6%；H=4, L=3时降低2.4%。在H=4, L=2时参数量相近，分别为172.5M与175.9M。在相同两块GPU上，4-张量运行2.4小时完成，基线运行45.2小时完成，基线采用自由运行解码，每个目标token需要一次顺序前向传播。
AI.conclusion: 4-张量注意力更新在相同任务与相近参数量下优于自由运行的一维Transformer，并大幅降低训练时间，表明联合语义与时序上下文纤维的注意力机制在下一语义状态预测上更有效。

title: MultiWorldBench: Do Independently Controlled Views Describe One Shared World?
summary: Multiplayer world models must ensure that independently controlled views remain consistent with one shared and persistent world. We introduce MultiWorldBench, a diagnostic Minecraft benchmark containing 495 case configurations across seven task suites and ten capabilities, including independent control, cross-view motion, shared-state synchronization, persistence, structural reasoning, concurrent interaction, and delayed revisit. We evaluate Solaris, Gamma-World, and MineWorld, using Engine GT as a reference. Gamma-World achieves the highest ten-capability average among the generated systems at 21.39, followed by Solaris at 20.88 and MineWorld at 1.89, while Engine GT reaches 91.69. Gamma-World performs better on several control, shared-state, and revisit capabilities, whereas Solaris leads in cross-view motion and race-condition consistency. Nevertheless, all generated systems score at most 8.00 on state persistence and 1.33 on structural consistency, and none succeeds in spatial reasoning or building-identity preservation. Human preferences produce the same overall ranking and show strong alignment with the automatic evaluation, with a mean dimension-level Spearman correlation of 0.96. These results show that plausible individual views do not yet constitute a coherent multiplayer world.

AI.tldr: 提出MultiWorldBench多玩家世界模型诊断基准（495个案例、7类任务、10项能力），评测Solaris、Gamma-World、MineWorld并与引擎真值对比，发现生成系统在持久性与结构一致性上表现极差，仅具表面合理性的单视角不足以构成连贯多玩家世界。
AI.motivation: 多玩家世界模型要求多个独立控制的视角与同一持续共享世界保持一致，但现有评测缺乏针对这种多视角一致性、共享状态与持久性的系统性诊断工具，因此需要建立专门基准来揭示生成系统与真实引擎之间的差距。
AI.method: 构建MultiWorldBench：基于Minecraft的诊断基准，包含495个案例配置、7类任务套件与10项能力维度（独立控制、跨视角运动、共享状态同步、持久性、结构推理、并发交互、延迟重访等）。以Engine GT为参考，评测Solaris、Gamma-World、MineWorld，并结合人工偏好评估与自动评估做相关性分析。
AI.result: Gamma-World十项能力平均分最高（21.39），Solaris次之（20.88），MineWorld最低（1.89），Engine GT达91.69。Gamma-World在控制、共享状态与重访能力上更优，Solaris在跨视角运动与竞态一致性上领先。但所有生成系统在状态持久性上不超过8.00、结构一致性不超过1.33，且在空间推理与建筑身份保持上均未成功。人工偏好排名与自动评估一致，维度级Spearman相关系数均值0.96。
AI.conclusion: 现有多玩家世界生成系统虽能产出看似合理的个体视角，却无法维持共享、持久、结构一致的世界状态，尚不构成真正的连贯多玩家世界；MultiWorldBench可作为诊断此类能力缺口的有效基准。

title: Onboard Marine Anomaly Detection on $Φ$sat-2: From Simulation-Based Development to In-Orbit Demonstration
summary: Onboard Artificial Intelligence can improve responsiveness and bandwidth efficiency of Earth Observation systems by processing data directly on the satellite. This paper presents the experience gained from the development, onboard integration, and post-launch adaptation of a lightweight marine anomaly detection pipeline deployed on the European Space Agency's $Φ$sat-2 mission. The application combines sea segmentation, self-supervised feature encoding of marine regions, generic anomaly detection based on deviations from a normal sea state, and optional characterization of selected anomaly types. Before launch, the pipeline was trained and validated on simulated $Φ$sat-2 imagery to assess algorithmic performance and compatibility with resource-constrained onboard hardware. After integration and functional validation in the mission environment, early experiments on real $Φ$sat-2 acquisitions revealed a significant mismatch between simulated and in-orbit data. The pipeline was therefore retrained on real Level-1 imagery using an improved annotation strategy to better handle ambiguous marine regions, substantially enhancing performance. Beyond demonstrating the onboard feasibility of the application, the $Φ$sat-2 experience highlights the importance of robust annotation strategies and sensor-aware design, and shows that simulation-based development is valuable for pre-flight risk reduction, while reliable scientific validation requires representative in-orbit data and should be clearly distinguished from functional validation.

AI.tldr: 本文总结在ESA Φsat-2任务上部署轻量级海洋异常检测流程的经验：仿真训练→在轨集成→功能验证→发现仿真与真实数据失配→用真实L1影像重训并改进标注策略，性能显著提升。
AI.motivation: 在轨AI可提升对地观测系统的响应速度与带宽效率，但资源受限硬件上的部署、以及仿真数据向真实在轨数据的迁移存在风险，需要实践验证其可行性与设计要点。
AI.method: 构建轻量级海洋异常检测流程：海面分割、海洋区域自监督特征编码、基于偏离正常海况的通用异常检测、以及可选的异常类型刻画；发射前用模拟Φsat-2影像训练与验证，完成在轨集成与功能验证；发射后发现仿真与在轨数据显著失配，遂基于真实Level-1影像、采用改进的标注策略进行重训。
AI.result: 验证了该应用在轨部署的可行性；改进标注策略并基于真实L1影像重训后，检测性能大幅提升；确认仿真开发有助于降低飞行前风险，而仿真与真实数据间存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: Φsat-2经验强调鲁棒的标注策略与传感器感知设计的重要性；仿真可用于飞行前风险削减，但可靠的科学验证必须依赖具有代表性的在轨数据，且应与功能验证明确区分。

title: Towards Unified Evaluation of Prompt Enhancers for Video Generation
summary: Modern video generators can realize increasingly complex visual narratives, positioning the prompt enhancer (PE) as a critical bridge from concise user instructions and multimodal references to structured cinematic plans. However, existing PE evaluation relies on rendered videos, imposing substantial computational and human costs, slowing PE training and iteration, and conflating PE quality with downstream generator behavior. To address this gap, we introduce PEBench, the first unified benchmark for direct PE evaluation across text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video prompt enhancement. It comprises 1,100 expert-verified cases and 1,005 visual assets, spanning 35 fine-grained tasks with diverse temporal, cinematic, audiovisual, and multi-reference requirements. In addition, we develop PEBench evaluation, an evidence-grounded framework that combines modality-aware fact extraction with rubric-based assessment across 24 criteria. Our systematic evaluation of representative open- and closed-source PE methods reveals an emerging shift from fine-grained descriptive expansion toward intent-preserving cinematic planning, while the caption-reconstruction and forward-refinement methods show complementary strengths in cinematic coverage and semantic fidelity or internal coherence, respectively. Human validation shows that PEBench scores align closely with expert judgments of enhanced prompts and downstream videos from Wan3.0 and MiniMax-H3, indicating that prompt-level evaluation reliably reflects downstream utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PEBench，首个面向 text-to-video、image-to-video 和 reference-to-video 提示增强（PE）的统一直接评测基准，包含 1,100 个专家验证案例、1,005 个视觉资产和 35 项细粒度任务，并提出结合模态感知事实抽取与 24 项标准评分量表的证据驱动评测框架 PEBench evaluation。
AI.motivation: 现有 PE 评测依赖渲染后的视频，计算与人工成本高，拖慢 PE 训练与迭代，且将 PE 质量与下游生成器行为混为一谈，缺乏对 PE 本身的直接评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 PEBench 统一基准（1,100 专家验证案例、1,005 视觉资产、覆盖 35 项任务，涵盖时间、电影化、视听与多参考需求），并提出证据驱动的 PEBench evaluation 框架，将模态感知的事实抽取与基于评分量表（rubric）的 24 项标准评估相结合；对代表性开源与闭源 PE 方法进行系统评测，并开展人类验证。
AI.result: 系统评测显示 PE 正从细粒度描述性扩展转向意图保持的电影化规划；标题重建（caption-reconstruction）与前向精炼（forward-refinement）方法分别在电影化覆盖与语义保真、内部一致性方面展现互补优势。人类验证表明 PEBench 分数与专家对增强提示及 Wan3.0、MiniMax-H3 下游视频的判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 提示级（prompt-level）评测能够可靠反映下游实用价值，PEBench 为 PE 提供了低成本、可统一的直接评测方案，支持更高效的 PE 训练与迭代。

title: Streaming-Aware Diffusion for Real-Time Video Super-Resolution via Cross-Step Attention
summary: Real-time video super-resolution requires high spatio-temporal fidelity under strict latency constraints, challenging diffusion models due to their iterative sampling cost and limited temporal coordination. We propose a streaming-aware framework that adapts pretrained single-image latent diffusion models for efficient video super-resolution (VSR) by exploiting the sequential structure of video streams. Our Cross-Step Attention mechanism reuses intermediate denoising features across adjacent frames and diffusion steps, enabling temporal information exchange without explicit temporal modeling. We further introduce Trajectory-Coupled Diffusion Scheduling, which aligns adjacent diffusion states and provides cleaner intermediate representations for cross-step conditioning, improving temporal coherence. These components are integrated into a streaming inference pipeline that incrementally propagates latent states across frames, reducing the effective computational complexity from $O(N \cdot S)$ to $O(N + S)$ for $N$ frames and $S$ diffusion steps. Experiments on REDS4 and YouHQ40-Test demonstrate improved perceptual quality and temporal realism while maintaining frame-wise stability. Our method achieves over 40 FPS at $512 \times 512$ resolution after cold start, enabling real-time VSR without explicit temporal modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出流式感知框架，复用预训练单图潜在扩散模型实现实时视频超分，通过跨步注意力与轨迹耦合调度降低计算复杂度并提升时序一致性。
AI.motivation: 实时视频超分需要在严格延迟约束下保持高时空保真度，但扩散模型的迭代采样开销大、时序协调能力有限，难以直接应用。
AI.method: 1) 跨步注意力（Cross-Step Attention）：在相邻帧与扩散步之间复用中间去噪特征，无需显式时序建模即可实现时序信息交换；2) 轨迹耦合扩散调度（Trajectory-Coupled Diffusion Scheduling）：对齐相邻扩散状态，为跨步条件提供更干净的中问表示以改善时序连贯性；3) 流式推理管线：逐帧增量传播潜在状态，将有效计算复杂度从 O(N·S) 降至 O(N+S)（N 帧、S 扩散步）。
AI.result: 在 REDS4 与 YouHQ40-Test 上取得更优的感知质量与时序真实感，同时保持逐帧稳定性；冷启动后在 512×512 分辨率下超过 40 FPS，实现无需显式时序建模的实时视频超分。
AI.conclusion: 通过复用扩散中间特征与耦合调度，可将单图潜在扩散模型高效适配为实时流式视频超分方案，在保证时序一致性的同时满足实时性要求。

title: Dino Forcing Flow Models: Do not denoise what you can predict
summary: Co-denoising pretrained representations such as DINO can substantially improve the training speed and quality of flow matching models, but it introduces a second denoising trajectory and requires carefully designed schedules. We propose a simpler alternative: predict the pretrained representation directly, then condition the model on its own prediction. This removes the need for a second ODE and any representation-specific denoising schedules, while retaining the benefits of representation guidance. Our approach converges substantially faster and achieves better generation quality as measured by FID score. On ImageNet, it outperforms the state of the art in latent space at 2x fewer epochs than prior methods; in pixel space, it improves FID over comparable prior methods by more than 20%. These results support a simple principle: do not denoise what you can predict. Our code is openly available at https://github.com/arijit-hub/dino_forcing.

AI.tldr: 提出一种更简单的表征引导流匹配方法：直接预测预训练表征（如DINO）并以自身预测作为条件，无需第二条去噪ODE与表征特定噪声调度，收敛更快、生成质量更好。
AI.motivation: 共去噪（co-denoising）预训练表征虽能显著提升流匹配模型的训练速度与质量，但引入第二条去噪轨迹并需精心设计调度，增加了复杂度。
AI.method: 直接预测预训练表征，再将模型条件化于其自身预测结果，从而省去第二条ODE和表征专属的去噪调度，同时保留表征引导的收益（即"不要对可预测之物去噪"）。
AI.result: 收敛显著更快，FID更优：在ImageNet上以比先前方法少2倍的epoch超越潜在空间最优结果；在像素空间，FID相比同类先前方法提升超过20%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一个简单原则：不要对可预测之物去噪；代码已开源。

title: Memory Forcing: Attendable Mid-Horizon History for Streaming Video Generation
comment: The current version contains serious formatting errors and cannot be retained. A simple replacement would still leave traces of the original version, failing to meet our requirements. Therefore, I request its withdrawal. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion enables causal video streaming without a bidirectional pass over the full clip, but existing few-step systems usually retain only the opening and most recent frames in a fixed-size KV cache. Once an event leaves this window, later frames can no longer attend to it, a failure we term mid-horizon forgetting. We present Memory Forcing, a few-step streaming method that preserves this missing history without increasing the cache size. Its Archive \& Working Banks partition the cache into sink, archive, and working regions, retaining diverse intermediate events alongside recent motion under fixed memory. Because absolute temporal indices drift outside the training range, Bank-aware RoPE reassigns indices at attention time so each bank remains distinguishable. At 1.3B, Memory Forcing leads on longer clips, shows the smallest drop from 5s to 60s among methods reporting all four lengths, and preserves subjects and scenes through leave-and-return. The same design scales to Wan2.2 5B, producing more physically plausible, realistic, and dynamic videos and, to our knowledge, the first public 5B model on this forcing line.

AI.tldr: Memory Forcing：通过归档/工作双库分区与 Bank-aware RoPE，在不增大 KV 缓存的前提下缓解自回归视频扩散中的"中程遗忘"，实现长视频流式生成。
AI.motivation: 现有少步自回归视频扩散系统采用固定大小的 KV 缓存，仅保留开头帧与最近帧，导致事件一旦离开窗口后续帧便无法再关注它（中程遗忘），长片段一致性受损。
AI.method: 提出 Archive & Working Banks，将缓存划分为 sink、archive、working 三区，在固定内存下同时保留多样的中间事件与近期运动；针对绝对时间索引超出训练范围的问题，设计 Bank-aware RoPE 在注意力计算时重分配索引，使各 bank 保持可区分。
AI.result: 在 1.3B 模型上，于较长片段上领先，在报告全部四种长度的方法中从 5s 到 60s 的性能下降最小，并在"离开—返回"场景中保持主体与场景一致；该设计可扩展至 Wan2.2 5B，生成更符合物理规律、更真实且动态性更强的视频，据称是该 forcing 路线上的首个公开 5B 模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过缓存分区与索引重分配的协同设计，可在不增加缓存开销的前提下有效保留中程历史信息，提升长时流式视频生成的一致性与可扩展性。

title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Website: https://thinking-inertia.github.io GitHub: https://github.com/thinking-inertia/code
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly ship with explicit "thinking modes", yet their counterpart, "no-thinking", has received far less attention. We study LLMs' no-thinking behavior along two axes. a. How to measure no-thinking? Prior work typically defines no-thinking through proxies such as a disabled thinking mode or the absence of long traces. These proxies are unreliable: disabled thinking modes may still emit reasoning, while long traces may contain filler rather than genuine inference. We instead normalize each response into a pre-answer trace and final answer, and evaluate it at three levels: (i) Empty-Thinking Rate for strict answer-only compliance; (ii) instruction-aware Question-Pre-answer Relevance for similarity between the question and pre-answer trace; and (iii) LLM-as-judge Explicit Inference Rate for visible explicit inference. Together, these metrics distinguish answer-only output, relevant but non-inferential text, and explicit inference. b. How does no-thinking vary across tasks and models? We evaluate six prompting interventions on six LLMs across Boolean, multiple-choice, and open-ended questions. We find that explicit no-think controls cannot reliably eliminate visible inference. Models instead exhibit "Thinking Inertia": explicit inference persists even under strict controls and becomes more prevalent as the answer space opens. Accuracy remains stable on Boolean and multiple-choice tasks, whereas open-ended tasks reveal a trade-off between answer-only compliance and task accuracy. Rewriting the same questions across answer spaces shows that supplying candidate answers makes answer-only responses easier to produce. These findings establish no-thinking as a non-trivial capability: stopping explicit reasoning cannot be assumed from model settings or instructions alone and deserves systematic evaluation alongside reasoning ability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对LLM"无思考(no-thinking)"行为的系统评估：将回答拆分为"作答前痕迹"与"最终答案"，用三层次指标度量（Empty-Thinking Rate、指令感知的Question-Pre-answer Relevance、LLM-as-judge Explicit Inference Rate），并在6个LLM、6种提示干预和三类任务上评测，发现"思考惯性"现象。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦LLM的"思考模式"，其对立面"无思考"被忽视。且以往对无思考的度量依赖不可靠的代理指标：禁用思考模式可能仍会输出推理，长痕迹可能只是填充而非真实推理，因而缺乏对无思考能力的严格刻画。
AI.method: 将每个回答规范化为"作答前痕迹(pre-answer trace)"与"最终答案"两部分，并在三个层面评测：(i) Empty-Thinking Rate，衡量严格仅输出答案的合规性；(ii) 指令感知的 Question-Pre-answer Relevance，衡量问题与作答前痕迹的相似度；(iii) LLM-as-judge Explicit Inference Rate，检测显式可见推理。实验覆盖6个LLM、6种提示干预，任务含布尔题、多选题与开放式问题，并通过在相同问题跨答案空间改写进行对照。
AI.result: 显式的"禁止思考"控制无法可靠消除可见推理；模型表现出"思考惯性(Thinking Inertia)"——即使严格约束下显式推理仍存在，且随答案空间开放而更普遍。布尔题与多选题准确率保持稳定；开放式任务则显示"仅答案合规性"与"任务准确率"之间的权衡。相同问题跨答案空间改写表明，提供候选答案会使仅答案式回答更易产生。
AI.conclusion: 无思考是一种非平凡能力：仅凭模型设置或指令无法假定其能停止显式推理，应与推理能力一样被系统评估。

title: Same Outcome, Different Evidence: Intent Recovery in LLM Safety Evaluation
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures. Code and experiment inputs: https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/IRIS
summary: Safety evaluations of large language models commonly summarize harmful-output behavior with attack success rate (ASR). Yet the same non-harmful outcome can arise for very different reasons. A model may recover a harmful task and refuse it, fail to recover the task, or respond to something else entirely. Distinguishing these cases becomes especially important under intent-obscuring prompts, where a low ASR does not reveal whether the evaluated task was actually engaged. To make this distinction explicit, we pair ASR with operative understanding rate (UR), which measures whether a response both identifies the evaluated task and treats it as the task to be answered. Across interfaces, this paired view reveals substantial variation hidden by ASR: similar ASR values can correspond to sharply different recovery rates. Controlled English reconstructions show that recovery consistently improves as compressed prompts become more explicit, whereas ASR does not follow the same pattern. A complementary contrast comes from FormalLogic, where high recovery can still coincide with frequent harmful assistance. Together, these results show that non-harmful outcomes are not equally informative about model safety, motivating the joint reporting of intent recovery and ASR in LLM safety evaluation. Code and experiment inputs are available at https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/IRIS.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出现有大型语言模型安全评估仅用攻击成功率（ASR）总结有害输出行为存在信息损失，提出将ASR与"操作性理解率"（UR）配对报告，以区分"识别任务并拒绝""未识别任务""答非所问"等不同非有害结果。
AI.motivation: 低ASR并不意味着模型真正理解并拒绝了被评估的有害任务：同样的非有害结果可能源于模型恢复了任务并拒绝、未能恢复任务、或完全回应了别的内容。在意图模糊（intent-obscuring）提示下，这种混淆尤为严重——低ASR无法揭示模型是否实际接触到了被评估任务，因此需要一种能显式区分这些情形的度量。
AI.method: 在ASR之外引入操作性理解率（UR），衡量响应是否既识别出被评估任务、又将其作为待回答的任务来处理。在不同交互界面（interfaces）上对ASR与UR进行配对观测；并用受控的英文重构实验，观察提示压缩程度与显式程度变化时恢复率与ASR的变化；同时以FormalLogic作为补充对照，考察高恢复率与高频有害协助并存的情形。
AI.result: 配对视角揭示了被ASR掩盖的显著差异：相近的ASR数值可能对应截然不同的任务恢复率。受控英文重构显示，随着压缩提示变得更显式，任务恢复率持续上升，而ASR并不遵循相同趋势。FormalLogic上的对照表明，高恢复率仍可与频繁的有害协助同时出现。
AI.conclusion: 非有害结果在反映模型安全性方面并不具有同等的信息量。仅报告ASR会误导安全评估，因此主张在LLM安全评估中联合报告意图恢复（UR）与ASR，代码与实验输入已公开于 https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/IRIS。

title: From Video Clips to Creation Trajectory: Sora100K for AI-Native Video Creation
summary: AI-Native video creation is shifting from isolated video clips toward iterative video creation workflows. However, existing datasets remain largely video clips, representing video generation and editing as separate tasks rather than connected stages of a video creation workflow. In this paper, we introduce Sora100K, a dataset that represents the AI-Native video creation workflow as a structured video creation trajectory. Specifically, we first identify video creation trajectories and decompose them into three subsets according to their structural roles: text-to-video generation records as roots, single-turn video editing records as editing edges, and multi-turn video editing records as complete trajectories. Then, we use a VLM to assign semantic annotations for generation roots and editing-operation annotations for editing edges. A strict construction pipeline further reconstructs source-to-edit lineage, editing order, and intermediate video states while ensuring data quality. Finally, we perform lightweight adaptation on LTX-2 models to assess the supervision value of Sora100K. The results show improvements in visual quality, multi-shot generation, and cross-shot consistency, while successive-turn evaluation reveals that following multi-turn editing instructions remains challenging. Sora100K establishes a new data foundation for AI-Native video creation beyond isolated video clips and toward structured video creation trajectory. The dataset and supplementary materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ysicong/Sora100K.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Sora100K 数据集，将 AI 原生视频创作建模为结构化的"视频创作轨迹"，而非孤立的视频片段，并以此评估其监督价值。
AI.motivation: 现有视频数据集大多由孤立视频片段构成，将视频生成与视频编辑视为彼此独立的任务，而非视频创作流程中相互衔接的阶段。这无法反映 AI 原生视频创作从单一片段走向迭代式工作流的实际形态，因此缺乏能够刻画"创作轨迹"的数据基础。
AI.method: 1) 识别视频创作轨迹，并按结构角色拆分为三个子集：文生视频生成记录作为"根"（roots），单轮视频编辑记录作为"编辑边"（editing edges），多轮视频编辑记录作为"完整轨迹"。2) 使用 VLM 为生成根赋予语义标注，为编辑边赋予编辑操作标注。3) 通过严格的构建流程重建"源→编辑"血缘关系、编辑顺序与中间视频状态，并保证数据质量。4) 在 LTX-2 模型上进行轻量适配，以评估 Sora100K 的监督价值。
AI.result: 轻量适配实验显示，模型在视觉质量、多镜头生成与跨镜头一致性方面均有提升；但连续多轮评估表明，遵循多轮编辑指令仍然具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: Sora100K 为 AI 原生视频创作确立了新的数据基础，推动该领域从孤立视频片段走向结构化视频创作轨迹。数据集与补充材料已公开。

title: RouterInterp: Understanding Superposed Specialisation in Mixture of Experts Routing
comment: 33 pages (12 non-appendix pages), 7 figures, published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
summary: Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) models scale more efficiently than dense models by routing tokens to modular expert networks that are only active for processing a fraction of tokens. A leading hypothesis for the performance of MoE models is that each expert specialises in a single, coherent domain. However, interpretability efforts that assume this hypothesis have generally been unsuccessful. We propose and present evidence for an alternative account that we call the Superposed Specialisation Hypothesis (SSH): experts specialise in a disjoint union of fine-grained features rather than one broad domain. Leveraging the SSH, we introduce RouterInterp, a method for interpreting expert routing that identifies Sparse Autoencoder features most predictive of routing decisions and produces unified natural language explanations. On gpt-oss-20b, RouterInterp explains expert routing with ${\sim}65\%$ higher detection accuracy than prior token statistics based methods. This work provides a scalable method for generating more accurate explanations of expert routing and increases our understanding of a previously uninterpretable component of foundation models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“叠加特化假设”（SSH），认为MoE专家特化于细粒度特征的并集而非单一领域，并据此提出RouterInterp方法，在gpt-oss-20b上以约65%更高的检测准确率解释专家路由。
AI.motivation: 稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型通过将token路由到仅对部分token激活的模块化专家网络，实现比稠密模型更高效的扩展。关于MoE性能的主流假设是每个专家特化于单一、连贯的领域，但基于该假设的可解释性研究普遍未能成功，因此需要新的解释框架。
AI.method: 提出“叠加特化假设”（SSH）：专家特化于细粒度特征的并集（disjoint union），而非一个宽泛领域。基于SSH设计了RouterInterp方法，用于解释专家路由：识别对路由决策最具预测性的稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoder）特征，并生成统一的自然语言解释。
AI.result: 在gpt-oss-20b上，RouterInterp解释专家路由的检测准确率比先前基于token统计的方法高出约65%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种可扩展的方法来生成更准确的专家路由解释，增进了对基础模型中此前难以解释组件的理解。

title: DPPM: Dual-Path Parametric Memory for Personalized Language Models
summary: Long-term personalization requires language models to use interaction history to track users' preferences across sessions. Parametric memory encodes this interaction history into model parameters or adapters, reducing the need to include it in the inference context. However, independent context compilation leaves cross-session integration unspecified, while recurrent updates can attenuate earlier evidence. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-Path Parametric Memory (DPPM). Its Evidence path directly pools representations of the interaction history to preserve earlier evidence, while its Delta path sequentially updates an associative state to capture changes. Fusing both outputs produces history-conditioned LoRA adapters that combine evidence accumulation with ordered revision. Across multiple backbones, DPPM outperforms the evaluated baselines, achieving 54.22% on PersonaMem-v2 and 86.79% on PrefEval. These results suggest that DPPM provides a simple and effective design choice for cross-session personalized parametric memory.

AI.tldr: 提出双路径参数化记忆（DPPM），通过 Evidence 路径保存早期证据、Delta 路径捕捉顺序更新，融合生成历史条件 LoRA 适配器，实现跨会话个性化。
AI.motivation: 长期个性化要求语言模型利用交互历史跨会话追踪用户偏好，而现有参数化记忆存在缺陷：独立上下文编译未明确跨会话整合方式，循环更新又会衰减早期证据。
AI.method: DPPM 包含两条路径：Evidence 路径直接池化交互历史的表示以保留早期证据；Delta 路径顺序更新关联状态以捕捉变化；融合两者输出生成历史条件 LoRA 适配器，兼得证据累积与有序修正。
AI.result: 在多个主干模型上超越所评估的基线，PersonaMem-v2 达 54.22%，PrefEval 达 86.79%。
AI.conclusion: DPPM 为跨会话个性化参数化记忆提供了一种简洁有效的设计选择。

title: Skill-V: Verifiable Self-Evolving Skill Library for Interactive Agents
summary: Interactive agents can turn experience into reusable skills, yet existing self-evolving skill libraries primarily improve by accumulating new knowledge. Failures may lead to new skills, while previously stored skills are less often revisited as new evidence arrives. However, growth alone does not ensure reliability, as a retrieved skill may be inapplicable under the current task conditions, and an existing skill may encode a mis-specified operational boundary. Reliable skill evolution therefore requires not only adding knowledge, but also testing and revising what is already stored. We introduce Skill-V, a verifiable self-evolving skill library. To make stored knowledge testable, we propose representing skills as versioned, falsifiable contracts that link semantic intent to observable behavioral criteria. We use environment outcomes to drive library evolution. Specifically, task failures motivate skill addition, while disagreements between contract evaluations and task outcomes guide revisions to existing skill boundaries. To validate these revisions, we require them to preserve protected semantic constraints and satisfy non-regression criteria for rubric-outcome metrics on historical replay evidence. Finally, we employ an applicability-aware filter to exclude candidates judged confidently inapplicable to the current task. Across ALFWorld and WebShop, Skill-V achieves success rates of 95.3% and 85.9%, respectively, while maintaining a more compact skill library than growth-oriented baselines. Applicability-aware filtering reduces incorrect skill invocations, and outcome-grounded revisions correct mis-specified skill boundaries without degrading performance on previously observed evidence. These results show that reliable skill evolution requires more than accumulating experience: the library must learn which knowledge to retain, when to revise it, and when it should be applied.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Skill-V，一个可验证的自演化技能库，将技能表示为带版本、可证伪的契约，利用环境结果驱动技能的新增与修订，并通过适用性过滤与历史重放非回归校验保证可靠性，在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上分别达到 95.3% 和 85.9% 的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化技能库主要依靠不断累积新知识来改进：失败会导致新技能的产生，而已存储的旧技能很少在新证据到来时被重新审视。然而仅靠增长无法保证可靠性——检索到的技能可能在当前任务条件下不适用，已有技能也可能编码了错误设定的操作边界。因此可靠的技能演化不仅需要增加知识，还需要对已存储内容进行检验与修订。
AI.method: 1) 将技能表示为带版本、可证伪的契约，将语义意图与可观测的行为准则相链接，使存储的知识可被检验；2) 以环境结果驱动技能库演化：任务失败促使新增技能，契约评估与任务结果之间的不一致则引导对已有技能边界的修订；3) 修订需保留受保护的语义约束，并在历史重放证据上满足评分-结果指标的非回归准则；4) 采用适用性感知过滤器，排除被高置信判定为不适用于当前任务的候选技能。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，Skill-V 的成功率分别为 95.3% 和 85.9%，且技能库比以增长为导向的基线更紧凑。适用性感知过滤减少了错误的技能调用，基于结果的修订在不降低历史证据表现的前提下修正了错误设定的技能边界。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的技能演化不只是积累经验：技能库必须学会保留哪些知识、何时修订以及何时应用。Skill-V 通过可证伪契约、结果驱动的修订与非回归验证，验证了这一观点。

title: From Sparse Representations to Behavioral Insights for Multimodal Depression Assessment
summary: Multimodal depression assessment offers a promising approach to analyzing behavioral patterns associated with depression. However, existing methods often rely on dense and opaque multimodal representations, making it difficult to interpret the behavioral patterns underlying their predictions. In this work, we introduce BehavDep, a sparse factor-based framework that decomposes multimodal behavioral representations into sparse latent factors and associates them with behaviorally meaningful concepts through a semantic bridge. To address the mismatch between user-level annotations and heterogeneous video-level behaviors, BehavDep further learns video-level depression tendency scores under weak supervision and aggregates information across multiple observations for user-level assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BehavDep achieves the best overall assessment performance while revealing complementary modality contributions, heterogeneous behavioral patterns across observations, and prediction responses to concept-level editing. These results show that BehavDep provides a structured and interpretable approach to analyzing multimodal behavioral representations for depression assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出BehavDep框架，用稀疏因子分解多模态行为表征并借语义桥关联行为概念，实现可解释的抑郁评估。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态抑郁评估依赖稠密且不透明的表征，难以解释预测背后的行为模式，缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 将多模态行为表征分解为稀疏潜在因子，并通过语义桥与行为有意义的概念关联；针对用户级标注与异质视频级行为的失配，在弱监督下学习视频级抑郁倾向分数，并聚合多观测信息用于用户级评估。
AI.result: 大量实验表明BehavDep取得最佳整体评估性能，同时揭示互补的模态贡献、跨观测的异质行为模式以及概念级编辑下的预测响应。
AI.conclusion: BehavDep为多模态行为表征的抑郁评估提供了一种结构化、可解释的分析方法。

title: Easy to anticipate, hard to compute: boundary dependence finds the computed outputs that entropy patching misses
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code, logs and results: https://github.com/nicoveraz/segresearch (archived: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23238215)
summary: Byte-level language models such as the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) group bytes into patches and run their large global model once per patch. BLT starts a patch where a small model's next-byte entropy is high, so global compute goes where the next byte is hard to predict. We show that this rule has a systematic blind spot: positions whose type is predictable but whose value must be computed, such as the number after "=" in a worked math solution. Under tight patch budgets, entropy-triggered layouts skip these positions, and accuracy on them collapses. In Meta's BLT-1B with patch starts on 10% of bytes, the entropy rule puts a patch start at 16% of the computed results in GSM8K solutions and gets 19.0% of them exactly right; a boundary after each "=" at the same patch count gets 51.8%, and entropy combined with a label-free boundary-dependence signal gets 67.1% (default layout at 26% of bytes: 76.8%). The gap survives adapting BLT-1B to the budget with low-rank fine-tuning (32.9% vs 72.7%, three runs per rule, paired p < 1e-200) and grows with model size in byte models trained from scratch at a 10% budget: at 1M, 12M and 50M parameters, boundary dependence beats entropy on final answers by -1.6, +10.1 and +19.8 points, and at 50M it gets 35.9% of computed results against 13.9% (3 seeds each). BLT's entropy-jump rule helps neither target at 50M. The entropy trigger of Scratchpad Patching is likewise indistinguishable from random scratchpads on final answers (5.6% vs 5.9%, 5 seeds), while answer-start scratchpads give 38.1%. The effect is specific to computed values: copies and lookups gain little, and values the model cannot compute gain nothing. Boundary dependence, the rise in the model's own loss when a patch start is removed, measured per two-byte context, finds these positions without labels: combined with entropy it beats the hand-written rule on computed results.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示字节级语言模型（如BLT）中基于熵的补丁划分规则存在系统性盲区：对"类型可预测但值需计算"的位置（如"="后的计算结果），熵触发规则会跳过这些位置，导致准确率崩塌；提出并验证了"边界依赖性"这一无标签信号可有效识别此类位置，显著提升计算结果的准确率。
AI.motivation: Byte Latent Transformer（BLT）等字节级语言模型通过在下一字节熵高之处开启补丁，将全局计算资源分配到难以预测的位置。然而，作者认为这一规则存在系统性盲区：对于类型可预测但值必须实际计算的位置（例如数学解题中"="后的数字），熵值并不一定高，因此在紧张的补丁预算下，熵触发布局会跳过这些位置，导致其准确率急剧下降。研究动机在于识别并修正这一盲区，以提升字节模型在需要计算的任务上的表现。
AI.method: 研究对比了多种补丁划分规则在多种模型与预算设置下的表现：在Meta的BLT-1B上，对比了熵规则（10%字节处开启补丁）、每个"="后开启边界、熵结合无标签的"边界依赖性"信号，以及默认布局（26%字节）。进一步通过低秩微调适配预算，并在从零训练的1M、12M、50M参数字节模型上以10%预算对比边界依赖性与熵规则。作者将"边界依赖性"定义为：在给定两字节上下文下，移除某补丁起点时模型自身损失的上升量，作为无需标签即可定位需计算值位置的信号。
AI.result: 在BLT-1B（10%字节处开启补丁）中，熵规则仅在GSM8K解答中16%的计算结果处放置补丁起点，精确正确率19.0%；相同补丁数下每个"="后加边界得51.8%；熵结合边界依赖性信号得67.1%（默认布局26%字节：76.8%）。低秩微调后差距依旧（32.9% vs 72.7%，每条规则三次运行，配对p<1e-200），且随模型规模增大而扩大：1M、12M、50M参数下边界依赖性在最终答案上分别领先熵规则-1.6、+10.1、+19.8个百分点，50M时计算结果准确率35.9% vs 13.9%（各3个种子）。BLT的熵跳变规则在50M时对两个目标均无帮助。Scratchpad Patching的熵触发器在最终答案上与随机scratchpad无差别（5.6% vs 5.9%，5个种子），而答案起始的scratchpad达38.1%。复制与查找类任务获益甚微，模型无法计算的值则无任何增益。
AI.conclusion: 熵触发的补丁划分存在系统性盲区，会跳过"类型可预测但值需计算"的位置，导致计算结果准确率崩塌，且该问题随模型规模增大而加剧。基于模型自身损失的"边界依赖性"信号无需标签即可定位这些位置，与熵结合后优于人工规则。该效应特异地存在于计算值场景：复制查找获益小，不可计算的值无增益。研究提示字节级模型的补丁划分应结合边界依赖性等信号，以弥补熵规则的不足。

title: Phase-aware video generation for physics-grounded dynamics and interactions
summary: Generating physically plausible videos for solid-gas dynamics is challenging as different phases exhibit distinct dynamics yet remain coupled through physical interactions. We present PAVG, a Phase-Aware Video Generator for solid-gas dynamics and interactions. It employs a dual-branch architecture to explicitly model the distinct dynamics of solids and gases, while spatiotemporal cross-attention captures their physical interactions. This design enables PAVG to preserve phasespecific motion characteristics while producing physically consistent responses across phases. To facilitate this task, we further construct a simulation corpus comprising over 700K physical trajectories across diverse solid, gas, and solid-gas interaction scenarios. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our PAVG produces videos with improved motion adherence, physical plausibility, and visual quality compared with existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PAVG，一种面向固-气动力学的相位感知视频生成器，采用双分支架构分别建模固体与气体的动力学，并通过时空交叉注意力刻画相间物理交互，同时构建了包含70万+物理轨迹的仿真语料库。实验表明其在运动一致性、物理合理性和视觉质量上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 固-气动力学视频生成具有挑战性：不同相（固相、气相）表现出截然不同的动力学特征，但彼此又通过物理交互耦合。现有方法难以在保持各相运动特性的同时刻画跨相的物理一致性。
AI.method: 提出 PAVG（Phase-Aware Video Generator）：1）双分支架构，显式建模固体与气体各自的动力学；2）时空交叉注意力（spatiotemporal cross-attention）捕捉相间的物理交互；3）构建仿真语料库，涵盖固体、气体及固-气交互场景，共超过70万条物理轨迹。
AI.result: 大量评估表明，与现有方法相比，PAVG 生成的视频在运动一致性（motion adherence）、物理合理性（physical plausibility）和视觉质量方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过相位感知的双分支建模与跨相时空注意力的结合，能够有效解耦并耦合固-气相动力学，为多相物理交互视频生成提供了可行方案，并为该任务提供了大规模仿真数据支持。

title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
summary: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.

AI.tldr: Memento 3 让冻结的 LLM 智能体通过外部记忆持续学习显式世界模型，在 ARC-AGI-3 上全部通关 25 个公开游戏并达到 RHAE 100.0，在 Atari Pong 上以 21:0 获胜。
AI.motivation: 智能体在陌生环境中行动需要推断世界运行规律并随新证据修正理解，但有限观测常支持多个都能解释历史交互、却在未见状态下预测不同的世界模型，因此需要一个可持续修正、保留不确定性的显式世界模型学习机制。
AI.method: 以 Memento 系列为基础构建 Memento 3：智能体以自然语言规则手册作为持久语义记忆，记录可修正的环境动力学假设，并对未知部分保持欠指定；将规则手册编译为可执行代码用于预测与规划；通过"观察—反思—规则修订—编译—验证"的持续循环，利用预测误差精炼规则手册与代码，仅当 LLM 判定代码忠实于规则手册且逐格重放能复现观测转移时才接受更新。同时引入群体扩展，并行维护多个世界模型，共享交互证据并以其预测引导探索；底层 LLM 保持冻结，将此过程视为基于模型的递归自我改进路径。
AI.result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 上，单模型智能体通关全部 25 个公开游戏的每一关，平均相对人类动作效率（RHAE）达 100.0，仅使用人类动作数的 44%。在 Atari Pong 案例研究中，学得的反馈控制器在三个不同开局的情节中均以 21:0 获胜，且无需进一步调用 LLM。
AI.conclusion: 冻结 LLM 的智能体可通过外部记忆中的显式、可验证世界模型实现持续学习与递归自我改进，从而在样本效率与任务表现上超越人类水平（如 ARC-AGI-3 与 Atari Pong），表明基于模型的 RSI 路径在固定底层模型下依然有效。

title: Seek-and-View Reasoning for Multi-View Spatial Understanding
summary: Existing approaches to multi-view spatial reasoning operate largely on sparse input views. Vision-language models (VLMs) are thus restricted to understand a scene and infer spatial relations within these fixed views, leading to fragile cross-view alignment and geometry-to-language bottleneck. To address these issues, we formulate a novel Seek-and-View reasoning approach to find implicit cross-view spatial evidence by locating a question-relevant view to support the spatial reasoning. To realize this approach, we propose Vantage, a training-free model-agnostic reasoning framework that pairs a VLM with a 3D foundation model: a viewpoint-grounded reasoning stage for question analysis and view planning, followed by a geometry-grounded evidence augmentation stage to effectively synthesize and incorporate visual evidence into the final reasoning. Comprehensive experiments on six VLMs demonstrate consistent improvements on five benchmarks without fine-tuning. Overall, by revealing spatial evidence through view-grounded reasoning, Vantage can largely reduce reliance on language-based cross-view alignment and improve multi-view spatial understanding. Our code is available at https://github.com/q1xiangchen/Vantage.

AI.tldr: Vantage是一种免训练、模型无关的推理框架，将VLM与3D基础模型结合，通过定位与问题相关的视角来寻找跨视图空间证据，从而改进多视图空间推理。
AI.motivation: 现有多视图空间推理方法大多依赖稀疏输入视图，导致VLM只能在这些固定视图内理解场景并推断空间关系，存在跨视图对齐脆弱以及"几何到语言"的瓶颈问题。
AI.method: 提出"Seek-and-View"推理范式，通过定位与问题相关的视角来寻找隐式的跨视图空间证据；并实现Vantage框架，包含两个阶段：（1）基于视角的推理阶段，用于问题分析与视图规划；（2）基于几何的证据增强阶段，将视觉证据有效合成并纳入最终推理。
AI.result: 在六种VLM、五个基准上进行了实验，在无需微调的情况下均取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于视角的推理揭示空间证据，Vantage可大幅降低对语言式跨视图对齐的依赖，提升多视图空间理解能力。代码已开源。

title: Fast Pose Tracking of Rigid Objects with Compact Pose Graph Optimization
summary: Tracking a novel object's 6D pose over long horizons currently requires either expensive onboarding or a reconstruction maintained throughout the sequence. This makes current trackers impractical for robotic manipulation and augmented reality, which need trackers that are ready to use and run in real time. We show that a lightweight tracking module can be applied on top of a wide range of correspondence estimation methods to keep drifts bounded while maintaining fast runtime. Our key idea is to avoid point-based optimization in the pose graph and operate only on relative pose constraints, which we weight by a derived uncertainty from the geometric alignment. This makes optimization independent of the number of correspondences while avoiding the direct inclusion of noisy point measurements, leading to fast and robust long-term tracking. Across four real-world benchmarks, our approach achieves tracking accuracy comparable to reconstruction-based trackers with a fraction of the optimization cost. Overall, these results suggest that a compact and reliable pose graph optimization can provide long-horizon consistency at substantially lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级6D位姿跟踪模块，基于相对位姿约束的位姿图优化，实现无需重建的实时长时跟踪。
AI.motivation: 现有新颖物体6D位姿长时跟踪需昂贵的前期建模或全程维护的重建，难以满足机器人操作与增强现实对即用、实时跟踪器的需求。
AI.method: 在多种对应估计方法之上叠加轻量跟踪模块；核心是不在位姿图中做基于点的优化，仅使用相对位姿约束，并用几何对齐推导出的不确定性对其加权，使优化与对应数量无关且不直接引入噪声点测量。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界基准上，跟踪精度与基于重建的跟踪器相当，而优化开销仅为其中一小部分，同时保持快速运行并抑制漂移。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑可靠的位姿图优化能以显著更低的计算成本提供长时一致性，适用于即用型实时6D跟踪。

title: From Pixels to Structure: Lightweight Vision-Language Models for Document OCR and Structured JSON Extraction
comment: 17 pages. Published in Document Analysis and Recognition - ICDAR 2026, LNCS vol. 16974, Springer. Code: https://github.com/uddipan77/Analysis-of-Lightweight-Vision-Language-Models-for-Document-OCR-and-Structured-Output-Generation
summary: While massive, closed-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) set strong benchmarks for document understanding, their dependence on commercial APIs limits adoption in institutional archives due to data autonomy concerns, recurring costs, and the environmental footprint of hyperscale computing. This is especially acute in heritage digitization, where documents include historical handwriting, domain-specific terminology (e.g., jewelry, prehistory, architecture), and non-standard layouts requiring high-dimensional structured extraction. We present a comparative study of eight open-source lightweight VLMs (up to 7B parameters) for Optical Character Recognition (OCR)-to-structure across three university heritage collections. Given a document image, models must extract text and generate schema-compliant JSON, enabling automatic validation and downstream use. We evaluate models under a constraint-aware protocol across zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning settings, measuring extraction fidelity and structured-output quality using Character Error Rate (CER), Approximate Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS*), and mean Average Precision F1 (mAP-F1). Against a fine-tuning baseline, we further test the independent impact of (i) hyperparameter optimization, (ii) classical image preprocessing (illumination flattening, denoising, and CLAHE), and (iii) multi-stage training. Finally, we analyze the trade-off between dataset-specific fine-tuning and a single multi-dataset checkpoint, where joint training enables one model to operate across collections but can shift performance between datasets. Overall, we show that carefully adapted VLMs with up to 7B parameters can provide a sustainable, private, high-performing alternative to manual transcription or commercial black-box systems, and we offer actionable guidance for heritage institutions seeking institution-controlled OCR-to-JSON extraction.

AI.tldr: 本文对8个开源轻量级VLM（≤7B参数）在三所大学文化遗产馆藏上开展OCR到结构化JSON提取的对比研究，在约束感知协议下评估零样本、少样本与微调，并检验超参优化、图像预处理与多阶段训练的独立影响，最终证明经适配的小模型可作为私有、可持续的替代方案。
AI.motivation: 大规模闭源VLM虽在文档理解上表现优异，但其依赖商业API，带来数据自主性、持续成本与超大规模计算环境足迹等问题，在文化遗产数字化场景中尤为突出——这类文档含历史手写体、领域术语（珠宝、史前史、建筑）与非标准版式，需要高维结构化抽取。因此机构亟需可控的本地化方案。
AI.method: 选取8个开源轻量级VLM（≤7B参数），任务为给定文档图像输出文本并生成符合schema的JSON，以支持自动校验与下游使用。在三所大学文化遗产馆藏上采用约束感知评估协议，覆盖零样本、少样本与微调三种设定；以微调为基线，分别独立测试（i）超参数优化、（ii）经典图像预处理（光照平坦化、去噪、CLAHE）、（iii）多阶段训练的作用；并比较数据集专属微调与单一多数据集联合检查点之间的权衡。
AI.result: 采用CER、ANLS*与mAP-F1三项指标衡量抽取保真度与结构化输出质量。结果显示，经精心适配的≤7B VLM能够提供可持续、私有且高性能的方案；多数据集联合训练可使单一模型跨馆藏运行，但会在数据集之间造成性能迁移（此消彼长）。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级开源VLM可作为人工转录或商业黑箱系统的替代，为寻求机构自主可控OCR-to-JSON抽取的文化遗产机构提供可操作的实施指南。

title: From Suppression to Repair: Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via Localized Distribution Alignment
summary: Object hallucination remains a major obstacle for large vision-language models (LVLMs) to generate reliable content. An intuitive mitigation strategy is to suppress hallucination-related components in hidden representations. However, these components may also contain useful information, and suppressing them can weaken the model's multimodal capabilities. In this paper, we propose ResOT, a training-free method that repairs representations at inference time through localized distribution alignment. Specifically, ResOT projects dominant hallucinated directions away from the faithful subspace, forming a low-dimensional residual subspace for intervention. Within this subspace, ResOT uses Gaussian optimal transport (OT) to align the hallucinated distribution with the faithful one. The resulting map defines repair targets with minimal changes to the original representations. At inference, ResOT adaptively controls how far each token state moves toward its OT target. Experiments on three representative LVLMs show that ResOT substantially reduces object hallucination while improving image caption quality and multimodal performance across multiple benchmarks. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ResOT，一种免训练方法，通过局部分布对齐在推理时修复表征，缓解大型视觉语言模型的对象幻觉。
AI.motivation: 对象幻觉严重影响大型视觉语言模型生成内容的可靠性。直觉上的缓解策略是抑制隐藏表征中的幻觉相关成分，但这些成分同时也包含有用信息，直接抑制会削弱模型的多模态能力。
AI.method: ResOT在推理时通过局部分布对齐修复表征。它将主导幻觉方向从忠实子空间中投影出去，构造一个低维残差子空间进行干预；在该子空间内，使用高斯最优传输（OT）将幻觉分布与忠实分布对齐，所得映射以对原始表征的最小改动定义修复目标；推理时自适应控制每个token状态向OT目标移动的距离。
AI.result: 在三个代表性LVLM上的实验表明，ResOT在多个基准上大幅减少对象幻觉，同时提升图像描述质量和多模态性能。
AI.conclusion: ResOT是一种无需训练的推理时表征修复方法，通过局部分布对齐在抑制幻觉的同时保留多模态能力，代码将开源。

title: Detecting Spin in Clinical Trials with Large Language Models
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at the 29th International Multiconference Information Society (IS 2026), AI in Healthcare track, Ljubljana, Slovenia. Code: https://github.com/ta5946/Spin
summary: Spin in clinical trials includes reporting practices that distort the presentation of results. This is particularly critical in medicine, where spin is present in more than 50% of randomized controlled trials that fail to reach statistical significance. The comparison of primary and reported outcomes is crucial for detecting several types of spin, including outcome switching. We used 300 pairs of outcomes labeled with semantic similarity to develop a system for automatic detection of outcome switching. We evaluated baseline text similarity models and open-source LLMs using generated similarity scores and the Youden index to determine the classification threshold. The proposed approach involves prompt engineering, classification based on token probabilities, and majority voting for the final decision. The results on the test set of 2,496 examples with an F1 score of 0.78 and an accuracy of 0.90 outperform baseline text similarity models but trail behind fine-tuned versions of BERT. We used LLMs to generate natural language explanations for the classified instances and manually assessed their quality.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一套基于开源LLM的结局切换自动检测系统，利用提示工程、token概率分类与多数投票决策，在2,496个测试样本上取得F1=0.78、准确率=0.90，优于基线文本相似度模型但逊于微调BERT。
AI.motivation: 临床试验中的"spin"（结果粉饰）会扭曲结果呈现，在未达到统计显著性的随机对照试验中超过50%存在此现象。比较主要结局与报告结局是检测spin（含结局切换）的关键，但人工核查成本高，需要自动化手段。
AI.method: 使用300对带语义相似度标注的结局数据构建检测系统。评估基线文本相似度模型与开源LLM（基于生成的相似度分数及Youden指数确定分类阈值）。所提方法包括提示工程、基于token概率的分类以及多数投票的最终决策。
AI.result: 在2,496个测试样本上，F1为0.78、准确率为0.90，优于基线文本相似度模型，但落后于微调版BERT。此外，利用LLM为分类实例生成自然语言解释，并人工评估其质量。
AI.conclusion: 基于开源LLM与提示工程的方案可有效自动检测结局切换，性能优于基线相似度模型；虽不及微调BERT，但具备生成可解释性说明的能力，为spin检测提供了可行的可解释路径。

title: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization via Complex-Valued Fusion
comment: Accepted to British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
summary: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization (OV-AVEL) labels each video segment with an event class, including classes that were never seen during training. The dominant pipeline uses a frozen multimodal foundation model (e.g. ImageBind) to embed the visual frame, the audio mel-spectrogram, and each candidate class name into a shared space, then computes two cosine similarities for each segment against each class: visual-text and audio-text. Existing methods then collapse this pair into a single scalar score with a fixed rule (geometric mean, weighted average) before taking the argmax. Instead, we compute complex-valued similarities and learn their fusion using a complex-valued neural network (CVNN). Each modality's standard representation becomes the real part of our pipeline, and a paired companion stream supplies the imaginary part. We use imaginary part of iHSV for visual modality and CycleGAN-translated phase spectrogram for audio modality as these companion streams. This results in two complex similarities, which are then fused. While the vision and audio encoders remain frozen, only the temporal-attention blocks and the fusion CVNN are trained. The four-stream complex architecture sets a new state of the art on both OV-AVEL benchmarks. On the open (unseen-class) split of OV-AVEBench we reach 66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1 (+1.6/+4.1/+6.6 over the previously reported fine-tuned baseline), with consistent gains for seen classes as well. We also modify AVE dataset for this task and observe that our architecture reaches 60.7/51.9/50.4% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1, achieving state-of-the-art OV-AVEL results on it as well. We also propose a two-stream alternative, which also sees great improvements over the baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用复值神经网络学习视听事件定位中视觉-文本与音频-文本相似度的融合，替代固定融合规则，在OV-AVEL两个基准上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇视听事件定位（OV-AVEL）需对包括训练未见类的事件进行分类。现有主流方法基于冻结的多模态基础模型（如ImageBind），计算视觉-文本和音频-文本两个余弦相似度后，用几何平均或加权平均等固定规则合并为单一标量再取argmax，融合方式僵化，未能充分利用两种模态相似度的互补结构。
AI.method: 将每个模态的标准表示作为实部，并引入成对的伴随流提供虚部：视觉模态使用iHSV的虚部，音频模态使用CycleGAN转换的相位谱图，从而构造复值相似度；再用复值神经网络（CVNN）学习两个复值相似度的融合。视觉与音频编码器保持冻结，仅训练时间注意力模块与融合CVNN。此外提出两流替代方案。
AI.result: 四流复值架构在两个OV-AVEL基准上均达到新SOTA。在OV-AVEBench开放（未见类）划分上达到66.5/59.1/54.1%的Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1，较此前报道的微调基线提升+1.6/+4.1/+6.6，已见类也有一致提升。在修改后的AVE数据集上达到60.7/51.9/50.4% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1，同样取得SOTA。两流替代方案也较基线有显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 用复值表示与可学习的复值融合替代固定标量融合规则，能有效提升开放词汇视听事件定位性能，且方法在不同基准与更轻量的两流设置下均具鲁棒性。

title: VEDJE: Video-Efficient Discriminative Joint Encoder for Scalable Video-Text Retrieval
summary: Finding the right video often requires distinguishing similar scenes in which different events occur. Joint matching improves retrieval, but processing rich video representations for each query is costly. VEDJE compresses features within sampled frames while keeping their representations separate in a reusable cache. Feature-change prediction supplies an auxiliary training signal that improves retrieval from the compressed cache without adding work at query time. On MSR-VTT, MSVD, DiDeMo, and ActivityNet, VEDJE improves R@1 over matched first-stage retrievers in both retrieval directions. On MSR-VTT, it reaches 59.8 text-to-video R@1 with a fine-tuned VideoCLIP-XL first stage. In the VideoPrism configuration, shrinking the per-video cache fourfold to 12 KiB preserves text-to-video recall within 0.2 points. These results show that accurate video search can operate on compact evidence, encoded once and reused as new queries arrive.

AI.tldr: VEDJE 通过帧内特征压缩与可复用缓存实现高效联合视频检索，并以特征变化预测作为辅助训练信号，在不增加查询时开销的前提下提升检索性能。
AI.motivation: 视频检索需区分包含不同事件的相似场景，联合匹配可提升检索效果，但对每个查询处理丰富视频表示代价高昂，因此需要一种高效、可复用的方案。
AI.method: 在采样帧内部压缩特征，同时在可复用缓存中保持各表示相互独立；引入特征变化预测作为辅助训练信号，提升基于压缩缓存的检索，且不增加查询时计算。
AI.result: 在 MSR-VTT、MSVD、DiDeMo 和 ActivityNet 上，两个检索方向上的 R@1 均优于匹配的第一阶段检索器；在 MSR-VTT 上配合微调 VideoCLIP-XL 第一阶段达到 59.8 的文本到视频 R@1；在 VideoPrism 配置下，将单视频缓存缩小至 12 KiB（压缩四倍），文本到视频召回率损失在 0.2 个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 精确视频搜索可基于紧凑证据运行，特征编码一次即可在新查询到来时复用。

title: GRPODropout: Less is More for Online Reinforcement Learning Rollouts
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) methods such as GRPO substantially improve large language model reasoning but often suffer from policy entropy collapse: the loss of sampling diversity weakens exploration and limits further improvement. Existing methods address this issue either through algorithm-level interventions, such as reward modification and entropy/KL regularization, or through token-level reweighting. We investigate a complementary perspective: entropy collapse can also be mitigated by changing which generated rollouts contribute to policy updates. Under the same sampling budget, not all rollouts contribute positively to an update, and selectively excluding some can improve learning. To address this, we propose GRPODropout: before the standard update, we use a simple strategy that selectively removes a small number of high-probability positive-advantage rollouts and recenters the retained advantages. To motivate this design, we develop a rollout-level theoretical analysis that guides method design and threshold selection. The method changes only rollout usage, and adds negligible computational overhead. Experiments show higher accuracy than original GRPO and higher actor entropy while using fewer rollout samples for updates, illustrating "less is more." This work provides insight into RL rollout usage: removing some rollouts can improve performance. Code is available at https://github.com/hexuandeng/GRPODropout/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GRPODropout：在GRPO更新前选择性剔除少量高概率、正优势的rollout并重新中心化保留的优势，从而缓解策略熵崩塌，以更少rollout样本取得更高准确率与更高actor熵。
AI.motivation: GRPO等强化学习方法虽能显著提升大语言模型推理能力，但常出现策略熵崩塌——采样多样性丧失削弱探索、限制进一步改进。现有方法多从算法层面（奖励修改、熵/KL正则）或token级重加权入手。本文关注一个互补视角：熵崩塌也可通过改变"哪些生成的rollout参与策略更新"来缓解。相同采样预算下并非所有rollout都对更新有正贡献，选择性剔除部分rollout可改善学习。
AI.method: 提出GRPODropout：在标准更新前，采用简单策略选择性地移除少量高概率、正优势的rollout，并对保留下来的优势进行重新中心化（recenter）。为支撑该设计，作者建立了rollout级的理论分析，用于指导方法设计与阈值选择。该方法仅改变rollout的使用方式，额外计算开销可忽略。
AI.result: 实验表明，相较原始GRPO，GRPODropout取得更高准确率，同时保持更高的actor熵，且用于更新的rollout样本更少，体现了"less is more"。
