AI.conclusion: 该工作为强化学习中的rollout使用提供了新洞见：剔除部分rollout反而能提升性能。代码已开源。

title: Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Inpainting via Learnable Mask Attention and Support Token Refinement
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Project page: https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/
summary: 3D scene inpainting aims to recover missing or occluded regions in edited 3D scenes, while ensuring geometric and textural consistency. Existing approaches, however, typically require accurately calibrated camera poses, which restricts their applicability in casual, in-the-wild scenarios and introduces additional preprocessing overhead. To overcome this limitation, we present FreeInpaint, a novel feed-forward framework that generates complete and 3D-consistent scenes directly from unposed multi-view images with masked regions. At its core, FreeInpaint extends a 3D foundation model to propagate masked regions from a reference view to other unposed views, bridging 3D reconstruction and scene inpainting while preserving the model's native ability to recover camera poses and scene geometry. Our method addresses two key challenges in adapting feed-forward 3D foundation models to masked inputs. First, masked regions can corrupt cross-view correspondence reasoning, degrading pose estimation and geometry recovery. To address this, we introduce a Learnable Mask Attention mechanism that preserves the spatial anchoring of reliable observations while allowing masked regions to progressively absorb useful context in deeper layers. Second, under severe occlusions, a single forward pass often lacks sufficient appearance evidence for high-fidelity completion. Therefore, we propose a Support Token Refinement strategy, which injects diffusion-generated support evidence as confidence-weighted auxiliary tokens to refine under-observed regions while preserving the original spatial anchor. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that FreeInpaint achieves superior inpainting quality, eliminating the reliance on pre-computed camera poses while keeping a fast inference speed. The project page is https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/.

AI.tldr: 提出FreeInpaint，一个无需相机位姿的前馈3D场景修复框架，基于3D基础模型实现从无位姿多视图图像生成完整且3D一致的场景。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景修复方法通常依赖精确标定的相机位姿，限制了其在随意拍摄的野外场景中的适用性，并带来额外的预处理开销。
AI.method: FreeInpaint扩展3D基础模型，将参考视图的掩码区域传播到其他无位姿视图，桥接3D重建与场景修复，同时保留模型原生的位姿与几何恢复能力。针对两个挑战：引入Learnable Mask Attention机制，在保持可靠观测空间锚定的同时让掩码区域在深层逐步吸收上下文，缓解掩码对跨视图对应关系推理的干扰；提出Support Token Refinement策略，以置信度加权的辅助token注入扩散生成的支撑证据，精化欠观测区域并保持原有空间锚定。
AI.result: 在多样数据集上，FreeInpaint实现更优的修复质量，消除了对预计算相机位姿的依赖，同时保持快速推理速度。
AI.conclusion: FreeInpaint为无位姿3D场景修复提供了有效的前馈方案，兼顾修复质量、几何一致性与推理效率。

title: Relative Patch Response Learning for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Generative models can now synthesize highly realistic images, simultaneously increasing the risks of misinformation and visual forgery. Therefore, detecting AI-generated images becomes more essential, and a reliable detector must generalize to unseen generators and stay robust to unseen perturbations in the wild. Existing detectors are typically trained on either independently collected real and generated images or aligned real-generated pairs designed to mitigate content bias. Building on aligned pairs, recent methods form a mixed view by replacing some patches of the real image with their generated counterparts. However, we find that self-attention lets real and generated patches interact, so the feature of each patch no longer reflects its own source alone. This contextual shift makes a per-patch source label an imprecise target. To this end, we propose Relative Patch Response Learning (PRL). Instead of labeling each patch, PRL compares the same patch across two mixed views of an aligned pair and learns from its patch response, the change of its score between the views. (i) To give precise supervision under the contextual shift, a relative response objective measures the responses of source-changed patches against those of source-unchanged patches, which respond to the shift alone. (ii) To provide a reliable reference for the shift, a reference coherence objective keeps each group of source-unchanged patches moving as a whole. (iii) Since the two views contain different amounts of generated content, an area ranking objective asks the view with the larger generated area to have a higher mean patch score. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of PRL, which surpasses the best prior methods by 4.3% and 5.9% in average balanced accuracy across eight standard and three in-the-wild benchmarks, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出相对块响应学习（PRL）方法，用于检测AI生成图像。通过对比同一对齐图像对的两个混合视图下同一图像块的响应变化进行学习，避免了对每个块单独标注源标签的不精确性，在8个标准基准和3个真实场景基准上分别比最优方法平均提升4.3%和5.9%。
AI.motivation: 生成模型可合成高度逼真的图像，增加了虚假信息与视觉伪造的风险，因此AI生成图像检测变得更为重要。可靠的检测器需泛化到未见的生成器，并对真实场景中的未知扰动保持鲁棒。现有检测器通常基于独立采集的真假图像或对齐的真假配对训练，近期方法在对齐配对基础上构造混合视图（用生成块替换真实图像的若干块）。但作者发现自注意力机制会让真实块与生成块交互，使得每个块的特征不再仅反映其自身来源，这种上下文偏移导致按块赋源标签成为不精确的目标。
AI.method: 提出相对块响应学习（PRL）。不再对每个块单独标注，而是比较同一块在对齐配对的两个混合视图中的表现，学习其"块响应"——即该块得分在两个视图之间的变化。包含三个目标：(i) 相对响应目标：在上下文偏移下提供精确监督，衡量源发生变化的块相对于源未变化的块（后者仅反映偏移本身）的响应；(ii) 参考一致性目标：为偏移提供可靠参照，使每组源未变化的块作为一个整体一致移动；(iii) 区域排序目标：由于两个视图包含不同数量的生成内容，要求生成区域更大的视图具有更高的平均块得分。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PRL性能优越，在八个标准基准上平均平衡准确率超过此前最优方法4.3%，在三个真实场景（in-the-wild）基准上超过5.9%。
AI.conclusion: PRL通过相对块响应学习，绕开了上下文偏移下按块标注不精确的问题，显著提升了对未见生成器和未知扰动的泛化与鲁棒性，在标准与真实场景基准上均取得领先的检测性能。

title: SenseWeather: Multimodal Sensing for Robust Robotic Perception under Extreme Conditions
summary: Robotic perception must remain reliable when extreme environmental conditions severely degrade the primary RGB observation. Although robotic platforms commonly carry complementary sensors such as depth and infrared, much of the modern perception stack remains RGB-centric, creating a mismatch between multimodal onboard sensing and pretrained downstream models. We study whether complementary sensing can be used upstream to recover a task-compatible RGB observation that preserves existing perception capabilities without modifying or retraining the downstream stack. To this end, we introduce SenseWeather, a controlled multimodal benchmark for robotic perception under severe rain, snow, dust, fog, and darkness, with registered RGB, depth, and infrared observations, clean references, and grounded high-level perception tasks. We further develop Fusion-to-RGB, with two parameter-efficient sensor-fusion realizations based on token-space fusion for a diffusion transformer and residual latent conditioning for an inpainting UNet. Across frozen open-vocabulary grounding and vision-language models, RGB+D+IR fusion improves all paired downstream comparisons over the corresponding RGB-only restorers, including AP50 gains across all ten detector comparisons. Importantly, these perception gains do not consistently follow conventional image-fidelity metrics, and increasing weather severity does not induce monotonic downstream degradation. These results show that complementary sensing can preserve reusable robotic perception under extreme conditions, while highlighting task-level perception robustness as an objective distinct from visual restoration quality.

AI.tldr: 提出SenseWeather多模态基准与Fusion-to-RGB方法，在上游用RGB+D+IR融合恢复任务可用的RGB观测，从而在不改动下游感知模型的情况下提升极端天气下的机器人感知鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 极端环境（暴雨、雪、沙尘、雾、黑暗）会严重退化机器人主用的RGB观测。虽然机器人平台通常搭载深度、红外等互补传感器，但现代感知栈仍以RGB为中心，导致多模态机载传感与预训练下游模型之间存在不匹配。作者想验证：能否仅在上游利用互补传感恢复"任务兼容"的RGB观测，从而保留既有感知能力而无需修改或重训下游模型。
AI.method: 1) 构建SenseWeather——一个受控多模态基准，涵盖暴雨、雪、沙尘、雾和黑暗五种恶劣条件，提供配准的RGB、深度、红外观测、干净参考以及有标注的高层感知任务。2) 提出Fusion-to-RGB框架，包含两种参数高效的传感器融合实现：面向Diffusion Transformer的token空间融合，以及面向Inpainting UNet的残差潜空间条件化。
AI.result: 在冻结的开词汇grounding模型与视觉语言模型上，RGB+D+IR融合在所有成对下游对比中均优于对应的RGB-only恢复方法，且在全部十项检测器对比中取得AP50提升。感知增益与常规图像保真度指标（如PSNR/SSIM）并不一致地对应，且天气严重程度增加并未导致下游性能单调下降。
AI.conclusion: 互补传感可在极端条件下保留可复用的机器人感知能力；同时表明"任务级感知鲁棒性"应作为独立于视觉恢复质量（图像保真度）的目标来评估和优化。

title: Forms of LLM-Integrated Applications from LLM-Chats to Autonomous AI Agent System
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded as components in software systems, marketed under labels such as chatbot, copilot, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow, coding agent and AI agent. Whether these labels denote genuine architectural forms or serve as branding has not been assessed systematically. In the sources surveyed, labels do carry architectural content, most clearly in vendor usage: copilot denotes a router-worker architecture operating a host application under step-by-step user confirmation, while the more recent shift to the label agent coincides with AI-planned multi-step execution of which the user sees only the outcome. The coding agents of four major providers share one architecture, a reason-and-act loop delegating to subagents. This survey describes seven recurring forms---LLM chats, custom agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI-enhanced workflows, copilots, coding agents, and, in part, agentic RAG---in a common vocabulary of agents and tools. Each is characterized along four structural dimensions (agentic RAG only partially): the architectural pattern, the control of execution and the point of user intervention, the number of agent calls per task, and tool use. An illustrative corpus of 22 systems from research publications and vendor documentation grounds the descriptions and shows where they reach their limit.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统检验了 LLM 系统中"chatbot、copilot、RAG、workflow、coding agent、AI agent"等标签是否对应真实架构形态，提出用统一的 agent-tool 词汇描述七种反复出现的架构形式，并以四个结构维度刻画它们。
AI.motivation: LLM 越来越多地作为组件嵌入软件系统，并被冠以 chatbot、copilot、RAG、workflow、coding agent、AI agent 等标签。这些标签究竟代表真实的架构形式，还是仅作为营销品牌，此前缺乏系统性评估。
AI.method: 对研究文献与厂商文档进行综述，并以 22 个系统的示例语料作为支撑；采用统一的 agent 与 tool 词汇，从四个结构维度刻画七种架构形式：(1) 架构模式；(2) 执行控制权与用户介入点；(3) 每任务 agent 调用次数；(4) 工具使用。agentic RAG 仅部分适用。
AI.result: 在所调查的资料来源中，标签确实承载架构含义，厂商用法尤为明显：copilot 表示 router-worker 架构，在宿主应用中运行并需用户逐步确认；近期转向 agent 标签则与 AI 规划的多步执行相关，用户仅见最终结果。四家主要厂商的 coding agent 共享同一架构——reason-and-act 循环并委派给 subagents。共归纳出七种反复出现的架构形式：LLM chats、custom agents、RAG、AI-enhanced workflows、copilots、coding agents，以及部分意义上的 agentic RAG。
AI.conclusion: 标签并非纯营销，而是具有可辨识的架构内容；统一的 agent-tool 词汇与四维结构框架可用于区分和比较这些形式，同时示例语料也揭示了各描述框架的适用边界与局限。

title: Can Decision Models Understand Stance? Evaluating Jev Against General-Purpose LLMs
summary: Stance detection requires identifying an author's attitude toward a given target, sometimes based on conversational context. Jev, a specialized decision model designed for structured decision-making, offers an alternative to general-purpose large language models (LLMs). In this work, we evaluate Jev on two stance detection datasets, VAST (English texts) and ZS-CSD (Chinese conversations), comparing it with four general-purpose LLMs and two fine-tuned models. Results show that Jev achieves competitive performance on VAST, matching GPT-5.6 and outperforming the other general-purpose LLMs. However, it falls behind stronger LLMs on ZS-CSD, particularly in distinguishing favor from against. Further analysis suggests that this limitation may be related to understanding reply relationships and stance direction rather than conversation length alone. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of Jev for stance detection.

AI.tldr: 该文评估专用决策模型Jev在立场检测任务上的表现：在英文VAST上与GPT-5.6相当，但在中文对话ZS-CSD上落后于更强LLM，尤其在区分"支持/反对"上存在困难，其局限可能与回复关系及立场方向理解有关。
AI.motivation: 立场检测需识别作者对特定目标的态度，有时依赖对话上下文。通用大语言模型之外的专用决策模型（如Jev）是否适用于该任务尚不清楚，因此需要系统性评估其潜力与边界。
AI.method: 在两个立场检测数据集上评估Jev：英文文本数据集VAST与中文对话数据集ZS-CSD；对比对象包括四个通用LLM和两个微调模型，并开展进一步分析以探究性能差异来源。
AI.result: Jev在VAST上表现具有竞争力，与GPT-5.6相当并优于其他通用LLM；但在ZS-CSD上落后于更强的LLM，尤其在区分"支持"与"反对"方面表现较弱。分析表明该局限可能与回复关系和立场方向的理解有关，而非仅由对话长度导致。
AI.conclusion: Jev在结构化立场检测中展现出一定潜力，但在依赖对话上下文的场景（如中文对话）存在明显局限，未来需加强回复关系与立场方向建模。

title: Beyond Visual Enhancement: Adaptive Multi-Context Steering to Mitigate LVLM Hallucinations
summary: Hallucination remains a significant challenge in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Existing training-free methods generally mitigate hallucinations through contrastive decoding or visual enhancement, often increasing the relative influence of visual evidence during generation. This raises a fundamental question: Can LVLMs dynamically regulate the contributions of different context sources to suppress hallucinations? In this work, we investigate and quantify how LVLMs coordinate multiple context sources during decoding and examine how this intrinsic behavior can guide hallucination mitigation. We find that LVLMs exhibit an intrinsic vision-attending tendency that can guide adaptive visual steering, while textual contexts can also contribute to hallucination mitigation. Motivated by these findings, we propose AIMS (Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering), a lightweight training-free framework that adaptively coordinates visual, prefilled textual, and generated contexts during decoding. Specifically, AIMS constructs compact prototypes for the three context domains and estimates their affinities with the current query to determine head-wise steering weights. The resulting multi-source steering direction is applied to the query representation, enabling adaptive context integration without additional model training or auxiliary forward passes. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs and decoding strategies demonstrate that AIMS effectively mitigates object hallucination while maintaining competitive general-purpose multimodal capabilities.

AI.tldr: AIMS：一种免训练的多源自适应引导框架，通过量化LVLM解码时对视觉、预填充文本和生成文本三类上下文的协调行为，以head-wise权重自适应整合多源信息，抑制对象幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的幻觉问题突出。现有免训练方法多通过对比解码或视觉增强来提升视觉证据的相对影响，但存在一个根本性问题：LVLM能否动态调节不同上下文来源的贡献以抑制幻觉？本文旨在探究并量化LVLM在解码时如何协调多源上下文，并利用该内在行为指导幻觉缓解。
AI.method: 提出AIMS（Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering），一个轻量级免训练框架。为视觉、预填充文本、生成文本三个上下文域构建紧凑原型，估计各原型与当前查询的亲和度以确定head-wise引导权重；将得到的多源引导方向施加于查询表示，实现自适应上下文整合，且无需额外训练或辅助前向传播。
AI.result: 在多种LVLM和多种解码策略上的大量实验表明，AIMS能有效缓解对象幻觉，同时保持有竞争力的通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: LVLM具有内在的视觉关注倾向，可用于自适应视觉引导，且文本上下文亦有助于幻觉缓解；据此设计的AIMS通过head-wise多源引导有效抑制幻觉，验证了动态调节多源上下文贡献的可行性与有效性。

title: Not Every Change Is Necessary: Recoverable Drift in Large Language Model Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning in large language models aims to remove unwanted knowledge while preserving the model's remaining capabilities. Although existing methods use retention objectives or restrict where edits occur, achieving the desired forgetting level can still leave collateral changes that impair non-target behavior. Our recovery comparisons suggest that some of these changes can be reversed while preserving observed forgetting performance. In this work, we present Propose-Then-Project Unlearning (PTP-U), a framework that combines targeted forgetting with the recovery of non-target capabilities. PTP-U first applies local analytic edits to weaken target knowledge associations, then aligns non-target output distributions with those of the original model to recover capabilities while maintaining fixed forgetting constraints. Both stages serve a common goal: satisfying the forgetting requirements while preserving fluent generation and performance on non-target tasks. Across three benchmarks, PTP-U achieves the strongest forgetting-retention trade-off among evaluated methods, reaching 81.22%-91.03% forgetting while preserving 94.20% non-target utility on average. At matched forgetting, PTP-U consistently retains higher non-target utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Propose-Then-Project Unlearning (PTP-U) 框架，将定向遗忘与非目标能力恢复相结合，在满足遗忘约束的同时保持模型流畅生成和非目标任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型遗忘方法（unlearning）虽采用保留目标（retention objectives）或限制编辑位置，但在达到目标遗忘水平时仍会产生附带改变，损害非目标行为。作者通过恢复性对比（recovery comparisons）发现，这些附带改变中部分可在保持遗忘效果的前提下被逆转。
AI.method: PTP-U 分两阶段：1）Propose 阶段，对模型进行局部解析编辑（local analytic edits），削弱目标知识关联；2）Project 阶段，将非目标输出分布与原始模型对齐，在固定遗忘约束下恢复非目标能力。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，PTP-U 在评估方法中取得最优的遗忘-保留权衡，遗忘率达 81.22%–91.03%，平均保持 94.20% 的非目标效用；在同等遗忘水平下，其非目标效用持续更高。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段共同服务于同一目标——在满足遗忘要求的同时保持流畅生成和非目标任务性能。结果表明，将定向遗忘与非目标能力恢复结合，可有效缓解现有方法的附带损伤，实现更优的遗忘-保留权衡。

title: Event-Centric Memory with Query-Aware Graph Augmentation for Long-Term Conversational Agents
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
summary: For persistent and personalized conversational agents, memory systems can enable them to remember, update, and reason over long histories by storing past interactions and retrieving relevant information. Existing memory systems typically follow two paradigms: flat-structured memory and graph-based memory. The former is lightweight but leaves event relations and state updates implicit, while the latter explicitly models memory structure but incurs additional construction cost and introduces irrelevant relations over long histories. To address these limitations, we propose QGMem, a novel memory construction and activation framework motivated by human memory, in which experience is organized into events and query-relevant events are modeled by graph as working memory. QGMem converts long dialogue histories into event-indexed atomic memory units that preserve individual experiences and consolidates related units into dynamic memory traces that retain state trajectories and current states. When a query arrives, hybrid memory retrieval gathers complementary candidate memories, and query-aware reranking activates the most relevant units as a compact working memory. To expose relational dependencies in the working memory and support conflict-aware reasoning, QGMem organizes the working memory as a local graph, which is then encoded as a graph token and provided to the LLM together with the textual working memory to improve evidence utilization during answer generation. Experiments across six benchmarks validate the framework and show consistent gains in retrieval, multi-hop evidence composition, conflict resolution, and ultra-long dialogue reasoning with compact contexts and moderate inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QGMem——一种受人类记忆启发的对话记忆构建与激活框架，将长对话历史拆分为事件索引的原子记忆单元，并将与查询相关的事件组织为图结构的工作记忆，以提升检索、多跳推理与冲突感知能力。
AI.motivation: 面向持久化、个性化对话智能体，记忆系统需支持长历史的记忆、更新与推理。现有范式存在两难：扁平结构记忆轻量但事件关系与状态更新隐式；图结构记忆显式建模结构但构建开销大，且在长历史中引入无关关系。
AI.method: 提出QGMem框架。1）记忆构建：将长对话历史转换为事件索引的原子记忆单元，保留个体经验，并将相关单元整合为动态记忆轨迹，保留状态演化轨迹与当前状态。2）记忆激活：查询到来时先进行混合检索获得互补候选记忆，再通过查询感知重排序激活最相关单元，形成紧凑工作记忆。3）将工作记忆组织为局部图以显式表达关系依赖，支持冲突感知推理；该图被编码为图token，与文本工作记忆一同输入LLM，提升答案生成时的证据利用。
AI.result: 在六个基准上验证框架有效性，在检索、多跳证据组合、冲突消解以及超长对话推理方面均取得一致提升，同时保持紧凑上下文与适中推理成本。
AI.conclusion: QGMem通过事件索引原子记忆、动态记忆轨迹与查询相关的工作记忆图，兼顾了扁平记忆的轻量与图记忆的结构显式性，在长对话场景下以较低开销实现更强的检索与推理能力。

title: Project Greenhouse: Progress Toward Fully Open and Sovereign Agentic Search
summary: Project Greenhouse represents our exploration of a simple thesis: We believe that it is possible to build fully open and sovereign models for agentic search with only modest computational resources. As a first milestone, we describe how to build a competitive pointwise decoder-only reranker using a simple two-step recipe comprising pre-training from scratch followed by supervised fine-tuning, starting only from commonly available datasets. Contrary to the dominant approach in the literature, we do not rely on existing open-weight backbones from third parties, and thus we are fully in control of model training, from end to end. We were able to accomplish the bulk of our experiments using no more than a handful of GPUs. This report articulates the importance and benefits of our approach, and we share artifacts that enable transparent, independent reproduction of all aspects of model training. Beyond data, code, and configurations that capture our efforts, we also release checkpoints for our family of Gaggle models, demonstrating the feasibility of our approach and providing a first step toward validating our broader thesis.

AI.tldr: 介绍"Project Greenhouse"：证明仅用少量GPU即可从零构建完全开放、主权可控的智能体搜索模型，首个里程碑是用两步流程（从头预训练+有监督微调）构建了有竞争力的pointwise decoder-only重排序器。
AI.motivation: 主流方法依赖第三方开放权重骨干模型，无法端到端掌控训练过程。作者希望验证：仅凭常用公开数据集和有限算力，也能构建完全开放且自主可控的智能体搜索模型。
AI.method: 采用简单的两步配方：先从头预训练（不依赖任何第三方预训练骨干），再进行有监督微调，训练数据仅来自常见公开数据集；大部分实验只用少量GPU完成。
AI.result: 成功构建了具有竞争力的pointwise decoder-only重排序器，并发布Gaggle模型系列的检查点，以及数据、代码和配置，支持训练全流程的透明、独立复现。
AI.conclusion: 验证了在有限算力下从零训练开放主权模型方案的可行性，是推进其更广泛论题的第一步。

title: Revisiting Identity and Spectra Dispersion in Media-Bridged Time Series Forecasting: Linking Multivariate Signals and Narrative Flows
summary: Media-bridged time series forecasting is expanding to encompass traditional "multivariate" and emerging "multimodal" (e.g., through textual assistance). Existing Time Series Forecasting (TSF) models still rely on paradigm-specific relation, fusion, and temporal modules, hindering a common forecasting backbone across numerical and pre-aligned narrative-flow settings. To explore this, we propose the Multimedia Identity-Aware Prism Network (MIDAPN), a unified spatiotemporal forecasting backbone based on media-general graph adaptation and automatic temporal learning: (1) Following media pre-alignment, our Multimedia Identity-Aware Graph (MIDAG) revisits identity through static essence, dynamic behavior, and latent commonality, inducing affinities that extend variable-specific dependencies across media. Contextual Identity Modulation (CIM) further refines discriminative aggregation. (2) We develop Spectral Prism Convolution (SPConv) to automatically perform hierarchical temporal analysis, balancing coarse trends and fine-grained details. Meanwhile, its Adaptive Search Guidance configures a scale-efficient architecture for temporal-dimension reconstruction. These decoupled yet synergistic components jointly address media identity disentanglement and temporal-scale mismatch. Comprehensive evaluations involving 16 SOTA TSF models across 13 "multivariate" and 12 "multimodal" datasets, alongside targeted long-context comparisons against 14 time series foundation models and fused pretrained language models, demonstrate MIDAPN's consistent superiority and broad shared backbone compatibility. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/leijieruilq/MIDAPN/tree/main}{https://github.com/MIDAPN}.

AI.tldr: 提出统一时空预测骨干 MIDAPN，通过多媒体身份感知图与谱棱镜卷积，同时兼容传统多变量与新兴多模态时间序列预测任务。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测模型依赖任务特定的关系、融合、时序模块，无法在数值型与叙事流（多模态）设置间共享统一骨干，缺乏跨媒体的通用预测架构。
AI.method: 1) 多媒体身份感知图（MIDAG）：在媒体预对齐后，从静态本质、动态行为、潜在共性三方面重访身份，诱导跨媒体的变量依赖关系，并结合上下文身份调制（CIM）优化判别性聚合；2) 谱棱镜卷积（SPConv）：自动进行层级时序分析，平衡粗粒度趋势与细粒度细节，配合自适应搜索引导配置高效规模架构以重建时间维度。
AI.result: 在13个多变量与12个多模态数据集上与16个SOTA TSF模型对比，并针对14个时间序列基础模型及融合预训练语言模型进行长上下文对比，MIDAPN均表现出一致优越性及广泛的共享骨干兼容性。
AI.conclusion: 解耦但协同的组件联合解决媒体身份解缠与时间尺度失配问题，验证了统一骨干在多变量与多模态预测中的有效性与通用性。

title: Does Target Alignment Mean Target Recovery? An Evidence-Ladder Study of Adversarial Claims on Contrastive Encoders
summary: Adversarial attacks on vision-language models optimize an image toward a text target, then cite the attacked model's similarity score as evidence of success. We ask whether that score - victim-space target alignment (VTS) - predicts recovery of the target by an independent model. We first build a measurement instrument: supervised judges outside the attacked geometry, real-target blend controls, shuffled-target negatives, and a reference level derived from a 50% target-image blend. Two preregistered studies then compare six contrastive encoders under a matched attack at three perturbation budgets. Robustly trained encoders (FARE, TeCoA, PMG, TRADES) transfer substantially more independent evidence than vanilla CLIP or SigLIP; all eight contrasts reject at the bootstrap floor. However, no cell reaches the blend-derived reference level. The three best cells fall within its replication band, leaving practical recovery undecided. Within robust encoders, per-sample alignment gain correlates with evidence gain ($ρ= 0.24-0.51$); within vanilla CLIP the correlation is consistent with zero. Across encoders we find no monotone alignment-evidence relation. VTS is therefore informative only within a fixed robust encoder, and we provide a reporting protocol in its place.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了视觉语言模型对抗攻击中常用的"受害者空间目标对齐度"(VTS)指标是否能预测独立模型对目标文本的恢复；结果显示VTS仅在固定鲁棒编码器内部具有信息量，跨编码器无单调关系，故提出替代报告协议。
AI.motivation: 对抗攻击通常以被攻击模型自身的相似度分数（VTS）作为攻击成功的证据，但该分数是否真正反映独立模型能否恢复目标文本尚不清楚，即该指标的测量效度缺乏外部验证。
AI.method: 构建测量工具：采用被攻击几何之外的监督式评判器、真实目标混合对照、打乱目标负样本，以及由50%目标-图像混合导出的参考水平；随后开展两项预注册研究，在三种扰动预算下对六种对比式编码器施加匹配攻击并比较。
AI.result: 鲁棒训练编码器（FARE、TeCoA、PMG、TRADES）迁移的独立证据显著多于原始CLIP或SigLIP，全部八组对比均在bootstrap下限处拒绝；但无任何单元达到混合参考水平，最佳三个单元落入其重复性区间内，实际恢复结论未定。鲁棒编码器内每样本对齐增益与证据增益相关（ρ=0.24–0.51），原始CLIP中该相关与零一致，跨编码器不存在单调的对齐-证据关系。
AI.conclusion: VTS仅在固定鲁棒编码器内部具有信息性，不能作为跨模型通用的攻击成功证据，作者据此提出新的报告协议以替代VTS。

title: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
summary: A login screen that appears after a tap on Sign in is expected; the same screen after a tap on View order is an attack. For GUI agents, safety is therefore a property of the transition rather than of the screen, and a monitor that inspects only screens can be defeated by reusing a legitimate one. Judging a transition requires an expectation of what should have followed the action. Existing GUI world models provide one, but they output it as text, code, or images, so checking it against the observed screen requires a second model to judge the two. We argue that a world model meant for verification should instead predict in the space in which observations are encoded, and present LGWM, a decoder-free, action-conditioned world model that predicts the representation of the next screen directly, trained without semantic annotation on 1.85M real GUI transitions. Verification reduces to a vector comparison, and the same signal reveals whether a mismatch is harmful. We evaluate on RSWT-BENCH, a diagnostic where each credential screen appears under both a legitimate and a hijacked transition, so detectors that see only the screen are at chance by construction. The training-free score reaches 0.987 AUC at 17 ms per decision, on par with the strongest closed-source VLMs and about ten AUC points above generative GUI world models at over three orders of magnitude lower latency. The residual direction reaches 0.953 AUC at separating harmful from benign violations, where prompted VLMs are near chance. Further analyses show that the prediction is a usable future state rather than an anomaly score. World models have mostly served as simulators or planners; our results point to a third role, verification, for which predicting in representation space is the natural design.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LGWM，一种无解码器、动作条件的世界模型，直接在GUI表征空间中预测下一屏表征，将GUI安全验证简化为向量比较，在RSWT-BENCH上以0.987 AUC、17ms/次决策达到与最强闭源VLM相当的性能，并以0.953 AUC区分有害与良性违背。
AI.motivation: GUI安全是转移（transition）的属性而非界面的属性：同一登录界面在点击"Sign in"后出现是正常的，在点击"View order"后出现则是攻击。仅检查静态界面的监视器可被复用合法界面绕过；判断转移需要"该动作之后应当出现什么"的预期。现有GUI世界模型虽能提供这种预期，但以文本、代码或图像形式输出，需再用第二个模型与观测比对，成本高且不精确。
AI.method: 提出LGWM：无解码器（decoder-free）、动作条件的世界模型，在观测被编码的表征空间内直接预测下一屏表征，在185万条真实GUI转移上训练，无需语义标注。验证因此退化为一次向量比较，且残差信号同时揭示失配是否有害。构建RSWT-BENCH诊断基准，使每个凭证界面同时出现在合法与劫持两种转移下，从而让只看界面的检测器在构造上仅达随机水平。
AI.result: 免训练评分在RSWT-BENCH达0.987 AUC，每次决策17ms，与最强闭源VLM持平，比生成式GUI世界模型高出约10个AUC点且延迟低三个数量级以上。残差方向在区分有害与良性违背上达0.953 AUC，而带提示的VLM接近随机。进一步分析表明该预测是可用的未来状态而非单纯的异常分数。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型此前主要用作模拟器或规划器；本文结果指向第三种角色——验证（verification），而其中在表征空间内进行预测是自然的设计选择。

title: When History Helps and Hurts: Selective History Use across Multimodal Turns
summary: Reliable multimodal interaction depends on selective use of conversational history: an earlier question may remain relevant while its previous answer is outdated, whereas a current request may depend on historical evidence despite conflicting new observations. Existing multi-turn evaluations rarely separate these history-use demands from underlying question difficulty. To address this gap, we introduce ReTurn, a benchmark of 7,000 base tasks spanning visual and audio evidence for evaluating selective history use. For task-carrying history, Reconfirm/Reground require applying a historical question to current media while varying historical agreement; for evidence-carrying history, Retrieve/Rebind require answering a current question using historical media while varying current-media competition. Each pair preserves the target question, media, and answer. Tasks support open-ended and multiple-choice evaluation, with matched single-turn counterparts serving as answerability references. Across 13 omni-modal, vision-language, and audio-language models, median model-level open-ended accuracy falls from 93.7% with direct input to 72.3% in conversation. Behavioral probes show that high question recall can coexist with weaker task application, while competing media can redirect answers away from historical targets. Supervised adaptation yields only partial gains. ReTurn provides a controlled framework for assessing whether multimodal models select and use the historical information required by each request.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReTurn 基准（7000 个基础任务，涵盖视觉与音频证据），用于评估多模态模型在多轮对话中的选择性历史使用能力，并将其与问题本身的难度解耦。
AI.motivation: 现有对话中，历史信息的使用需求具有选择性：早期问题可能仍相关但其旧答案已过时，当前请求可能依赖历史证据却与新的观察冲突。然而现有多轮评测很少将这种"历史使用需求"与问题本身的固有难度分离，导致难以判断模型失败究竟源于任务难度还是历史选择能力不足。
AI.method: 构建 ReTurn 基准，包含 7000 个基础任务，跨越视觉与音频证据。针对两类历史使用需求设计四组任务：任务承载型历史用 Reconfirm/Reground（将历史问题应用于当前媒体，改变历史一致性）；证据承载型历史用 Retrieve/Rebind（用历史媒体回答当前问题，改变当前媒体竞争度）。每组配对保留相同目标问题、媒体与答案，并支持开放式与多选题评测，同时配有匹配的单轮对照任务作为可答性参照。对 13 个全模态、视觉语言与音频语言模型进行评估，并加入行为探针与监督适配实验。
AI.result: 13 个模型的开放式准确率中位数从直接输入的 93.7% 下降至对话中的 72.3%。行为探针显示，高问题召回率可与会话中任务应用能力偏弱并存；竞争性媒体会将答案从历史目标上带偏。监督适配仅带来部分增益。
AI.conclusion: ReTurn 提供了一个受控框架，用于评估多模态模型能否选择并使用每次请求所需的历史信息，揭示了对话中历史使用需求与问题难度分离后模型的显著能力缺口。

title: Look Where You Can: Active View Selection for CAD Reconstruction under Occlusion
summary: CAD reconstruction methods assume a luxury reality rarely grants: unrestricted visual access to the object, photographed from any desired angle. Real objects, however, are scene-embedded, bolted against walls, wedged into corners, resting on floors, where the scene renders much of the view sphere unreachable and the remaining views unequally informative. We introduce \textbf{SightCAD}, a framework for parametric CAD reconstruction that treats view feasibility as a first-class constraint. In this work we consider objects from standard CAD benchmarks embedded in realistic indoor scenes with physically derived visibility constraints over a discrete view sphere. A learned view selector must choose $K$ feasible views for a vision--language model (VLM) that generates executable CadQuery code, scored by geometric fidelity of the executed solid. Because reward arrives only after discrete view selection, autoregressive generation, and CAD-kernel execution, we propose a joint training paradigm in which the view selector and the CAD-generation VLM are trained together against this reward. The learned selection policy departs sharply from random, uniform, and coverage-greedy alternatives, outperforming surface-area maximization (SA-max) by up to $6.4$ Intersection-over-Union (IoU) points across budgets $K\in\{1,\dots,5\}$. The full system surpasses strong external baselines on scene-embedded, occluded multi-view renders of DeepCAD and Fusion360 objects ($+21$ and $+17$ effective-mIoU points over the best baseline, respectively), as well as on test-time domain-canonicalized real images from the industrial T-LESS benchmark and on both synthetic and real images from the MP6D industrial metal-parts benchmark, while producing the highest rate of executable programs of any method compared (invalid-code rate ${\leq}1.5\%$).

AI.tldr: SightCAD 将“视角可行性”作为参数化 CAD 重建的一等约束，在真实室内场景与物理可见性约束下，联合训练视角选择器与生成 CadQuery 代码的 VLM，显著超越 SA-max 与外部基线，并保持极低无效代码率。
AI.motivation: 现有 CAD 重建方法假设可任意角度无限制拍摄物体，但真实物体往往嵌入场景（靠墙、卡角、落地），导致视角球大面积不可达、剩余视角信息量不均。论文旨在把视角可行性显式建模为约束，解决场景嵌入式物体在受限视角下的 CAD 重建问题。
AI.method: 1) 将标准 CAD 基准物体嵌入真实室内场景，并在离散视角球上施加物理推导的可见性约束；2) 学习式视角选择器为 VLM 选择 K 个可行视角；3) VLM 依据所选视角生成可执行的 CadQuery 代码，并通过执行实体的几何保真度获得奖励；4) 由于奖励仅在“离散视角选择 + 自回归生成 + CAD 内核执行”之后到达，提出视角选择器与 CAD 生成 VLM 的联合训练范式，共同针对该奖励优化。
AI.result: 学习到的选择策略明显区别于随机、均匀与覆盖贪心策略；在 K∈{1,…,5} 的预算下较表面积最大化（SA-max）最高提升 6.4 个 IoU 点。完整系统在 DeepCAD 与 Fusion360 对象的场景嵌入、遮挡多视角渲染上分别较最佳基线提升 +21 与 +17 有效 mIoU 点；在 T-LESS 工业基准的测试时域规范化真实图像，以及 MP6D 工业金属零件基准的合成与真实图像上同样超越基线；可执行程序率最高，无效代码率 ≤1.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将视角可行性作为显式约束并联合训练视角选择与 CAD 生成，可有效应对场景嵌入式物体在视图球受限、遮挡严重条件下的参数化 CAD 重建，在多个基准上取得更高几何精度与更优代码可执行性。

title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is the central training paradigm for advancing large foundation models towards self-improvement. This report introduces the MiMo-V2.6 series, an omni-modal family that pushes the frontier of model intelligence by scaling RL compute. Prior to RL, we conduct mid-training on a broad multimodal corpus to provide ample exploration space, and build a solid infrastructure on the pretrained hybrid-SWA architecture to support subsequent scale-up. We scale RL compute along three dimensions: (1) larger batches and higher throughput, with an asynchronous training that consumes 1,568 samples and 2.7-3.7B tokens per step at context lengths of up to 1M; (2) more diverse and complex environments, spanning code, general, visual, and cyber domains under a mixture of agent harnesses; and (3) more grader compute, via groupwise agentic grading that yields more accurate reward signals for long-horizon tasks and steers the model towards shorter, more token-efficient solutions. To keep training stable at scale, we freeze the MoE router and establish a multi-layer defense against reward hacking. We further build infrastructure for mixed-task agentic RL, including a unified trajectory representation, high-concurrency multi-framework rollout, decoupled control and data planes, and training-inference consistency. We open-source the training dynamics, RL environments, and RL framework to facilitate reproduction and further research on scaled RL and model self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 本报告提出 MiMo-V2.6 系列全模态模型，通过在三方面规模化强化学习算力（大批量异步训练、多样复杂环境、组内智能体评分）推动模型智能前沿，并开源训练动态、RL 环境与框架。
AI.motivation: 强化学习是推动大基础模型走向自我提升的核心训练范式，作者希望以扩展 RL 算力来突破模型智能上限，并解决大规模 RL 训练的稳定性、奖励准确性与工程配套问题。
AI.method: RL 前先在广域多模态语料上做中期训练以提供探索空间，并在预训练混合 SWA 架构上搭建基础设施；RL 算力沿三方向扩展：更大批次与更高吞吐（异步训练，每步 1,568 样本、2.7-3.7B tokens，上下文最长 1M）、跨代码/通用/视觉/网络等领域并在多种 agent harness 混合下的多样复杂环境、以及组内智能体评分带来更准奖励；同时冻结 MoE 路由器并建立多层防御防奖励作弊，并构建混合任务智能体 RL 基础设施（统一轨迹表示、高并发多框架 rollout、控制与数据面解耦、训推一致性）。
AI.result: 实现了大规模 RL 训练的稳定性；组内智能体评分在长程任务上提供更准确奖励信号并引导模型给出更短、更省 token 的解；每步消耗 1,568 样本与 2.7-3.7B tokens，上下文长度最高 1M。
AI.conclusion: MiMo-V2.6 系列通过扩展 RL 算力推进全模态模型智能，并在稳定性与奖励质量上取得进展；作者开源训练动态、RL 环境与 RL 框架，以促进可复现研究及规模化 RL 与模型自我提升的后续工作。

title: MindFlow: Mind Supernet Powered Thinking Flows for Research Idea Innovation
summary: Research idea innovation is a fundamental engine of scientific progress, yet it remains difficult to generate and evaluate in a scalable and controllable way. This challenge lies in its inherently open-ended and multi-objective nature, where ideas should balance novelty, plausibility and feasibility. While recent LLM-based approaches have made progress through carefully designed prompts or agent pipelines, they are constrained by predefined, static ideation workflows. To address this limitation, we propose MindFlow, a framework that explicitly formulates ideation as a graph-structured Flow in Mind, which is composed of modular thinking operators and modeled by a probabilistic mind supernet. Given a research topic, a controller dynamically samples thinking flows to generate candidate ideas. This open-ended problem is optimized using a tournament-based relative ranking, enabling the controller to progressively favor higher-quality thinking flows. We further introduce an evaluation protocol that jointly assesses problem finding and problem solving, going beyond title- or abstractonly judgments. Across diverse topics, MindFlow shows its superiority as an explicit, controllable and optimizable research idea innovator.

AI.tldr: MindFlow将研究创意生成建模为"思维流"（Flow in Mind）：由模块化思维算子构成图结构，用概率化"思维超网"建模；给定研究主题，控制器动态采样思维流生成候选创意，并通过锦标赛式相对排序优化控制器。同时提出联合评估"发现问题"与"解决问题"的协议，实验表明该框架在显式、可控、可优化方面优于既有LLM方法。
AI.motivation: 研究创意创新是科学进步的基础引擎，但大规模、可控地生成与评估创意仍很困难。其难点在于创意过程本身是开放式、多目标的，需在新颖性、合理性与可行性之间取得平衡。现有基于LLM的方法虽借助精心设计的提示或智能体流水线取得进展，却受限于预定义、静态的构思工作流，缺乏显式结构与可优化性。
AI.method: 1）将构思过程显式形式化为图结构的"思维流"（Flow in Mind），由模块化"思维算子"组成；2）用概率化"思维超网"（mind supernet）对思维流的分布建模；3）给定研究主题时，控制器（controller）动态采样思维流以生成候选创意；4）以锦标赛式相对排序（tournament-based relative ranking）优化该开放式问题，使控制器逐步偏好更高质量的思维流；5）提出同时评估"发现问题"与"解决问题"的评估协议，超越仅基于标题或摘要的判断。
AI.result: 在多个不同研究主题上，MindFlow展现出优越性，可作为显式、可控且可优化的研究创意创新器（research idea innovator）。
AI.conclusion: 通过把创意生成从静态提示/流水线改造为可采样、可排序优化的图结构思维流，MindFlow在开放式多目标创意任务上实现了显式性、可控性与可优化性；配合更全面的评估协议，为研究创意生成提供了新的建模范式。

title: Learning Which Correspondences to Trust: Confidence-Weighted Event-Camera Localization in LiDAR Maps
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures/tables. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027 (under review). Code: https://github.com/panagiotisq/CELL
summary: Localizing an event camera against a pre-built LiDAR map can be cast as dense optical-flow estimation between a rendered depth view and an event image, followed by a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solver over the induced 3D-2D correspondences. Existing pipelines rely on geometric consensus during pose estimation, but do not explicitly model the reliability or pose informativeness, i.e., how strongly a correspondence constrains the camera pose, of individual correspondences. We show that the natural way to learn it -- using the per-correspondence error to constrain the learning of confidence -- suffers from a depth-dependent bias: small pixel errors reside predominantly at large depths and do not lead to high pose informativeness. Instead, in our method (CELL), we learn a per-correspondence confidence end-to-end through the pose, using a differentiable probabilistic PnP whose log-partition term encourages weight configurations that yield a better-constrained pose distribution. The learned confidence is used in three ways: (i) it reweights the flow supervision in a decoupled training scheme that keeps pose gradients out of the flow/edge backbone; (ii) it drives a probabilistic correspondence selection at test time; and (iii) together with the network's edge-probability it weights a final edge-matching refinement. We further design a partial-completion depth representation that adds signal without hallucinating across large gaps. On M3ED and DSEC our full system improves over the LEAR baseline on the majority of the evaluated sequences: it reduces the median translation error by up to 26.9% and the median rotation error by up to 15.8%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CELL，一种将事件相机在预建 LiDAR 地图中定位的端到端方法，通过学习逐对应关系置信度并经可微概率 PnP 传播，显式建模对应关系的位姿信息量。在 M3ED 与 DSEC 上将中位平移误差最多降低 26.9%、旋转误差最多降低 15.8%。
AI.motivation: 事件相机对 LiDAR 地图定位可建模为渲染深度视图与事件图像间的稠密光流估计，再由 PnP 求解 3D-2D 对应关系得到位姿。现有流程在位姿估计中仅依赖几何一致性（RANSAC 式共识），未显式建模每条对应关系的可靠性及其对位姿的约束强度（位姿信息量）。作者进一步指出，用逐对应误差来监督置信度学习存在深度相关偏差：小像素误差多出现在大深度处，并不代表高的位姿信息量，因而会误导置信度估计。
AI.method: 提出 CELL，通过可微概率 PnP 对逐对应置信度进行端到端学习，其对数配分项倾向于使权重配置产生约束更好的位姿分布，从而避免深度偏差。学到的置信度用于三处：(i) 在解耦训练中重加权光流监督，使位姿梯度不流入光流/边缘骨干网络；(ii) 测试时驱动概率化对应选择；(iii) 结合网络边缘概率对最终边缘匹配精化进行加权。此外设计部分补全深度表示，在不跨越大幅空隙进行幻觉插值的前提下增加有效信号。
AI.result: 在 M3ED 和 DSEC 数据集上，所提完整系统在多数评测序列上优于 LEAR 基线，中位平移误差最多降低 26.9%，中位旋转误差最多降低 15.8%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模每对应关系的位姿信息量、并通过可微概率 PnP 端到端学习置信度，可有效缓解误差监督中的深度偏差，提升事件相机对 LiDAR 地图的定位精度；置信度还可统一用于训练重加权、测试时选择与边缘精化，形成完整一致的流程。

title: Specialized Decision Models vs. General-Purpose LLMs: Benchmarking Jev Across Knowledge, Reasoning, and Multilingual Tasks
summary: Jev is a "System One" model that returns a choice among given options instead of generating text. We study how such a specialized decision model compares with general-purpose large language models (LLMs). We evaluate Jev on 13 multiple-choice benchmarks covering knowledge, reasoning, and multilingual understanding, and compare it with 19 LLMs in three tiers: frontier, representative, and small. Jev is competitive with frontier LLMs on knowledge and commonsense benchmarks and obtains the best score on MMLU-Redux and ARC-Challenge. Outside mathematics, it also outperforms most representative LLMs and all small LLMs. However, it falls behind on mathematical word problems: on MathQA, it is 17.7 points below the frontier median and scores lower than all 19 LLMs. These results indicate that a specialized decision model can match general-purpose LLMs on decisions that rely mainly on knowledge, but not on decisions that require multi-step calculation.

AI.tldr: Jev是一种"系统一"决策模型，直接返回选项而非生成文本；在13个多选基准上与19个LLM对比显示，其在知识类任务上可比肩前沿LLM，但在数学计算类任务上明显落后。
AI.motivation: 探究专用决策模型（Jev）与通用大语言模型（LLM）之间的能力差异，明确专用模型适用的任务类型边界。
AI.method: 在13个多选基准（涵盖知识、推理、多语言理解）上评测Jev，并与19个LLM（分为前沿、代表性、小型三个层级）进行对比。
AI.result: Jev在知识与常识基准上与前沿LLM相当，在MMLU-Redux和ARC-Challenge上取得最佳成绩；除数学外，优于大多数代表性LLM及所有小型LLM；但在MathQA上较前沿LLM中位数低17.7分，且低于全部19个LLM。
AI.conclusion: 专用决策模型可在主要依赖知识的决策任务上匹敌通用LLM，但在需要多步计算的任务上表现不足。

title: FearCaut-Qwen: Affective Steering in a Vision-Language Model Shifts the Decision Criterion for Hazard Assessment
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) show great potential for damage assessment after a disaster, but a recurring deficiency is that they are reluctant to declare a hazard; that is, recall is low even when overall accuracy appears adequate. This study examines that deficiency by using signal detection theory to decompose the decision behavior into perceptual capability and decision-criterion placement. We then propose a novel method for correcting the over-conservative decision policy, inspired by the finding that fear makes humans risk-averse, and ask whether an affective representation associated with fear can be causally manipulated to similarly alter a VLM's decision tendency. Using mechanistic interpretability, we localize a causally implicated affective circuit in the model and use activation steering to manipulate it while observing the effect on downstream prediction. The method is tested on a two-stage SeisMLLM pipeline built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, which flags only 27.0% of genuinely unsafe buildings on the SeisMLLM-1K test split and never issues a false Red, an SDT criterion of c = +1.354, despite adequate evidence quality (d' = 1.521). An affective direction is localized on emotion-rich natural scenes, causally validated by sparse-neuron knockout and distributed steering on held-out emotion data, and then injected into the building task. Fear-direction injection raises Red recall to 75.7% (p<0.001), and subtracting the same direction suppresses Red predictions entirely, whereas norm-matched random and matched happiness directions show no significant effect. The mechanism is a shift in criterion (c=-1.515) while discrimination is not improved (d'=-0.493). These results show that VLM decisions can be adjusted at inference time without retraining and demonstrate how mechanistic interpretability can be used to diagnose and control VLM decision behaviors in engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究用信号检测论诊断视觉语言模型（VLM）在灾害损伤评估中"高准确率但低召回"的问题，并通过机制可解释性定位"恐惧"情感回路，用激活引导（activation steering）因果性地调节决策判据，在无需重训练的情况下将红色（不安全）召回率从27.0%提升至75.7%。
AI.motivation: VLM在灾后损伤评估中潜力巨大，但普遍存在"不愿判危"的缺陷：整体准确率看似合格，召回率却很低（过保守的决策倾向）。作者希望区分这是"感知能力不足"还是"决策标准过严"，并寻找一种不重训练即可纠正该倾向的方法。受"恐惧使人风险规避"这一心理学发现启发，作者假设可因果操纵与恐惧相关的情感表征来改变VLM的决策倾向。
AI.method: 1) 用信号检测论（SDT）将决策行为分解为感知能力(d')与判据位置(c)；2) 借助机制可解释性，在富含情感的自然场景上定位一个因果相关的情感回路；3) 通过稀疏神经元敲除(knockout)与分布式引导(distributed steering)在留出情感数据上做因果验证；4) 将恐惧方向注入基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct的两阶段SeisMLLM管线，与范数匹配的随机方向及匹配的"快乐"方向作对照。
AI.result: 基线SeisMLLM在SeisMLLM-1K测试集上仅标出27.0%的真实不安全建筑，且从不误报红色，SDT判据c=+1.354，但证据质量充分(d'=1.521)，证明问题出在判据而非感知。注入"恐惧"方向后红色召回率升至75.7%(p<0.001)；减去同一方向则完全抑制红色预测；范数匹配的随机方向与快乐方向均无显著效果。机制为判据移动(c=-1.515)，而辨别力未提升(d'=-0.493)。
AI.conclusion: VLM的决策可在推理时被调节而无需重训练；机制可解释性可用于诊断并控制工程应用中VLM的决策行为。该工作提供了一条从"诊断过保守判据"到"因果操纵情感回路"的闭环路径。

title: DataVista: Diagnosing Multimodal LLMs on Data Video Understanding
summary: Data video is a media form that integrates data visualization with video narrative, widely adopted in news reporting and business analysis. Compared with general video understanding, data video understanding places greater emphasis on accurately reading data from animated charts, integrating evidence across charts and time, and understanding how narrative organization and visual design communicate information. Yet existing benchmarks target either general videos or static charts, and data video understanding has not been systematically evaluated. We present DataVista, the first benchmark for data video understanding, containing 961 real-world data videos and 6,775 evaluation questions organized under a three-level progressive capability framework (data perception, temporal reasoning, narrative understanding) with 10 fine-grained question types across five topic domains. Systematic evaluation of 19 mainstream MLLMs shows that the best-performing model, Gemini-3.1-Pro, achieves 70.0% overall accuracy, still far below human expert performance, with models performing worst on Causal Reasoning and Narrative Structure. Increasing frame counts and adding subtitles mainly benefit data perception and temporal reasoning, with limited gains in narrative understanding. Further analysis of model responses identifies typical failure modes in chart reading, evidence judgment, and instruction understanding. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个数据视频理解基准 DataVista，含961个真实数据视频与6775道题，构建三级能力框架（数据感知、时序推理、叙事理解）及10类细粒度问题；19个主流MLLM评测显示最佳模型Gemini-3.1-Pro仅达70.0%总体准确率，显著低于人类专家。
AI.motivation: 数据视频将数据可视化与视频叙事结合，广泛应用于新闻报道与商业分析。相较于通用视频理解，数据视频理解更强调从动画图表中准确读取数据、跨图表与跨时间整合证据，以及理解叙事组织与视觉设计如何传递信息。然而现有基准仅面向通用视频或静态图表，数据视频理解尚未得到系统评估，因此需要构建专门的基准。
AI.method: 提出 DataVista 基准，包含 961 个真实数据视频和 6,775 道评测问题，组织在三层递进能力框架（数据感知、时序推理、叙事理解）之下，覆盖五个主题领域、10 种细粒度问题类型。基于该基准对 19 个主流多模态大模型（MLLM）进行系统评测，并进行帧数与字幕的消融分析，以及模型回答的失败模式分析。
AI.result: 最佳模型 Gemini-3.1-Pro 总体准确率为 70.0%，仍远低于人类专家水平；模型在因果推理与叙事结构上表现最差。增加帧数和添加字幕主要提升数据感知与时序推理，对叙事理解增益有限。模型回答分析揭示出图表读取、证据判断与指令理解方面的典型失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 数据视频理解对现有 MLLM 仍是重大挑战，尤其在因果推理与叙事结构等高层次能力上存在明显短板；单纯增加帧数或字幕难以弥补叙事理解的不足。DataVista 为数据视频理解的系统评测提供了基准，并指明后续模型在图表读取、证据判断与指令理解方面的改进方向。基准已开源。

title: Agentic-TTT: Training test-time policy for test-time training
summary: Test-time training (TTT) adapts an LLM's parameters using signals derived from test inputs, and can make striking improvements in pre-specified settings such as IMO competitions or designated open problems. By turning deployment experience into parameter updates, TTT provides a direct mechanism for model-level self-improvement. Yet TTT is not universally beneficial: each TTT algorithm works in different settings, and applying an ill-suited method could waste test-time compute or even damage model performance. Therefore, such parameter-level self-improvement requires agency: the model must decide when TTT is warranted, which algorithm to invoke, and whether an existing skill can be reused. To fill this gap, we introduce Agentic-TTT, which learns a test-time policy to govern those decisions. Agentic-TTT turns TTT procedures into callable tools, treats accumulated skills as an evolving deployment environment, and trains its policy using the observed utility gains from its decisions. On our benchmark, Agentic-TTT nearly doubles the utility over the backbone model, learns to trade off utility against compute, and generalizes to domains unseen during training. Together, these results point toward autonomous self-improvement: models that can decide how to learn from their own deployment experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agentic-TTT，把多种 test-time training（TTT）过程封装为可调用工具、把累积技能视为演化的部署环境，并学习一个测试时策略来自主决定是否启用 TTT、选用哪个算法以及能否复用既有技能。
AI.motivation: TTT 能通过测试输入信号更新 LLM 参数，在 IMO 竞赛、指定开放问题等预设场景中带来显著提升，是模型级自我改进的直接机制；但 TTT 并非普遍有效：不同 TTT 算法适用的场景不同，误用不合适的算法会浪费测试时算力甚至损害性能。因此参数级自我改进需要"能动性"——模型须自行判断何时 TTT 有必要、调用哪个算法、既有技能可否复用。现有工作缺乏这种决策机制。
AI.method: Agentic-TTT 学习一个测试时策略来统管上述决策：将 TTT 过程转化为可调用工具（callable tools），把累积技能视为不断演化的部署环境，并利用自身决策所观察到的效用增益（utility gains）来训练该策略。
AI.result: 在其基准上，Agentic-TTT 相对骨干模型的效用几乎翻倍，学会了在效用与算力之间进行权衡，并能泛化到训练中未见的领域。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该方向指向自主自我改进：模型能够自行决定如何从自身部署经验中学习。

title: Examining Social Attribution in LLM Reasoning: A Theory-Guided Probing Methodology
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in sociotechnical systems where social attribution, the reasoning process attributing external events to the causes and reasons of agents' social behaviors, plays a critical role. These processes involve judgments of social cause, responsibility, and blame/credit to agents. Although attributional models are well-studied in social psychology and cognition through Attribution Theory, social attribution remains underexplored in AI, particularly LLM social reasoning. This paper provides the first systematic exploration of LLM social attribution. Our work focuses on responsibility and blame attributions, examining current LLMs' judgments and their underlying internal mechanisms. Guided by attribution theory, we construct a social attribution benchmark consisting of a Vignette subset based on classic scenarios from attribution theory research and a Reality subset based on real-world social narratives, yielding 7,639 responsibility/blame judgment questions. On this basis, we evaluate 32 representative LLMs and 5 basic non-LLM baselines. To further explore the internal mechanisms underlying the LLM judgment process, we develop a probing-based methodology to investigate the latent-space representations of 5 key attribution dimensions and the consistency of their influences on LLM judgments compared to those in human social attribution. Our research findings reveal that current LLMs exhibit measurable but incomplete agreement with human responsibility and blame judgments, and meanwhile, this agreement is positively correlated with model size. Some attribution dimensions are systematically decodable from specific positions in LLM hidden states, and their influences on the final judgment are consistent with those indicated by human Attribution Theory. The dataset and associated code are available at https://github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统探索大语言模型（LLM）的社会归因能力，构建了包含7,639道责任/责备判断问题的社会归因基准（SAB-Bench），评估了32个代表性LLM与5个非LLM基线，并通过探针方法研究了5个关键归因维度在LLM隐空间中的表征及其对判断的影响机制。
AI.motivation: LLM日益部署于社会技术系统中，社会归因（将外部事件归因于智能体社会行为的原因与理由）至关重要，涉及对智能体的社会原因、责任及责备/功劳判断。尽管归因理论在社会心理学与认知领域已有充分研究，但在AI尤其是LLM社会推理中仍探索不足，责任与责备归因研究尤为欠缺。
AI.method: 1）以归因理论为指导，构建社会归因基准，包含基于归因理论经典情境的Vignette子集和基于真实社会叙事的Reality子集，共7,639道责任/责备判断问题；2）评估32个代表性LLM和5个基础非LLM基线；3）开发基于探针（probing）的方法，考察5个关键归因维度在LLM隐空间中的表征，以及其对判断影响与人类社会归因的一致性。
AI.result: 当前LLM与人类责任和责备判断具有可测量但不完全的一致性；该一致性程度与模型规模正相关；部分归因维度可从LLM隐状态特定位置系统性地解码出来，且其对最终判断的影响与人类归因理论所指出的方向一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次系统性地探索了LLM社会归因，揭示了LLM在责任与责备判断上与人类部分一致，并初步阐明了其内部机制中归因维度表征及影响方式的合理性。数据集与代码已开源。

title: InterviewPlayground: A Validated Simulation Environment for Evaluating AI Interviewers
summary: Increasingly, AI interviewers are being developed to elicit open-ended responses in applications like market research, public polling, preference elicitation, and social science research. However, evaluating AI interviewers is challenging because they function in extended, multi-turn interactions where they must adapt to participant behaviors. To address this need, we develop InterviewPlayground, a simulation environment for evaluating AI interviewers using simulated study participants whose behaviors are grounded in social theory. Simulated studies in InterviewPlayground produce an InterviewReportCard, which assesses the performance of AI interviewers using a suite of validated measures. To test whether our simulation-based evaluations predict performance with human participants, we conduct 15 real qualitative studies with five AI interviewers, three interview topics, and 450 human participants and compare them to simulated studies in InterviewPlayground. We find that AI interviewer performance in InterviewPlayground predicts performance in human studies with an average Pearson correlation of 0.86 across 12 measures, and the simulated interactions from InterviewPlayground reproduce key findings from behavioral analysis of AI interviewers in the human studies. Together, these findings support the validity of InterviewPlayground in assessing AI interviewer performance and examining potential failure modes. Our work contributes a simulation environment for AI interviewers supported with empirical validation, and more broadly, a roadmap for future work to develop validated, simulation-based evaluations of conversational AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InterviewPlayground——一个基于社会理论驱动模拟被试的 AI 访谈者评估仿真环境，并通过 15 项真实定性研究（5 个 AI 访谈者、3 个访谈主题、450 名人类被试）验证其仿真评估能预测真实表现（12 项指标平均 Pearson 相关 0.86）。
AI.motivation: AI 访谈者正被用于市场调研、民意调查、偏好 elicitation 与社会科学研究等需要开放式回答的场景，但其评估困难：AI 访谈者工作在长时、多轮交互中，必须动态适应被试行为。现有评估方法难以覆盖这类交互特性，因此需要一种可扩展且具有效度的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建 InterviewPlayground 仿真环境，用具有社会理论依据的模拟研究被试来评估 AI 访谈者；每次模拟研究生成 InterviewReportCard，基于一套经过验证的指标衡量访谈者表现。为检验仿真评估的预测效度，开展 15 项真实定性研究（5 个 AI 访谈者、3 个访谈主题、450 名人类被试），并与仿真研究进行对照比较。
AI.result: InterviewPlayground 中的 AI 访谈者表现能预测真实人类研究中的表现，12 项指标上的平均 Pearson 相关系数为 0.86；仿真交互还复现了人类研究中 AI 访谈者行为分析的关键发现。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持 InterviewPlayground 在评估 AI 访谈者表现与识别潜在失败模式方面的效度，贡献了一个带实证验证的 AI 访谈者仿真环境，并为未来开发经过验证的、基于仿真的对话式 AI 系统评估提供了路线图。

title: Natural Language to First-Order Logic LLM-based Autoformalization
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have renewed interest in autoformalization. Yet, when First-Order Logic (FOL) is considered as the target formalism, the field still lacks a unified task formulation and a systematic survey. This paper addresses this gap: we first provide a principled definition for the FOL-autoformalization task by distinguishing Ontology Extraction from Logical Translation, showing how their conflation obscures (cross-study) evaluation; we review existing datasets, evaluation metrics, and LLM-based methods, including fine-tuning, prompting, and verification-based refinement; we identify open challenges in benchmarking, semantic evaluation, ontology-aware methods, and end-to-end applications.

AI.tldr: 本文定位为一篇关于一阶逻辑自动形式化的综述性工作，提出将任务拆分为"本体抽取"与"逻辑翻译"两个子任务的原则性定义，梳理现有数据集、评测指标与LLM方法，并指出基准、语义评测、本体感知方法与端到端应用等开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型重新激发了自动形式化研究的兴趣，但当目标形式体系为一阶逻辑（FOL）时，该领域仍缺乏统一的任务表述与系统综述，导致不同研究之间概念混用、评测难以横向比较。
AI.method: （1）给出FOL自动形式化任务的原则性定义，将本体抽取（Ontology Extraction）与逻辑翻译（Logical Translation）相区分，并说明二者混淆如何遮蔽跨研究评测；（2）系统回顾现有数据集、评测指标与基于LLM的方法，涵盖微调、提示工程与基于验证的迭代精化三类路径。
AI.result: 论文以综述与框架性分析为主，通过任务分解厘清了FOL自动形式化的研究格局，归纳了现有数据集、度量与方法的现状及其局限，未报告新的实验性性能结果。
AI.conclusion: 该领域在基准构建、语义级评测、本体感知方法以及端到端应用四个方面仍存在开放挑战，是未来研究的关键方向。

title: Do Not Train Away Uncertainty: Early Uncertainty Anchored Calibration
summary: Deep neural networks, including large language models, have achieved remarkable performance across various tasks. However, they are prone to overconfidence during training or fine-tuning. In this work, we observe a consistent phenomenon across different models that the early model is better calibrated, while later training or fine-tuning yields marginal accuracy gains but substantially increases calibration errors. Our analysis suggests that the early model retains uncertainty awareness in both its predictions and features, which is gradually lost with continued training. To avoid training away this uncertainty awareness, we propose \textbf{EUA-Cal}, a novel method that exploits the \textbf{E}arly model as an \textbf{U}ncertainty \textbf{A}nchor for \textbf{Cal}ibration. EUA-Cal introduces early prediction regularization to preserve early predictive uncertainty and prototype structure regularization to exploit uncertainty reflected in the early feature space, jointly mitigating overconfidence. Extensive experiments on image classification and multiple-choice question answering across eight diverse models demonstrate that EUA-Cal outperforms state-of-the-art calibration methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EUA-Cal方法，利用训练早期模型作为不确定性锚点，通过早期预测正则化和原型结构正则化，在保持精度的同时显著降低模型过度自信，在8个模型上的图像分类和多项选择问答任务中优于现有校准方法。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络（包括大语言模型）在训练或微调过程中普遍存在过度自信问题。作者观察到一致现象：早期模型校准更好，而后期训练虽仅带来边际精度提升，却大幅增加校准误差。分析表明早期模型在预测和特征中保留了不确定性感知，而这种感知会随训练逐渐丧失。因此需要一种方法来避免训练过程中消除这种不确定性感知。
AI.method: 提出EUA-Cal（Early model as Uncertainty Anchor for Calibration）方法。该方法包含两个正则化项：1）早期预测正则化，用于保留早期模型的预测不确定性；2）原型结构正则化，用于利用早期特征空间中反映的不确定性。两者联合作用以缓解过度自信。
AI.result: 在图像分类和多项选择问答任务上，跨越8个不同模型的广泛实验表明，EUA-Cal优于当前最先进的校准方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用早期模型作为不确定性锚点可有效缓解训练/微调后期的过度自信问题，EUA-Cal是一种有效的校准方法，在多种模型和任务上具有优越性和通用性。

title: Look Back, Think Ahead: Visual Memory on Demand for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Processing long visual token sequences from high-resolution images makes multi-step reasoning computationally expensive for multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing one-shot pruning and aggregation methods compress visual tokens into a fixed context before decoding. However, visual evidence needs can shift as reasoning unfolds, making it difficult for a fixed compressed context to retain all the details needed across stages. To address this challenge, we propose ViMoD, a lightweight framework that maintains a compact visual context while preserving access to original fine-grained evidence as reasoning needs evolve. Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens (DART) learns content-adaptive groups and aggregation capacities, constructing compact Coarse representations linked to recoverable original Fine tokens. Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence (TRACE) integrates decoding history to anticipate upcoming evidence needs and select, retain, or replace active Fine-token groups. Selected Fine tokens augment the persistent Coarse context in the frozen backbone, enabling stage-specific evidence access without continuously attending to all visual tokens. On Qwen3-VL-4B, ViMoD outperforms all evaluated baselines on all eight reasoning benchmarks at a 20% target visual token budget, improving the mean normalized score by 39.0% over the strongest evaluated one-shot baseline. These gains are achieved with only 0.0546% additional trainable parameters relative to the frozen backbone.

AI.tldr: ViMoD 提出一种轻量框架，在保持紧凑视觉上下文的同时，支持随推理进程动态访问原始细粒度视觉证据，在 20% 视觉 token 预算下显著优于现有一次性压缩基线。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像产生的长视觉 token 序列使多模态大模型（MLLMs）的多步推理计算代价高昂。现有的一次性剪枝与聚合方法在解码前将视觉 token 压缩为固定上下文，但视觉证据需求会随推理展开而变化，固定压缩上下文难以在各阶段保留全部所需细节。
AI.method: ViMoD 由两个组件构成：DART（Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens）学习内容自适应的分组与聚合容量，构建与可恢复原始 Fine token 关联的紧凑 Coarse 表示；TRACE（Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence）结合解码历史预测后续证据需求，对活跃的 Fine-token 组进行选择、保留或替换。被选中的 Fine token 在冻结主干中增强持久的 Coarse 上下文，实现阶段特异性的证据访问，而无需持续关注全部视觉 token。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上，于 20% 目标视觉 token 预算下，ViMoD 在全部八个推理基准上均超越所有评估基线，平均归一化分数相比最强的评估一次性基线提升 39.0%，且仅增加相对冻结主干 0.0546% 的可训练参数。
AI.conclusion: ViMoD 通过将紧凑粗粒度上下文与可恢复的细粒度证据动态结合，有效缓解固定压缩上下文在多变推理阶段丢失关键细节的问题，以极低参数开销实现显著的推理性能提升。

title: When Should Agents Think? Adaptive Reasoning via Cross-Turn Estimation
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities on complex tasks. They typically perform reasoning before each action throughout an interaction trajectory. However, reasoning may not be necessary at every turn, as reasoning produced earlier can continue to support subsequent actions. A key challenge is therefore to determine when existing reasoning remains sufficient and when a new reasoning step is needed, without relying on costly generation-based verification. We find that decreases in the likelihood of subsequent reference actions after removing additional reasoning closely track whether those actions remain recoverable given earlier reasoning, providing an effective and lightweight signal for estimating cross-turn action support. Based on this observation, we propose Reasoning Adaptation through Cross-Turn Estimation (RACE), a training approach for adaptive agent reasoning. RACE introduces a Likelihood-Guided Progressive Reasoning Cover Detection (LoGiC) procedure that progressively identifies reasoning turns whose removal has limited impact on the current and subsequent reference actions. The resulting removal signals are incorporated into both supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning, enabling the policy to learn when to reason and when to act directly. Extensive experiments on four representative agent benchmarks show that RACE substantially reduces reasoning cost while maintaining or improving task performance.

AI.tldr: 提出RACE训练方法，通过跨轮次的似然估计判断何时需要重新推理，使智能体能自适应地决定"推理"或"直接行动"，在四个智能体基准上大幅降低推理成本且不损性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在每个交互轮次都先推理再行动，但早期推理往往可持续支撑后续动作，逐轮推理并非必要。核心难点在于：如何在不依赖高成本生成式验证的前提下，判断既有推理是否仍然充分、何时需要开启新的推理步骤。
AI.method: 作者观察到：移除某段额外推理后，后续参考动作似然的下降幅度，能紧密反映这些动作在既有推理下是否仍可恢复，从而作为跨轮动作支撑度的轻量信号。基于此提出RACE训练方法，其中包含LoGiC（似然引导的渐进式推理覆盖检测）过程，逐步识别移除后对当前及后续参考动作影响有限的推理轮次。这些移除信号被融入监督微调与智能体强化学习，使策略学会何时推理、何时直接行动。
AI.result: 在四个代表性智能体基准上开展实验，RACE在保持甚至提升任务性能的同时，显著降低了推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过似然引导的跨轮推理冗余检测与训练信号注入，可实现智能体推理的自适应化，在性能不降的前提下有效削减推理成本，为高效智能体推理提供了可行方案。

title: ILM: An AI-Powered Storytelling Educational Tool
summary: Digital technologies have made Islamic narratives more accessible, but existing platforms provide limited support for structured learning and comprehension of these stories, particularly in Arabic and multilingual settings. We present ILM, an interactive educational platform for Stories of the Prophets that combines Arabic natural language processing, structured knowledge representation, and retrieval-based question generation. Admin-approved Arabic narratives are processed by a Knowledge Graph (KG) Constructor Engine that identifies entities and narrative relationships and stores them as structured knowledge, enabling learners to explore stories through a visual story map and answer entity- and relation-based questions generated from the KG. Separately, a multilingual retrieval pipeline retrieves relevant passages from the original narratives to generate multiple-choice and open-ended comprehension questions. For open-ended questions, an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluates learners' answers against the retrieved passages and reference answers to determine correctness. The platform also incorporates Quranic content as a separate enrichment layer, allowing selected narratives to be supplemented with source-supported information. By combining structured knowledge with passage-based retrieval, ILM supports narrative exploration, comprehension, and assessment across Arabic and multilingual content. The system demonstrates the feasibility of combining structured knowledge representation and retrieval-based generation to support interactive learning of Islamic narratives. A demo is available at anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF.

AI.tldr: ILM是一个面向"先知故事"的交互式教育平台，结合阿拉伯语自然语言处理、结构化知识表示与基于检索的问题生成，支持阿拉伯语及多语言环境下的叙事探索、理解与测评。
AI.motivation: 数字技术虽使伊斯兰叙事更易获取，但现有平台对这类故事的结构化学习与理解支持有限，尤其在阿拉伯语和多语言场景下缺乏有效的学习与评估工具。
AI.method: 平台以管理员审核的阿拉伯语叙事为输入：知识图谱构建引擎识别实体与叙事关系并存储为结构化知识，支持可视化故事地图与基于实体、关系的问答题生成；同时用多语言检索流水线从原始叙事中检索相关段落，生成选择题与开放式理解题；开放式题目由"LLM-as-a-Judge"对照检索段落与参考答案评判正确性；另设古兰经内容作为独立增强层。
AI.result: 通过结合结构化知识与基于段落的检索，ILM实现了跨阿拉伯语与多语言内容的叙事探索、理解与评估，验证了结构化知识表示与检索式生成相结合用于伊斯兰叙事互动学习的可行性；并提供了在线演示。
AI.conclusion: ILM表明将结构化知识表示与检索式问题生成相结合，能够有效支撑伊斯兰叙事的交互式学习，为多语言宗教教育内容的学习与测评提供了可行方案。

title: LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes
summary: Realistic household simulation must capture not only diverse environments but also the lived-in object arrangements and spatial constraints that shape robot motion and interaction. Existing resources often trade off scale, real-world correspondence, and interaction readiness, leaving a gap in faithful, interactive replicas of how real homes are actually arranged. To this end, we introduce LIVIN, a benchmark for spatial and embodied intelligence built on digital twins of 30 diverse lived-in homes. These replicas preserve observed room layouts, furniture configurations, and everyday belongings. To construct them, we design a human-in-the-loop workflow comprising instance recognition, architectural reconstruction, and object generation and placement, with intermediate results reviewed and corrected by humans against the source observations at each stage. We evaluate four tasks in LIVIN: 3D detection, 3D reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation. Our evaluations show that current methods remain challenged by the dense object arrangements, occlusions, limited free space, and constrained interaction regions found in realistic lived-in homes. We hope LIVIN will help advance embodied AI in real-world homes, from spatial understanding to robotic interaction, and ultimately bring embodied intelligence into everyday home environments.

AI.tldr: LIVIN：基于30个真实有人居住家庭数字孪生的空间与具身智能基准，采用人机协同流程构建，评测3D检测、3D重建、导航与移动操作四类任务。
AI.motivation: 真实家庭场景仿真需同时兼顾环境多样性、真实居住状态下的物体摆放与空间约束（影响机器人运动与交互）。现有资源在规模、真实世界对应性与交互可用性之间难以兼顾，缺少对真实家庭实际布置的高保真可交互复刻。
AI.method: 构建数字孪生：采集30个多样化有人居住家庭，保留观测到的房间布局、家具配置与日常物品。设计人机协同（human-in-the-loop）工作流，包括实例识别、建筑结构重建、物体生成与摆放，各阶段中间结果由人工对照原始观测进行审核与修正。在LIVIN上评测3D检测、3D重建、导航、移动操作四项任务。
AI.result: 评测显示，现有方法在真实居住家庭中普遍存在的密集物体摆放、遮挡、有限自由空间与受限交互区域等条件下仍面临显著困难。
AI.conclusion: LIVIN有望推动具身智能在真实家庭场景中的发展，从空间理解到机器人交互，最终将具身智能带入日常家庭环境。

title: A Minimal Optical-Flow Representation for Vision-Based Tactile Rotation Classification in Robotic Manipulation Across Gravity Domains
summary: Vision-based tactile sensors provide rich contact information, but processing high-resolution images can be costly for resource-constrained platforms such as space robots. This work investigates whether a compact representation of tactile motion can classify object rotation across different gravity conditions. Dense optical flow from a simulated GelSight Mini is aggregated over a 7x9 grid into 126 features and used to classify the direction of load-induced rotation under Earth, Mars, Moon, and orbital gravity. Gravity causes a small but significant shift in these features, accounting for 1.6% of their variance (R2 = 0.016). Despite its small magnitude, this shift affects models trained only on Earth data: XGBoost accuracy decreases from 94.4% on Earth to 75.9% in orbit. In contrast, a single model trained across all four gravity domains achieves 96.3% overall accuracy and 95.1%-97.0% across individual domains, without using gravity as an input. The representation can also be reduced to 40 features while retaining 95.7% accuracy, with XGBoost requiring only 0.14 ms per inference. These findings show that Earth-gravity performance alone is insufficient to establish the transferability of tactile perception for space robotic manipulation, highlighting the need to account for gravity-induced domain shifts during training and validation.

AI.tldr: 该研究将模拟GelSight Mini的稠密光流聚合为7x9网格的126维特征，用其分类不同重力条件下载荷引起的旋转方向。重力仅解释1.6%的特征方差，但仅在地球数据上训练的XGBoost从94.4%（地球）降至75.9%（轨道）；而跨四种重力域训练的单一模型达到96.3%总体准确率，且特征可压缩至40维仍保持95.7%准确率，单次推理仅0.14 ms。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的触觉传感器能提供丰富接触信息，但高分辨率图像处理对空间机器人等资源受限平台代价高昂。作者希望探究：紧凑的触觉运动表示能否在不同重力条件下实现物体旋转分类，并检验仅凭地球重力下的性能是否足以说明触觉感知在空间操作中的可迁移性。
AI.method: 从模拟的GelSight Mini获取稠密光流，将其在7x9网格上聚合为126维特征，用于分类地球、火星、月球和轨道重力下由载荷引起的旋转方向。评估重力对特征分布的影响（方差解释比例与R2），并比较仅用地球数据训练的XGBoost与跨四个重力域联合训练的单一模型（不以重力为输入）的表现，同时进行特征降维实验并测量推理耗时。
AI.result: 重力引起特征分布微小但显著的偏移，仅解释1.6%的方差（R2 = 0.016）。这一偏移使仅在地球数据上训练的模型性能下降：XGBoost准确率从地球上的94.4%降至轨道环境中的75.9%。相反，跨四种重力域训练的单一模型总体准确率达96.3%，各域准确率为95.1%–97.0%，且未将重力作为输入。特征可降至40维并保持95.7%准确率，XGBoost单次推理仅需0.14 ms。
AI.conclusion: 仅依据地球重力下的性能不足以确立触觉感知在空间机器人操作中的可迁移性。重力引起的域偏移虽小却会显著影响跨域泛化，因此在训练与验证中必须考虑重力导致的域偏移；同时，紧凑的触觉运动表示在多种重力条件下能够实现高精度且低计算开销的旋转分类。

title: Perception Test 2026: Challenge Summary and Extension to City-scale Audio-Visual Reasoning
summary: Continuing the Perception Test challenge series, we organised the fourth edition as a workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026 in Malmö, Sweden. This edition focused on spatial intelligence and featured four different tracks: unified multiple-choice videoQA and grounded videoQA from the original Perception Test benchmark, alongside two new tracks based on city-scale walking-tour videos (KilometerAudio and KilometerVision). In this report, we describe the new benchmarks used for the city-scale tracks and summarise the winning solutions across all tracks, including a generalist model that competed across all tracks with satisfactory performance. The winning solutions in the newly added city-scale tracks demonstrated that complex spatial and multimodal reasoning can be solved by expensive agentic pipelines, but remains difficult for multimodal models used standalone.

AI.tldr: 本文是ECCV 2026第四届Perception Test挑战赛（Malmö）的总结报告，主题为空间智能，含四个赛道：基于原基准的videoQA与grounded videoQA，以及新增城市场景行走视频赛道KilometerAudio和KilometerVision。报告介绍了新基准并总结各赛道获胜方案。
AI.motivation: 延续Perception Test系列挑战赛，聚焦空间智能，并通过引入城市尺度行走视频的新赛道，推动复杂空间与多模态推理能力的评测，考察现有模型在真实长时程场景下的局限。
AI.method: 以ECCV 2026研讨会形式组织第四届挑战赛，设置四个赛道：原基准的统一多选videoQA与grounded videoQA，以及基于城市尺度行走视频的两个新赛道KilometerAudio和KilometerVision；为城市尺度赛道构建新基准，并汇总、比较各赛道参赛方案（含跨赛道通用模型）的表现。
AI.result: 新增城市尺度赛道的获胜方案表明，复杂的空间与多模态推理可通过高成本的智能体式（agentic）流水线解决，但对单独使用的多模态模型仍具挑战性；同时出现了一个跨全部赛道参赛并取得满意表现的通用模型。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型独立完成城市尺度复杂空间推理仍困难，需借助昂贵的agentic流水线；通用模型展现出一定潜力，未来值得进一步研究。

title: All Verdicts are Not Equal: Rethinking LLM Judge Reliability
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge is the standard paradigm for NLP evaluation, yet its systemic reliability remains poorly understood despite being widely treated as a deterministic ground truth. We present a comprehensive reliability audit, stresstesting six frontier models across four benchmarks, five prompt formats, two presentation orders, three sampling temperatures, and ten repetitions per condition. Our empirical analysis reveals severe vulnerabilities: verdicts change across identical replications at temperature zero, position-order swaps flip the majority of verdicts on challenging tasks, and the most deterministic judge achieves perfect consistency by trivially repeating incorrect verdicts, agreeing with ground truth only 51% of the time. To formalize these multi-faceted failure modes, we introduce the trustworthy verdict rate (T ), a unified metric capturing the joint probability that an evaluation is reproducible, order-invariant, and accurate. UsingT , we derive a theoretical upper bound on accuracy imposed by position bias and show that reliability is item-specific rather than modellevel. Finally, we demonstrate that shifting from pairwise win-rate to holistic rubric scoring improves trustworthiness more than any single-format prompting intervention, offering an actionable framework for robust NLP evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文对LLM-as-a-Judge的可靠性进行了系统性审计，提出"可信裁决率"(T)统一度量，揭示现有评测范式的严重不可靠性，并给出改进框架。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge已成为NLP评估的标准范式，被广泛视为确定性的"金标准"，但其系统性可靠性缺乏深入研究，存在被盲目信任的风险。
AI.method: 对六个前沿模型进行压力测试，覆盖四个基准、五种提示格式、两种呈现顺序、三种采样温度和每条件十次重复；提出"可信裁决率"(T)指标，衡量评估同时具备可复现性、顺序不变性与准确性的联合概率，并据此推导位置偏置对准确率的上界。
AI.result: 发现严重缺陷：温度为零时相同重复的裁决仍会变化；位置顺序交换可翻转多数裁决；最确定的评判者通过重复错误裁决实现完美一致性，与真实标签一致率仅51%。可靠性是条目特异性的，而非模型层面的。
AI.conclusion: 从成对胜率转向整体性评分标准(rubric scoring)对可信度的提升超过任何单一格式的提示干预，为稳健的NLP评估提供了可操作的框架。

title: DVLA-RL++: Dual-Level Vision-Language Alignment with Reinforcement Learning Gating for Few-Shot Learning
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE TPAMI for possible publication
summary: Few-shot learning aims to recognize novel categories from limited labeled examples. Recent studies incorporate textual semantics to compensate for limited visual observations and improve class representations. However, high image-text agreement may reflect both intrinsic object properties and incidental context, making support prototypes susceptible to contextual contamination. To address this problem, we propose DVLA-RL++, which extends DVLA-RL with complementary semantic purification (CSP) and counterfactual reinforcement-learning gating (CRG). Specifically, CSP generates intrinsic and nuisance descriptions from labeled supports and compares their agreement with each support token. An ambiguity-dependent rejection margin guides sparse evidence allocation, while an intrinsic semantic anchor fills the unassigned mass to provide a fallback when visual evidence is unreliable. CRG learns layer-wise semantic fusion strengths using a reward that balances recognition performance and nuisance exposure. An independently executed reference trajectory on the same episode provides a paired learning signal. Theoretical analysis relates retained evidence and anchor quality to prototype stability and establishes conditions for unbiased on-policy gradient estimation. Experiments on standard, fine-grained, and cross-domain benchmarks show state-of-the-art accuracy, with an average gain of 1.4% over DVLA-RL. The project page is available at https://peacelwh.github.io/TPAMI27-DVLA-RLpp/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DVLA-RL++，通过互补语义净化（CSP）与反事实强化学习门控（CRG）缓解小样本学习中支持原型的上下文污染，在多个基准上取得SOTA，平均较DVLA-RL提升1.4%。
AI.motivation: 小样本学习借助文本语义弥补视觉样本不足以增强类表示，但图像-文本的高一致性既可能源自主体内在属性，也可能来自偶然上下文，导致支持原型易受上下文污染。
AI.method: 在DVLA-RL基础上扩展出DVLA-RL++：CSP利用带标签支持样本生成内在描述与干扰描述，比较其与支持token的一致性，以歧义相关的拒绝裕度引导稀疏证据分配，并用内在语义锚填补未分配质量作为视觉证据不可靠时的回退；CRG以兼顾识别性能与干扰暴露的奖励学习逐层语义融合强度，并通过同一episode上独立执行的参考轨迹提供配对学习信号。
AI.result: 在标准、细粒度与跨域基准上取得SOTA精度，较DVLA-RL平均提升1.4%。
AI.conclusion: 理论分析将保留证据与锚质量同原型稳定性相联系，并给出无偏on-policy梯度估计的条件，验证了语义净化与强化学习门控在抑制上下文污染方面的有效性。

title: Few-Step Generation via Data-Space Iteration
summary: Flow matching has emerged as a scalable paradigm for training high-quality generative models, but sampling from the learned probability flow requires many network evaluations. Distillation can reduce this cost to one or a few evaluations; however, one-step generation often sacrifices quality, making few-step generation the practical operating regime. Existing few-step methods perform their iterative computation along the probability flow and therefore require a fixed, manually chosen timestep discretization. This discretization is often chosen heuristically and is expensive to tune; it may also be restrictive when refinement difficulty differs across samples or spatial locations. We introduce data-space iteration, a few-step generation framework that removes flow discretization altogether. Starting from noise, a shared generator directly refines its prediction in data space, with every iteration trained to produce the best sample permitted by its capacity. Our formulation integrates with distribution matching distillation (DMD) with minimal changes, enabling a controlled comparison between iteration methods under matched training settings. On class-conditional ImageNet 256x256, data-space iteration outperforms standard discretization baselines and matches or improves upon variants selected through schedule search, without requiring schedule-specific training. These results show that data-space iteration provides a simple and effective alternative to discretized flow-space iteration for fast generation.

AI.tldr: 提出数据空间迭代框架，消除少步生成中的流离散化，在ImageNet 256x256上优于标准离散化基线。
AI.motivation: 流匹配训练生成模型具备可扩展性，但采样需要大量网络评估；蒸馏可降至一到几步，但一步生成质量下降，少步生成成为实用区间。现有少步方法沿概率流迭代，需要固定且人工选定的时间步离散化，该离散化依赖启发式、调参昂贵，且当样本或空间位置的细化难度不同时可能受限。
AI.method: 提出数据空间迭代（data-space iteration），一种完全去除流离散化的少步生成框架。从噪声出发，共享生成器直接在数据空间细化其预测，每次迭代都被训练以产出其容量所允许的最佳样本。该形式与分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）结合，仅需极小改动，从而在匹配训练设置下对迭代方法进行可控比较。
AI.result: 在类条件ImageNet 256x256上，数据空间迭代优于标准离散化基线，并匹配或超过通过调度搜索选出的变体，且无需针对调度进行训练。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，数据空间迭代为快速生成提供了一种简单有效的替代方案，可取代离散化的流空间迭代。

title: VINCIE-NExT: Unlocking Video Editing from Images via In-Context Modeling
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS'26. Project page: https://vincie-next.github.io/
summary: Building a capable video editor remains significantly harder than a video generator: editing requires (source, instruction, edited) triplets that are prohibitively expensive to annotate and difficult to synthesize at scale, whereas image editing has already reached maturity with millions of such pairs readily available. In this work, we introduce VINCIE-NExT, a unified framework that transfers editing capability from images to videos through in-context visual demonstrations, alleviating the need for large-scale paired video editing data. VINCIE-NExT decomposes video editing into a structured chain of composable sub-tasks (Video -> Image -> Image -> Video), routing editing intent through the image domain and enabling scalable joint training from heterogeneous image and video corpora under a unified diffusion objective. An image editing pair, synthesized by the model or supplied by the user, is prepended as an in-context visual demonstration that serves as a spatial appearance blueprint for every output frame. To ground appearance edits across the interleaved context, we introduce a novel position encoding that links image demonstrations and video frames in a shared spatial coordinate system, enabling pixel-faithful propagation of appearance changes to every output frame. Chain-of-Editing further provides principled test-time scaling: by executing the sub-task chain as progressive diffusion stages, editing quality can be improved by investing additional compute without retraining. Comprehensive experiments on OpenVE-Bench demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance across diverse editing categories, with ablations confirming the effectiveness of each component.

AI.tldr: VINCIE-NExT通过上下文视觉示范将图像编辑能力迁移到视频编辑，无需大规模成对视频编辑数据，在OpenVE-Bench上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 视频编辑比视频生成更难，核心瓶颈在于（源视频、指令、编辑后视频）三元组成对数据标注成本极高且难以规模化合成；相比之下，图像编辑领域已有数百万成对数据，技术成熟。因此需要一种方法来迁移图像编辑能力以规避对大规模成对视频编辑数据的依赖。
AI.method: 提出统一框架VINCIE-NExT，将视频编辑分解为结构化可组合子任务链（Video → Image → Image → Video），将编辑意图路由至图像域，并在统一扩散目标下从异构图像与视频语料进行可扩展联合训练。将模型合成或用户提供的图像编辑对作为上下文视觉示范前置，充当每帧输出的空间外观蓝图。引入新的位置编码，在共享空间坐标系中关联图像示范与视频帧，实现外观编辑到每帧的像素级忠实传播。Chain-of-Editing支持测试时缩放：将子任务链作为渐进扩散阶段执行，无需重训练即可通过增加算力提升编辑质量。
AI.result: 在OpenVE-Bench上的综合实验表明，该方法在多种编辑类别上均达到当前最优性能，消融实验证实了各组件均有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过图像域中介的上下文视觉示范与共享坐标位置编码，VINCIE-NExT有效缓解了视频编辑数据稀缺问题，并在统一扩散框架下实现了高质量、可测试时扩展的视频编辑。

title: ContourVLA: A Closed-Loop Perception-Action Contour Policy for Generalized Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: Generalized referring expression segmentation (GRES) requires dynamically balancing high-level semantics for identifying a variable number of language-specified referents with fine-grained visual evidence for precise boundary delineation. This requirement challenges existing cascaded vision-language architectures, which typically rely on static feature interfaces and single-pass mask prediction, limiting adaptive perception and geometric correction. We introduce ContourVLA, a vision-language-action policy that recasts GRES as a closed-loop visuomotor process, in which editable contours serve as explicit policy states that condition multimodal perception and are updated by geometric action chunks. Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling (EASS) couples contour-guided bidirectional boundary sampling with state-conditioned routing of multilevel multimodal features, adapting perception to each contour state. Following supervised initialization, Dustbin-Augmented Entropic Credit Transport GRPO (DECT-GRPO) jointly optimizes discrete grounding and continuous contour actions with instance-level credits. Its rollout rewards and credits are derived from soft prediction-target correspondences that account for false positives and missed targets. ContourVLA improves gIoU over the strongest evaluated baselines by 8.7, 2.8, and 2.7 points on gRefCOCO val, testA, and testB, respectively, and achieves the highest mIoU across all eight RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg splits.

AI.tldr: ContourVLA 将广义指代分割（GRES）重构为闭环视觉运动策略过程，以可编辑轮廓作为显式策略状态，通过演化感知语义调度与专用 GRPO 优化实现自适应感知与几何修正，在 gRefCOCO 与 RefCOCO 系列基准上显著领先。
AI.motivation: GRES 需要动态平衡高层语义（识别数量可变的语言指定目标）与细粒度视觉证据（精确边界刻画）。现有级联视觉-语言架构依赖静态特征接口与单次掩码预测，缺乏自适应感知与几何校正能力，难以满足上述双重需求。
AI.method: 提出 ContourVLA，一种视觉-语言-动作策略，将 GRES 建模为闭环视觉运动过程，以可编辑轮廓作为显式策略状态并驱动多模态感知，由几何动作块迭代更新。其 Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling (EASS) 结合轮廓引导的双向边界采样与状态条件化的多层多模态特征路由，使感知随轮廓状态自适应。监督初始化后，采用 Dustbin-Augmented Entropic Credit Transport GRPO (DECT-GRPO)，基于软预测-目标对应关系（考虑误检与漏检）生成 rollout 奖励与实例级信用，联合优化离散定位与连续轮廓动作。
