AI.result: 在 gRefCOCO val、testA、testB 上，gIoU 分别较最强评测基线提升 8.7、2.8、2.7 个百分点；在 RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg 全部八个划分上取得最高 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 以可编辑轮廓为策略状态、将分割转化为闭环视觉运动过程的范式，配合演化感知的语义调度与实例级信用强化学习，可有效提升 GRES 的自适应感知与边界精度，并全面超越现有级联式方法。

title: A persistent accuracy ceiling in automated verbal deception detection
summary: Automated methods have been proposed to overcome the limitations of human verbal deception detection, but evidence remains fragmented across disciplines. We systematically reviewed 25 years of research (289 reports, 6,136 classification models) and meta-analyzed 3,653 models nested within 97 datasets. Pooled accuracy was 74.4% (95% CI: 71.2%-77.4%) with substantial heterogeneity. Accuracy was driven by methodological quality (ground truth, data source, class balance, evaluation procedure) more than by model complexity: the adoption of embeddings and large language models has not translated into improved predictive performance. Only 12.46% of reports used data with verifiable ground-truth, and only 23.96% of models were evaluated on independent data. The pooled accuracy aligns with meta-analyses of manual approaches, suggesting a ceiling of 70-75%, unlikely to be lifted by current research conventions.

AI.tldr: 对25年自动化欺骗检测研究进行系统综述与元分析，发现合并准确率约74.4%，且由方法学质量而非模型复杂度驱动，与人工检测的准确率上限相当。
AI.motivation: 人工言语欺骗检测存在局限，自动化方法虽被提出，但相关证据分散于不同学科，缺乏整合性结论。
AI.method: 系统综述25年研究（289篇报告、6136个分类模型），并对嵌套于97个数据集中的3653个模型进行元分析。
AI.result: 合并准确率为74.4%（95% CI：71.2%-77.4%），异质性较大；准确率主要受方法学质量（真值、数据来源、类别平衡、评估程序）驱动，而非模型复杂度（嵌入与LLM未带来性能提升）；仅12.46%报告使用可验证真值数据，仅23.96%模型在独立数据上评估。
AI.conclusion: 自动化欺骗检测的准确率与人工方法元分析结果一致，提示存在70-75%的上限，当前研究范式难以突破。

title: SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene
summary: General-purpose service robots need navigation systems that can handle diverse human requests in unfamiliar environments, combining task generality with scene generality. Some existing methods fine-tune multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict navigation actions, making their behavior dependent on the coverage of navigation training data and potentially limiting generalization to new requests and environments. Our key insight is to let the MLLM focus on interpreting requests, understanding scenes, and making decisions while preserving its general-purpose capabilities and delegating motion execution to navigation tools. To realize this idea, we introduce SuperNav, which equips a pretrained MLLM with a specialized agent harness without navigation-specific fine-tuning of the MLLM. Our harness supports these decisions with Navigation Skills, agent-oriented Tools for physical interaction, and task-progress and context management. A unified visual-point interface connects decision-making to motion by allowing the model to specify destinations directly in images and revise its decisions from execution feedback. Together, these components support sustained navigation across different task requirements and environments. SuperNav outperforms four evaluated baselines on instance-level, multi-object, and demand-driven tasks. Category-level evaluation on HM3D and deployment on a real quadruped robot further demonstrate its applicability across environments. Project Page: https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav/

AI.tldr: SuperNav 提出一种不微调 MLLM 的通用机器人导航框架，通过智能体工具链（导航技能、物理交互工具、任务进度与上下文管理）和统一的视觉点接口，将决策与运动执行解耦，在实例级、多物体和需求驱动任务上超越四个基线，并在 HM3D 与真实四足机器人上验证了跨环境泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 通用服务机器人需要在陌生环境中处理多样的人类请求，同时具备任务通用性与场景通用性。现有方法通过微调多模态大语言模型（MLLM）直接预测导航动作，导致行为受限于导航训练数据的覆盖范围，难以泛化到新请求和新环境。
AI.method: 核心思路是让 MLLM 专注于请求解析、场景理解与决策，保留其通用能力，而将运动执行委托给导航工具。具体实现 SuperNav：在不进行导航特定微调的前提下，为预训练 MLLM 配备专门的智能体框架（agent harness），包含导航技能（Navigation Skills）、面向智能体的物理交互工具（Tools）、任务进度与上下文管理；并通过统一的视觉点接口（visual-point interface）让模型直接在图像中指定目标点，并根据执行反馈修正决策。
AI.result: SuperNav 在实例级、多物体和需求驱动任务上优于四个被评估的基线；在 HM3D 上的类别级评估以及真实四足机器人上的部署进一步证明了其跨环境的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将 MLLM 的通用推理能力与模块化导航工具及视觉点接口相结合、避免导航特定微调，可在不牺牲通用性的前提下支持跨任务需求与跨环境的持续导航，为通用服务机器人导航提供了可行路径。

title: LVS: Local View Synthesis from Relative Camera Pose by Reusing Previous Views
summary: Interactive scene exploration requires frequent view updates, although small camera motions preserve much of the visible content. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting nevertheless renders each target view, leaving this image overlap unexploited. Reusing rendered images offers an alternative. Geometric warping alone cannot recover newly exposed content and remains sensitive to depth errors. We propose a per-scene framework that replaces repeated scene rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse. Geometric warping uses depth and relative pose to transport source content, while a lightweight multiscale network predicts RGB residuals to correct artifacts and infer missing appearance. Cached source features further reduce repeated computation. On GS-render, residual refinement improves PSNR by 0.72~dB over pure warping; evaluations on captured and rendered scenes demonstrate low query latency. This separation of scene rendering from local view updates supports responsive scene exploration, with potential applications in augmented and virtual reality.

AI.tldr: 提出一种逐场景的RGB-D图像复用框架，用相对位姿引导的几何warping加轻量多尺度残差网络替代邻近视角的重复3DGS渲染，实现低延迟视角更新。
AI.motivation: 交互式场景探索需要频繁更新视角，而小幅相机移动时可见内容大部分重叠，但传统3D Gaussian Splatting对每个目标视角都完整渲染，未利用这种图像重叠；仅靠几何warping又无法恢复新暴露区域且对深度误差敏感。
AI.method: 逐场景框架：以相对位姿引导的RGB-D图像复用替代邻近视角的重复渲染。利用深度与相对位姿做几何warping传输源内容；用轻量多尺度网络预测RGB残差以修正伪影并推断缺失外观；同时缓存源特征以减少重复计算。
AI.result: 在GS-render上，残差细化相比纯warping将PSNR提升约0.72 dB；在真实拍摄与渲染场景上的评估显示查询延迟较低。
AI.conclusion: 将场景渲染与局部视角更新解耦，可支持响应式场景探索，在增强现实与虚拟现实中具有应用潜力。

title: Rehearse Everything, Remember Nothing: Attic-KV Rehearses What Will Be Read
summary: Many key-value (KV) caches are compressed before anyone knows what will be asked of them: a document cached for retrieval, a prompt prefix shared across requests, the memory of a long conversation. The prevailing approach scores KV entries by rehearsal: the model rereads the context and keeps the entries it attends to, assuming that the more completely a cache rehearses its context, the better it remembers it. We show that under tight budgets this assumption backfires: rehearse everything, remember nothing. At a 3% keep ratio, rereading the whole context keeps 31.5 of 96.5 points on RULER, and on LongBench's natural-text tasks it falls below methods that rehearse nothing at all. The cause is that a cache keeps what it rehearses: rereading spreads the budget across the whole context, so the answer's own entries survive at little more than chance. Like a student before an exam, a cache remembers more by testing itself than by rereading. Two principles follow: rehearse what will be read, and rehearse as much as there is. We instantiate them as Attic-KV (Attic for short), a training-free rehearsal in which the model quizzes itself with question-answer pairs that quote the context, alongside anchor tokens in a content-adaptive amount. Changing only the rehearsal lifts three hosts that score it in three different ways: Attic alone is the best training-free method in all eight settings we test on RULER and LongBench's natural-text tasks, and plugged into the gradient-based KVgrad and the trained RestoreKV+, it raises them by up to 17.1 and 28.1 points. Its advantage grows as the budget shrinks, reaching 41.9 points over full rereading at a 3% keep ratio, and on long documents it compresses faster than rereading them.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练KV缓存压缩方法Attic-KV，通过"自测式排练"（用引用上下文的问答对进行自问）替代"重读式排练"，在低预算下显著优于全上下文重读方法。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩方法假设"越完整地重读上下文，记忆越好"，但本文发现在紧预算下该假设失效：全上下文重读会把预算摊薄到整个上下文，导致答案相关条目仅以接近随机的概率被保留（"重读一切，等同无记忆"）。需要新的排练范式。
AI.method: 提出两条原则："排练将要被读取的内容"与"排练量应与内容量相匹配"。据此实例化Attic-KV：免训练的排练方式，让模型用引用上下文的问答对进行自我提问，并配合内容自适应的锚点token数量；可即插即用接入梯度方法KVgrad与训练方法RestoreKV+。
AI.result: 在3%保留率下，全上下文重读在RULER上仅得31.5/96.5分，在LongBench自然文本任务上甚至低于完全不排练的方法；Attic在8个设置中均为最佳免训练方法，比全重读高出41.9分；接入KVgrad和RestoreKV+分别提升最多17.1和28.1分；优势随预算缩小而增大，长文档上压缩速度快于重读。
AI.conclusion: KV缓存应"测而不读"：通过自测式排练与内容自适应锚点，可在紧预算下大幅提升压缩缓存的问答性能，且方法免训练、与现有梯度/训练方法兼容。

title: Language-Specific Effects of Tokenizer Choice in Multilingual Language Models
summary: Tokenizer choice affects multilingual language modeling, but vocabulary capacity is finite and vocabulary size is often constrained: improving representation for some languages often comes at the expense of others. We therefore ask whether tokenizer choice matters equally across languages, a question that the current literature leave unanswered. To this end, we train 123 language models spanning 54 tokenizers. In the main comparison, architecture, training corpus, training-token budget, and optimization are held fixed, so the models differ only in their tokenizer. We find that tokenizer choice matters more for languages with less language-model training data: across the 54 tokenizers, the standard deviation of a language's bits-per-byte (BPB) increases as its model training-data share decreases (Spearman rho = -0.52 over the 31 trained languages and -0.69 over the 28 written with word boundaries). Leaving a language out of tokenizer training raises its BPB in every language we study, and the penalty tends to be larger for languages with less language-model training data. Giving lower-resource languages a larger share of tokenizer-training data, however, does not unconditionally help those languages: both equal weighting and an allocation inverting the shares with respect to the language model training data increase their BPB, particularly when language-model training repeats data. Finally, which intrinsic tokenizer properties are associated with better BPB differs across languages, providing further evidence that what makes a good tokenizer depends on the language. We find that the metrics quantifying these properties can be successfully used to predict downstream models' pairwise BPB rankings, suggesting a practical strategy for screening tokenizer candidates before training language models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过训练123个语言模型（覆盖54种分词器），在固定架构、语料、token预算与优化设置下，考察分词器选择对不同语言的影响差异，发现低资源语言对分词器选择更敏感，并提出了筛选分词器候选的实用策略。
AI.motivation: 词汇容量有限、分词器训练数据分配存在竞争关系，改善某些语言的表示往往以牺牲其他语言为代价。然而现有文献未回答"分词器选择是否对所有语言同等重要"这一问题。
AI.method: 训练123个语言模型，覆盖54种分词器；除分词器外，架构、训练语料、训练token预算和优化设置全部固定，从而将差异归因于分词器。分析语言训练数据占比与其BPB标准差的关系，并考察分词器训练中语言被排除、以及低资源语言分配更大分词器训练数据份额的影响，最后检验内在分词器属性指标对下游BPB排序的预测能力。
AI.result: 在54种分词器间，语言BPB的标准差随其模型训练数据份额下降而增大（31种受训语言Spearman rho=-0.52，28种带词边界的语言rho=-0.69）。将某语言排除在分词器训练之外会在所研究的每种语言中提高其BPB，且惩罚通常对训练数据较少的语言更大。给低资源语言更大的分词器训练数据份额并非无条件有益：等权重分配以及与语言模型训练数据份额相反的分配都会提高其BPB，在语言模型训练重复数据时尤为明显。与更优BPB相关的内在分词器属性因语言而异。量化这些属性的指标可成功预测下游模型的成对BPB排序。
AI.conclusion: 分词器选择对低资源语言的影响更大，好分词器的标准取决于具体语言；分词器内在属性指标可用于在训练语言模型前筛选候选分词器，具有实用价值。

title: Healthy Counterfactual Generation via Diffusion Inpainting for Mammography Classification
summary: False negatives remain a critical limitation of computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems for breast cancer screening due to delayed detection and treatment. To address this issue, we propose a counterfactual data augmentation strategy that generates healthy mammograms by "erasing" lesions from anomalous images, thereby enriching the training distribution. We train a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model on BI-RADS 1 (healthy) mammograms and use a RePaint-based sampling strategy to inpaint realistic normal tissue within annotated lesion bounding boxes. The resulting healthy counterfactuals replace annotated lesion regions with realistic healthy tissue while preserving patient-specific anatomical structure, as supported by similarity metrics between real and generated images. Image realism was further assessed by radiologists and found to be consistent with the original dataset quality. We evaluate counterfactual augmentation across four representative classifier architectures: a convolutional neural network (ConvNeXt), a vision transformer (ViT), a vision-language model pre-trained on mammogram-report pairs (Mammo-CLIP) and a multi-scale attention-based multiple-instance learning framework (FPN-MIL). Experiments conducted on the VinDr-Mammo dataset show improvements in sensitivity across all architectures, particularly at 80\% fixed specificity, contributing towards more reliable CAD systems for breast cancer. Code is available at: https://github.com/ines03garcia/diffusion-based-counterfactual-generation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于扩散模型的反事实数据增强策略，通过在异常乳腺X线图像中"擦除"病灶并生成健康组织，丰富训练分布，从而降低CAD系统的假阴性率。
AI.motivation: 乳腺X线筛查CAD系统的假阴性问题严重，导致检测与治疗延误；现有训练数据分布不足，需要增加健康样本以提升敏感性。
AI.method: 在BI-RADS 1健康乳腺X线图像上训练去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），采用RePaint采样策略，在标注病灶边界框内修复生成逼真的正常组织；用生成的健康反事实图像替换病灶区域；在四种分类器架构（ConvNeXt、ViT、Mammo-CLIP、FPN-MIL）上评估该增强策略，数据集为VinDr-Mammo。
AI.result: 生成图像与真实图像的相似度指标支持其保留了患者特异性解剖结构，放射科医生评估其真实性与原始数据集质量一致；在VinDr-Mammo数据集上，所有架构的敏感性均有提升，尤其在80%固定特异度下表现明显。
AI.conclusion: 基于扩散模型的反事实生成可有效增强训练数据，提升多种CAD架构的敏感性，有助于构建更可靠的乳腺X线筛查CAD系统。

title: Connected Self Forcing: Beyond Local Learning in Video Autoregression
summary: To stream long videos while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency, Self Forcing mitigates exposure bias through self-rollout training on self-generated histories with key-value (KV) caching. To keep memory manageable, it detaches historical caches, preserving forward dependencies between chunks but severing the backward gradient paths. We introduce Connected Self Forcing, a training framework that reconnects gradient paths across autoregressive chunks, allowing feedback from later predictions to guide how earlier context is generated. These connections go beyond historical KV-writing: gradients pass through generated latents into the computations that produced them, linking the generation of earlier context to its use in later predictions. To make this connected training memory-efficient, we develop shortcut gradient replay, which recovers cross-chunk gradients without retaining the full rollout computation graph. Integrated with distribution matching distillation, Connected Self Forcing trains historical chunks according to both their direct supervision and their contribution to subsequent generation. Experiments on autoregressive video generation show improvements in long-horizon visual quality and temporal consistency, without changing the inference procedure.

AI.tldr: 提出 Connected Self Forcing 训练框架，通过重新连接自回归视频生成各 chunk 间的梯度路径，使后续预测能反馈指导早期上下文的生成，并配以 shortcut gradient replay 实现内存高效训练。
AI.motivation: 自回归长视频生成中，Self Forcing 通过自 rollout 训练缓解 exposure bias，并使用 KV caching 控制内存。但为保证内存可管理，历史缓存被 detach，导致前向依赖保留、反向梯度路径被切断，早期上下文只能受直接监督，无法根据其在后续生成中的作用进行优化。
AI.method: 提出 Connected Self Forcing：1) 跨自回归 chunk 重新连接梯度路径，梯度不仅经过历史 KV 写入，还穿过生成的 latent 进入产生它们的计算过程，从而将早期上下文的生成与其在后续预测中的使用联系起来；2) 设计 shortcut gradient replay，在不保留完整 rollout 计算图的情况下恢复跨 chunk 梯度，降低显存开销；3) 与 distribution matching distillation 集成，使历史 chunk 同时依据直接监督和其对后续生成的贡献进行训练。
AI.result: 在自回归视频生成实验中，长时程视觉质量和时间一致性均得到提升，且推理过程无需改变。
AI.conclusion: 通过恢复并利用跨 chunk 的梯度反馈，Connected Self Forcing 在不增加推理成本的前提下改善了长视频生成质量与时序一致性，为自回归生成训练提供了内存高效的新范式。

title: When KL Regularization Misfires in Group Policy Optimization
summary: Why does removing reference-policy KL regularization sometimes improve group policy optimization? This motivates studying how reference-policy information should enter group-relative updates. We analyze seven potential failure modes in the interactions between KL and rewards: residual KL updates after reward clipping, after gradient cancellation, and in groups with identical rewards; KL growth with response length and an imbalance in its relative contribution; KL concentration on a small number of tokens; and sampling noise when k1 is incorporated into rewards. We propose Zero-Sum Calibrated Policy Optimization (ZCPO), which uses relative drift measured by conditional KL to calibrate within-group reward coefficients and integrates them into the base surrogate. Mathematical reasoning experiments and ablations support this design's effectiveness in our settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文剖析了在组策略优化中移除参考策略KL正则化有时反而有效的原因，识别出KL与奖励交互的七种失效模式，并提出零和校准策略优化（ZCPO）方法。
AI.motivation: 虽然KL正则化通常用于约束策略偏离参考策略，但实践中移除它有时能提升组策略优化效果，其机理尚不明确。作者希望厘清参考策略信息应如何进入组相对更新，从而解释并改进这一现象。
AI.method: 作者系统分析了KL与奖励交互中的七种潜在失效模式：奖励裁剪后的残余KL更新、梯度抵消后的残余KL更新、奖励相同组内的KL更新、KL随响应长度增长及其相对贡献失衡、KL集中在少数token上、以及将k1纳入奖励时的采样噪声。据此提出ZCPO方法：用条件KL度量的相对漂移来校准组内奖励系数，并将其整合进基础代理目标。
AI.result: 在数学推理实验中，ZCPO的设计有效性得到验证，消融实验进一步支持各关键组件的作用。
AI.conclusion: 参考策略KL在组相对优化中的引入方式至关重要，直接使用或移除均可能带来问题。通过条件KL校准组内奖励系数的ZCPO在给定设置下能有效缓解上述失效模式并提升优化效果。

title: AI-Based On-Board Maritime Object Detection for Earth Observation Payload Data Reduction on Versal Embedded Hardware
comment: 8 pages. Accepted at the 10th On-Board Payload Data Compression Workshop (OBPDC 2026), Barcelona, Spain, 12-14 October 2026
summary: Very-high-resolution Earth-observation satellites acquire more data than they can store and downlink, while in maritime surveillance the vessels cover a tiny fraction of each scene. We study onboard vessel detection as a way to select what is downlinked, which reduces the data according to its content rather than coding every pixel; it is complementary to conventional onboard compression. The work follows three axes. (i) Data and algorithm: a controlled dataset is generated from 68 annotated Maxar scenes with 43 vessel classes, and a YOLOX-S detector is trained on it. (ii) Embedded deployment: the detector is quantized and deployed on the DPU of a Versal VC1902, with a limited loss of detection quality and a processing time of a few seconds per scene. (iii) Data reduction: we propose several downlink modes, from metadata only (box, class and score of each detection) to image crops around vessels, tiles holding detections, or the whole scene with a degraded background, and estimate from the measured detection errors the trade-off each offers between the vessels kept and the volume downlinked. On our dense harbor and coastal scenes, tiles keep 98% of the vessels with 29% of the scene volume, and crops 83% with 3%.

AI.tldr: 该研究将星上船只检测作为内容驱动的下传选择手段，构建数据集、在Versal VC1902的DPU上部署量化YOLOX-S，并提出多种下传模式以权衡保留船只比例与下传数据量。
AI.motivation: 超高分辨率地球观测卫星采集的数据量超过其存储与下传能力，而海事监视中船只仅占每个场景的极小部分，因此需要根据内容而非逐像素编码来决定下传内容，以缓解数据瓶颈。
AI.method: 工作分三部分：(i) 数据与算法：基于68幅Maxar标注场景和43类船只生成受控数据集，训练YOLOX-S检测器；(ii) 嵌入式部署：将检测器量化后部署于Versal VC1902的DPU，检测质量损失有限，每场景处理耗时数秒；(iii) 数据缩减：提出多种下传模式，包括仅元数据、船只周围裁剪、含检测的瓦片、以及背景降质的整幅场景，并基于实测检测误差估计各模式在保留船只与下传数据量间的权衡。
AI.result: 在密集港口与海岸场景中，瓦片模式以29%的场景数据量保留98%的船只，裁剪模式以3%的数据量保留83%的船只；嵌入式部署检测质量损失有限，处理时间为每场景数秒。
AI.conclusion: 星上船只检测可实现基于内容的下传选择，与常规星上压缩互补；瓦片和裁剪等下传模式能在显著降低数据量的同时保留大部分船只，验证了该方案在超高分辨率海事监视中的可行性。

title: Just Weather Scoring: Efficient End-to-end Nowcasting with Distributional Diffusion
summary: Generative diffusion models are well-suited for probabilistic precipitation nowcasting, but existing approaches often rely on separately trained compression or deterministic forecasting components and remain costly at inference due to iterative denoising. We introduce Just Weather Scoring (JWS), a single-stage, end-to-end diffusion model which addresses both issues by forecasting directly in radar space and enabling few-step generation. Radar-space modeling greatly simplifies training and inference and eliminates uncertainty arising from lossy compression. JWS combines Masked Asynchronous Diffusion, a timestep-sampling scheme that preserves clean context while adapting diffusion training to high-dimensional spatio-temporal data, with a simple scoring-rule objective that aligns training with probabilistic forecasting and unlocks few-step generation. On the SEVIR and MeteoNet benchmarks, JWS achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at reduced training and inference cost. Even our smallest model remains competitive using substantially fewer parameters and more than 17x faster inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JWS，一种单阶段端到端扩散模型，直接在雷达空间进行降水临近预报并支持少步生成，在SEVIR和MeteoNet上取得最优概率预报性能且训练与推理成本更低。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式扩散方法用于概率降水临近预报时，通常依赖单独训练的压缩或确定性预报组件，且迭代去噪导致推理成本高，同时有损压缩引入不确定性。
AI.method: JWS直接在雷达空间建模，简化训练与推理并消除压缩带来的不确定性；结合掩码异步扩散（Masked Asynchronous Diffusion），一种在保留干净上下文的同时适配高维时空数据的时刻采样方案；并采用简单的评分规则目标，使训练与概率预报对齐并支持少步生成。
AI.result: 在SEVIR和MeteoNet基准上，JWS以更低的训练和推理成本达到最优的概率预报性能；最小的模型仍具竞争力，参数量大幅减少且推理速度提升超过17倍。
AI.conclusion: JWS通过单阶段雷达空间端到端扩散与少步生成，在保证概率预报精度的同时显著降低训练和推理开销。

title: SteerablePlex: Can We Steer Full-Duplex Models?
summary: Full-duplex speech models can listen and speak simultaneously, enabling natural interaction, but become increasingly difficult to control as the conversation history grows. When used as user simulators, this lack of control can cause them to deviate from prescribed scenarios and produce unreliable evaluation outcomes. We introduce SimIF-Bench (Simulator Instruction-Following Benchmark), which evaluates whether a conversational model stays within a prescribed scenario and completes multiple goals in the required order. The benchmark reveals that current open-source full-duplex models struggle to follow such constraints. We then introduce a Group Reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO)-based training recipe that enables a full-duplex model to follow textual instructions during an ongoing conversation while maintaining its turn-taking ability. By connecting the resulting SteerablePlex to an asynchronous backend language model that monitors the conversation and provides instructions when needed, we build a more controllable full-duplex user simulator that follows multi-stage constraints more reliably than existing open-source models and GPT-Realtime.

AI.tldr: 提出SimIF-Bench基准评估全双工对话模型的场景约束遵循能力，发现开源模型表现不足，并用GDPO训练出可操控的SteerablePlex，结合异步后端语言模型构建更可靠的全双工用户模拟器。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音模型能同时听说、支持自然交互，但随着对话历史增长，其可控性下降；当用作用户模拟器时，易偏离预设场景，导致评估结果不可靠。因此需要衡量并提升模型在对话中遵循场景约束与多目标顺序的能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建SimIF-Bench（Simulator Instruction-Following Benchmark），评估对话模型是否停留在预设场景并按要求的顺序完成多个目标；2) 提出基于Group Reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization（GDPO）的训练方案，使全双工模型在对话进行中遵循文本指令，同时保持轮次转换（turn-taking）能力，得到SteerablePlex；3) 将SteerablePlex与一个异步后端语言模型连接，后者监控对话并在需要时提供指令，从而构成可控的全双工用户模拟器。
AI.result: SimIF-Bench显示当前开源全双工模型难以遵循上述约束；所构建的用户模拟器在多阶段约束遵循上比现有开源模型和GPT-Realtime更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 通过基准评测揭示全双工模型指令遵循的不足，并借助GDPO训练与异步后端语言模型的协同，能够显著提升全双工用户模拟器的可控性与约束遵循可靠性。

title: SciTBERT: A family of chronologically consistent language models for scientific and technological language processing
summary: Pre-trained transformer models are increasingly being used to study scientific and technological progress. Encoders tuned to paper or patent text outperform general-purpose models on downstream classification, regression, and proximity tasks within science and technology. However, the applicability of these models for studying time-dependent or archival properties of science, technology, and their interface is limited due to lookahead and domain biases inherent to these pre-trained models. These limitations arise from training on corpora with unconstrained chronological and text source distributions. We introduce SciTBERT: a family of chronologically consistent BERT-derived language models trained on text from scientific papers, patents, and high-quality educational web text with training data cutoff dates spanning each year between 2013 and 2025. We also post-train these models in a chronologically-consistent manner using paper and patent citations, creating SciTBERT-CI model family. We find that these models generally outperform predecessor domain-specific encoder models even when training data is limited by early year restrictions in the corpus. To further investigate the extent to which this class of models can learn representations that bridge science and technology, we introduce the PatRepEval benchmark, a suite of patent-related text embedding tasks at the science-technology interface. Performance in a variety of classification, regression, and retrieval tasks spanning papers and patents highlights the importance of aligning encoder model representations with the domain distributions of their downstream tasks, and chronologically consistent encoders can match or exceed models trained without temporal constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出SciTBERT系列按年度数据截止（2013–2025）训练的时序一致编码器，并基于引文后训练出SciTBERT-CI，同时发布PatRepEval基准，验证时序一致模型在科学—技术接口任务上可媲美或超越无时序约束模型。
AI.motivation: 现有面向论文/专利的领域预训练编码器虽在下游任务上优于通用模型，但因训练语料的时间与文本来源分布不受约束，存在"前视偏差"和领域偏差，限制其在研究科学技术的时序性或档案性属性时的适用性。
AI.method: 构建SciTBERT：在科学论文、专利及高质量教育网页文本上训练，训练数据截止日期分别覆盖2013至2025年各年份，保证时序一致；再用论文与专利引文进行时序一致的后训练，得到SciTBERT-CI；并提出PatRepEval基准，包含科学—技术接口处的专利相关文本嵌入任务（分类、回归、检索）。
AI.result: SciTBERT系列在训练数据受早期年份限制的情况下，仍总体优于此前的领域专用编码器；在PatRepEval多类分类、回归与检索任务上，表现显示编码器表示与下游任务领域分布对齐的重要性，且时序一致编码器可匹配或超过无时序约束训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 时序一致（chronologically consistent）的领域编码器可有效缓解前视偏差，同时保持甚至提升性能，是研究科学技术随时间演化及其交叉界面的可行建模方案。

title: DiffuPlex: Accelerating Full-Duplex Spoken Dialog Models via Rolling Masked Diffusion
comment: 41 pages, 11 figures, 18 tables. Preprint, under review. Project page: https://diffuplex.github.io/
summary: Recent full-duplex spoken dialog models enable simultaneous listening and speaking, but fine-grained models still advance their backbone autoregressively at every interaction frame. We introduce DiffuPlex, a rolling masked diffusion framework that reduces this sequential computation by predicting multiple future user and assistant frames in a single backbone wake. DiffuPlex consumes only a confident prefix of each predicted future while interaction continues at the original frame rate. As user speech arrives, it checks the corresponding user predictions and, when the interaction diverges, preserves already played assistant content while revising only the unplayed future. We consider two inference policies over the same predictor: DiffuPlex-LISTEN consumes multiple future frames when they predict assistant silence, whereas DiffuPlex-SPEAK can also consume predicted assistant speech. Across full-duplex interaction and spoken-language evaluations, DiffuPlex substantially reduces sequential backbone computation while largely preserving interaction behavior and general capability. DiffuPlex-LISTEN and DiffuPlex-SPEAK achieve $1.46\times$ and $1.59\times$ deployment-path wall-clock speedups and $1.61\times$ and $1.80\times$ Core LM speedups, with all measured backbone invocations completing within the 80ms interaction interval. Human evaluation shows that LISTEN preserves speech naturalness and conversational quality, while SPEAK retains conversational quality with some degradation in speech naturalness.

AI.tldr: DiffuPlex 是一个滚动掩码扩散框架，通过一次骨干唤醒预测多个未来帧，减少全双工语音对话模型的顺序计算，实现最高 1.59× 端到端加速，同时基本保持交互行为与通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有细粒度全双工语音对话模型虽能同时听说，但每个交互帧都需自回归推进骨干网络，顺序计算开销大，难以满足低延迟交互需求。
AI.method: 提出 DiffuPlex 滚动掩码扩散框架：单次骨干唤醒中预测多个未来用户与助手帧，仅消费置信前缀；用户语音到达时校验对应用户预测，若交互发散则保留已播放的助手内容、仅修订未播放未来。基于同一预测器设计两种推理策略：DiffuPlex-LISTEN（预测助手静音时消费多帧）与 DiffuPlex-SPEAK（亦可消费预测的助手语音）。
AI.result: 在双工交互与口语语言评测中，LISTEN 和 SPEAK 分别取得 1.46× 和 1.59× 的部署路径墙钟加速，Core LM 加速为 1.61× 和 1.80×，所有骨干调用均在 80ms 交互间隔内完成。人工评测显示 LISTEN 保持语音自然度与对话质量，SPEAK 保持对话质量但语音自然度有所下降。
AI.conclusion: DiffuPlex 在显著降低顺序骨干计算的同时，基本保持交互行为与通用能力，为低延迟全双工语音对话提供了可行的加速方案。

title: Stride Independent Patching for Deep Learning
summary: This paper presents semi-automatic stride-independent patching (SSP) as an alternative to automatic stride-dependent patching techniques. SSP uses user or expert input to position predefined patches over one or more objects of interest. To evaluate its effectiveness, three patch-based datasets were created using SSP, overlapping patching (Overlap), and non-overlapping patching (Noverlap). DeepLabV3+ models with ResNet50, ResNet18, and MobileNetV2 backbones were trained sepa-rately on each dataset. Quantitative evaluations were performed on the respective test splits and a common external test set. SSP generally achieved higher segmentation scores on the test splits and required the shortest model training time across all three backbones. On the external test set, SSP achieved the highest average precision and F1-score across backbones, whereas Noverlap achieved the highest average recall. These preliminary results demonstrate that the potentially greater spatial coverage of Noverlap and Overlap does not generally translate into better segmentation perfor-mance and that SSP offers a favorable balance between segmentation performance and model training time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出半自动、与步幅无关的切块方法SSP，通过与重叠(Overlap)和非重叠(Noverlap)切块对比，验证其在分割性能与训练时间上的平衡优势。
AI.motivation: 自动切块技术通常依赖步幅(stride)，其参数设置会影响样本生成。作者希望探索一种不依赖固定步幅、由用户或专家参与定位的切块方式(SSP)，以在分割性能与训练成本之间取得更优平衡。
AI.method: SSP利用用户或专家输入，将预定义的patch定位在一个或多个感兴趣目标上。基于SSP、重叠切块(Overlap)和非重叠切块(Noverlap)分别构建三个patch数据集，并分别训练以ResNet50、ResNet18、MobileNetV2为骨干的DeepLabV3+模型；在各自测试集和共同外部测试集上进行定量评估。
AI.result: 在各自测试集上，SSP总体获得更高的分割分数，且在三种骨干网络下均实现最短的训练时间。在外部测试集上，SSP在三种骨干下取得最高的平均精度和F1分数，而Noverlap获得最高的平均召回率。
AI.conclusion: 初步结果表明，Noverlap和Overlap可能带来的更大空间覆盖并不必然转化为更好的分割性能，SSP在分割性能与模型训练时间之间提供了有利的折中。

title: VibeEdit: Image Editing with Canvas Instructions
summary: In text-guided image editing, describing the desired change is often straightforward, but identifying the intended object or region can be cumbersome, especially when several objects look alike. We introduce a new image editing interface that lets users place spatial marks and optional short notes directly on the image. Together, these annotations form a canvas instruction that specifies where to edit and what to change. Our editor, VibeEdit, follows these instructions to perform object addition, removal, replacement, attribute modification, and movement without a separate text prompt. We construct 1.55 million source-target edit pairs with object masks and structured edit descriptions, from which we render canvas instructions during training. We adapt Qwen-Image-Edit with layer-decoupled conditioning that separately encodes source images and canvas instructions for image editing. We train the model with region-weighted supervised fine-tuning, followed by rubric-guided reinforcement learning to improve edit completion, local edit quality, and preservation of unedited regions. We evaluate VibeEdit on an independently constructed, human-curated benchmark of 419 cases emphasizing target selection among similar objects. VibeEdit achieves a VLM rubric score of 79.9 and an outside-region PSNR of 32.8 dB, compared with 67.4 and 24.0 dB for FireRed, the highest-scoring text-instructed baseline in our evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出VibeEdit，一种基于画布指令（空间标记+短注释）的图像编辑界面，无需文本提示即可完成对象的添加、删除、替换、属性修改与移动。
AI.motivation: 文本引导图像编辑中，描述期望的修改通常容易，但精确定位目标对象或区域却很繁琐，尤其是当多个对象外观相似时，仅靠文本难以准确指定待编辑目标。
AI.method: 构建155万对源-目标编辑对（含对象掩码与结构化编辑描述），训练时渲染为画布指令；基于Qwen-Image-Edit引入层解耦条件（分别编码源图像与画布指令）；采用区域加权监督微调，再用评分标准引导的强化学习优化编辑完成度、局部编辑质量与未编辑区域保持。
AI.result: 在独立构建、人工筛选的419例基准（侧重点为相似对象间目标选择）上，VibeEdit取得VLM评分79.9、区域外PSNR 32.8 dB；文本指令基线中得分最高的FireRed分别为67.4与24.0 dB。
AI.conclusion: 空间标记与短注释构成的画布指令能有效替代文本提示，在目标定位与编辑质量上显著优于纯文本引导方法，并更好地保持未编辑区域。

title: From Prompting to Composing: A Spatial Canvas Interface for Poster Generation
summary: Text prompting is an indirect interface for poster generation, requiring users to encode inherently two-dimensional composition intent into a one-dimensional sequence of words. We introduce a Spatial Canvas Interface that enables users to directly compose generation intent in space through four complementary binding types: semantic, identity, text, and pixel, together with Text Specifications for individual elements and global appearance. Based on this interface, we develop Compo, a poster generation model adapted from a pretrained image editing model to understand Spatial Canvas inputs and Text Specifications. Compo supports both direct inference, where users explicitly construct the canvas, and agentic mode, where a high-level request is automatically translated into a planned Spatial Canvas. To train Compo, we develop a scalable pipeline that automatically constructs supervision data for different binding types and their combinations, enabling efficient adaptation without training a specialized poster generator from scratch. We further introduce a benchmark that evaluates adherence to individual binding types and their joint composition. Experiments show that Compo achieves stronger compositional controllability than both general-purpose image generation models and dedicated poster generation systems while maintaining high visual quality. By decoupling intent specification from visual generation, our work shifts poster generation from prompting toward composing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出空间画布接口（Spatial Canvas Interface）与海报生成模型 Compo，将海报生成从"提示词生成"转向"空间构图"，通过四类绑定实现更强的构图可控性。
AI.motivation: 文本提示是间接的海报生成接口，用户需将本质上是二维的构图意图压缩成一维词序列，导致构图意图表达受限、可控性不足。作者希望让用户直接在空间中表达生成意图。
AI.method: 提出 Spatial Canvas Interface，支持语义、身份、文本、像素四种互补绑定类型，并为单个元素与整体外观提供 Text Specifications。基于该接口构建 Compo 模型，由预训练图像编辑模型适配而来，支持直接推理（用户显式构建画布）与智能体模式（高层请求自动转译为规划好的空间画布）。训练上设计可扩展流水线，自动构造不同绑定类型及其组合的监督数据，无需从头训练专用海报生成器。同时提出评测基准，衡量对各类绑定及联合构图的遵循程度。
AI.result: 实验表明，Compo 在构图可控性上优于通用图像生成模型与专用海报生成系统，同时保持较高的视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过将意图指定与视觉生成解耦，该工作将海报生成从"提示"范式推进到"构图"范式。

title: Language Models as AI Research World Models
summary: AI research agents automate the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments, opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them in real environments, making outcome prediction a key capability for sustained self-improvement under limited experimental budgets. We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将语言模型作为"研究世界模型"（RWM），用于预测候选实验干预的结果，并基于9个研究环境、2600余条实验记录验证了研究知识对预测能力、跨环境迁移与自动研究选择预算分配的提升作用。
AI.motivation: AI研究智能体提出实验的能力远超其在真实环境中执行实验的能力，在有限实验预算下，准确预测实验结果成为持续自我改进的关键能力，因此需要研究语言模型能否充当研究世界模型。
AI.method: 构建Research World Model（RWM）框架，令语言模型预测候选干预在不同研究环境中的结果；评估使用9个研究环境（涵盖预训练、后训练、推理）、2600余条实验记录、累计超171,000 H100 GPU小时的实验数据；并设计零经验、环境内经验、跨环境经验等设定，以及多轮Autoresearch固定选择预算实验，并在13个语言模型上做消融。
AI.result: 从真实实验经验获得的研究知识能提升同环境内未见干预的预测（Spearman +0.27），并可跨环境复用：仅用OLMo3、Marin、Nanochat的预训练经验，RWM在Qwen3环境中将选择遗憾降低78%；在固定预算多轮Autoresearch中，具备环境内与跨环境研究知识分别使最佳增益提升15.8%和11.6%；消融显示加入研究知识对干预排序的提升超过更换模型或增加推理投入。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持语言模型作为研究世界模型，并说明积累实验数据以训练未来RWM具有重要价值。

title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing distributes inference work across different models, advancing the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM serving. While coarse-grained routing at the session or query level has been widely adopted in production systems, recent algorithmic work shows that fine-grained token-level routing can yield substantial efficiency and quality gains. However, efficiently serving token-level routed inference poses significant challenges to existing systems. Built on single-LLM assumptions, current systems suffer from severe step desynchronization and frequent batch admission delays under token-level routing, and they also impose high implementation complexity on developers. To address these challenges, we design TokenRouter, an efficient and developer-friendly serving system for token-level routed LLM inference. TokenRouter follows the principle of request-centric programming, model-centric execution: developers describe routing logic from the perspective of a single request, while the runtime launches a subserver for each LLM and dispatches requests asynchronously. Each subserver employs a delayed-batching scheduler, whose optimal hyperparameters are derived from a mathematical throughput model of the system. Across diverse routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs, TokenRouter achieves 2.01-64.15x higher decoding throughput than existing systems, substantially advancing the serving efficiency of token-level LLM routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter.

AI.tldr: TokenRouter 是一个面向 token 级路由 LLM 推理的高效、开发者友好的服务系统，采用"请求中心编程、模型中心执行"原则，通过子服务器与延迟批处理调度器，将解码吞吐提升 2.01–64.15 倍。
AI.motivation: LLM 路由可在多模型间分配推理负载，推进成本-质量帕累托前沿。会话级或查询级粗粒度路由已广泛用于生产，但近期算法表明 token 级细粒度路由能带来显著效率与质量收益。然而现有系统基于"单 LLM"假设，在 token 级路由下会出现严重的步调失同步（step desynchronization）与频繁的批次准入延迟，且给开发者带来高实现复杂度。
AI.method: 提出 TokenRouter，遵循"请求中心编程、模型中心执行"原则：开发者仅从单个请求视角描述路由逻辑，运行时为每个 LLM 启动一个子服务器（subserver）并异步派发请求。每个子服务器采用延迟批处理（delayed-batching）调度器，其最优超参数由系统的数学吞吐模型推导得到。
AI.result: 在多种路由算法、工作负载与模型组合下，TokenRouter 的解码吞吐比现有系统高 2.01–64.15 倍，显著提升了 token 级 LLM 路由的服务效率。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: TokenRouter 有效解决了 token 级路由推理中的系统级挑战，兼顾高效性与开发者友好性，为 token 级 LLM 路由的服务部署提供了可行方案。

title: NativeScope: Relation-Localized Retrieval over Native Topology with a Correct Anchor
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, and 6 tables. Includes an appendix with reproduction information and an evidence inventory
summary: Dense retrieval usually ranks text chunks by their semantic similarity to a question. This ignores structure that many data systems already store, including section membership, session boundaries, and native order. We propose NativeScope, a scope-then-rank method for queries with a known anchor and relation. It represents a query as q -> (A, r, B). The anchor A and relation r select native units through belonging, before, or after operators, and the target term B ranks only chunks that overlap the selected scope. An internal variant, NS-FullQ, ranks the same candidates with the full question. We evaluate both methods on 200 controlled document and memory records derived from QASPER and LongMemEval under a 1,024-token budget. NativeScope attains native-unit recall of 89.28 percent for documents and 72.50 percent for memories, improving over instance-wide Dense RAG by 42.75 and 22.00 percentage points. NS-FullQ reaches 87.78 percent and 68.50 percent; its differences from NativeScope are inconclusive, locating the primary gain in relational scoping rather than the shorter ranking query. With automatic Top-1 anchors, memory recall falls to 35.50 percent. NativeScope is therefore effective when anchor coordinates and native relations are reliable, but hard scoping inherits errors from the localization interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NativeScope方法：将查询表示为q -> (A, r, B)，先用锚点A和关系r通过belonging/before/after算子选定原生单元（scope），再用目标词B在选定范围内排序，从而利用数据系统中已有的结构信息（章节、会话边界、原生顺序）。
AI.motivation: 密集检索通常仅依据文本块与问题的语义相似度排序，忽略了数据系统已存储的结构信息，如章节归属、会话边界和原生顺序。
AI.method: 提出scope-then-rank的NativeScope方法，将查询表示为q -> (A, r, B)：锚点A和关系r通过belonging、before、after算子选择原生单元，目标词B仅在所选范围内对重叠块排序；并设置内部变体NS-FullQ，用完整问题对相同候选排序。在QASPER与LongMemEval派生的200条受控文档和记忆记录上，于1,024 token预算下评估。
AI.result: NativeScope在文档和记忆上的原生单元召回率分别为89.28%和72.50%，较instance-wide Dense RAG分别提升42.75和22.00个百分点；NS-FullQ为87.78%和68.50%，与NativeScope差异不显著。使用自动Top-1锚点时，记忆召回降至35.50%。
AI.conclusion: 当锚点坐标和原生关系可靠时NativeScope有效，主要增益来自关系式scoping而非更短的排序查询；但硬性scoping会继承定位接口的误差。

title: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 25 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://egocentricvoice.github.io/
summary: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EgoVoice，一个用于训练与评估主动式第一人称语音助手的框架，解决在连续第一人称音视频流中"何时说话"与"说什么"的联合决策问题。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴 AR 助手正朝持续真实世界交互发展，需要借助第一人称视频与音频感知用户活动，并在未被明确询问时主动提供及时语音指导。尽管主动式视频助手、口语对话系统和第一人称任务理解各自进展迅速，但现有系统均未解决从连续第一人称流中同时决定发言时机与发言内容的联合问题。
AI.method: 基于 HoloAssist 真实人类指导者的视频记录，通过声源分离与语音重合成构建干净音频流，并将每个视频会话转换为模型需在每个时刻决定保持沉默或给出语音指导的格式。随后用该数据微调一个全模态大语言模型（omni-modal LLM），并进一步通过直接偏好优化（DPO）改进其主动干预行为。
AI.result: 在闭源与开源模型上的实验表明，现有系统很少产生时机恰当且有意义的主动干预；相较零样本骨干模型，EgoVoice 在干预时机、内容相关性和人类偏好方面均有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: EgoVoice 为主动式第一人称语音助手提供了可行的训练与评估范式，验证了数据构建、全模态微调与 DPO 相结合能有效提升主动干预的时机与内容质量。

title: Syn-Omni: Structured Specialization and Progressive Collaboration for Omnimodal Embeddings
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Long, Findings). Code: https://github.com/sony/syn-omni
summary: Omnimodal embeddings naturally involve both shared representations and modality-specific features across heterogeneous inputs. However, existing omnimodal embedding methods often rely on a single shared parameter space over mixed-modality data, limiting structural separation between universal and modality-specific representations. To address this, we propose Syn-Omni, a unified framework for structured omnimodal adaptation with modality specialization and controlled cross-modal collaboration. Specifically, we introduce Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA (OME-LoRA), which decomposes adaptation into a shared LoRA path for universal semantics and modality-expert LoRA paths for modality-aware specialization. Furthermore, Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) enables experts to first establish modality-specific priors, then gradually interact with other modality-experts for cross-modal synergy. Evaluated across 81 diverse tasks spanning image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities, Syn-Omni consistently outperforms omnimodal baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured specialization and cross-modal progressive collaboration.

AI.tldr: 提出 Syn-Omni 统一框架，用正交模态专家 LoRA 与渐进协同路由实现结构化全模态适配。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态嵌入方法通常在混合模态数据上依赖单一共享参数空间，难以在结构上区分通用表示与模态特有表示。
AI.method: OME-LoRA 将适配分解为共享 LoRA 路径（通用语义）与模态专家 LoRA 路径（模态特化）；PSR 让专家先建立模态先验，再逐步与其他模态专家交互形成跨模态协同。
AI.result: 在图像、视频、音频和视听四类共 81 个任务上评估，Syn-Omni 持续优于全模态基线。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的模态特化与跨模态渐进协同是有效的全模态适配方案。

title: DVD: Dynamic Vector Decoding for Efficient MLLM-based Perception
summary: Multimodal large language models have made remarkable progress in bridging vision and language, facilitating various perception tasks essential for human-machine interaction, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, existing MLLM-based perception methods predominantly rely on text-based coordinate representation, which suffers from excessive token overhead, or fixed-range quantization, which suffers from range and precision constraints, especially for 3D domains with unbounded spatial range and high localization accuracy requirements. To address these challenges, we propose a dynamic vector decoding method named DVD, which unifies the representation of 2D and 3D perception tasks. Specifically, we first transform diverse perceptual representation (i.e., 2D bounding boxes, 2D masks, and 3D bounding boxes) into 1D vector sequences, which are then mapped to compact discrete tokens in the high-dimensional space. Then, a lightweight de-tokenizer enables seamless integration with MLLMs by decoding output tokens back to original 2D and 3D perceptual representations. Extensive experiments on 2D and 3D perception benchmarks including RefCOCO series, SUN-RGBD, KITTI, Hypersim, nuScenes demonstrate that DVD achieves superior performance in 2D and 3D tasks and reduces significantly the token overhead and inference latency. DVD provides an efficient and general framework for integrating perception capabilities into MLLMs, overcoming the inherent limitations of existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态向量解码方法DVD，将2D与3D感知任务统一表示为高维离散token序列，通过轻量级去分词器与MLLM无缝集成，显著降低token开销与推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型感知方法要么依赖文本坐标表示导致token开销过大，要么采用固定范围量化受限于范围和精度，难以应对3D领域无界空间范围与高定位精度需求。
AI.method: DVD先将多种感知表示（2D边界框、2D掩码、3D边界框）转化为1D向量序列，再映射到高维空间的紧凑离散token；随后用轻量级de-tokenizer将输出token解码回原始2D/3D感知表示，实现与MLLM的无缝集成。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO系列、SUN-RGBD、KITTI、Hypersim、nuScenes等2D与3D感知基准上，DVD在2D和3D任务中均取得优越性能，并显著降低token开销与推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: DVD为将感知能力集成到MLLM提供了高效且通用的框架，克服了现有方法的固有局限。

title: HarnessSQL: Harness-Native Training for SQL Agents in Realistic Database Environments
summary: Text-to-SQL models are commonly trained to map questions directly to static queries, whereas real-world database agents operate through stateful, multi-turn interaction with live databases -- inspecting schemas, executing probe queries, diagnosing errors, and revising hypotheses. This creates a critical train-deploy mismatch, as the execution harness that mediates this interaction is introduced only at inference time. To bridge this gap, we propose HarnessSQL, a harness-native post-training framework that preserves the full interaction structure throughout both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. HarnessSQL builds isolated, executable database environments paired with hidden execution oracles, rolls out teachers directly inside the target SQL harness, and retains only verified trajectories for full-sequence SFT, followed by execution-reward RL. Across Spider 2.0-SQLite, HarnessSQL dramatically boosts the execution accuracy of compact models, raising Qwen3-8B from 15.5% to 45.2% and Qwen3-14B from 22.2% to 54.8%, while transferring effectively to out-of-distribution interactive benchmarks such as BIRD-Interact and LiveSQLBench. Our findings demonstrate that training database agents directly within their execution harness is essential for mastering complex, long-horizon database workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出HarnessSQL，一种在完整交互执行框架内进行后训练（SFT+RL）的框架，用于弥合Text-to-SQL的训练-部署不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 传统Text-to-SQL模型训练时直接将问题映射为静态查询，而真实的数据库智能体需要与实时数据库进行有状态的多轮交互（检查schema、执行探测查询、诊断错误、修正假设）。这导致训练与部署之间的严重不匹配，因为调节此交互的执行框架只在推理时引入。
AI.method: HarnessSQL在监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）全过程中保留完整交互结构：构建隔离的可执行数据库环境并搭配隐藏执行预言机（oracle），让教师模型直接在目标SQL执行框架内展开rollout，仅保留经过验证的轨迹用于全序列SFT，随后进行执行奖励驱动的RL。
AI.result: 在Spider 2.0-SQLite上大幅提升小模型的执行准确率：Qwen3-8B从15.5%提升至45.2%，Qwen3-14B从22.2%提升至54.8%，并能有效迁移到BIRD-Interact、LiveSQLBench等分布外交互式基准。
AI.conclusion: 直接在执行框架内训练数据库智能体，对于掌握复杂、长周期的数据库工作流至关重要。

title: Slot3R: Set-Associative Spatial Memory for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction must preserve evidence from each frame while processing an expanding scene online. Spatial memory is a natural fit because it organizes history by reconstructed 3D location. Yet Point3R uses spatial proximity both to associate a new observation with an existing memory entry and to decide whether to fuse it, conflating co-location with state identity. Because pointers summarize image patches, nearby pointers may encode distinct surfaces, viewpoints, or visibility conditions; averaging them can destroy complementary evidence before later frames disambiguate it. We argue that location should determine address, not whether observations must merge. Slot3R realizes this principle as a training-free, set-associative retrofit that lets multiple states coexist at a shared address while keeping the pretrained Point3R backbone frozen. A bounded sparse readout further decouples persistent storage from per-frame decoder access. At 300-500 sampled frames, Slot3R reduces Point3R's point-cloud accuracy error (Acc) by 57.1%-63.1% on 7Scenes and 64.0%-72.0% on NeuralRGBD, lowers Sim(3)-aligned absolute trajectory error (ATE) on all three pose benchmarks, and remains competitive on video-depth estimation. It completes all evaluated settings from 600 to 1000 sampled frames at about 19 FPS under the same protocol, whereas Point3R and InfiniteVGGT run out of memory at 800 frames and beyond.

AI.tldr: 提出Slot3R：一种免训练的集合关联式改造，将空间槽的"地址"与"融合判定"解耦，允许同一地址共存多状态，在冻结Point3R骨干的前提下显著提升流式3D重建精度与显存可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 流式3D重建需在处理不断扩张的场景时保留每一帧的证据，空间记忆因按重建3D位置组织历史而天然适配。但Point3R用空间近邻同时完成"新观测与已有记忆条目的关联"和"是否融合"两个决策，把共址（co-location）与状态同一性（state identity）混为一谈。由于指针（pointer）是对图像块的摘要，邻近指针可能对应不同表面、视角或可见性条件，直接平均会在后续帧尚能消歧之前就破坏互补证据。
AI.method: 核心主张是位置只应决定地址（address），而不应决定观测是否必须合并。Slot3R据此实现为免训练（training-free）、集合关联（set-associative）的改造：允许同一地址上多个状态共存，同时保持预训练的Point3R骨干冻结。并引入有界稀疏读出（bounded sparse readout），将持久化存储与逐帧解码器访问解耦。
AI.result: 在300–500采样帧下，Slot3R将Point3R的点云精度误差（Acc）在7Scenes上降低57.1%–63.1%，在NeuralRGBD上降低64.0%–72.0%；在全部三个位姿基准上降低Sim(3)对齐的绝对轨迹误差（ATE），并在视频深度估计上保持竞争力。在相同协议下，600至1000采样帧的所有评测设置均可在约19 FPS下完成，而Point3R与InfiniteVGGT在800帧及以上会出现显存不足（OOM）。
AI.conclusion: 以"位置决定地址、而非决定合并"为原则的集合关联式空间记忆设计，能在不重训练骨干的情况下大幅提升流式3D重建的几何精度、位姿精度与长序列可扩展性。

title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
summary: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World), which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents' target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 ME-World 多智能体自我中心世界模型，通过对多路 ego 流联合去噪、以全体智能体目标视角位姿为条件、并借助共享环境记忆，实现细粒度交互下的同步自我中心世界建模。
AI.motivation: 现有自我中心世界模型多针对单智能体；真实具身场景常涉及多智能体在同一环境中的交互。而已有多智能体世界模型多依赖粗粒度动作（移动、相机控制或离散指令），细粒度具身交互建模不足。
AI.method: 将多智能体自我中心世界建模定义为多智能体细粒度交互下的同步 ego 流生成，需满足跨视角动作一致性、共享环境一致性和交互诱发状态更新的传播一致性。提出 ME-World：在共享 token 序列中联合去噪多路 ego 流，以所有智能体的目标视角位姿为各流条件，并用共享环境记忆约束生成。
AI.result: 在真实与合成多智能体数据上训练评估，并提出共享世界一致性指标（环境一致性、更新一致性、身份一致性）。实验表明 ME-World 在共享世界一致性、动作控制、身份保持和视频质量上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: ME-World 将多智能体自我中心世界建模推进到细粒度交互与共享环境一致性层面，联合去噪与共享环境记忆是提升一致性与控制效果的关键，所提指标为多智能体世界模型评估提供了依据。

title: From What to Which: Decoding Modifier Grounding in Frozen MLLMs
summary: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can describe increasingly complex visual scenes, token-level grounding becomes crucial. Yet, when an MLLM generates "the yellow banana on the left", established grounding approaches focus on what is in the image ("banana"), overlooking tokens that help describe which instance is meant ("yellow", "left"). In this work, we ask whether frozen MLLM representations contain decodable grounding information about the referred instance across generated tokens, extending to modifiers such as attributes, spatial expressions, and relational/action terms. To address this question, we introduce OTTER, a lightweight supervised probe over frozen MLLM representations that uses Optimal Transport (OT) to align generated tokens with visual regions and produce compact grounding maps. Our results show that (i) instance-discriminative visual information can be decoded from modifier tokens, with the clearest evidence for spatial terms, but (ii) is not confined to them, as contextualized object nouns also carry referential information; (iii) the recovered grounding remains informative under context perturbations, while selected regions remain relevant to generation; and (iv) the learned OT-based grounding extends beyond the controlled setting to free generation and cross-dataset transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出OTTER——一个基于冻结MLLM表征的轻量监督探针，利用最优传输对齐生成token与视觉区域，证明修饰词（尤其空间词）及上下文名词均可解码出实例判别性视觉信息，并在上下文扰动、自由生成与跨数据集迁移中保持有效。
AI.motivation: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能描述日益复杂的视觉场景，token级别的视觉定位变得关键。但现有定位方法在MLLM生成“左边那根黄香蕉”时，只关注图像中有什么（“香蕉”），忽视了帮助确定具体实例的token（“黄色”“左边”）。因此需要探究冻结MLLM表征中是否蕴含关于被指代实例的可解码定位信息，并扩展到属性、空间表达式和关系/动作词等修饰语。
AI.method: 提出OTTER：在冻结MLLM表征上训练轻量级监督探针，利用最优传输（Optimal Transport, OT）将生成的token与视觉区域对齐，生成紧凑的定位图。通过上下文扰动实验检验所恢复定位的信息量，并评估其从受控设定到自由生成与跨数据集迁移的泛化能力。
AI.result: （i）修饰词token可解码出具有实例判别性的视觉信息，其中空间词证据最清晰；（ii）该信息并不局限于修饰词，上下文中的物体名词同样携带指代信息；（iii）在上下文扰动下恢复的定位仍具信息量，所选区域仍与生成相关；（iv）基于OT学习到的定位能从受控设定泛化到自由生成及跨数据集迁移。
AI.conclusion: 冻结MLLM的token表征中普遍蕴含可解码的实例级定位信息，不限于指代物名词，修饰词（尤其空间表达式）是重要来源；OT对齐是一种有效且泛化性强的token级定位手段，为更细粒度的视觉定位提供依据。

title: BudgetPix: Compute-Adaptive Tokenization for Pixel-Space Image Diffusion
comment: More details are available at our project page: https://karaozgur.com/BudgetPix
summary: Most image generation models rely on uniform tokenization, allocating the exact same computational budget to equally-sized image patches. This static paradigm cannot adapt to different resource constraints at inference time, and yields suboptimal quality-cost tradeoff by devoting the same effort to both plain backgrounds and intricate details. We propose BudgetPix, an adaptive tokenization framework that dynamically allocates compute based on visual complexity and spatial layout, enabling flexible computational budgeting at inference time. BudgetPix comprises three key components: (1) an adaptive encoder that maps a fixed-size image to a variable-length token sequence using an entropy-guided quadtree alongside a multi-scale patch embedder; (2) a scale-aware decoder reconstructs fixed-resolution images from multi-scale token sets; and (3) a flexible training and sampling schedule that enables pixel-space denoisers to operate across variable token counts. BudgetPix seamlessly integrates with existing pixel-space diffusion architectures, enabling a single checkpoint to be operated at a wide range of compute budgets. Evaluated on text-to-image generation, BudgetPix matches the fidelity of MiniT2I-L at $512^2$ and PixelDiT at $1024^2$ using just 25% of the original compute budget. In class-conditional generation using a MeanFlow backbone, BudgetPix requires merely 60% of the full compute budget to produce images with near-zero quality degradation, observing a marginal 0.8-point increase in FID. Comprehensive assessments by human and VLM judges confirm that BudgetPix establishes a significantly improved quality-efficiency tradeoff over prior budget-adaptive baselines. More details are available at our project page: https://karaozgur.com/BudgetPix

AI.tldr: BudgetPix 提出一种自适应 tokenization 框架，根据视觉复杂度与空间布局动态分配计算量，实现推理时灵活的计算预算调节，并可与现有像素空间扩散架构无缝集成。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成模型多采用均匀 tokenization，对等尺寸图像块分配相同计算预算。这种静态范式无法适应推理时的资源约束，且对平淡背景与复杂细节投入相同计算，导致质量-成本权衡次优。
AI.method: BudgetPix 包含三个关键组件：(1) 自适应编码器，利用熵引导四叉树与多尺度图像块嵌入器，将固定尺寸图像映射为可变长度 token 序列；(2) 尺度感知解码器，从多尺度 token 集合重建固定分辨率图像；(3) 灵活的训练与采样调度，使像素空间去噪器能在可变 token 数量下运行。
AI.result: 在文本到图像生成任务中，BudgetPix 仅用原计算预算的 25%，在 512² 分辨率下匹配 MiniT2I-L 的保真度，在 1024² 下匹配 PixelDiT。在使用 MeanFlow 骨干的类别条件生成中，仅需 60% 的完整计算预算即可实现近乎零的质量下降，FID 仅增加 0.8 点。人类与 VLM 评测均证实其质量-效率权衡显著优于先前的预算自适应基线。
AI.conclusion: BudgetPix 通过自适应 tokenization 实现了显著改进的质量-效率权衡，单个检查点即可在广泛的计算预算范围内运行，为图像生成提供了灵活且高效的解决方案。

title: Is In-Domain Training Enough for Fine-Grained Industrial Anomaly Understanding?
summary: A single multimodal large language model (MLLM) struggles to excel simultaneously at detection, localization, description, and reasoning in multimodal industrial anomaly understanding (MM-IAU). We show that in-domain training does not close this gap. On MMAD, a widely adopted MM-IAU benchmark, trained specialists reach at most 75.5% accuracy in defect localization, against 92.3% for human experts, and even detect anomalies less accurately than their untrained base model. Meanwhile, different MLLMs offer complementary strengths but share this weakness in fine-grained perception, so combining them alone cannot remove it. We therefore propose SiGMA, a spatially grounded multi-agent framework that divides labor between heterogeneous MLLM agents and a dedicated visual defect expert. A multimodal searcher supplies industrial knowledge and normal references, the defect expert turns query-reference comparison into calibrated anomaly evidence, and a label-free reliability controller weighs each source by task-wise competence and query-level evidence quality. SiGMA reaches 85.2% average accuracy on MMAD, 4.0% above the strongest trained specialist and Gemini-2.5-Pro and within 1.5% of human experts. Even with three agents of at most 9B parameters, it reaches 84.4%, and new MLLMs join without retraining.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对多模态工业异常理解（MM-IAU）中单一多模态大模型难以兼顾检测、定位、描述与推理的问题，提出空间接地的多智能体框架SiGMA，在MMAD基准上达到85.2%平均准确率，接近人类专家水平。
AI.motivation: 单个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）难以同时在检测、定位、描述和推理上表现出色，且领域内训练无法弥合这一差距：在MMAD基准上，训练后的专家模型缺陷定位准确率最高仅75.5%，远低于人类专家的92.3%，甚至检测异常能力不如其未训练的基座模型。不同MLLM各有互补优势，但共享细粒度感知的短板，单纯组合无法解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出SiGMA——一种空间接地的多智能体框架。将任务分工给异构MLLM智能体与专用视觉缺陷专家：多模态检索器提供工业知识与正常参考；缺陷专家将查询-参考对比转化为校准的异常证据；无标签可靠性控制器依据任务级能力与查询级证据质量对每个信息源加权。
AI.result: SiGMA在MMAD上达到85.2%平均准确率，比最强训练专家及Gemini-2.5-Pro高4.0%，与人类专家差距在1.5%以内。即使仅使用三个不超过9B参数的智能体，也能达到84.4%，且新MLLM可直接加入而无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: 空间接地的多智能体协作架构能有效弥补单一MLLM在细粒度工业异常感知上的不足，在接近人类专家水平的同时具备良好可扩展性，支持新模型即插即用。

title: Verdict Without the Rule: Diagnosing and Auditing Regulatory Rule Sensitivity in LLM Compliance Systems
summary: Large language model compliance systems are deployed on the assumption that a verdict depends on the regulatory rule it is given. We test this directly across five models and 20 regulatory and platform-policy domains: delete, swap, or negate the governing rule while holding the case fixed, and check whether the verdict changes (OCS) or the model's internal representation of compliance shifts at all (ICS-delta). Neither moves much: models' verdicts are often invariant to substantial perturbations of the supplied rule, and the guard model, evaluated here under a custom-rule adaptation of its native taxonomy, is the least rule-sensitive and least accurate of the five, barely above chance (51%, versus 90-92% for general-purpose models). This reflects easy cases more than blanket neglect: on cases where deleting the rule changes a previously correct model prediction, models do track it closely. Neither better prompting nor direct intervention on the model's internal representations closes this gap. Accuracy alone does not establish that a compliance verdict is grounded in the supplied rule.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验合规判定是否真正依赖所给规则：在5个模型与20个监管/平台政策域中，删除、替换或否定规则并保持案例不变，发现判定（OCS）与内部合规表征（ICS-delta）几乎不变，说明合规判定未必以给定规则为依据。
AI.motivation: 合规系统部署的前提假设是：模型的判定取决于其所接收的监管规则。若该假设不成立，则高准确率可能只是对案例难易度的反映，而非真正的规则遵循，从而动摇合规系统的可信度与有效性。作者因此要直接检验判定对规则的敏感性。
AI.method: 在5个模型、20个监管与平台政策域上做规则扰动实验：固定案例不变，对管辖规则进行删除、替换或否定，观察两项指标——判定是否变化（OCS）以及模型内部合规表征是否位移（ICS-delta）。同时评估一个guard模型（在其原生分类法上做自定义规则适配），并检验两种改进手段（更好的提示、对内部表征的直接干预）能否弥合差距。
AI.result: 判定与内部表征在规则大幅扰动下均变化甚微；guard模型对规则最不敏感且最不准确，仅略高于随机（51%），而通用模型为90–92%。这一现象更多反映案例本身容易，而非全面忽视规则：当删除规则会改变模型原本正确的预测时，模型对规则追踪得很紧。更好的提示与内部表征干预均未能缩小这一缺口。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭准确率无法证明合规判定建立在所给规则之上。规则敏感性与内部表征指标应作为合规评估的必要维度，否则难以区分真正的规则遵循与依赖表面案例线索或先验的伪合规行为。

title: Controllable Exaggeration for Generative Motion Models via Training-Time Adaptation and Inference-Time Guidance
summary: Recent motion generative models have demonstrated strong capabilities in synthesizing physically plausible character motion, but often overlook established animation principles used by professional animators to ground and design their animation work. Understanding and incorporating these principles into motion generative pipelines is essential for producing motions that serve not only physically grounded applications but also the needs of the character animation community. This enables the creation of characters that not only move in physically plausible ways but also feel alive, expressive, and engaging. To close this gap, we focus on the Exaggeration principle of animation and investigate how it can be incorporated into modern motion generative pipelines to produce more expressive character motions. To this end, we introduce a framework that operates at two stages of existing motion generative pipelines. The first stage introduces exaggeration during training, where we perform supervised fine-tuning of pre-trained text-to-motion models on our curated exaggeration dataset. The second stage operates at inference time, where we: (i) introduce a mathematical formulation of exaggeration based on dynamic movement primitives (DMPs); and (ii) leverage this formulation as an exaggeration guidance signal to guide existing diffusion and flow-matching text-to-motion generation models toward exaggerated motion without additional training. Through qualitative and quantitative evaluations against three strong motion generation models, we show that our methods generate more exaggerated and expressive motions while preserving neutral reference motion intent and physical plausibility.

AI.tldr: 该论文聚焦动画中的"夸张"原则，提出一个两阶段框架，将夸张融入文本到动作生成流程：训练阶段用自建夸张数据集微调预训练模型，推理阶段基于动态运动基元（DMPs）给出夸张的数学形式化并作为引导信号，无需额外训练即可引导扩散与流匹配模型生成夸张动作。实验表明方法在保持动作意图与物理合理性的同时提升了夸张性与表现力。
AI.motivation: 现有动作生成模型虽能合成物理合理的角色动作，但忽视了专业动画师遵循的动画原则；将动画原则（尤其是夸张原则）纳入生成流程，才能产出既物理合理又生动、富有表现力、引人入胜的角色动作，服务动画创作需求。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。(1) 训练阶段：在自建的夸张数据集上对预训练文本到动作模型进行有监督微调，引入夸张。(2) 推理阶段：(i) 基于动态运动基元(DMPs)提出夸张的数学形式化；(ii) 将该形式化作为夸张引导信号，在无需额外训练的情况下引导现有扩散与流匹配文本到动作生成模型生成夸张动作。
AI.result: 与三个强基线动作生成模型进行定性与定量评估，所提方法生成的动作更具夸张性与表现力，同时保持中性参考动作意图与物理合理性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将动画夸张原则与动作生成流程结合，论文提供了一条可兼顾物理合理性与艺术表现力的实用路径，既服务于动画社区对生动角色的需求，也为生成模型的可控表达性提供了新思路。

title: SparseDecoding: Decoding-Aware Pruning for Accurate and Efficient LLM Inference
summary: The memory-bound nature of the decoding stage of large language model (LLM) inference incurs significant latency. Layer-wise training-free network pruning approaches guided by the Hessian have been a prominent solution to this problem, as pruning reduces the number of nonzero parameters read from memory during decoding. Nevertheless, typical methods in this line compute the Hessian using pre-collected natural sequences, whereas the model is fed self-generated tokens during decoding, creating a distribution shift between the two sequences. The Hessian calculated on the natural sequence is different from that calculated on the generated sequence. We observe that this discrepancy causes the activation distribution during generation to deviate from that used for pruning, further hurting the pruned model performance. Moreover, most existing LLM pruning methods that bring actual speedup primarily target the sparse matrix-matrix (SpMM) multiplication, providing limited support for the sparse matrix-vector (SpMV) operations, which dominate decoding. To solve these problems, we introduce SparseDecoding, a principled decoding-aware pruning framework tailored for accurate and efficient LLM decoding. Specifically, at the algorithmic axis, SparseDecoding constructs calibration matrices from layer-wise activations collected during the dense-model autoregressive generation, excluding prefill, thereby aligning the pruning objective with the decoding activations. At the system axis, we develop an optimized N:M sparse matrix-vector kernel with bitmask indexing and fixed-step traversal. Substantial empirical results on representative LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen3-14B / 32B) demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms standard fixed-text calibration on the long-form generation benchmarks while achieving up to 1.48x end-to-end wall-clock decoding speedup on A100 GPUs.

AI.tldr: SparseDecoding 通过解码活化校准剪枝目标并结合优化的 N:M SpMV 内核，实现准确且高效的 LLM 解码。
AI.motivation: LLM 解码阶段受内存带宽限制导致高延迟；现有 Hessian 引导的免训练剪枝使用预收集的自然序列计算 Hessian，但解码时输入为自生成 token，存在分布偏移，导致活化分布偏离剪枝所用分布，损害剪枝模型性能；且多数加速方法针对 SpMM，对解码主导的 SpMV 支持有限。
AI.method: 算法层面：从稠密模型自回归生成（排除 prefill）中收集逐层活化构造校准矩阵，使剪枝目标对齐解码活化。系统层面：设计带位掩码索引与固定步长遍历的优化 N:M 稀疏矩阵-向量内核。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen3-14B/32B 等模型上，长文本生成基准一致优于固定文本校准，A100 上端到端解码墙钟加速最高达 1.48 倍。
AI.conclusion: SparseDecoding 是面向解码的剪枝框架，同时改善剪枝精度与 SpMV 解码效率。

title: RiCo: Neural Simulation of Rigid-Body Interactions via Local Contact Reasoning
summary: Accurate simulation of rigid-body interactions is essential for predictive physical world models. Despite recent progress in modeling object dynamics, capturing how local contacts between surfaces shape object motion remains challenging. While end-to-end world models predict interactions across entire scenes or objects, in practice, rigid-body contact is inherently local, and only nearby surfaces can directly exchange contact forces. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Rigid-body Contact Reasoning (RiCo), which represents interactions between objects through sparse neighborhoods of contact surface points. RiCo combines each point's state with the relative geometry, motion, and physical properties of nearby surfaces, then reasons across the object's points to determine how these local contacts jointly affect its motion. By confining cross-object reasoning to nearby surfaces while propagating contact information within each rigid body, RiCo retains fine-grained interaction details without the cost of modeling every pair of scene points. Such properties enable RiCo a higher accuracy and contact fidelity. Experiments on MOVi-benchmark demonstrate that RiCo reduces 100-frame position and orientation errors by 31-35% and approximately 38%, respectively, compared with baselines. Moreover, RiCo achieves high contact fidelity, with ground-truth-relative penetration-time and mean-depth differences of 11.0% and 2.22 mm, respectively. RiCo further generalizes zero-shot from small-scale training scenarios to scenes containing 270 objects. Our real-world multi-ball collision experiments further provide preliminary evidence of sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出刚体接触推理方法RiCo，通过稀疏的接触表面点邻域表示物体间交互，在保持局部接触细节的同时避免建模所有场景点对，在MOVi基准上显著降低长时序位置与姿态误差，并展现零样本泛化与初步的sim-to-real能力。
AI.motivation: 准确模拟刚体交互对预测性物理世界模型至关重要，但现有方法难以刻画表面局部接触如何影响物体运动。端到端世界模型通常对整场景或整物体预测交互，而刚体接触本质上是局部的，只有邻近表面之间才能直接交换接触力，因此全对全建模既低效又损失接触保真度。
AI.method: 提出Rigid-body Contact Reasoning (RiCo)，用接触表面点的稀疏邻域表示物体间交互。RiCo将每个点的状态与邻近表面的相对几何、运动及物理属性相结合，并在物体各点之间进行推理，以确定这些局部接触如何共同影响物体运动。其核心在于将跨物体推理限制在邻近表面，同时在每个刚体内部传播接触信息，从而在无需建模所有场景点对的情况下保留细粒度交互细节。
AI.result: 在MOVi基准上，相比基线方法，RiCo将100帧的位置与朝向误差分别降低31-35%和约38%；接触保真度也较高，相对真值的穿透时间与平均深度差异分别为11.0%与2.22 mm。RiCo还能从中小规模训练场景零样本泛化到包含270个物体的场景，并通过真实世界多球碰撞实验初步验证了sim-to-real迁移。
AI.conclusion: RiCo表明，以稀疏接触表面点邻域为核心的局部接触推理，能够兼顾细粒度交互建模与计算效率，从而提升刚体交互预测的精度与接触保真度，并具备向大规模场景与真实世界迁移的潜力。

title: ContiLNN: Mitigating Slice Sampling Discontinuity with Liquid Neural Networks for Medical Image Restoration
summary: Anatomical continuity provides complementary information for medical image restoration, but its use requires accounting for local anatomy and variations in slice sampling. We introduce ContiLNN, which augments two-dimensional restoration backbones with bidirectional closed-form continuous-time (Bi-CfC) modules for cross-slice modeling while retaining in-plane feature extraction. Slice-index intervals modulate gates determined by local features and hidden states, enabling propagation to respond to sampling variations without numerical ODE integration. Reference-guided consistency aligns first- and second-order cross-slice intensity differences to preserve anatomical variation, while distillation from a frozen backbone helps retain in-plane fidelity. Across five training seeds, ContiLNN improves mean PSNR over Restore-RWKV by 0.1907, 1.0176, and 1.2482 dB for CT denoising, MRI super-resolution, and reduced-count PET restoration, respectively, with lower RMSE in all three tasks. CT results are descriptive for one held-out patient. PET ablations support ordered propagation beyond additional pointwise capacity. Under contiguous training, Bi-CfC achieves higher fidelity than a Bi-GRU with similar parameter counts and arithmetic costs across all tested sampling conditions. Matched seven-slice profiling shows 52.8% lower latency and 57.0% lower peak GPU memory use than Bi-GRU. Mixed-gap training improves sparse and irregular-context performance for both operators, without a uniform ranking across metrics and contexts. Experiments with fewer training patients and a second backbone further support data efficiency and backbone compatibility.

AI.tldr: ContiLNN在二维恢复骨干上引入双向闭式连续时间模块进行跨切片建模，在CT去噪、MRI超分和低计数PET恢复上均超越Restore-RWKV，且延迟和显存优于Bi-GRU。
AI.motivation: 医学图像恢复中解剖连续性可提供互补信息，但利用它需同时考虑局部解剖结构与切片采样变化（如层间距不规则、稀疏采样）。
AI.method: 在二维恢复骨干中嵌入双向闭式连续时间（Bi-CfC）模块做跨切片建模，同时保留平面内特征提取；用切片索引区间调制由局部特征与隐状态决定的门控，实现无需数值ODE积分的传播；引入参考引导一致性对齐一阶、二阶跨切片强度差异以保留解剖变化；并从冻结骨干蒸馏以维持平面内保真度。
AI.result: 在五个训练种子下，相较Restore-RWKV平均PSNR分别提升0.1907 dB（CT去噪）、1.0176 dB（MRI超分）、1.2482 dB（低计数PET恢复），三项任务RMSE均更低；CT结果仅为单个留出患者的描述性结果。PET消融表明有序传播优于单纯增加逐点容量。连续切片训练下，Bi-CfC在全部测试采样条件下保真度高于参数量与计算量相近的Bi-GRU；七切片配置下延迟低52.8%、峰值GPU显存低57.0%。混合间隔训练提升两种算子的稀疏与不规则上下文表现，但各指标与上下文间无一致排序。更少训练患者与第二个骨干的实验支持数据效率与骨干兼容性。
AI.conclusion: ContiLNN以闭式连续时间跨切片建模有效利用解剖连续性，在多种医学图像恢复任务中精度更高、效率更优，并具备数据效率与骨干兼容性。

title: VFold: Symmetry-Aware Cross-Layer Value Cache Compression
summary: While caching key-value (KV) states accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) decoding, this cache can dominate memory usage at long context lengths. One solution is to compress this memory by exploiting inter-layer cache similarities. However, most existing techniques necessitate architectural changes to LLMs and incur substantial overhead. In this work, we propose a symmetry-aware value cache merging strategy that reduces cache memory while avoiding both harmful performance degradation and architectural overhead during decoding. Furthermore, we show that this approach can be exploited alongside existing cache compression techniques, composing with high-ratio quantization or key cache pruning to reach compression ratios that neither method reaches alone, with minimal additional cost. Ultimately, our findings reveal a major source of underutilized capacity in the value cache, offering a simple yet highly effective direction for scaling context windows under memory constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出一种对称感知的value cache合并策略，在不改变模型架构、不显著损害性能的前提下降低LLM长上下文解码时的KV缓存内存，并可与量化、key剪枝等既有压缩方法叠加使用。
AI.motivation: 长上下文解码时KV缓存成为内存占用的主要来源。已有基于层间缓存相似性的压缩方法多需要修改LLM架构并带来较大开销，因此需要一种无需架构改动、低开销且不损害性能的缓存压缩方案。
AI.method: 利用层间缓存的对称性（symmetry-aware），对value cache进行合并（merging），在解码过程中直接减少缓存内存；不引入架构修改，并可与其他缓存压缩技术（如高比率量化、key cache剪枝）组合使用。
AI.result: 该方法在避免性能明显下降和架构开销的同时降低缓存内存；与高比率量化或key cache剪枝组合时，可达到单一方法无法实现的压缩率，且额外成本极小，显示出value cache中存在大量未被利用的容量。
AI.conclusion: value cache中的层间对称性是被忽视的压缩潜力来源，所提简单且高效的合并策略为在内存受限条件下扩展上下文窗口提供了可行方向。

title: Can AI Agents Learn Their Way to the Top? Evaluating Heuristic Learning in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition
summary: Adversarial games have driven advances from heuristic search to reinforcement learning, yet learning and adapting strategies from limited samples remain challenging. AI agents offer an alternative by turning game experience into revisions of executable policies. Building on heuristic learning (HL), we formalize Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), a paradigm that uses AI agents as learning engines to refine game policies and supporting software while keeping model weights fixed. We introduce AAArena, a benchmark comprising 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Agents interpret rules, choose opponents, analyze replays, and revise game agents to achieve their highest ranking within fixed match and evaluation budgets. We evaluate \val{completedmodels} model and harness configurations: Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals, while no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications. Further experiments show that opponent selection and dense feedback support policy improvement, and that agents learn from both on-policy replays of their own matches and off-policy replays of other players' matches. These results highlight HL's potential in adversarial games and identify persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出对抗启发式学习（AHL）范式，并以AAArena基准测试AI代理基于人类程序经验改进对抗博弈策略的能力。
AI.motivation: 对抗博弈虽推动了启发式搜索与强化学习的发展，但从有限样本中学习和适应策略仍具挑战。作者希望利用AI代理作为学习引擎，将博弈经验转化为可执行策略的修订，固定模型权重，探索在真实竞赛式条件下的策略改进潜力。
AI.method: 在启发式学习（HL）基础上形式化对抗启发式学习（AHL），构建AAArena基准，包含12款真实对抗博弈与1920份人类存档程序；采用模拟真实竞赛的评估协议，代理需解读规则、选择对手、分析回放并修订博弈代理，在固定对局与评估预算内争取最高排名。
AI.result: 评估了多种模型与工具配置：Opus5.5搭配Claude Code获得6枚金牌，但没有任何配置能在其余6个人类梯队中登顶；规则越复杂的博弈表现越弱。进一步实验表明，对手选择与密集反馈有助于策略提升，代理可从自身对局的on-policy回放和其他玩家的off-policy回放中学习。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显HL在对抗博弈中的潜力，同时揭示在博弈理解、策略实现与长时程策略开发方面仍存在持续挑战。

title: Reasoning-Informed Visual Editing
summary: Large Multi-modality Models (LMMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation, but still face challenges in visual editing, particularly in following complex instructions, preserving appearance consistency, and supporting flexible input formats. To study this gap, we introduce RISEBench, the first benchmark for evaluating Reasoning-Informed viSual Editing (RISE), and extend it to RISEBench++, a more comprehensive and fine-grained benchmark for this emerging task. RISEBench++ extends the taxonomy into a hierarchical scheme spanning six reasoning dimensions: Temporal, Causal, Spatial, Logical, and Counterfactual Reasoning, together with Hybrid Reasoning integrating multiple reasoning types across multi-turn edits. These dimensions are further decomposed into 12 subcategories and 65 fine-grained task types. We expand input formats to include multi-image conditioning and scale the benchmark to 1000 human-annotated test cases, released in English and Chinese. We also improve our evaluation framework, assessing Instruction Reasoning, Appearance Consistency, and Visual Plausibility with human judges and an LMM-as-a-judge approach for more reliable and calibrated judgements. Beyond benchmarking, we introduce RISE-Agent, a training-free agentic framework integrating reasoning-driven planning, tool-augmented execution, and verifier-guided refinement, outperforming most strong existing approaches across diverse RISE tasks. We evaluate 58 visual editing approaches, including 34 open-source models, 19 closed-source models, and 5 agentic methods. The results reveal substantial challenges in reasoning-based visual editing, with even the strongest evaluated approach, GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst, achieving only 56.6% accuracy. RISEBench++ highlights the limitations of contemporary editing models, provides insights, and indicates future directions for reasoning-aware visual editing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RISEBench 及升级版 RISEBench++，这是首个面向"推理驱动的视觉编辑"（RISE）的基准，并配套提出免训练的智能体框架 RISE-Agent，系统评测了 58 种视觉编辑方法。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型在视觉理解与生成上进展显著，但在视觉编辑中仍难以遵循复杂指令、保持外观一致性并支持灵活输入格式，而针对"推理驱动视觉编辑"缺乏系统性评测基准，因此需要建立基准以揭示现有模型的局限。
AI.method: 构建分层分类体系，覆盖 Temporal、Causal、Spatial、Logical、Counterfactual 五类推理维度及整合多推理类型的 Hybrid Reasoning，细分为 12 个子类与 65 种细粒度任务；扩展输入格式至多图条件，构建 1000 条中英文人工标注测试用例；改进评测框架，从指令推理、外观一致性、视觉合理性三方面结合人类评判与 LMM-as-a-judge 进行校准评分；并提出具有推理驱动规划、工具增强执行与验证器引导精炼的免训练智能体框架 RISE-Agent。
AI.result: 评测了 58 种视觉编辑方法，包括 34 个开源模型、19 个闭源模型和 5 种智能体方法。结果显示推理式视觉编辑仍面临重大挑战，即使最强方法 GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst 仅达 56.6% 准确率；RISE-Agent 在多种 RISE 任务上优于多数现有强方法。
AI.conclusion: RISEBench++ 揭示了当代编辑模型在推理感知视觉编辑方面的能力局限，提供了相关洞见并指明了未来研究方向。

title: Overcoming Prior Barriers: Supervised Fine-Tuning under Long-Tail Distribution
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) adapts pretrained large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but the required concepts can receive substantially different levels of pretrained support. Frequent concepts are more likely to be well learned, whereas rare concepts may remain weakly represented. We introduce a novel notion named prior barrier to quantify how strongly the pretrained model supports competing concepts over the target concept. We observe that prior barriers follow a long-tail distribution, placing head and tail concepts at different starting points for SFT: head concepts face lower prior barriers, whereas tail concepts require additional instructions to overcome their higher prior barriers. Our theoretical analysis further derives a predictive risk bound for SFT under long-tail prior barriers, explicitly characterizing how the prior barrier and accumulated SFT evidence jointly determine predictive performance. Motivated by this prior barrier-dependent demand, we propose PASS, an adaptive SFT instruction selection method that constructs reference-derived concepts and estimates the distinguishing evidence provided by each instruction, and adaptively allocates the selection budget toward concepts that remain insufficiently covered under the current selection. In this way, PASS jointly considers which instructions can provide useful evidence and where additional supervision is needed under a limited budget. Experiments show that our method consistently outperforms seven state-of-the-art instruction selection methods on four backbone-budget settings. An ablation study further shows that PASS's adaptive allocation consistently improves over uniform allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"先验壁垒"(prior barrier)概念量化预训练模型对目标概念的支撑强度，发现其呈长尾分布，并据此提出自适应指令选择方法PASS。
AI.motivation: SFT需适配下游任务，但所需概念获得的预训练支持差异显著：高频概念易学好，稀有概念表征薄弱。现有方法未刻画这种预训练支持差异对SFT的影响，也缺乏针对性的监督分配策略。
AI.method: 提出prior barrier度量竞争概念相对目标概念的预训练支持强度；进行理论分析，在长尾先验壁垒下推导SFT的预测风险界，刻画先验壁垒与累积SFT证据对性能的联合作用；据此提出PASS自适应指令选择方法：构造参考衍生概念、估计每条指令提供的区分性证据，并将选择预算自适应分配到当前覆盖不足的概念上。
AI.result: 在四种骨干模型-预算设置上，PASS一致优于七种最先进指令选择方法；消融实验表明其自适应分配持续优于均匀分配。
AI.conclusion: 先验壁垒的长尾特性解释了头尾概念SFT起点差异；PASS通过联合考虑"哪条指令有用"与"何处需要额外监督"，在有限预算下实现更优的SFT指令选择。

title: Distilling Routed 3D Privilege for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD).
