Non-compensatory gates reject infeasible candidates, and the best verified candidate is distilled into the editor through lightweight adapter training. On Qwen-Image-Edit, Rubric-CEPR improves ImgEdit from 4.36 to 4.60 (+5.5%), with a +24.9% gain on object isolation, and transfers to GEdit-Bench and Complex-Edit. The same procedure also improves Step1X-Edit by +7.8% on ImgEdit. We hope our approach will serve as a solid baseline for image editors that improve themselves from their own verified samples. Our code is publicly available at $\href{https://riteshthawkar.github.io/Rubric-CEPR/}{\text{this URL}}$

AI.tldr: 提出 Rubric-CEPR 自进化框架，仅利用编辑器自身生成样本进行自我改进，无需人工编辑目标或外部奖励模型。
AI.motivation: 指令引导图像编辑器虽能力强大，但进一步提升依赖人工编辑训练对或外部奖励模型，监督成本高，且可能奖励"看似合理实则失败"的结果（如未完成请求的修改，或破坏了应保留的内容）。
AI.method: Rubric-CEPR 通过评分标准增强的对比编辑-保留奖励（CEPR），利用编辑器内部表示验证自身样本。流程为：Planner 从无标注图像生成结构化编辑指令；Editor 采样多个候选编辑；冻结的 Critic 用编辑器已暴露的特征，按分解式评分标准对每个候选打分（编辑实现、旧状态移除、内容保持）；非补偿性门控剔除不可行候选；将最佳已验证候选通过轻量适配器训练蒸馏回编辑器。
AI.result: 在 Qwen-Image-Edit 上，ImgEdit 指标从 4.36 提升至 4.60（+5.5%），物体隔离任务提升 +24.9%，并可迁移至 GEdit-Bench 和 Complex-Edit；同一流程使 Step1X-Edit 在 ImgEdit 上提升 +7.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可作为图像编辑器"利用自身已验证样本自我提升"的坚实基线，代码已开源。

title: Fly-by-Code: Embodied Coding Agents for Aerial Manipulation with Active Visual and Physical Feedback
summary: Embodied coding agents construct robot policies from natural-language instructions by generating executable programs and refining them from execution feedback. This refinement assumes that execution feedback reveals whether the task succeeded and, after a failure, provides sufficient evidence to guide program revision. Aerial manipulation violates this assumption in two ways. Payload constraints restrict onboard camera coverage and leave task-critical outcomes outside the robot's view (partial observability), while strong dynamic coupling and limited control margins make physical interactions fragile (limited interaction robustness) and leave failure causes unresolved. Re-examining the same feedback cannot recover observations that were never collected or separate failure causes that the available evidence does not distinguish. To acquire this missing evidence, we introduce Active Feedback (AF), an active "View and Probe" framework. When execution feedback leaves unresolved questions, the agent synthesizes a separate diagnostic program that runs in simulation to inspect unseen outcomes from informative viewpoints (View) or test hypotheses about failure causes through targeted physical interactions (Probe). Across six simulated aerial manipulation tasks with 60 trials per condition, AF reduces false completion declarations from 25 to 5 and raises final task success from 31.7% to 75% compared with terminal feedback under the same coding-agent configuration and task-execution limit. Using shared robot APIs, task programs refined with AF in simulation run on a physical aerial manipulator without task-program source-code modification and complete multi-stage manipulation tasks in the real world. These results show that executable diagnosis fills gaps in execution feedback for embodied coding agents, improving both completion assessment and program refinement in aerial manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Active Feedback（AF）主动"查看与探测"框架，通过合成诊断程序在仿真中获取缺失证据，将空中操作任务成功率从 31.7% 提升至 75%，并成功迁移至真实机器人。
AI.motivation: 具身编码智能体依赖执行反馈来判断任务是否成功并指导程序修正，但空中操作场景破坏了这一假设：载荷限制导致机载相机覆盖不足（部分可观测性），强动态耦合与控制裕度有限使物理交互脆弱（交互鲁棒性受限），从而使失败原因无法分辨。仅重新审视现有反馈无法恢复未采集的观测，也无法分离证据无法区分的失败原因，因此需要主动获取缺失证据。
AI.method: 提出 Active Feedback（AF）主动"View and Probe"框架。当执行反馈存在未解决问题时，智能体合成独立的诊断程序并在仿真中运行：通过"View"从有信息量的视角检查未观测到的结果，或通过"Probe"以有针对性的物理交互检验关于失败原因的假设。
AI.result: 在六个仿真空中操作任务、每种条件 60 次试验中，在相同编码智能体配置与任务执行限制下，AF 将虚假完成声明从 25 次降至 5 次，最终任务成功率从 31.7% 提升至 75%。借助共享机器人 API，经仿真中 AF 精炼的任务程序无需修改任务程序源代码即可运行于物理空中机械臂，并完成真实世界的多阶段操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 可执行诊断能够弥补具身编码智能体执行反馈中的信息缺口，同时改进空中操作场景下的完成度评估与程序精炼。

title: CASTER: Formalizing Zero-Shot Manipulation from Synthetic Videos as Constrained Optimization
summary: Prior research on learning from humans often requires real human demonstrations. But advances in video generation models offer a new paradigm: we can now prompt these generators to make synthetic videos of the task. On the plus side, these synthetic videos take place in the robot's current environment, and do not require actual human teaching. However, while the generated videos appear to show plausible motions, they lack both physical consistency and robot grounding, and thus the robot cannot directly roll out the trajectory shown by the video. In this paper we seek to formalize the process of going from synthetic video generation to real-world robot trajectories for zero-shot manipulation tasks. We recognize that this problem is an instance of constrained optimization. The object trajectories extracted from the synthetic video provide an initial guess at the correct motion, and the robot must refine these trajectories (for instance, within a digital twin) while enforcing physical feasibility and semantic consistency. Our optimization-based formalism provides insights into the video generation properties necessary for success. Specifically, we show that the video generation must probabilistically seed the search within a semantic basin of attraction where the trajectory can be locally modified without losing its task alignment. Our analysis further reveals that state-of-the-art approaches can be viewed as instances of our unified formalism with key simplifications. In our experiments we remove these simplifications to more closely match the underlying optimization, leading to more robust zero-shot trajectories from synthetic videos and improving average task success by 34.1% compared to the best-performing baseline. See videos at our project website: https://collab.me.vt.edu/CASTER

AI.tldr: 本文将"从合成视频生成到真实机器人轨迹"这一问题形式化为带约束的优化问题，并据此提出改进方法，使零样本操作任务平均成功率较最佳基线提升34.1%。
AI.motivation: 传统从人类学习的方法依赖真实人类演示，成本高；而视频生成模型可生成机器人当前环境下的合成任务视频，无需人类教学。但合成视频虽动作看似合理，却缺乏物理一致性与机器人接地（robot grounding），机器人无法直接 rollout 其轨迹，因此需要形式化从合成视频到真实轨迹的转换过程。
AI.method: 将问题建模为约束优化：从合成视频提取的物体轨迹作为正确运动的初始猜测，机器人在数字孪生等环境中细化轨迹，同时施加物理可行性与语义一致性约束。基于该形式化分析视频生成需具备的性质——必须在语义吸引域内概率性地播撒搜索起点，使轨迹可局部修改而不丢失任务对齐。并指出已有方法可视为该统一形式化在关键简化下的特例，实验中去掉这些简化以更贴近底层优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，去除简化后从合成视频得到的零样本轨迹更鲁棒，平均任务成功率相比最佳基线提升34.1%。
AI.conclusion: 该优化形式化框架统一了现有方法并揭示成功所需条件，为利用合成视频实现零样本机器人操作提供了理论支撑与实用改进。

title: MIRAGE: Metric Inference and Reliability-Aware Gaussian Estimation from Feed-Forward Vision
summary: Feed-forward 3D priors enable high-quality reconstruction from image streams but often lack reliable metric scale and suffer from long-term trajectory drift. In contrast, LiDAR--inertial estimation provides metrically accurate motion but lacks the image-space consistency needed for high-fidelity reconstruction. We propose $MIRAGE$, which anchors feed-forward visual geometry to LiDAR--IMU metric motion and regulates online pose corrections according to correspondence support and cross-modal agreement, jointly enabling accurate metric pose estimation and high-fidelity Gaussian reconstruction. Experiments on Oxford Spires, M2DGR and INS show that MIRAGE achieves accurate metric trajectory estimation, outperforming COLMAP, a widely used but computationally expensive reference for vision-only benchmarks. Motivated by the scarcity of long-horizon monocular benchmarks for large-scale indoor reconstruction, we further build a multimodal data-collection platform and use MIRAGE to establish accurate 6-DoF reference trajectories for a new vision-only benchmark. We benchmark recent monocular large-scale reconstruction methods on this dataset, providing a systematic evaluation of their performance in long-horizon indoor scenes.

AI.tldr: MIRAGE将前馈视觉几何锚定到LiDAR-IMU度量运动，并按对应支持与跨模态一致性调节在线位姿修正，同时实现度量位姿估计与高保真高斯重建，并构建了长时序室内单目重建基准。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D先验虽能从图像流高质量重建，但缺乏可靠度量尺度且存在长期轨迹漂移；LiDAR-惯性估计度量精确但缺乏图像空间一致性。二者互补，但如何联合尚缺失；同时大规模室内长时序单目重建缺乏基准。
AI.method: 提出MIRAGE：将前馈视觉几何锚定到LiDAR-IMU度量运动；依据对应关系支持度与跨模态一致性来调节在线位姿修正；联合优化度量位姿与高斯重建。并搭建多模态采集平台，用MIRAGE为新视觉基准生成6-DoF参考轨迹。
AI.result: 在Oxford Spires、M2DGR与INS上实现精确度量轨迹估计，优于计算昂贵的COLMAP视觉基准参考；在所建数据集上系统评测近期单目大规模重建方法的长时序室内性能。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态锚定与一致性调节可兼顾度量精度与图像空间一致性，实现度量位姿估计与高保真高斯重建，并推动长时序室内单目重建基准的建立与评测。

title: SWE-Duel: Towards a Self-Scaling Arena for Coding Agents
comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: Static coding benchmarks are fixed at release. Over time their tasks leak into training data, and stronger agents eventually saturate them. We argue that a benchmark should instead aim to be self-scaling: its tasks and oracles are created at evaluation time, so no content exists in advance to leak, and its difficulty is set by the participating agents rather than fixed at release. We introduce SWE-Duel, an arena in which two coding agents evaluate each other over mirrored Red-Blue turns. In each turn, the Red agent works on a real repository across three context-isolated sessions. It proposes and implements a new feature with feature tests, then embeds a subtle bug in that feature along with sealed bug-triggering tests. The resulting pull request is admitted only if (1) it passes the feature tests and the repository's existing tests while failing exactly the bug tests, and (2) a fresh session of the same agent can repair the bug blind, which rules out unsolvable tasks. The Blue agent then reviews the pull request without being told a bug exists. It wins only if its revision passes all three test suites, and then the two agents swap roles. We run a tournament among 11 model-harness participants on 15 repositories in five languages for 1,500 turns. The leaders win in different ways. GPT-5.5 with Codex CLI ranks first as the strongest solver, repairing 98.3% of the defects it reviews. Claude Opus 4.8 with mini-swe-agent ranks second as the strongest task author, with a 27.3% Red win rate. Finally, within one model family, tasks written by the newest version defeat a fixed-reference solver far more often than those of older versions (42.9% vs. 4.0%), giving preliminary evidence that task difficulty scales with task authoring capability.

AI.tldr: 提出自扩展基准 SWE-Duel：任务与判据在评测时由参赛智能体互相对抗生成，难度随作者能力自动缩放，避免数据泄漏与饱和。
AI.motivation: 静态代码基准在发布时即固定，随训练数据泄漏与模型能力提升会被饱和，无法持续有效评测。
AI.method: 构建双智能体对抗竞技场：镜像 Red-Blue 回合制。Red 在真实仓库的三个上下文隔离会话中实现新功能及功能测试，再植入细微缺陷与封存的触发测试；PR 需满足功能测试与仓库既有测试通过且仅缺陷测试失败，且同智能体新会话能盲修该缺陷（排除无解题）。Blue 在未知存在缺陷的前提下审查 PR，若其修改通过全部三套测试则获胜，随后双方互换角色。
AI.result: 在 15 个仓库、5 种语言、11 个模型-工具组合、共 1500 回合的锦标赛中：GPT-5.5 + Codex CLI 以最强求解者身份居首，修复其审查缺陷的 98.3%；Claude Opus 4.8 + mini-swe-agent 以最强任务作者身份居次，Red 胜率 27.3%；同一模型族内，最新版本所出任务击败固定参考求解者的比例远高于旧版本（42.9% vs 4.0%）。
AI.conclusion: SWE-Duel 展示出自扩展基准可行，任务难度与作者能力正相关，为对抗式、评测时生成的代码基准提供初步证据。

title: Contextual Correction of Parallel Drafts for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by the target model. Recent diffusion-based drafters make this paradigm particularly attractive: deep attention-based neural backbones provide strong predictions, while drafting multiple future positions in parallel avoids the sequential cost of autoregressive generation. This parallelism, however, comes at a cost. Tokens within a draft block are predicted without access to the realized identities of preceding draft tokens, removing intra-block dependencies that would naturally be available under autoregressive generation. We introduce DCOCO (DFlash Contextual Corrector), a lightweight mechanism that restores these dependencies while preserving parallel drafting. Rather than committing to each position's top prediction, DCOCO retains multiple candidate tokens and evaluates their contextual compatibility across adjacent draft positions in parallel, enabling contextually informed token selection at low additional cost. Across four verifier backbones and ten benchmarks, DCOCO achieves the highest average throughput in every evaluated configuration, spanning greedy and stochastic decoding with and without extended reasoning, with speedups of up to 6.6x over vanilla decoding. Its advantage persists under concurrent serving: DCOCO outperforms the strongest competing method by 6-23% across 4-32 concurrent requests, while other sequential correctors fall below uncorrected DFlash at these loads. These results demonstrate that recovering intra-block dependencies through parallel contextual scoring delivers consistent acceleration across decoding regimes and serving loads.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DCOCO（DFlash Contextual Corrector），一种轻量机制，通过在并行草稿中保留多候选词元并跨相邻草稿位置进行上下文兼容性评分，恢复扩散式草稿器缺失的块内依赖关系，从而在多种验证器与解码设置下实现一致的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的草稿器（如 DFlash）能够并行预测草稿块中多个未来位置，规避自回归生成的串行开销；但其代价是草稿块内的词元在预测时无法获知前面草稿词元的实际身份，导致块内依赖关系丢失。这种依赖在自回归生成中天然存在，缺失会削弱草稿质量与验证接受率，进而限制投机解码的加速收益。
AI.method: DCOCO 并不直接提交每个位置的 top-1 预测，而是为每个位置保留多个候选词元，并跨相邻草稿位置并行评估这些候选的上下文兼容性，从而在保持并行草稿的前提下以较低额外开销实现上下文感知的词元选择。该方法即插即用，兼容贪婪与随机解码，并支持扩展推理与并发服务场景。
AI.result: 在 4 个验证器骨干与 10 个基准上，DCOCO 在所有评估配置中均取得最高平均吞吐量，相对普通解码最高加速 6.6 倍。在并发服务下优势依然成立：在 4–32 并发请求范围内，DCOCO 比最强竞争方法高出 6%–23%；而其他串行校正器在这些负载下甚至低于未校正的 DFlash。
AI.conclusion: 通过并行上下文评分恢复块内依赖关系，DCOCO 能在不同解码机制与服务负载下提供一致且稳健的加速效果，验证了该思路对扩散式投机解码的有效性与通用性。

title: Scaling Multi-Teacher Distillation for Digital Pathology
summary: Multi-teacher distillation allows transferring knowledge from multiple "teacher" networks to a single "student" network. This method is promising in fields such as digital pathology, where many powerful foundation models were proposed recently. However, as we show in this paper, the standard multi-teacher distillation approach reacts poorly to an increase in the number of teachers used to train a student encoder. We demonstrate that learning teacher-specific representations is a key to scaling in MTD. Importantly, different design choices, such as learnable teacher tokens, a tailored attention scheme, additional mixture-of-experts layers and a contrastive loss, are proposed to better learn such teacher-specific representations. We show that our method better scales with respect to the number of considered teachers, allowing us to train compact student encoders, up to 10x more efficient than larger teacher foundation models, while matching their performance and even outperforming them on a large set of tile-level and slide-level tasks. We conduct a thorough empirical validation, evaluating more than 10 foundation models on 39 tasks spanning tile and slide levels. As a result, we release a new collection of strong and efficient foundation models, named OMNI, trained from the knowledge of 10 state-of-the-art foundation models. We finally conduct an analysis of the learned teacher-specific representations, highlighting their complementarity and explaining why they can be easily aggregated at downstream time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出改进的多教师蒸馏(MTD)方法，通过学习教师特定表征解决教师数量增加时性能下降的问题，训练出比教师基础模型效率高10倍且性能相当的紧凑学生编码器，并发布OMNI模型集合。
AI.motivation: 标准多教师蒸馏方法在教师数量增加时表现变差，难以扩展；而在数字病理等领域存在众多强大的基础模型，亟需一种可随教师数量扩展、能训练紧凑高效学生编码器的蒸馏方案。
AI.method: 核心是学习教师特定表征：采用可学习教师token、定制的注意力机制、额外的混合专家(MoE)层以及对比损失，以更好地捕捉各教师独有的知识表征。
AI.result: 在覆盖切片级与瓦片级的39个任务上评估了10余个基础模型，所提方法随教师数量扩展性更好；学生编码器效率比大型教师基础模型高至多10倍，性能相当甚至在大量任务上更优；发布了由10个SOTA基础模型知识蒸馏得到的OMNI模型集合。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习教师特定表征可显著提升多教师蒸馏的可扩展性，构建出强且高效的紧凑基础模型；对学到的教师特定表征的分析揭示了其互补性，并解释了其在下游任务中易于聚合的原因。

title: Mind the Temporal Gap: Evaluating Video Models for Temporal Understanding in Driving
summary: Modern video-language models are increasingly treated as general-purpose video reasoners, yet it remains unclear whether they robustly capture temporal dynamics in safety-critical settings such as driving. We study this question through controlled ego-motion tasks that require identifying actions from driving videos. Across video-language models, we find that standard prompting, visual prompting, few-shot prompting, and chain-of-thought prompting remain unreliable and highly task- and model-dependent, with persistent class biases, although newer models show substantial task-specific few-shot gains. In contrast, lightweight LoRA finetuning and simple probes trained on intermediate visual features recover strong motion-discriminative performance, indicating that motion-relevant cues are often present inside the models but are not reliably used by the final video-to-language pathway. These results suggest that, in driving, current video-language models remain unreliable temporal reasoners and often behave more like frame-level, bias-driven recognizers than dependable temporal world models.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过受控自运动（ego-motion）驾驶任务，系统评估现代视频-语言模型是否真正具备时间动态推理能力，发现常规/视觉/少样本/思维链等提示方式均不可靠且依赖具体任务与模型，而轻量LoRA微调与中间视觉特征探针能恢复强运动判别性能，说明运动线索存在于模型内部但未被最终视频-语言通路可靠利用。
AI.motivation: 视频-语言模型正被当作通用视频推理器使用，但在驾驶等安全关键场景中，其能否鲁棒捕捉时间动态尚不明确；作者希望检验这类模型是否可被视为可靠的时间世界模型。
AI.method: 设计需要从驾驶视频中识别动作的受控自运动任务，对多个视频-语言模型系统比较标准提示、视觉提示、少样本提示与思维链提示的效果，并对比轻量LoRA微调以及在中间视觉特征上训练的简单探针（probe）的表现。
AI.result: 各类提示方法整体不可靠，性能高度依赖任务与模型，并存在持续的类别偏置；较新模型在特定任务上有显著少样本提升。相反，LoRA微调与简单探针均取得强运动判别性能。
AI.conclusion: 运动相关线索往往已存在于模型内部，但最终的视频到语言（video-to-language）通路未能可靠利用它们；在驾驶场景中，当前视频-语言模型仍是不靠谱的时间推理器，更像帧级、偏置驱动的识别器而非可信的时间世界模型。

title: CLUE: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Unsupervised Event Type Induction and Annotation
summary: Event ontology is the foundational framework for defining events in a dataset. Event type induction generally involves domain experts who define guidelines for creating event types and their names based on the dataset's domain and scope. However, this process is resource-intensive in terms of annotation costs and is prone to human biases. To alleviate the need for manual event ontology creation, we propose the CLUE framework for event type induction, naming, and annotation. Our main contributions in this work are: 1) designing a novel joint embedding representation for expressing both the verb-centric view and the semantic view of events; 2) event type induction using contrastive loss guided clustering; 3) event naming and refinement. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Our code is available at https://github.com/PratikMaitra/CLUE.

AI.tldr: 提出CLUE框架，自动完成事件类型归纳、命名与标注，减少对领域专家和人工本体构建的依赖。
AI.motivation: 事件本体是数据集中定义事件的基础框架，但传统事件类型归纳依赖领域专家制定类型及其命名规范，标注成本高且易引入人为偏差。为降低人工构建事件本体的需求，作者提出自动化方案。
AI.method: CLUE框架包含三项核心设计：1）一种新的联合嵌入表示，同时刻画事件的"动词中心视角"与"语义视角"；2）基于对比损失引导聚类的对比损失（contrastive loss guided clustering）进行事件类型归纳；3）事件命名与精炼。
AI.result: 实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CLUE可自动实现事件类型归纳、命名与标注，降低人工本体构建成本，代码已开源。

title: One Model to Loop Them All: Elastic Latent Recurrence for Language Models
summary: A latent recurrent language model applies a shared block of layers repeatedly, so one checkpoint can trade inference compute for accuracy by changing the loop count. At one loop, however, such models typically fall well short of a non-recurrent model of the same size, a one-loop tax that makes a separate non-recurrent model the better choice whenever latency matters. We present Elastic Latent Recurrence (ELR), a recipe for training looped language models without this tax. At one loop, an ELR model costs the same to serve as a non-recurrent model of the same size and, trained on the same data, reaches similar accuracy. Each additional loop then buys more accuracy for more inference compute. Three choices make this work: a gated state update with a learned step size, loop counts mixed within each optimizer update, and conditioning each pass on its loop index and budget. The first two preserve one-loop accuracy, and the third lowers loss at every additional loop. Mixed depths can be introduced late in pretraining to limit the added training cost, and with zero-initialized conditioning added at the switch, this late schedule reaches lower loss than mixed-depth training from scratch. In MoE models, reusing first-loop expert routes on later loops cuts mixed-depth update time by 11.7% with no measurable change in accuracy. At inference, keeping only the last loop's attention KV cache holds attention KV memory at its one-loop level while retaining most of the gain from additional loops. On 4B dense and 30B-A3B MoE hybrid models, ELR at one loop is 0.52 points below and 1.04 points above its matched baseline on a ten-task average, and four loops add 7.25 and 4.75 points. Carried through post-training, the recipe yields Koi-4B, a single checkpoint that scores an estimated 18 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at one loop, matching Qwen3.5-4B, and 29 at four loops.

AI.tldr: 提出ELR训练配方，使循环潜在语言模型在单循环下与同规模非循环模型精度相当（消除"单循环税"），并随循环数增加持续提升精度与推理性能。
AI.motivation: 潜循环语言模型通过重复使用共享层块，让同一checkpoint以推理算力换精度。但单循环时其精度远低于同规模非循环模型，存在"单循环税"，使得延迟敏感场景不得不改用独立非循环模型。
AI.method: 三项关键设计：1）带可学习步长的门控状态更新；2）在每个优化器更新中混合不同循环数（混合深度）；3）每轮前向以循环索引与预算为条件。混合深度可仅在预训练后期引入以降低训练成本，并在切换处以零初始化条件注入。MoE模型中后续循环复用首循环专家路由。推理时仅保留最后一轮注意力KV缓存。
AI.result: 在4B稠密与30B-A3B MoE混合模型上，单循环ELR在十任务平均上分别落后/领先匹配基线0.52与1.04分；四循环分别增加7.25与4.75分。后期引入混合深度优于从头训练；MoE专家路由复用使混合深度更新耗时降低11.7%且精度无明显变化；仅保留末轮KV缓存可将注意力KV内存维持单循环水平并保留大部分增益。经后训练得到Koi-4B，单循环Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index约18（匹配Qwen3.5-4B），四循环达29。
AI.conclusion: ELR消除了循环模型的单循环税，实现单checkpoint在相同服务成本下匹配非循环基线，并可通过增加循环数单调提升精度，为延迟与算力可调的部署提供统一方案。

title: Human Pose Estimation by Probabilistic Mixtures of Gaussian and Uniform Distributions
comment: 38 pages, 11 figures, 20 tables. Includes supplementary material. Code available at https://github.com/santiago-git19/probabilistic-pose-gmm
summary: Despite advancements in sub-pixel decoding, modern Human Pose Estimation (HPE) architectures remain constrained by deterministic coordinate extraction from discrete heatmaps, which systematically fails under dense occlusions and Out-of-Distribution (OoD) ambiguities. To address these limitations, we propose a post-hoc continuous probabilistic framework that intercepts raw heatmaps and models them as a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) augmented with a spatially agnostic uniform distribution, requiring no architectural modifications or retraining. This continuous representation allows us to comprehensively explore the distinct contributions of density modeling to HPE. We show that the spatial expectation of our fitted GMM achieves precision parity with leading sub-pixel decoders without heuristic post-processing. Leveraging this continuous space, our test-time augmentation aggregates probability distributions rather than discrete activations, mitigating multi-scale heatmap poisoning. Furthermore, because our multimodal GMM parameterization isolates competing spatial hypotheses, it naturally interfaces with geometric regularizers such as Markov Random Fields. However, our analysis exposes the inherent vulnerabilities of 2D kinematic priors under perspective foreshortening and visual degradation. Crucially, this density formulation yields significant improvements in uncertainty quantification: our calibrated geometric covariance volume outperforms standard peak-intensity heuristics in OoD anomaly detection under severe occlusion. For in-distribution calibration, dynamically fusing our geometric metric via Adaptive Softmax reduces or matches baseline Area Under the Sparsification Error (AUSE) across benchmarks and degradation levels. Finally, we establish that this continuous parameterization is extensible to multi-view 3D architectures, bypassing the $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$ voxel memory bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种后处理连续概率框架，将HPE的离散热图建模为带均匀分布的GMM，无需重训练即可提升解码精度、增强不确定性量化与OoD检测能力，并可扩展至多视图3D。
AI.motivation: 现代HPE架构依赖从离散热图中确定性提取坐标，在密集遮挡和OoD歧义下系统性失效。作者希望在不修改架构、不重训练的前提下，用连续概率表示替代离散解码，以全面挖掘密度建模对HPE的价值。
AI.method: 提出test-time的后处理框架：截取原始热图，将其建模为GMM并加入空间无关的均匀分布，得到连续概率空间。基于该空间的期望值实现无启发式后处理的子像素解码；测试时增强通过聚合概率分布而非离散激活缓解多尺度热图污染；利用多模态GMM隔离竞争性空间假设，与MRF等几何正则器自然耦合；用校准的几何协方差体积进行不确定性量化，并通过Adaptive Softmax动态融合几何度量；将该连续参数化扩展至多视图3D，绕过O(N^3)体素内存瓶颈。
AI.result: 拟合GMM的空间期望在无启发式后处理下达到与领先子像素解码器相当的精度；概率分布聚合的TTA缓解多尺度热图中毒；几何协方差体积在严重遮挡下的OoD异常检测中优于峰值强度启发式；在分布内校准上，Adaptive Softmax融合使AUSE在多个基准和退化水平上降低或持平。分析同时揭示2D运动学先验在透视缩短和视觉退化下的脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 连续概率参数化为HPE提供了统一的后处理方案，在精度、不确定性量化和OoD鲁棒性上均带来增益，且可扩展至多视图3D。但它也暴露了2D先验在透视与视觉退化下的固有局限，提示未来需更强的几何先验或3D一致性约束。

title: Scenes as an Attack Surface: Uncovering Scene-Grounded Safety Failures in MLLMs
summary: Existing jailbreak attacks have exposed serious safety weaknesses in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Most prior attacks rely on specially constructed visual inputs to carry or support harmful intent. In this paper, we uncover a different vulnerability: task-relevant scene semantics alone can shift an MLLM from refusal to compliance, even when the visual input introduces no additional attack instructions and the original task intent remains unchanged. We formalize this failure as a scene-grounded visual safety vulnerability and introduce SceneSafetyBench to investigate it across eight risk categories and nine white- and black-box MLLMs. Our analysis reveals that this failure is associated with how task-relevant visual evidence influences downstream safety representations, suggesting that visual grounding alone cannot fully explain the observed safety shift. Building on this finding, we propose Scene-Grounded Attacks (SGA), which preserve the original task while constructing validated scene-grounded queries and combining their independent responses. Across nine target MLLMs, SGA achieves an average attack success rate (ASR) of 86.17%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 8.55 percentage points and achieving the highest ASR on eight models. Our results identify scene semantics as an overlooked attack surface in MLLMs and highlight a growing tension between stronger visual grounding and robust multimodal safety alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多模态大模型中"任务相关场景语义本身即可导致安全对齐失效"这一新漏洞，提出SceneSafetyBench基准与场景接地攻击(SGA)，在九个模型上平均攻击成功率达86.17%。
AI.motivation: 既有越狱攻击多依赖特制的视觉输入来承载或辅助有害意图，而本文揭示了一种被忽视的漏洞：即使视觉输入不含额外攻击指令、原始任务意图也未改变，仅靠任务相关的场景语义就能使MLLM从拒绝转为顺从。作者将此形式化为"场景接地的视觉安全脆弱性"，并关注更强视觉接地与多模态安全对齐之间日益加剧的矛盾。
AI.method: 1) 形式化场景接地的视觉安全脆弱性；2) 构建SceneSafetyBench基准，覆盖八个风险类别与九个白盒/黑盒MLLM；3) 分析任务相关视觉证据如何影响下游安全表征，指出仅用视觉接地无法完全解释安全偏移；4) 提出场景接地攻击(SGA)：在保持原始任务不变的前提下，构造经验证的场景接地查询并组合其独立响应。
AI.result: 在九个目标MLLM上，SGA平均攻击成功率达86.17%，较最强基线高出8.55个百分点，并在八个模型上取得最高ASR。分析表明该失效与任务相关视觉证据对下游安全表征的影响有关。
AI.conclusion: 场景语义是MLLM中被忽视的攻击面，凸显了更强视觉接地能力与稳健多模态安全对齐之间的紧张关系，提示需重新审视视觉接地对安全性的影响。

title: SpireBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Strategic Play of Agentic Models with Slay the Spire
summary: Agentic large language models now tackle complex tasks, yet strategic reasoning over long horizons is under-studied: most agentic benchmarks are short and episodic, and performance on long tasks is hard to dissect into stored knowledge, reasoning and luck. We introduce SpireBench, in which models play the complete commercial deck-builder Slay the Spire (StS), where early decisions decide long-term success. Across 20 large language models (LLMs) at the game's highest difficulty, frontier models beat heuristic baselines and match the average human player but remain far behind experts. This gap widens as the run lengthens: the strongest models win the first act as often as experts, then fall behind. What separates strong models from weak is how well they play each fight; all of them misjudge risk over a run, preserving health rather than spending it to grow stronger. A comprehensive, self-consistent renaming of every game term shows that part of their performance rests on prior knowledge of the game, and models do not improve from the memories they write across runs, which are often wrong and overly cautious. Our harness is the first to give a model the complete original game, and we compare it with existing harnesses. Overall, SpireBench offers an unsaturated long-horizon benchmark with tools to locate where and why agents fail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpireBench：让大语言模型完整游玩商业卡牌构筑游戏《杀戮尖塔》（最高难度），用于评测长时程策略推理。20 个 LLM 中，前沿模型超过启发式基线并接近人类平均水平，但远逊于专家，且随赛程变长差距扩大。强弱模型的关键差异在于单场战斗表现；所有模型都误判风险，倾向保守保血而非以血量换成长。全量术语改名实验表明部分性能依赖先验游戏知识；模型无法从跨局记忆（常错误且过度保守）中学习。该基准具有未饱和性与可诊断性。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准多为短时程、情节式任务，缺乏对长时程策略推理的考察；且在长任务上难以将表现拆解为已有知识、推理能力与运气三部分。作者希望建立一个可定位、可解释失败原因的长时程基准。
AI.method: 构建 SpireBench：模型在最高难度下完整游玩原版《杀戮尖塔》（商业卡牌构筑游戏），早期决策决定长期成败。评测 20 个 LLM，与启发式基线、人类平均水平及专家对比。为拆解知识贡献，对全部游戏术语进行自洽的全面重命名。测试模型跨局写入记忆后的学习效果，并与其他现有测试框架进行比较。
AI.result: 前沿模型优于启发式基线、与人类平均玩家相当，但显著落后于专家。差距随局内进程扩大：最强模型在第一幕的胜率与专家相当，随后被拉开。强弱模型的区分主要在于每场战斗的操作质量。所有模型在整个赛程中对风险判断有误，倾向保血而非用血量换取成长。术语重命名后性能下降，说明部分表现依赖先验游戏知识；跨局记忆常错误且过度保守，模型未能由此改进。
AI.conclusion: SpireBench 是首个让模型游玩完整原版游戏的测试框架，提供了未饱和的长时程基准及定位失败原因的工具：性能差距集中在长程风险权衡与战斗执行，且受先验知识影响、缺乏跨局学习能力。

title: Reflective Prompt Optimization of a Deep-Research Agent: A Topic-Disjoint, Multi-Seed Protocol for Measuring Transferable Gains and Prompt-Level Overfitting
summary: Prompt optimization is an attractive alternative to reinforcement learning for adapting language-model agents, since it is cheap and produces human-readable artifacts. On factual tasks, however, it carries a failure mode that scalar-reward reinforcement learning does not. An optimizer that reads the training examples can write their answers into the prompt, so an in-distribution gain may be memorization rather than transferable behaviour. We apply reflective prompt evolution (GEPA) to the two system prompts of a multi-agent deep-research agent and evaluate it under a topic-disjoint split in which no topic is shared across train, validation, and test. Held-out citation reward rises by 0.079, from 0.702 to 0.781, with a bootstrap 95\% confidence interval of [0.051, 0.107], and the gain replicates across three seeds (mean 0.107). Nearly half of the winning prompt is a memorized answer key, yet a controlled ablation shows this content earns no reward even on the exact training questions it encodes. The large validation-minus-held-out gap is therefore small-sample selection under a noisy judge, not memorization. Varying the verifier isolates what makes the gain transfer. Decomposed per-dimension feedback is the causal ingredient, and collapsing it to a single scalar reward makes held-out transfer negative. The gain persists under an out-of-family judge and is largely reproduced by a hand-written version of the discovered recipe. Credible evaluation of prompt optimizers therefore requires held-out topics, multiple seeds, and verifier ablations. We release the candidate prompts, lineage diffs, figures, tables, and analysis.

AI.tldr: 将反思式提示进化（GEPA）应用于多智能体深度研究代理的两个系统提示，在主题不相交划分下评估其迁移效果并剖析增益来源。
AI.motivation: 提示优化比强化学习更廉价且产物可读，但在事实性任务上存在"把训练答案写入提示"的记忆化风险，导致分布内增益可能是记忆而非可迁移行为。因此需要在严格留出设置下检验其真实泛化性，并厘清增益的因果来源。
AI.method: 对多智能体深度研究代理的两个系统提示应用GEPA（reflective prompt evolution）；采用主题不相交划分（训练/验证/测试无共享主题），跨3个种子重复；进行消融实验（移除记忆化答案键内容、将逐维度分解反馈坍缩为标量奖励、更换验证器/评判模型），并与手工编写的配方版本对比。
AI.result: 留出集引用奖励从0.702提升至0.781，提升0.079，bootstrap 95%置信区间[0.051, 0.107]，三种子均值0.107。获胜提示中近半为记忆化答案键，但消融显示该内容即使在其编码的原始训练题上也不产生奖励。验证集与留出集的较大差距源于噪声评判下的小样本选择偏差，而非记忆化。逐维度分解反馈是增益可迁移的因果要素；将其坍缩为单一标量奖励会使留出迁移转为负值。增益在异族评判模型下依然成立，并可被手写版本大致复现。
AI.conclusion: 对提示优化器的可信评估需同时采用留出主题、多种子与验证器消融；标量奖励可能破坏迁移，分解式反馈更有效。作者公开候选提示、演化谱系diff、图表与分析。

title: Self-Preservation in Language Models
summary: Continual learning (CL) seeks to adapt pretrained models while preserving prior capabilities. Yet the tasks supplied for preservation cover only part of what a model knows, while forgetting can extend beyond them. Recent work shows that language models can supplement this limited evidence by generating useful replay without access to their original training data. This raises a question about self-preservation: can a model help choose preservation targets that protect its own capabilities more broadly? To study this question, we organize task descriptions and their examples into Task Banks, whose entries can be selected and combined to guide replay generation by a frozen model. Continual instruction tuning with Qwen models of varying sizes yields three findings. First, the new task and learning rate shape which prior capabilities degrade, while tracking previously correct answers reveals losses that average accuracy can conceal. Second, generated replay reduces forgetting on tasks outside the bank. Combining partial banks strengthens this protection, improving mean retention of previously correct answers over either bank alone across the tested sizes. Third, the model can also help choose replay targets: selection informed by the new task improves mean held-out retention over random selection at 4B, with similar new-task gains, although smaller models show no corresponding advantage. Under a fixed example budget, however, replacing new-task examples with replay improves preservation at the cost of smaller new-task gains. Together, these findings show that models can support broader self-preservation by generating replay data and, in some settings, choosing which tasks to replay.

AI.tldr: 研究提出用Task Banks组织任务描述与示例指导冻结模型生成回放数据，发现生成式回放可缓解任务库外遗忘，选择部分任务库合并可增强保护，且模型能在一定规模下辅助选择回放目标。
AI.motivation: 持续学习（CL）旨在适应预训练模型并保留原有能力，但用以"保留"的任务只覆盖模型所知的一部分，遗忘可能超出这些任务范围。近期工作表明语言模型可在不访问原始训练数据的情况下生成有用的回放。由此引出"自我保留"问题：模型能否帮助选择保护目标，从而更广泛地保护自身能力？
AI.method: 将任务描述及其示例组织成Task Banks，其条目可被选择并组合，用于指导冻结模型生成回放数据；在Qwen系列不同规模模型上进行持续指令微调（continual instruction tuning）进行实验。
AI.result: 三点发现：1）新任务与学习率决定哪些先验能力退化，追踪原本正确的答案可揭示被平均准确率掩盖的损失；2）生成式回放减少任务库之外任务的遗忘，合并部分任务库比单一任务库在测试规模上均提升先前正确答案的平均保留率；3）模型可协助选择回放目标，由新任务引导的选择在4B规模上优于随机选择且不损失新任务收益，但更小模型无此优势；在固定示例预算下，用回放替换新任务示例可提升保留但降低新任务收益。
AI.conclusion: 模型可通过生成回放数据、并在某些设置下选择回放任务，支持更广泛的自我保留。

title: Knowing Is Not Telling: Identity Ossification in LLM Representations of Trans-border Communities
summary: Ethnic and cultural identities rarely align with political borders, a tension made sharper by migration and long-standing cross-border ties. Communities such as the Sami, the Rohingya, and the Kurds have long lived across more than one state. This tension is especially clear in mainland Southeast Asia, where many communities share history, language, and culture across state lines. We study nine such transborder ethnic communities along China's southwestern border with mainland Southeast Asia, looking at how large language models (LLMs) represent them. We define and study identity ossification: a pattern where LLMs turn a fluid, cross-border ethnic identity into a single, fixed nation-state identity. We introduce the Transborder Identity Ossification Diagnostic Framework (TIODF) that compares direct factual questions with open-ended narrative questions to test whether ossification comes from missing knowledge or from how models frame their answers. We test GPT-5.1 and DeepSeek-V3.2 in English and Chinese. Ossification varies substantially across models and query languages. It appears in only 10.1% of GPT-5.1's English answers, but in 62.6% of DeepSeek-V3.2's Chinese answers. Models often still tell a single-nation story even when they answer the factual question correctly. This decoupling suggests that ossification reflects narrative framing rather than simple knowledge absence, which matters for how we test cultural fairness in multilingual AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大语言模型（LLM）如何表征中国西南边境与东南亚之间九个跨境民族群体，提出"身份固化"（identity ossification）概念及TIODF诊断框架，发现在GPT-5.1与DeepSeek-V3.2中固化程度随模型与查询语言显著变化，且固化源于叙事框架而非知识缺失。
AI.motivation: 族群与文化身份极少与政治边界一致，移民与长期跨境联系加剧了这一张力。萨米人、罗兴亚人、库尔德人等群体长期分布于多个国家，东南亚大陆尤为典型。已有文化公平性评测多关注单国语境，忽视了跨境民族被LLM强行归入单一民族国家身份的问题，因此需要界定并量化这一现象。
AI.method: 聚焦中国西南边境与东南亚大陆的九个跨境民族群体。提出"身份固化"概念：LLM将流动的跨境族群身份压缩为单一、固定的民族国家身份。设计TIODF（跨境身份固化诊断框架），对比直接事实性提问与开放式叙事性提问，以区分固化源自知识缺失还是回答框架方式。在英文与中文下测试GPT-5.1与DeepSeek-V3.2。
AI.result: 固化程度随模型与查询语言差异显著：GPT-5.1英文回答中仅10.1%出现固化，DeepSeek-V3.2中文回答中高达62.6%。模型即使正确回答事实性问题，仍常讲述单一民族国家的叙事。
AI.conclusion: 事实正确性与叙事框架出现解耦，表明身份固化反映的是叙事框架问题而非单纯知识缺失。这提示多语言AI系统中的文化公平性评测不能止于事实准确性，还需考察叙事层面的表征偏差。

title: GeopoliticalQA: Benchmarking Retrieval and Generation over Intelligence Reports
summary: Geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports constitute a rich source of expert knowledge and have increasing value in the current political climate, but their heterogeneity and analytical complexity pose challenges for retrieval-augmented question answering. We introduce a benchmark for grounded question answering over 415 open-source geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports, comprising 5,525 document-grounded question-answer pairs spanning factual, inferential, comparative, and risk-oriented questions. We propose a document-aware generation pipeline that profiles reports before generating questions and validate dataset quality through expert annotation and an LLM-as-judge protocol. Using the benchmark, we evaluate 15 retrieval systems and six open-weight LLMs for RAG. We find that models perform similarly on document-level retrieval, while at the harder chunk level retrieval quality is not driven by embedding-model scale: bge-m3, a mid-size open encoder matches an order of magnitude larger ones and outperforms commercial embedding APIs. In contrast, answer generation remains challenging even given the gold evidence, particularly for inferential and risk-oriented questions.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个面向地缘政治与战略情报报告的有据问答基准，并提出文档感知的问答生成流程，系统评估了15个检索系统与6个开源LLM在RAG中的表现。
AI.motivation: 地缘政治与战略情报报告是专家知识的重要来源，价值日益凸显，但其异质性和分析复杂性给检索增强问答带来挑战，目前缺乏针对该领域的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建包含415份开源情报报告、5,525个文档有据问答对的基准，覆盖事实型、推理型、比较型和风险导向型问题；提出文档感知生成流程，先生成报告画像再生成问题，并通过专家标注与LLM-as-judge协议验证数据质量；基于该基准评测15个检索系统和6个开源权重的LLM。
AI.result: 模型在文档级检索上表现相近；在更难的分块级检索上，检索质量并非由嵌入模型规模驱动：中等规模开源编码器bge-m3可媲美大一个数量级的模型，并优于商业嵌入API；即便给定黄金证据，答案生成仍具挑战，尤其对推理型和风险导向型问题。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为地缘政治与战略情报领域的RAG研究提供了评测基础，揭示了嵌入规模并非检索质量的决定因素，且推理与风险类问答生成仍是瓶颈。

title: MemReg: Streaming Outdoor LiDAR Point Cloud Registration with Hybrid Memory Buffers
summary: Prior outdoor LiDAR registration works are commonly limited by the pair-wise input paradigm, which neglects temporal correlations inherent within streaming sequences. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-frame outdoor point cloud registration network for streaming LiDAR scans enhanced with pose-related memory buffers. The key observation is that long-term temporal LiDAR sequences can provide rich global contextual information to complete sparse measurements, filter outliers, and address low-overlap problems, thereby boosting registration performance. Specifically, two hybrid memory buffers are designed, including an implicit memory feature buffer and an explicit memory pose buffer, to store and dynamically update pose-related temporal features. Moreover, a novel dynamic history weighting module is developed to adaptively fuse current and history pose-related features. Extensive experiments on three outdoor datasets, including KITTI, nuScenes, and Apollo-Southbay, demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of MemReg, surpassing all previous pair-wise methods and also multi-frame SLAM systems. Our method also generalizes surprisingly well to multiview indoor registration scenarios with rather competitive performance on 3DMatch, 3DLoMatch, and ScanNet. Code will be released at https://github.com/IRMVLab/MemReg.

AI.tldr: MemReg：一种面向流式LiDAR扫描的多帧室外点云配准网络，借助隐式记忆特征缓冲与显式记忆位姿缓冲存储并动态更新位姿相关时序特征，通过动态历史加权模块融合当前与历史特征，在KITTI、nuScenes、Apollo-Southbay上超越所有成对方法及多帧SLAM系统，并在3DMatch等室内多视图场景展现强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有室外LiDAR配准工作多受限于成对输入范式，忽略了流式序列中固有的时序相关性，导致稀疏测量、离群点与低重叠等问题难以被有效解决。
AI.method: 提出多帧室外点云配准网络MemReg，用于流式LiDAR扫描。核心在于利用长时时序LiDAR序列提供丰富全局上下文信息以补全稀疏测量、滤除离群点并缓解低重叠问题。具体设计两种混合记忆缓冲：隐式记忆特征缓冲与显式记忆位姿缓冲，用于存储并动态更新位姿相关时序特征；同时提出动态历史加权模块，自适应融合当前与历史位姿相关特征。
AI.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes、Apollo-Southbay三个室外数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能，超越所有先前成对方法及多帧SLAM系统；在多视图室内配准场景中泛化良好，于3DMatch、3DLoMatch、ScanNet上具有相当有竞争力的表现。代码将开源于 https://github.com/IRMVLab/MemReg。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入位姿相关记忆缓冲机制，打破传统成对输入限制，充分利用流式LiDAR序列的时序全局上下文，显著提升室外配准性能并具备跨域泛化能力。

title: ForcingBooster: Adaptive Patch-wise Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models have become a leading approach to real-time interactive video generation and video world modeling. However, existing methods typically allocate computation uniformly across space when generating the next video chunk, updating all patches with the same denoising schedule and number of function evaluations. This ignores the spatial heterogeneity of video content: static, simple, or recurring regions are often easier to denoise, while other regions require further refinement or additional context. A uniform budget thus leads to redundant computation on easy patches, whereas reducing the fixed step count can leave difficult patches insufficiently refined. We introduce \methodname{}, a general framework that dynamically allocates denoising steps to individual patches: easy patches stop early to improve efficiency, while difficult patches receive more refinement steps. This design accelerates generation with negligible quality degradation. Our method is compatible with most existing few-step autoregressive diffusion models, requiring only a lightweight routing module with modest training. Experiments demonstrate that \methodname{} reduces the total number of denoising steps applied across video patches by about 50\% while maintaining visual quality comparable to the four-step baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种动态按块分配去噪步数的通用框架，让简单图像块提前停止、困难图像块获得更多细化步数，在几乎不损失画质的前提下将自回归视频扩散模型的总去噪步数减少约50%。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型在生成下一个视频块时，对整个空间统一分配计算量，对所有patch采用相同的去噪调度和函数评估次数。但视频内容存在空间异质性：静态、简单或重复区域更易去噪，而其他区域需要更多细化或额外上下文。统一预算会在简单patch上造成冗余计算，而单纯减少固定步数又会导致困难patch细化不足。
AI.method: 提出一个通用框架，对各个patch动态分配去噪步数：简单patch提前停止以提升效率，困难patch获得更多细化步数。该方法与大多数现有少步自回归扩散模型兼容，仅需一个轻量级路由模块和适度的训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在视觉质量与四步基线相当的情况下，将应用于视频各patch的总去噪步数减少约50%。
AI.conclusion: 按patch动态分配去噪计算量可在几乎不损失生成质量的前提下显著加速自回归视频扩散模型的生成，是一种通用且兼容性强的效率优化方案。

title: Cancerous Backdoor Attack: Gradual Activation via Invisible Tokens and A Stage Controller
summary: Backdoor Attacks on Large Language Models (LLMs) typically follow a trigger-response pattern, where satisfying a trigger condition activates a single terminal behavior. However, this single-point backdoor activation does not explore attacks in which malicious behavior develops gradually through multiple intermediate stages before reaching the terminal activation stage. We present Cancerous Backdoor Attack, that gradually corrupts an LLM's reasoning over a sequence of interactions by leveraging invisible tokens and a stage controller. Specifically, invisible tokens provide hidden stages to the model without appearing in the user's visible request and the stage controller tracks the attack's progression during inference to realize gradual activation. We evaluate Cancerous Backdoor Attack across several reasoning datasets. The attack consistently produces gradual reasoning corruption across models and tasks. We compare Cancerous Backdoor Attack with prior backdoor attack baselines to demonstrate our proposed attack outperforms the baselines. Our results indicate that reasoning corruption can develop gradually before it becomes visible, making answer accuracy alone insufficient for detecting backdoor attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出"癌性后门攻击"（Cancerous Backdoor Attack），利用不可见token与阶段控制器，使LLM的推理在多轮交互中逐步腐化、渐进激活，而非单点触发单一终端行为。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM后门攻击多遵循"触发—响应"模式，即满足触发条件后直接激活单一终端行为，未探索恶意行为经过多个中间阶段逐步发展的攻击形式；且仅凭答案准确率难以检测此类隐蔽后门。
AI.method: 方法包含两个核心组件：（1）不可见token（invisible tokens），在不出现于用户可见请求的情况下向模型提供隐藏阶段信息；（2）阶段控制器（stage controller），在推理过程中追踪攻击进度，实现渐进式激活。攻击通过多轮交互逐步腐化模型推理。
AI.result: 在多个推理数据集上评测，该攻击在多种模型和任务上均稳定地产生渐进式推理腐化；与已有后门攻击基线相比，所提攻击表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 推理腐化可在变得可见之前逐步发展，因此仅依赖答案准确率不足以检测后门攻击，需要关注推理过程的渐进异常。

title: Feature Competition and Its Representational Origins in Vision Language Models: Evidence from the Stroop Paradigm
summary: When you ask a vision-language model (VLM) a question with an image, it answers your question based on the image. But to act means to choose: saying one thing means choosing to respond not say another. This becomes an issue when the image contains multiple features that equally relate to the question at hand: how would VLMs choose to respond? This problem is precisely studied by the classical Stroop task in psychology: among a set of deliberately designed images whose text and color conflicts (e.g., \textcolor{blue}{RED}), participants are instructed to report the color. We adapt this psychological paradigm to a benchmark and prompted a range of contrastive and generative VLMs on their behavior. Across models, we observe a persistent bias toward the feature of text in Stroop images: when text and color disagree, models preferentially generate responses centered to the text rather than color. We then opened the black box and examined the source of this bias and why certain features influences the model's behavior more than others. In the embedding space, we found that textual cues are represented more strongly and separably than color cues. This representational asymmetry predicts intervention success: steering models toward text-related directions is substantially easier than steering them toward color-related directions. Using a classical psychological paradigm, we demonstrate, at both behavioral and representational levels, that distinct features within the same image can exert unequal influence on VLM behavior. Our findings suggest that VLMs assign different degrees of saliency to different features within the same image, highlighting the need to understand how cue-specific saliency shapes their performance in widely used downstream applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文将心理学经典Stroop任务改编为视觉语言模型(VLM)基准，发现模型在图文冲突（如蓝色字体的"RED"）时持续偏向文本特征；嵌入空间中文本线索表示更强、更可分，这种表征不对称预测了干预难易程度，揭示同一图像内不同特征对VLM行为影响不均。
AI.motivation: 当图像包含多个与问题同等相关的特征时，VLM如何"选择"作答尚不明确。作者借用心理学Stroop范式来系统考察这种特征竞争下的行为偏向及其内在来源。
AI.method: 将Stroop任务改编为基准，构建文本与颜色冲突的图像（如蓝色字体的"RED"），要求模型报告颜色；对多种对比式与生成式VLM进行行为测试，并在嵌入空间中分析文本与颜色线索的表征，进一步用表征引导(steering)实验验证。
AI.result: 各模型均表现出对文本特征的持续偏向：当文本与颜色不一致时，模型优先给出以文本为中心的回答。嵌入空间中文本线索比颜色线索表示更强、更可分；该表征不对称可预测干预效果——将模型引导向文本相关方向明显比引导向颜色方向更容易。
AI.conclusion: 在行为与表征两个层面证明：同一图像中的不同特征对VLM行为影响不均，模型对同图中的不同特征赋予不同显著度(saliency)。这提示需理解线索特异性显著度如何影响VLM在广泛下游应用中的表现。

title: perturber: A Stateless Service for Semantics-Preserving Text Perturbations
comment: 14 pages (6 main + references and appendix), 5 figures, 13 tables. Code: https://github.com/IBM/perturber
summary: Large language model (LLM) evaluations on clean benchmarks overstate model robustness: real inputs arrive perturbed, and these meaning-preserving variants routinely move model answers. Studying this systematically requires applying perturbations one at a time, reproducibly, and identically wherever they run, yet existing tools couple them to a benchmarking stack rather than packaging them as a reusable transform layer. We present perturber, a stateless service and Python library that applies exactly one semantics-preserving perturbation per call, drawn from a first-party catalog of 68 perturbations across 11 families. It turns on a single primitive, with composition left to the caller chaining calls, so the service and the library produce identical output by construction. We evaluate the tool itself, its correctness, reproducibility, and cost, rather than any model's robustness, measuring meaning-preservation per perturbation rather than assuming it. The demonstration adds a live playground, an introspectable catalog for benchmark selection, and a one-command reproducible evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 perturber：一个无状态服务与 Python 库，每次调用仅施加一个语义保持扰动，涵盖 11 个族系、68 种扰动，并以单一基元保证服务与库输出一致。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 评测基于干净基准，高估了模型鲁棒性；真实输入常带扰动且语义保持变体会改变模型答案。系统研究需要可复现、可一致迁移、且逐次施加扰动的能力，但现有工具与评测栈耦合，未打包为可复用的变换层。
AI.method: 设计并实现 perturber：无状态服务与 Python 库，单次调用只施加一个语义保持扰动，来自第一方目录（11 个族系、68 种扰动）；以单一基元实现，组合交由调用方链式调用，从而在构造上保证服务与库输出一致。评估对象为工具本身（正确性、可复现性、成本），并逐扰动测量语义保持而非默认假设。
AI.result: 通过逐扰动的语义保持度量验证了扰动质量；验证了服务与库输出一致性、可复现性与成本；演示包含实时 playground、可内省目录用于基准选择，以及一条命令可复现的评测流程。
AI.conclusion: perturber 将扰动封装为可复用的无状态变换层，支持逐次、可复现、跨环境一致的语义保持扰动施加，并为基准选择与可复现评测提供支持。

title: Recurrent Harness for Agentic Continual Learning
summary: Language model agents increasingly operate over long interaction streams, requiring online adaptation to distribution shifts through continual learning. However, existing agent harnesses typically either evolve their states only through forward information flow or rely on additional replay or validation data for harness optimization. To address this, we propose ReHarness, a recurrent harness framework for agentic continual learning that complements forward read and write with backward revision under a strictly online streaming protocol. We ask what information could have been captured differently in the harness state to better inform the current instance in the stream. Specifically, after each instance, we leverage the resulting trajectory as feedback to revise the reflections retrieved for that instance, thereby propagating feedback backward through the textual harness state. Across three continual learning benchmarks and three language model backbones, ReHarness consistently outperforms strong raw-context baselines, memory- and reflection-based methods, and prompt optimization approaches. Further analysis shows that ReHarness produces source-grounded and meaningful revisions, corrects overgeneralized or outdated experience under distribution shifts, and improves both stability and plasticity during continual learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReHarness，一种在严格在线流式协议下进行智能体持续学习的循环式 harness 框架。它在正向读/写之外增加"反向修正"：每个实例结束后用产生的轨迹作为反馈，修正该实例检索到的反思内容，从而把反馈沿文本化 harness 状态反向传播。在三个持续学习基准和三个语言模型骨干上，ReHarness 稳定优于原始上下文基线、基于记忆与反思的方法以及提示优化方法，并产生有来源依据的修正，缓解过泛化/过时经验问题，同时提升稳定性与可塑性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体需在长交互流中在线适应分布漂移，但现有 harness 要么仅靠前向信息流更新状态，要么依赖额外回放或验证数据来优化 harness，难以满足严格在线流式设定。作者由此追问：harness 状态中哪些信息本可以以不同方式被捕获，从而更好地服务于当前流中的实例。
AI.method: 提出 ReHarness，循环式 harness 框架：在正向读（read）与写（write）之外引入反向修正（backward revision）。在每个实例完成后，将其产生的轨迹作为反馈，用于修正该实例所检索到的反思（reflections），使反馈通过文本化 harness 状态向后传播，整个过程不依赖回放或验证数据，严格遵循在线流式协议。
AI.result: 在三个持续学习基准与三个语言模型骨干上，ReHarness 一致优于强原始上下文基线、基于记忆与反思的方法以及提示优化方法。进一步分析表明其修正具有来源依据且有意义，能纠正在分布漂移下过泛化或过时的经验，并在持续学习中同时提升稳定性与可塑性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在文本化 harness 状态上实现前向读写与反向修正的循环互补，可在严格在线流式条件下有效支撑智能体持续学习，兼顾经验纠错与整体性能提升。

title: GeoFitBench-LLM: A Benchmark for Assessing Large Language Models' Capabilities in Geospatial Data Requirements Elicitation for Geo-Analytic Tasks
comment: Presented as an Oral Presentation Paper at GeoAI 2026, Ghent, Belgium. Also available on Zenodo
summary: Large language models are becoming central to GeoAI systems, yet their evaluation rarely considers the elicitation of geospatial data requirements. This omission is critical as retrieval oriented geo-analytic tasks cannot be supported reliably without first identifying the necessary datasets and constraints. GeoFitBench-LLM is introduced as a benchmark for assessing whether LLMs can infer the datasets, the supporting resources and the constraints required by geo-analytic requests in natural language. The benchmark is structured around two reasoning dimensions, Spatio-Temporal Relational and Semantic Grounding, reflecting long-standing challenges in geospatial information retrieval and related natural language tasks. Ground truth requirements are encoded in a fixed, provider-independent schema for reproducible evaluation of resource identification and attribute-level specification. Experiments on seven models under minimal prompting indicate that identifying the necessary resources is often achievable, with GPT-5.4 Thinking achieving the best result by recovering the complete set of resources in 66.67% of benchmark requests. Results further indicate that accurate fitness-for-use specification remains more difficult as inferential demands increase.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 GeoFitBench-LLM，一个评估大语言模型能否从自然语言地理分析请求中推断所需数据集、支撑资源与约束条件的基准，基于时空关系推理与语义锚定两个维度，采用与提供方无关的固定模式编码标准答案，并在七个模型上评测。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正成为 GeoAI 系统的核心，但现有评测很少考察其对地理空间数据需求的启发能力；若不能先识别必要数据集与约束，面向检索的地理分析任务无法可靠完成。
AI.method: 构建 GeoFitBench-LLM 基准，围绕两个推理维度（时空关系推理、语义锚定）设计任务，标准需求以固定的、与数据提供方无关的模式编码，用于可复现地评估资源识别与属性级规格；在最小提示条件下对七个模型进行实验。
AI.result: 七个模型在最小提示下，识别必要资源通常可实现，GPT-5.4 Thinking 表现最佳，在 66.67% 的基准请求中找回了完整资源集合；随着推理需求增加，准确的适用性规格说明仍然更困难。
AI.conclusion: GeoFitBench-LLM 填补了地理空间数据需求启发评测的空白，表明资源识别相对可行而适用性规格推断仍是瓶颈，为后续 GeoAI 中 LLM 能力提升提供了可复现的评测框架。

title: WoodBR-Cross: A public wood-image dataset and individual-tree-disjoint benchmark for species identification
summary: Wood-image benchmarks can yield optimistic estimates when images from the same tree occur in both training and test sets. WoodBR-Cross contains 4,875 transverse-surface images in 38 operational taxonomic classes, linked to 303 distinct trees identified by numeric catalogue witness codes (codigos-testemunho) in the Brazilian Forest Service collection. A species-level subset comprises 3,406 images, 20 classes and 214 trees. Three tasks compare duplicate-aware image partitions for all classes (A), image partitions for the species subset (B1), and individual-tree-disjoint partitions for that subset (B2). In B2, all images from each tree are kept together, so no tree is shared across training, validation or test within a fold. ResNet-50, ConvNeXt-Tiny and ViT-B/16 were evaluated with three outer folds, internal validation and five training seeds. Handcrafted and frozen-feature baselines complement border-only and randomized-label controls. Validation-selected ConvNeXt-Tiny achieved B2 tree-level macro-F1 of 0.8621 +/- 0.0317; frozen DINOv2 features yielded 0.9000 +/- 0.0722. Values are means and standard deviations across three seed-averaged fold means. Results estimate performance on previously unseen trees from this collection.

AI.tldr: 提出WoodBR-Cross基准，通过树级不相交划分避免同株重复导致的乐观估计，评估CNN与ViT在巴西木材横截面图像上的识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有木材图像基准若同一棵树的图像同时出现在训练集与测试集中，会产生过于乐观的性能估计，缺乏可靠的跨树泛化评估。
AI.method: 构建WoodBR-Cross数据集，含4,875张横截面图像、38个分类单元，关联巴西林务局收藏中303棵由编号凭证码标识的树；物种级子集含3,406张图像、20类、214棵树。设计三种任务：A为全类的重复感知图像划分，B1为子集的图像划分，B2为子集的单树不相交划分（同株图像全部保留在同一划分，折内无树跨训练/验证/测试）。评估ResNet-50、ConvNeXt-Tiny与ViT-B/16，采用三折外部折、内部验证与五个训练随机种子，并加入手工特征与冻结特征基线及仅边界和随机标签对照。
AI.result: 验证集选择的ConvNeXt-Tiny在B2任务上达到树级宏F1为0.8621±0.0317；冻结DINOv2特征取得0.9000±0.0722，数值为三个种子平均折均值的均值与标准差。
AI.conclusion: B2划分下的结果可估计模型对该收藏中未见树的识别性能，为木材图像分类提供更严格的跨树泛化基准。

title: Fin_Agent at FinEval 2026: Task-Aware Methods for Multilingual Financial NLP
comment: 5 pages, 1 Figure, FinEval 2026: Multilingual Financial Language Understanding, Co-located with EMNLP WORKSHOP, OCT 28 2026, BUDAPEST, HUNGARY
summary: We present Fin_Agent, our submission to the FinEval 2026 shared task on multilingual fi nancial language understanding. Our sys tems address Greek financial named-entity recognition, Japanese implicit communication recognition, and multilingual financial ques tion answering. For Greek NER, we com bine annotation-aware numeric rules with zero shot Qwen2.5-32B classification, achieving 0.9521 public F1 and 0.8884 private F1. For Japanese implicit communication, an inter pretable cue-based ordinal scorer achieves 98.0% test accuracy. For multilingual financial QA, BGE-M3retrieval with Qwen3-32B gen eration achieves 0.3023 and 0.3419 ROUGE-1 F1 on the public and private splits. Key limita tions include dataset-specific rules, handcrafted cues, and limited supervision. Implementa tion code is available https://github.com/ Rashidnira/finagent-fineval-2026.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 Fin_Agent 系统，参与 FinEval 2026 多语言金融语言理解共享任务，涵盖希腊语金融命名实体识别、日语隐含通信识别和多语言金融问答三个子任务。
AI.motivation: 面向 FinEval 2026 共享任务，构建多语言金融语言理解系统，解决希腊语 NER、日语隐含通信识别与多语言金融问答三类任务。
AI.method: 希腊语 NER 采用标注感知数值规则与零样本 Qwen2.5-32B 分类相结合；日语隐含通信识别采用可解释的线索驱动的序数评分器；多语言金融问答采用 BGE-M3 检索配合 Qwen3-32B 生成。
AI.result: 希腊语 NER 公开/私有 F1 分别为 0.9521 和 0.8884；日语隐含通信测试准确率 98.0%；多语言金融问答公开/私有 ROUGE-1 F1 分别为 0.3023 和 0.3419。
AI.conclusion: 系统在三项子任务上取得较好效果，但存在依赖数据集特定规则、手工设计线索以及监督数据有限等局限，代码已开源。

title: Activating the Annotator: Operationalising Lived Experience in Data Annotation
summary: Perspectivist NLP has established that annotator positionality shapes labels for subjective tasks, but the field still lacks methods for operationalising it. Positionality is typically operationalised as a demographic form completed at recruitment: a static attribute recorded once and treated as a covariate, on the assumption that the knowledge it indexes is active when the annotator reads an item. This paper treats that assumption as a design problem and asks whether lived experience can instead be primed by the task itself. We introduce AXLE, a pre-annotation stage in which a scenario vignette anchors a short, axis-guided conversation that is synthesised into a first-person micro-narrative and returned to the annotator before labelling begins. In a 2x2 between-subjects study (104 annotators, 30 items, 1,040 annotations) on ambiguous hate speech spanning immigration, religion and gender, elicitation was associated with higher identity resonance and higher sensitivity to harm. It also increased label entropy and lowered inter-annotator agreement: the stage appears to surface plurality rather than manufacture consensus, which distinguishes it from annotator training, whose success criterion is convergence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AXLE 预标注阶段，用情景小故事引导轴向导对话并合成第一人称微叙事，以激活标注者的生活经验；2x2 实验（104 人、30 项、1,040 条标注）表明该阶段提升身份共鸣与伤害敏感度，同时提高标签熵、降低标注者间一致性。
AI.motivation: 视角主义 NLP 已确认标注者立场会塑造主观任务标签，但缺乏可操作化方法。现有做法将立场视为招募时填写的静态人口学属性，作为协变量使用，并预设其所索引的知识在标注者阅读条目时处于激活状态。本文把这一假设当作设计问题，追问生活经验能否由任务本身启动。
AI.method: 引入 AXLE——一个预标注阶段：以情景小故事（scenario vignette）锚定一段简短的、轴向导的对话，将其合成为第一人称微叙事，并在标注开始前返回给标注者。在涉及移民、宗教与性别的模糊仇恨言论上开展 2x2 被试间研究（104 名标注者、30 个条目、1,040 条标注）。
AI.result: 启发式启动与更高的身份共鸣和更高的伤害敏感度相关；同时标签熵上升、标注者间一致性下降。
AI.conclusion: 该阶段似乎显现的是多元性而非制造共识，这与以收敛为成功标准的标注者培训形成区别。

title: Bridging Human and Model Attention: Explainability Analysis of CNN, Mamba, and ViT Architectures with Gaze-Based Validation
comment: Submitted to Image and Vision Computing
summary: High-risk applications of deep learning require precise characterization of model decision-making. We conduct a systematic explainability evaluation across Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Vision Transformers (ViTs), and Vision Mamba (ViM). Unlike predominantly qualitative studies, we quantify the alignment between model attention and human visual perception using eye-tracking ground truth. We formalize this comparison via a standardized normalization pipeline mapping post-hoc attribution maps and gaze heatmaps onto spatial probability distributions. Alignment is evaluated across fine-grained classification, medical imaging, and emotion recognition using architecture-specific XAI methods. We measure fidelity using Jensen-Shannon similarity, Chi-square similarity, and Pearson correlation, three complementary estimators capturing support overlap, mass discrepancy, and structural co-variation. Our results reveal distinct attention dynamics: CNNs tend to exhibit a more global focus, with spatially more diffuse saliency maps that correlate well with human perception in general contexts, while ViTs demonstrate fine-grained, patch-level attention, often focused on discriminative microfeatures. The Mamba architecture shows biased behavior: it achieves strong explainability in medical tasks but exhibits divergent intensity distributions in natural images; our analytical characterization of the metrics makes this dissociation explicit, since near-unit support overlap is attained simultaneously with a vanishing linear correlation. We further analyze the effect of backbone freezing and ensemble strategies on model interpretability. The results highlight how architectural and training choices influence the alignment between model saliency and human visual attention.

AI.tldr: 系统评估CNN、ViT、ViM三种架构的可解释性,用眼动数据量化模型注意力与人类视觉感知的对齐度。
AI.motivation: 高风险深度学习应用需要精确刻画模型决策过程,而现有研究多为定性分析,缺乏模型注意力与人类视觉感知之间对齐程度的定量评估。
AI.method: 构建标准化归一化流程,将事后归因图与注视热图映射为空间概率分布;在细粒度分类、医学影像、情感识别任务上,采用各架构专属XAI方法;用Jensen-Shannon相似度、卡方相似度和皮尔逊相关三个互补指标衡量保真度,并分析骨干冻结与集成策略的影响。
AI.result: CNN呈现更全局、空间更弥散的显著图,在通用场景中与人类感知相关性良好;ViT表现出细粒度、patch级注意力,常聚焦于判别性微特征;ViM行为存在偏差,在医学任务中可解释性强,但在自然图像中强度分布发散,出现近乎单位的支撑重叠与趋零线性相关同时存在的解离现象。
AI.conclusion: 架构与训练选择会显著影响模型显著性与人类视觉注意力的对齐程度,该研究为可解释性评估提供了定量化的标准化框架。

title: RePrior: Measurement-Reconciled Prior Correction for Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction
summary: Sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is severely under-constrained by limited X-ray projections. Learned reconstruction can provide complementary anatomical information, but using it as a prior in patient-specific Gaussian reconstruction introduces two challenges. First, the discrepancy between the learned prior and current reconstruction is spatially non-uniform: some local differences contain useful missing 3D information, whereas others reflect prior bias. Second, even a volumetrically beneficial correction can conflict with the observed X-ray measurements. Since X-ray measurements are line integrals, spatially separated corrections may affect overlapping rays, with their signed projection responses reinforcing or partially canceling in the measurement residual, so their feasibility cannot always be assessed independently. In this paper, we introduce RePrior, a multi-stage progressive prior-correction framework that addresses correction actionability, measurement feasibility, and representation expressivity. Selective Correction Proposal (SCP) first identifies actionable signed local corrections from prior--reconstruction discrepancies. Measurement-Constrained Reconciliation (MCR) then jointly enforces their consistency with patient-specific X-ray measurements, while Hybrid Residual Enhancement (HRE) recovers additional correction capacity through complementary voxel- and Gaussian-domain degrees of freedom around the reconciled anchor. RePrior requires neither test-time ground truth nor case-specific network fine-tuning. RePrior gains approximately 2.6~dB in 3D PSNR over R$^2$-Gaussian across LUNA16, PANORAMA, and PENGWIN. Beyond prior-assisted reconstruction, it delivers additional gains in volumetric quality and observed-view projection fidelity, with consistent gains in held-out-view fidelity in the backbone-matched evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RePrior，一个多阶段渐进式先验校正框架，用于稀疏视图锥束CT重建。框架包含选择性校正提议、测量约束调和与混合残差增强三个模块，无需测试时真值或个案微调，在多个数据集上3D PSNR约提升2.6 dB。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视图CBCT因X射线投影有限而严重欠约束。学习式重建可提供互补解剖信息，但将其作为先验引入患者特异性高斯重建存在两大挑战：一是先验与当前重建的差异在空间上非均匀，部分局部差异含有效缺失3D信息，部分反映先验偏差；二是即使体素上有益的校正也可能与观测X射线测量冲突，因X射线为线积分，空间分离的校正可能影响重叠射线，其带符号投影响应在测量残差中相互增强或抵消，故可行性无法独立评估。
AI.method: RePrior为多阶段渐进式先验校正框架，解决校正可操作性、测量可行性与表示表达能力三问题。选择性校正提议（SCP）先从先验-重建差异中识别可操作的带符号局部校正；测量约束调和（MCR）联合强制其与患者特异性X射线测量一致；混合残差增强（HRE）通过体素域与高斯域的互补自由度，在调和锚点周围恢复额外校正能力。该方法无需测试时真值，也无需个案网络微调。
AI.result: 在LUNA16、PANORAMA和PENGWIN数据集上，RePrior相较R²-Gaussian的3D PSNR约提升2.6 dB；除先验辅助重建外，在体数据质量与观测视图投影保真度上均有额外增益，在骨干匹配评估中于留出视图保真度上取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: RePrior通过多阶段渐进式先验校正，有效解决了稀疏视图CBCT中先验差异非均匀与测量可行性耦合的问题，在无需真值和微调的条件下显著提升重建质量与投影保真度，且在不同骨干网络下表现一致。

title: Unsupervised Multimodal Reward Modeling
summary: Vision-language reward models are trained on annotated preference pairs, which are expensive to collect, can disagree, and are ranked by benchmark accuracy. We build one with no human preference label: a linear head on an intermediate layer of a frozen Qwen3-VL backbone, trained to score a web caption above a perturbed version of the same caption; labeled data enters only to select the layer. The layer is the decisive choice, worth 5.8 points over the last layer, and one recipe transferred without re-tuning beats or at least matches GPT-4o on three benchmarks at 32B, 6.6 points ahead on VL-RewardBench, from a few thousand parameters at about a thousandth of fine-tuning compute. At an equal pair budget, perturbations teach a frozen head 3 to 5 points more than curated RLAIF-V pairs. Because the backbone is frozen, the objective is convex, and the perturbation sampler specifies the reward, which the benchmark does not identify: two heads trained on disjoint halves of the same perturbations tie on the benchmark and differ by 6.4 points in hallucination judging. Retraining the head on the policy's own verifier-labeled candidates cuts caption hallucination by 5.1 CHAIR points and lifts image-generation pass rate by 5.4, while scoring lower on every reward benchmark. Together, an intermediate-layer probe, free same-image perturbations, and a verifier-driven bootstrap turn give a recipe for multimodal reward modeling that needs no annotator, costs a fraction of fine-tuning, and is specified by the comparisons it is trained on rather than by a benchmark rank.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无需人工偏好标注的多模态奖励建模方法：在冻结的Qwen3-VL骨干中间层上训练线性头，用同图扰动生成偏好对，标注数据仅用于选层。该方案以极少参数和约千分之一微调算力，在多个基准上媲美或超越GPT-4o。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言奖励模型依赖昂贵的人工偏好标注，标注间存在分歧，且以基准准确率作为排名目标，导致奖励信号被基准而非真实比较所定义。作者希望构建一种无需人工偏好标签、成本低、且由训练比较本身而非基准排名所定义的奖励模型。
AI.method: 在冻结的Qwen3-VL骨干中间层上加线性头，训练其将网络caption打分高于同图扰动版本；标注数据仅用于选择层。扰动采样器定义奖励，因骨干冻结使目标为凸问题。进一步用策略自身、经verifier标注的候选重训该头进行引导式自举。
AI.result: 选层是关键，比最后一层高5.8分；单一配方无需重调即在32B规模上于三个基准上打平或超越GPT-4o，在VL-RewardBench上领先6.6分，仅用几千参数和约千分之一微调算力。相同对预算下，扰动比精选RLAIF-V对多教出3–5分。两个在不相交扰动半集上训练的头在基准上打平，但在幻觉评判上差6.4分。用verifier标注候选重训后，caption幻觉降5.1 CHAIR分，图像生成通过率升5.4，但在所有奖励基准上得分更低。
AI.conclusion: 中间层探针、免费的同图扰动与verifier驱动自举共同构成了无需标注者、成本远低于微调、且由训练比较而非基准排名所指定的多模态奖励建模配方。

title: Zebra3D: Efficient Hybrid Foundation Models For Scalable 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct scenes from unposed images, but the quadratic cost of global attention limits their scalability to large view sets. We present Zebra3D, a layerwise sparse-linear hybrid attention framework that improves the efficiency of pretrained 3D foundation models without training from scratch. Across VGGT, HunyuanWorld-Mirror, and $π^3$, we observe a broadly consistent depth-wise pattern: early stages are relatively tolerant to linear replacement, while sensitive middle-to-late stages tend to exhibit more concentrated attention. Zebra3D exploits this structure by assigning linear-centered attention to tolerant stages and tile-sparse attention to sensitive stages, using landmark summaries to preserve unselected context. Closed-form affine fitting enables training-free conversion, while optional post-conversion training combines task supervision with output and relational feature distillation. Across all three backbones, Zebra3D achieves strong reconstruction and camera-pose accuracy at high attention sparsity, with training-free variants remaining close to their dense counterparts. End-to-end speedups increase with input view count, reaching up to $7.1\times$ at 1,024 views. After post-conversion training, Zebra3D-VGGT reaches 80.5\% RealEstate10K AUC@30 at 94\% mean attention sparsity, within 1.1 percentage points of dense VGGT fine-tuned on the same data and schedule.

AI.tldr: Zebra3D 提出分层稀疏-线性混合注意力框架，将预训练前馈三维基础模型高效转换，实现高稀疏度下的高精度重建与位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 前馈三维基础模型依赖全局注意力，其二次复杂度限制了在大规模视图集上的可扩展性，且从头训练成本高昂。
AI.method: 观察到 VGGT、HunyuanWorld-Mirror、π³ 存在一致的深度分层模式：浅层对线性替换容忍度高，中后层注意力集中。据此对容忍层用线性中心注意力、敏感层用分块稀疏注意力，并以 landmark 摘要保留未选上下文；通过闭式仿射拟合实现免训练转换，可选后训练结合任务监督与输出、关系特征蒸馏。
AI.result: 三种骨干在高度稀疏下均保持强重建与相机位姿精度，免训练版接近稠密模型；端到端加速随视图数增长，1,024 视图达 7.1×。后训练 Zebra3D-VGGT 在 94% 平均注意力稀疏度下 RealEstate10K AUC@30 达 80.5%，仅比同等数据与schedule微调的稠密 VGGT 低 1.1 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Zebra3D 以分层分辨率自适应注意力有效提升三维基础模型效率，兼顾精度与可扩展性，无需从头训练。

title: StereoEngine: Scaling Stereo Bimanual Robot Data without Stereo Cameras
summary: Stereo vision is increasingly used for robotic manipulation, with a growing body of work incorporating it into Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, the scarcity of large-scale, real-world stereo datasets remains a fundamental bottleneck for scaling such policies. Recent generative monocular-to-stereo methods target settings such as VR content and autonomous driving. No prior work produces realistic synthetic stereo data for robotic manipulation, where stereo supervision has come predominantly from simulation. We propose StereoEngine, which introduces two complementary methods to synthesize stereo data for robotic manipulation. In the first, we warp a monocular (left) video into the right view using estimated depth and inpaint the disoccluded regions with a video diffusion model, lifting monocular demonstrations into stereo pairs without training on real stereo. In the second, we render a stereo pair in simulation and jointly generate both photorealistic views, producing consistent left-right data without any real video as input. StereoEngine outperforms existing baselines in generated stereo quality, and using its synthetic data for policy mid-training or task-specific fine-tuning substantially improves downstream bimanual manipulation. Project website: https://stereoengine.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出 StereoEngine，用两种互补方法为机器人操作合成逼真立体数据，缓解真实立体数据集稀缺问题，并提升双臂操作策略性能。
AI.motivation: 立体视觉在机器人操作与 VLA 模型中日益重要，但大规模真实立体数据集稀缺，成为扩展此类策略的根本瓶颈。现有单目转立体生成方法主要面向 VR 内容和自动驾驶，尚无工作为机器人操作生成逼真合成立体数据，该领域立体监督主要依赖仿真。
AI.method: StereoEngine 提出两条互补路径：其一，用估计深度将单目（左）视频变形为右视图，并用视频扩散模型修复遮挡显露区域，从而在无需真实立体训练的情况下将单目演示提升为立体对；其二，在仿真中渲染立体对，并联合生成两幅照片级真实视图，在无需任何真实视频输入的条件下生成左右一致的数据。
AI.result: StereoEngine 生成的立体质量优于现有基线；将其合成数据用于策略中期训练或任务特定微调，可显著提升下游双臂操作性能。
AI.conclusion: StereoEngine 为机器人操作提供了可行的合成立体数据方案，既可将单目数据升维为立体对，也可从仿真生成逼真立体对，验证了合成立体数据在提升双臂操作策略上的有效性。项目网站：https://stereoengine.github.io

title: Reference-Free Food Volume Estimation from Egocentric Stereo Video
summary: Current stereo vision-based approaches for food portion estimation are hindered by the user burden of using a mobile phone to capture multiple images or placing a reference object in the scene for scale calibration. As a step towards passive dietary intake monitoring, we introduce a method that uses stereo video from a wearable egocentric device to reconstruct food items in true physical scale to accurately estimate volume. By utilizing FoundationStereo for zero-shot stereo matching, SAM 2 for food segmentation, and TSDF fusion over a set of keyframes, our method yields a visually and metrically accurate 3D mesh of any plated food item from a single stereo recording. We leverage the unique offerings of wearables, such as a factory-calibrated stereo baseline and camera poses estimated on-device via visual-inertial odometry (VIO), to perform fully automatic reconstruction without a scale reference object in the scene. We show strong initial volume estimation results across five recorded food items, achieving a mean absolute percentage error of 9.1%.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于可穿戴立体相机的无标定食物三维重建与体积估计方法，利用FoundationStereo、SAM 2与TSDF融合，平均绝对百分比误差为9.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于立体视觉的食物体积估计依赖用户用手机拍摄多张图像或在场景中放置参照物进行尺度标定，操作负担重，难以满足被动式膳食摄入监测的需求。
AI.method: 采用可穿戴第一视角设备的立体视频：使用FoundationStereo进行零样本立体匹配，SAM 2进行食物分割，并对一组关键帧进行TSDF融合，重建出真实物理尺度的食物三维网格；借助可穿戴设备出厂标定的立体基线和基于视觉惯性里程计（VIO）估计的相机位姿，实现无需场景参照物的全自动重建。
AI.result: 在五种记录食物上取得较强的初步体积估计结果，平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为9.1%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法仅需单次立体录制即可自动获得视觉与度量上均准确的食物三维重建，为被动式膳食摄入监测提供了可行路径。

title: Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlases for Amortized Conditional Interpretability
summary: Gradient-based attribution provides input-specific information about model parameters, but computing it via backpropagation for many samples is expensive, while static importance scores discard input dependence. We derive KPSA (Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlas) from a block decomposition of the empirical neural tangent kernel. It measures normalized parameter-group sensitivity, embeds those sources in an explicit query space, and uses a lightweight kernel to estimate sensitivities for unseen inputs. We derive bounds that separate finite-source from irreducible representation error and give margin-based top-$k$ recovery. This paper studies two interpretability applications. Firstly, KPSA identifies parameter groups with high susceptibility to perturbations across vision, forecasting, and protein-modeling setups. Across a fivefold range of parameter budgets ($0.02$-$0.1\%$), its selected groups attain $39$-$85\%$ of the perturbation susceptibility of a first-order backpropagation oracle. In vision and forecasting, these parameter groups form sparse sensitivity circuits that extend across depth and vary systematically with the input. Secondly, we use KPSA on an activation-attribution problem for MLP features in transformers. It retains $81\%$ of the gap between a backpropagation oracle and a constant-sensitivity baseline on vision while increasing batched query-time throughput from 551 to 2,041 images/s and reducing peak GPU memory from 4.55 to 0.44GB. On the protein-modeling task, it recovers $68\%$ of this gap. An ablation of KPSA's kernel aggregation shows that nearest-neighbor retrieval in KPSA space can remain competitive. The empirics show that compact kernel atlases can store useful input-dependent parameter sensitivity while amortizing repeated gradient attribution, a step toward scalable conditional interpretability. Code can be found at https://github.com/Axym-Labs/kpsa .

AI.tldr: 该论文提出KPSA（核化参数敏感度图谱），从经验神经正切核的块分解出发，度量归一化的参数组敏感度，并将其嵌入显式查询空间，用轻量核估计未见输入的敏感度，从而实现可扩展的条件可解释性。
AI.motivation: 基于梯度的归因能提供输入相关的模型参数信息，但对多样本反向传播计算成本高昂；而静态重要性分数又丢弃了输入依赖性。因此需要一个既能保留输入依赖、又能摊销重复梯度计算成本的方法。
AI.method: 从经验神经正切核的块分解推导KPSA，度量归一化参数组敏感度，将敏感度来源嵌入显式查询空间，并用轻量核为未见输入估计敏感度。理论上给出区分有限源误差与不可约表示误差的界，并给出基于间隔的top-k恢复保证。应用于两个可解释性任务：参数组敏感度识别与transformer中MLP特征的激活归因。
AI.result: 在视觉、预测和蛋白质建模任务中，KPSA在0.02%-0.1%（五倍范围）参数预算下，所选参数组达到一阶反向传播oracle扰动敏感度的39%-85%；视觉与预测任务中这些参数组形成跨越深度的稀疏敏感电路并随输入系统性变化。在transformer MLP激活归因任务上，视觉任务保留oracle与常敏感度基线差距的81%，批量查询吞吐从551提升到2041 images/s，峰值GPU内存从4.55GB降至0.44GB；蛋白质任务恢复该差距的68%。核聚合消融显示KPSA空间中的最近邻检索仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的核图谱能够存储有用的输入依赖参数敏感度，同时摊销重复的梯度归因计算，是迈向可扩展条件可解释性的一步。

title: U4RASD at KnowledgeGraphEval-2026: Ontology-Constrained Encoder and LLM Systems for Arabic Relation Extraction
comment: 20 pages. System description paper for the KnowledgeGraphEval 2026 Shared Task at ArabicNLP 2026
summary: This paper details our submission to KnowledgeGraphEval 2026 Subtask 2 on directed Arabic relation extraction. We explored encoder-based and large language model approaches for predicting one of 40 relations or no_relation from an Arabic sentence and a subject-object pair. Our encoder systems use typed entity markers and separate relation-existence and relation-classification heads, while our LLM systems fine-tune Yehia and Qwen3.5 with QLoRA and ontology-constrained prediction. Our best system, an ensemble of Yehia-RE, Qwen-RE, and TypedPair, achieved a micro-F1 score of 94.06 and ranked 1st in Subtask 2. Yehia-RE (full-vocabulary) achieved 92.98, while the best encoder and Qwen-RE achieved 92.69 and 91.94 respectively. Our results highlight the importance of constrained prediction and complementary modeling approaches for Arabic relation extraction.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 KnowledgeGraphEval 2026 Subtask 2（阿拉伯语有向关系抽取）的参赛系统，融合编码器与 LLM 方案，最佳集成模型 micro-F1 达 94.06，排名第一。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语有向关系抽取任务具有语言与本体复杂性，需探索编码器与 LLM 两类方法，并验证受限预测与互补建模的有效性。
AI.method: 编码器系统采用类型化实体标记（typed entity markers），并设置关系存在性与关系分类双头；LLM 系统对 Yehia 和 Qwen3.5 进行 QLoRA 微调，并施加本体约束预测。最终将 Yehia-RE、Qwen-RE 与 TypedPair 集成。
AI.result: 最佳集成系统 micro-F1 为 94.06，位列 Subtask 2 第 1；Yehia-RE（全词表）为 92.98，最佳编码器为 92.69，Qwen-RE 为 91.94。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，约束预测与互补建模策略对阿拉伯语关系抽取性能提升至关重要。

title: MADS: Multi-Agent Dialog Simulation for Robust Conversational Agents
summary: Task-oriented conversational agents remain fragile under realistic conditions, especially when users exhibit non-cooperative behavior. Existing function-calling benchmarks underrepresent adversarial conversation trajectories, thereby limiting the training resources available for developing robust agents. We present MADS (Multi-Agent Dialog Simulation), a synthetic data generation pipeline that produces structured, diverse dialogue trajectories. We inject adversarial conversation, producing validated conversation trajectories that capture realistic, unhappy paths. Using MADS, we construct MADS-Bench: a benchmark spanning six domains, 55 personas, and 1095 conversations, with approximately 66% of conversations containing failure-prone conversation scenarios. We evaluate the robustness of the trained models using a two-stage training approach that combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR).

AI.tldr: 提出MADS多智能体对话模拟数据生成管线，注入对抗性对话生成"不顺利路径"轨迹，构建涵盖6领域、55人格、1095对话（约66%含易失败场景）的MADS-Bench基准，并采用SFT+RLVR两阶段训练评估模型鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 任务导向对话智能体在真实场景中表现脆弱，尤其面对用户非合作行为时。现有函数调用基准对对抗性对话轨迹覆盖不足，导致缺乏训练鲁棒智能体的资源。
AI.method: MADS（Multi-Agent Dialog Simulation）合成数据生成管线：产出结构化、多样化的对话轨迹，并注入对抗性对话，生成经校验的、捕捉真实"不顺利路径"的对话轨迹。基于MADS构建MADS-Bench基准。模型评估采用SFT与带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）相结合的两阶段训练方法。
AI.result: MADS-Bench覆盖6个领域、55种人格、1095段对话，其中约66%的对话包含易引发失败的对话场景；该基准用于评估经两阶段训练模型的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MADS与MADS-Bench为对抗性、非合作用户场景下的对话智能体鲁棒性研究与训练提供了数据与评测基础，SFT+RLVR两阶段训练作为鲁棒性评估途径。

title: DistressBench: Evaluating Multi-Dimensional Crisis Support in Large Language Models
summary: Language models have been adopted faster than evaluation practices that reliably assess their risks, and a growing share of use is affective rather than informational. Within that traffic users disclose suicide and self-harm (SSH) crises. Existing safety benchmarks score models primarily on refusal, but refusal is not the desired behavior here; the conversation requires a substantive supportive response. We introduce DistressBench, 718 English conversations with clinician-authored user turns spanning 23 SSH subcategories, each paired with a task-specific rubric of weighted atomic criteria across seven dimensions of crisis support and a clinician reference response. A model's score is the weighted average over the criteria its reply satisfies, reading directly as the fraction of required care delivered. The best of 25 frontier models satisfies 88.4% of weighted criteria and the median model 71.4%, against 98.7% for clinician references scored on the same criteria. Pooled across all 25 models, in 35.3% of conversations where a model satisfied every criterion for recognizing the crisis, it failed to route the user toward human help. The shortfall concentrates in the dimensions requiring the model to act rather than withhold. Contrasting each dimension's median model against its best separates capability limits from choices: de-escalation reaches 74.6% in the strongest model against a median of 46.0%, and safety disclaimers 84.6% against 8.3%. Multi-turn conversations score below single-turn ones (68.5% against 74.2%). We release the corpus, rubrics, judge calibration labels, and a companion annex of 20 long-horizon red-team transcripts. These results argue for evaluating crisis safety on the care a model delivers rather than on what it declines to say, and for treating de-escalation and resource routing as deployment requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DistressBench，一个包含 718 段英语对话、覆盖 23 个自杀与自伤（SSH）子类别的危机支持评测基准，以临床医生撰写的用户话轮、加权原子标准评分卡和医生参考回复为核心，将模型得分定义为"实际交付所需关怀的比例"，而非拒答率。结果显示最强模型满足 88.4% 的加权标准，中位模型 71.4%，医生参考为 98.7%；且在最能识别危机的对话中仍有 35.3% 未能将用户导向人类求助。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的部署速度远超风险评估实践，且越来越多的使用场景是情感性而非信息性的。这类流量中包含用户披露自杀与自伤危机，而现有安全基准主要以"拒答"为评分标准——但拒答并非此处期望的行为，用户需要的是实质性的支持性回应。因此需要一套以"模型实际提供的关怀"为核心的评测框架。
AI.method: 构建 DistressBench：718 段英语对话，用户话轮由临床医生撰写，覆盖 23 个 SSH 子类别；每段对话配有一个任务特定的评分卡，由跨七个危机支持维度的加权原子标准组成，并附有临床医生参考回复。模型得分即为其回复所满足标准的加权平均值，可直接解读为"交付所需关怀的比例"。评测了 25 个前沿模型，并对评分者进行了校准标注。
AI.result: 25 个前沿模型中最佳者满足 88.4% 的加权标准，中位模型为 71.4%，而医生参考在同一标准下为 98.7%。汇总全部 25 个模型，在模型满足"识别危机"所有标准的对话中，仍有 35.3% 未能将用户导向人类求助。短板集中在要求模型"行动"而非"沉默"的维度上：去升级（de-escalation）最强模型达 74.6%，中位仅 46.0%；安全免责声明为 84.6% 对 8.3%。多轮对话得分低于单轮（68.5% 对 74.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果主张：危机安全评测应基于模型"交付的关怀"而非"拒绝言说的内容"，并应将去升级与资源转介视为部署的必要条件。作者发布了语料库、评分卡、评分者校准标签，以及包含 20 段长时程红队对话的配套附录。

title: REDaCT: Collapse-Free Unlearning in Large Reasoning Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 19 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Copyright 2026 Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL). Licensed under CC BY 4.0
summary: Unlearning in large reasoning models (LRMs) requires removing forget-set information from both the reasoning trace and the final answer. Existing approaches achieve this objective at the cost of reasoning collapse, where the model fails to produce a coherent chain-of-thought (CoT) and does not properly terminate its reasoning process.
